chapters.title: Chapter 4201: North Heavenly Realm Buddha Son
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
The Venerate Tier elites had arrived, so they were naturally treated with the highest level of respect. They were respectfully invited to stay in the highest level Divine Temple here.

Ling Han and Wide Clouds Heaven naturally moved in as well. Sandalwood was lit here, and it was made from the highest grade material. It could interact with heaven and earth, allowing one to more easily sense Regulations of heaven and earth.
After staying here for two days, the North and South Heavenly Realm’s Buddha Sons and Holy Daughters had all arrived, and the spar officially began.

On the surface, this was a sparring match, but in truth, it was a ranking competition for the branches of the Buddhist Race of the four great Heavenly Realms. And like the overall strength of the four great Heavenly Realms, it has always been the South Heavenly Realm that ranked first, while the North Heavenly Realm ranked last.
Ling Han and Wide Clouds Heaven were invited to the venue of the tournament. Meanwhile, Yunshu Bodhisattva did not go with them, but he probably would still watch the tournament.
Not long after, Buddha Sons and Holy Daughters from the four Heavenly Realms all gathered together.
Among these three men and three women, Ling Han only recognized one person, and that was Prosperous Heaven, the Holy Daughter of North Heavenly Realm.

A woman’s instincts were really sensitive. Though Ling Han’s appearance had changed greatly, and even the fluctuation in his soul was completely different, Prosperous Heaven still looked at him a few times, a hint of confusion in her eyes.
Ling Han feigned ignorance, and turned his attention to the other three men and two women.

The newly promoted Buddha Son of the North Heavenly Realm was a young man with dishevelled black hair, with a slightly sloppy aura. It was clear that his flame of life was raging fiercely, and he was extremely young, but there was a hint of age in his eyes, which formed a strong contrast.
Ling Han took another look at this person, and for some reason, a powerful feeling rose up in his heart. It could not be said whether it was animosity or appreciation for his talent.
He was bestowed the name of Shi Tianyun.
Tianyun?
Hehe, the North Heavenly Realm had high hopes for him1.

Looking again at the East Heavenly Realm, the Buddha Son and the Holy Daughter were still the same. The Buddha Son was Shi Tianwen, and the Holy Daughter was Building Heaven. Finally, the strongest was the South Heavenly Realm. Their Buddha Son was Shi Moka and their Holy Daughter was Black Sand Heaven.

Unlike Buddha Son, who was bestowed a name, Holy Daughter’s name was inherited. For example, if a misfortune befell Prosperous Heaven, the succeeding Holy Daughter would also be known as Prosperous Heaven.
“Hehe, what a joke. The weakest North Heavenly Realm dares to restart the ranking battle!” Shi Moka said calmly, his tone filled with disdain for North Heavenly Realm.

Who didn’t know that among the four Heavenly Realms, North Heavenly Realm was the weakest, whether it was in terms of overall strength or high-end battle prowess, they were at the bottom of the barrel. In the previous sparring tournament, the Buddha Son of the North Heavenly Realm had even been crippled by Shi Yongming.
Now that a new Buddha Son had appeared, did he think he could overturn the heavens?
What a joke.
Shi Tianyun smiled at him, “When we draw lots later, I hope you can draw me!”
Hiss, this was a blatant provocation.
Shi Moka’s expression darkened. This new Buddha Son from the North Heavenly Realm was a little arrogant.
“Humph, no matter who becomes my opponent, it would be the same!” he said indifferently, showing a strong confidence, “The only path for all of you would be defeat!”
Shi Tianyun merely smiled, revealing two rows of snow-white teeth.
“Draw lots!” A monk walked out, allowing the eight of them to draw lots to decide their battles.
According to the previous rankings, the West Heavenly Realm would draw first. The result was Shi Tianyun drew Jia, and Prosperous Heaven drew Zi.
Then, it was West Heavenly Realm. Ling Han drew Yi, and West Heavenly Realm drew Chou.
Then, it was the East Heavenly Realm. Shi Tianwen drew Yi, and Building Heaven drew Zi.
The result was already decided. There was no need to draw lots for South Heavenly Realm.
The battles were as follows: Ling Han against Shi Tianwen, Shi Tianyun against Shi Moka, Wide Clouds Heaven against Black Sand Heaven, Prosperous Heaven against Building Heaven.
“Not bad, not bad.” Shi Tianyun revealed a smile, “Momo, prepare to be pressed onto the ground by me!”
Shi Moka was naturally enraged. How could this brat from the North Heavenly Realm be so cheeky?
“Humph, your predecessor has just been crippled by Shi Yongming, and you want to follow in his footsteps so quickly?” he said balefully.
“Wrong, wrong, wrong. This time, I have come to sweep aside all of you,” Shi Tianyun said, smiling.
“I am very expectant,” Shi Moka said word by word. He naturally was not anticipating a battle with Shi Tianyun, but rather wanted to cripple his opponent.
The first match began, and it was precisely Shi Moka against Shi Tianyun.
“And now, you have gotten your wish,” Shi Moka said calmly, but his killing intent could not be concealed.

The competition between the four divisions of the Buddhist Race was actually more or less the same as the competition among the four great Heavenly Realms. They would fight together when facing outsiders, but when they were not facing outsiders, they were also competitors.
Shi Tianyun crooked a finger, “Come, see how I will beat you up!”
Shi Moka humphed, and charged out.
Boom, he channelled out a Saint Technique. As he shot out a punch, it turned into a golden tiger that pounced towards Shi Tianyun.
“I forgot to tell you. Last time, the Buddha Son of your North Heavenly Realm was defeated with a single strike from me,” Shi Moka said disdainfully.
The golden tiger charged over, opening its bloody mouth. Its canines were sharp, and they were formed from Regulations, so their destructive power was naturally extremely terrifying.
Shi Tianyun did not speak, and merely shot out a punch, aimed at the golden tiger.
Peng!
With a single punch, this golden tiger was instantly blasted into smithereens.
What!
Everyone was stunned. No one had expected that Shi Tianyun would actually be so powerful.
F***, was this really a cultivator from the North Heavenly Realm?
Shi Tianyun stood proudly, high-level energy still burning on his right fist, bestowing on him the incomparably terrifying might of that attack just now.

This was too inconceivable. Whether it was Shi Moka or Shi Tianyun, both of them were in the early stage of the True Self Tier. Logically speaking, this was a battle between equals, so how could Shi Tianyun be so strong?
“I am different from the previous idiot.” Shi Tianyun broke into a grin, possessing an indescribable coquettishness.

“Humph, you have only blocked a single blow from me, what is there to be so proud of!” Shi Moka felt slightly embarrassed. He had just spoken so confidently, yet the attack he had delivered was easily dispersed.
“I said I would press you to the ground and rub you against it. As a person, you cannot go back on your word!” Shi Tianyun laughed loudly, and leaped up high, charging towards Shi Moka.
Boom!
His whole body was enshrouded in Regulations, while his hands were burning with high-level energy, as if he was a god of war.
“Do you think I’m afraid of you!” Shi Moka stepped forwards.
Peng!

Shi Tianyun shot out a punch, and Shi Moka was actually no match for him. He was forcefully blasted down from the skies, and crashed heavily into the ground. Instantly, with him as the centre, the ground directly caved in.
F***, what was going on?
Everyone was dumbfounded. Just how powerful was Shi Moka? He had crushed the Buddha Sons of the other three Heavenly Realms. This was proven through successive victories.
But now? He had actually been knocked down with a single punch?
This!
It was definitely not that Shi Moka was weak, but rather that Shi Tianyun was too strong.
Hiss, where had the North Heavenly Realm found such a freak?

If it was not for the fact that this person’s appearance was too different from Ling Han’s, and the fluctuation of his soul was completely different, they would really wonder if this was Ling Han himself under diguise. It seemed like only this guy could be as powerful as this.

Even Ling Han’s eyes narrowed slightly. He had not thought that in this competition for the ranking of the four divisions, his greatest opponent was actually not Shi Moka of the South Heavenly Realm, but rather the newly promoted Buddha Son of the North Heavenly Realm.
It was clear that he was just like him, someone who had been found on the spot. He definitely wasn’t someone who had been nurtured by the Buddhist Race since childhood—this was clear from his tone.
This was what shocked Ling Han the most. He wasn’t from the Imperial Clan, yet he was still this powerful?

chapters.title: Chapter 4202: Exceeding expectations
paragraphs: Shi Moka got back to his feet. There was a trace of blood at the corner of his lips, while his face was filled with an expression of disbelief.
It wasn’t just him; almost everyone else had the same expression.

Who did not know that Shi Moka had always been number one in the competition of Buddha Sons in the four Heavenly Realms? It had not changed for more than a hundred years, but now? He was actually no match for a single punch from Shi Tianyun!
“Good! Good! Good!” he said through gritted teeth. Boom! The aura in his body boiled, and formed multiple mushroom clouds that subsequently exploded, appearing extremely terrifying.
He was truly angered now, and wanted to kill someone to vent his anger.
Meanwhile, Shi Tianyun was laidback, looking like he did not take it to heart at all.

“Die!” Shi Moka summoned his personal Spirit Tool. This was a sword, and as the sword swept out, endless Regulations condensed, turning into multiple golden swords. In that one instant, there were as many as thirty thousand swords.
“Imperial Technique, Myriad Sword Technique!” All the big shots exclaimed in shock, looking stunned.

This Imperial Technique was extremely difficult to cultivate, because it was completely the use of the Regulations of heaven and earth. At least, one had to reach the True Self Tier to be able to cultivate this Imperial Technique, but there were really not many people that could grasp it at this cultivation level in history.
As expected of Shi Moka, who had actually cultivated the Myriad Sword Technique!
Hiss, if he had not been knocked down with a single punch from Shi Tianyun, he probably would not have channelled this Imperial Technique either, right?

The limit of this Imperial Technique was condensing into 330,000 swords of Regulations, symbolizing the thirty three Heavens, possessing boundless might. It was created by Ah Han in his later years to suppress Yin soul, so its destructive power was especially terrifying. “Hehe!” Shi Tianyun merely smiled faintly, his whole body burning with high-level energy. His fists wrapped with Regulations, and directly charged into the myriad of swords.
Peng, peng, peng! He charged madly, destroying all the tens of thousands of swords. Then, with a flash, he had already appeared in front of Shi Moka.
What!
Shi Moka’s eyes widened, and his mouth also gaped widely, as if he was silently expressing his surprise. How could this opponent be strong to this extent? He had used the Imperial Technique.

He wanted to dodge and parry, but while the Imperial Technique was powerful, it was also the weakest moment after the strongest attack. The present Shi Moka was at the weakest point of his battle prowess, so how could he possibly block Shi Tianyun’s counterattack?
Peng!
It was still just a single strike, and Shi Moka was sent flying.
Pa, he sprawled out on the ground. This time, he could not get back to his feet. This?
In just two punches, Shi Moka was completely sprawled out on the ground.

That was the Buddha Son of the South Heavenly Realm. At one time, he was a symbol of invincibility, and became the nightmare of the other three Buddha Sons. Who would have thought that he would be dealt with so easily?
It was as if this was a dream.
But that was the truth. There were many pairs of eyes watching, and it was an absolute fact.
“Interesting,” Ling Han murmured, his eyes gradually lighting up.

He could easily thrash the Imperial Son. Thus, no matter how awesome Shi Moka was, he would only be a piece of cake in front of him. However, Shi Tianyun was different. He was very strong, and had even surpassed the majority of Imperial Sons.
Judging from the battle prowess he displayed, he was at least on the same level as Chi Menghan and the Imperial Son of Golden Silk Moth Clan.
Perhaps, he was even stronger, because just now, it may not have been all his abilities.

The whole area was silent. Up until now, everyone had not come back to their senses from the shock of Shi Moka’s defeat. After another while, someone finally announced Shi Tianyun’s victory, and at this moment, a round of exclamations rang out in the surroundings.
This was inconceivable. This was too inconceivable. The weakest North Heavenly Realm had actually risen up?
‘F*ck! Is this because of Ling Han? He’s inspiring the younger generation of the North Heavenly Realm.
“The next battle begins!”

Next, it was the battle between the Holy Daughters. However, even though the Buddha Son was on the same level as the Holy Daughter, it was only in name. No matter how strong the Holy Daughter was, it was useless. In the Buddhist Tribe, men were extremely favored over women, and all important positions were held by men. In fact, the Holy Daughter was unable to cultivate the highest level of techniques.
Even if they learnt an Imperial Technique like the Six Characters Bright King Curse, it was only a neutered version.
Thus, though the battle between the Holy Daughters was also very exciting, no one paid much attention to it. They just treated it as entertainment. In any case, the result would not have
any effect.
After this match, it would be the highlight again.
West Heavenly Realm Buddha Son versus East Heavenly Realm Buddha Son.
Because this was the territory of the East Heavenly Realm, when Shi Tianwen stepped forward, cheers instantly erupted in the area, cheering him on.

In everyone’s eyes, although the West Heavenly Realm had also changed their Buddha Son, the overall level of cultivation in the East Heavenly Realm had always been superior to the West Heavenly Realm so it was believed that even if it was another Buddha Son, it would be impossible to change this result.
Thus, as long as Shi Tianwen won, then even if he lost to Shi Tianyun, he could still maintain his position as second place.
“Admit defeat!” Shi Tianwen stated calmly. He wanted to conserve his power, so he could
also last a few more moves against Shi Tianyun.
-He knew himself very well. There was absolutely no way that he could be a match for Shi Tianyun, because he couldn’t even defeat Shi Moka.
Ling Han smiled faintly, “How much benefits are you giving me?”
In any case, he was only here to gather cultivation resources and Imperial Techniques. If there
were enough benefits, it was fine even if he had to give up the first place.
When these words fell, everyone’s expressions became strange.
How could anyone ask for benefits in public like this? How could anyone cheat in public like
this?

Shi Tianwen had told Ling Han to admit defeat. That was a display of confidence, but after Ling Han’s words, it had become two people bribing each other in private, deliberately manipulating the competition.
“Pei, if our Buddha Son wanted to defeat you, would we still need to bribe you?”
“Don’t be too conceited!”
“You are absolutely no match for our Buddha Son. Hurry up and admit defeat!”
“That’s right, don’t waste time!”
The Buddhist Race elites from the East Heavenly Realm called out angrily. Don’t even think of dragging our Buddha Son down with you.
Ling Han shrugged, and said, “Since the price can’t be settled, we can only fight for real.”
‘F*ck! Who’s faking a fight?!’
Shi Tianwen’s face twisted in anger. How could there be such an infuriating Buddha Son?

He hurriedly recited the Six Characters Bright King Curse in his mind to calm himself down. This was the Imperial Technique, which allowed one to see through one’s heart and mind, and immediately return to normal. However, Shi Tianwen also revealed a baleful killing intent, feeling that Ling Han was too detestable. Even if he didn’t kill him, he would have to cripple him.
“To speak glibly in front of me, this is extremely unwise,” he stated calmly.
Xiu!
Ling Han had already charged over, throwing a punch.
Just how powerful was he? Even if he had not used the Imperial Technique, his terrifying
power exploded, and he was still overwhelmingly powerful.
Shi Tianwen did not have the time to react at all, when he saw a dark fist had already shot
towards him.
How could it be so fast?
This was his only reaction. Then, before he could even raise his hand, he was sent flying with a
punch from Ling Han.
Pu, he spat out a mouthful of blood, and directly collapsed onto the ground.
All of a sudden, there was complete silence, but soon after, the Buddhist Race from the East
Heavenly Realm were angered.
“You actually launched a sneak attack!”
“How despicable and shameless!”
“This doesn’t count!”
“Disqualify him from participating!”
They called out one after another, and requested permission from the Bodhisattvas that were
seated on the high platform.
However, these Venerate Tier elites all looked at each other, their faces filled with surprise.
They could see very clearly that though Ling Han’s punch was indeed suspected to have
caught Shi Tianwen off guard, it could not conceal his strength. Even if it was another time, Shi Tianwen would definitely be outmatched. The only question was how many moves he
could last.

They just treated it as entertainment.
In any case, the result would not have
any effect.
After this match, it would be the highlight again.
West Heavenly Realm Buddha Son versus East Heavenly Realm Buddha Son.
Because this was the territory of the East Heavenly Realm, when Shi Tianwen stepped forward, cheers instantly erupted in the area, cheering him on.

In everyone’s eyes, although the West Heavenly Realm had also changed their Buddha Son, the overall level of cultivation in the East Heavenly Realm had always been superior to the West Heavenly Realm so it was believed that even if it was another Buddha Son, it would be impossible to change this result.
Thus, as long as Shi Tianwen won, then even if he lost to Shi Tianyun, he could still maintain his position as second place.
“Admit defeat!” Shi Tianwen stated calmly.
He wanted to conserve his power, so he could
also last a few more moves against Shi Tianyun.
-He knew himself very well.
There was absolutely no way that he could be a match for Shi Tianyun, because he couldn’t even defeat Shi Moka.
Ling Han smiled faintly, “How much benefits are you giving me?”
In any case, he was only here to gather cultivation resources and Imperial Techniques.
If there
were enough benefits, it was fine even if he had to give up the first place.
When these words fell, everyone’s expressions became strange.
How could anyone ask for benefits in public like this?
How could anyone cheat in public like
this?
Shi Tianwen had told Ling Han to admit defeat.
That was a display of confidence, but after Ling Han’s words, it had become two people bribing each other in private, deliberately manipulating the competition.
“Pei, if our Buddha Son wanted to defeat you, would we still need to bribe you?”
“Don’t be too conceited!”
“You are absolutely no match for our Buddha Son.
Hurry up and admit defeat!”
“That’s right, don’t waste time!”
The Buddhist Race elites from the East Heavenly Realm called out angrily.
Don’t even think of dragging our Buddha Son down with you.
Ling Han shrugged, and said, “Since the price can’t be settled, we can only fight for real.”
‘F*ck!
Who’s faking a fight?!’
Shi Tianwen’s face twisted in anger.
How could there be such an infuriating Buddha Son?
He hurriedly recited the Six Characters Bright King Curse in his mind to calm himself down.
This was the Imperial Technique, which allowed one to see through one’s heart and mind, and immediately return to normal.
However, Shi Tianwen also revealed a baleful killing intent, feeling that Ling Han was too detestable.
Even if he didn’t kill him, he would have to cripple him.
“To speak glibly in front of me, this is extremely unwise,” he stated calmly.
Xiu!
Ling Han had already charged over, throwing a punch.
Just how powerful was he?
Even if he had not used the Imperial Technique, his terrifying
power exploded, and he was still overwhelmingly powerful.
Shi Tianwen did not have the time to react at all, when he saw a dark fist had already shot
towards him.
How could it be so fast?
This was his only reaction.
Then, before he could even raise his hand, he was sent flying with a
punch from Ling Han.
Pu, he spat out a mouthful of blood, and directly collapsed onto the ground.
All of a sudden, there was complete silence, but soon after, the Buddhist Race from the East
Heavenly Realm were angered.
“You actually launched a sneak attack!”
“How despicable and shameless!”
“This doesn’t count!”
“Disqualify him from participating!”
They called out one after another, and requested permission from the Bodhisattvas that were
seated on the high platform.
However, these Venerate Tier elites all looked at each other, their faces filled with surprise.
They could see very clearly that though Ling Han’s punch was indeed suspected to have
caught Shi Tianwen off guard, it could not conceal his strength.
Even if it was another time, Shi Tianwen would definitely be outmatched.
The only question was how many moves he
could last.

chapters.title: Chapter 4203: Strongest Opponent
paragraphs: What else was there to say?
The Bodhisattvas signaled that this result would be the final verdict.

This caused public indignation. The Buddhist Race from the East Heavenly Realm glared at Ling Han. This guy had successfully won through a sneak attack, which was an insult to the status of Buddhist Race!
Yet Ling Han was completely unconcerned. You guys can glare all you want, but what does it have to do with him?
Next, it was another battle between Holy Daughters, giving Ling Han time to recover, so that he could proceed with the final battle.

The Buddha Son battle this time had ended too quickly, so the battle that was supposed to last for two to three days was resolved with two to three punches. It was completely different from previous years.

Similarly, no one paid any attention to the Holy Daughter battle in the second round. Thus, the two Holy Daughters didn’t use their full strength either. In any case, no one cared about the result of the battle.
Thus, after two hours, this battle ended.
The tournament authorities sought the opinions of Ling Han and Shi Tianyun, and both sides agreed to immediately begin, and there was no need to drag it out until tomorrow.
The battle immediately began.
“Shi Tianyun!”
“Kill that guy!”
“We support you!”
Once the two sides took the field, the Buddhist Race of the East Heavenly Realm cheered Shi Tianyun on.
It was very simple. Ling Han had defeated their Buddha Son, and he had even used a “shady move”, which made all of them furious. Naturally, they were leaning in favor Ling Han’s opponent.
Shi Tianyun picked his ears, and said to Ling Han, “You don’t seem to be very popular.”
Ling Han laughed loudly, “Those who are not envied by others are idiots. This is proof of my excellence.”
“Your skin is very thick,” Shi Tianyun said, smiling.
“Same to you,” Ling Han said.
Shi Tianyun was not in a rush to make a move, and said, “I still prefer to use my real name... Ding Shu!”
Ding Shu?
He had never heard of it before.
Yet Ling Han did not dare underestimate him in the slightest. This was a guy that was stronger than even the majority of Imperial Sons.
“All right.” Ling Han nodded, but had no intention of announcing his real name. Otherwise, it would really be fun.

“You give me a very strange feeling.” Ding Shu crossed his arms behind his back, and slowly began to pace around, “You are obviously very young, but your eyes are very aged. That is not because you have encountered some unforeseen event, that allowed you to see through the fickleness of the world overnight, but rather that you have really experienced countless years.”
“This is very strange!”
A thought flashed in Ling Han’s mind, and he said deeply, “I also saw the same thing in your eyes.”
At this moment, neither of them spoke another word, nor did they make a move. They just stood there, looking at each other.
“Let’s fight!”
“Why aren’t you fighting?”
“Shi Tianyun, are you afraid?”
“Exert your previous strength, and defeat that despicable person!”
Everyone called out one after another, really unable to bear the procrastination of these two people.
However, Ling Han and Ding Shu were unmoved. After a long while, Ling Han finally said, “Then, let’s spar for a while.”
“Sure!” Ding Shu nodded.
“Please.”
“Please.”
The two of them both gestured for the other to begin. Then, the atmosphere immediately became tense.
Initially, the two of them were very casual, but now, their gazes were like blades,
indescribably sharp.
Hu, there was no wind in the environment, but multiple cyclones formed around the two of them, turning rapidly.
Pa! Pa! Pa!
These cyclones collided, and exploded one after another. Seals actually exploded, and Regulations floated.
Seeing this scene, everyone was so shocked that their scalps went numb.
These two people... just how strong were they?
Xiu, Ling Han and Ding Shu took a step forwards at the same time, and charged towards each other.
So fast!
This thought flashed through everyone’s minds. They could not grasp the trajectory of these two people at all, and saw that they had already closed in on each other, throwing punches.
Peng, peng, peng! In that short instant, the two of them had already exchanged several hundred blows.
Boom, a terrifying force surged out, turning into multiple mushroom clouds. Multiple seals exploded, terrifying without bounds.
“Heavens!”
Everyone was grabbing their heads and exclaiming in shock. What kind of strength was this?

Now, they finally understood why the Bodhisattvas hadn’t judged Ling Han as a “sneak attack”. This was because Ling Han was far too powerful, and he was no weaker than Shi Tianyun. Thus, a fair battle would have the same result.
Then what was the point of wasting time?
“The two of them... are both only in the early stage of the True Self Tier!”
“This is the first time I know that the early stage of the True Self Tier can be this strong!”
“Er, I am in the peak stage of my fourth form of True Self Tier, but I definitely do not have this
kind of battle prowess.”
“Two freaks!”
“Even if the Imperial Son himself came, would he be a match for these two?”
“If there wasn’t two of them, I would have suspected that it was Ling Han in disguise.”
“Our tribe is going to prosper. These two people are definitely on the level of the strongest Imperial Son. In fact, they can even be unafraid of Ling Han.”

“That’s right. Ling Han’s strength can only be reflected below the True Self Tier, but after entering into the True Self Tier, the Imperial Technique can truly show its might. Ling Han has already been swept out of the Nine Suns Holy Land. Even if he learns a few Saint Techniques, it would still be difficult for him to make a mark.”
Everyone said one after another. They were also filled with excitement and joy for the Buddhist Race. In the future... they could finally hold their heads high in front of the Imperial
Clans.

On the high platform, the Bodhisattvas all looked stunned. They had long since known that Ling Han and Ding Shu were extraordinary, but right until these two people showed their full might, only then did they realize that they had still underestimated these two people.

“You’ve cultivated the Imperial Scroll!” As Ling Han fought, he communicated through divine sense, “Your original power is only at the Tenth Heaven, but the Imperial Techniquehas boosted your battle prowess by nine Heavens!”
Ding Shu did not deny it, but rather said, “You have cultivated Body Art at the same time.
Thus, your original power is as high as 13 Heavens, and when you cast the Body Art, you too have battle prowess of 19 Heavens!”
The eyes of these two people were burning, easily seeing through the background of their
opponent.
After this simple conversation, the two of them fell silent at the same time, and simply
attacked with their heads lowered.
This was far too remarkable!
One had actually cultivated the Imperial Scroll, so could it be that he was the Imperial Son?
The other had also cultivated Body Art, and this was a treatment that only the Golden
Generation could enjoy.
“Who exactly are you?” These were the unspoken words hidden in their minds.
The two of them suspected that their opponent was some Imperial Son of the Imperial Clan,
who had used the chance of selecting Buddha Sons to sneak into the Buddhist Race. But the problem was, what was the other’s motive?
As the Imperial Son, was he short of cultivation resources? Was he short of Imperial
Techniques?

This was the first time that Ling Han had encountered an opponent that could truly battle against him at the same cultivation level. Of course, he had not truly cultivated to the peak stage of the first form of the True Self Tier yet. Otherwise, he should have two powers of ten Heavnens, which could reach 14 to 15 Heavens altogether, and in the case of the other, he had obviously reached the end of the first form.
However, Ding Shu could also cultivate Body Art, and by then, the comparison of strength between the two sides would be reversed.
Of course, Ling Han also had room for improvement, and that was Imperial Scroll.
For the moment, their abilities were equal, and it was hard to decide who was stronger
between them.

Everyone was watching in a daze. This was a battle of the highest grade. It did not mean that Ling Han and Ding Shu’s cultivation levels were top-notch, but rather that they were both the strongest prodigies of this cultivation level, and every move was perfect.
After several hundred moves, Ling Han’s technique suddenly changed. He delivered a palm strike, and like an antelope hanging on its horns, this was an ingenious move.

chapters.title: Chapter 4204: Similarly shocked
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
Ding Shu couldn’t help but pale.
Ling Han’s celestial technique clearly hadn’t changed much, and his original power was still 13 Heavens, but his battle prowess had forcibly increased a bit.
It wasn’t too much, but they were already tied in the first place. As long as either side was just a little bit stronger, it would be enough to affect the tilt of the scales.
How was this possible?
On the basis that power and celestial techniques remained unchanged, battle prowess could actually increase?
He observed attentively, and saw that every move and style from Ling Han was extremely simple, and extremely natural.
“Return to simplicity!” he exclaimed in shock.
Where did cultivation come from?
It all originated from the use of the Regulations of heaven and earth, so ultimately, Dao was natural, and was the foundation.

Ling Han presently had the momentum of “returning to one”. Though he was still very, very far away, and had only grasped a superficial part of it, it was as if he had grasped the general principles of the world’s martial arts. Whatever celestial technique would be able to increase its might by a small amount in his hands.
Hiss!
Ding Shu inhaled sharply, “You have already created your own path!”
Why were the Great Emperors able to achieve dao?

They had all walked their own paths, and reached the peak, and the so-called path of their own was the exploration of the Regulations of heaven and earth. All techniques were different, yet came from the same source. In the end, they would all return to one.
Ling Han smiled to himself. He had obtained this by chance when he had encountered the Saint-level woodcutter, and had not used it all this while, because no one could force him to this extent.
However, Ding Shu had succeeded.
Merely from this aspect, he had surpassed all the Imperial Sons.
“Come battle!” Ding Shu’s eyes lit up. He did not lose his confidence just because Ling Han was strong. Instead, his fighting spirit was ignited.
From this aspect, he and Ling Han were really the same kind of person.
Hong! Hong! Hong!
The two of them clashed, both of them going all out, unleashing their own brilliance to their heart’s content.

In truth, Ling Han had still hidden a few ultimate techniques, such as... the barrage of murderous aura. Now, it could be considered his signature move. If he used it, it would definitely draw suspicion.
“Haha, take this!” Ding Shu laughed loudly, and charged over aggressively.
Yi?
Ling Han was shocked, because a small black figure had suddenly appeared in his mind, and was just about to wreak havoc.
‘Holy f*ck!’
The murderous aura charged towards him!
Ling Han was slightly dazed. Ding Shu could also use murderous aura?

This was really too shocking. It should be known that this was something he had cultivated at the mortal level, and as his cultivation level increased, not only did its might not decrease, it became more and more powerful.
This was his ultimate move, and also his signature move.
But now, this kind of signature ultimate move had actually appeared on another person, so how could Ling Han not be surprised?
This was a Mystical Power that even the Imperial Son hadn’t mastered!
Ling Han naturally knew just how terrifying the barrage of this murderous aura was. Hurriedly, he also condensed his divine sense, which blasted towards this tiny black figure.
Peng!
A direct clash occurred between their divine senses, and the tiny black figure was instantly annihilated. However, Ling Han was also unable to launch a counterattack.
It was a draw again!
Why was this guy’s divine sense also so powerful?

Ling Han murmured internally. Though he was in the True Self Tier, the strength of his soul had reached the Spiritual Transformation Tier. This was something that even the Imperial Son could not compare to. He had not thought that Ding Shu was not the slightest bit inferior to him.
Shouldn’t a freak like him be unique?
He was stunned. Ding Shu was not much better off either.
The murderous aura attack was actually ineffective?
Imperial Son? So there was a treasure left behind by the Ancestral King that could resolve all negative effects?
No, he immediately shook his head. Ling Han had clearly used his divine sense as a blade to clash head-on with him.
This did not depend on the power of the treasure, but rather on one’s own abilities.
The murderous aura barraged him; it similarly was a barrage of murderous aura.
Hiss, this was the first time he had encountered such a freak.
The two of them became even more serious. Their opponent had actually grasped their ultimate technique, causing their hearts to throb.
The question in their minds grew larger and larger, and that was: “Who exactly are you?”
Boom!

Though they were becoming more and more careful, their battle did not become less intense because of this. They were still clashing aggressively, and Ling Han had already roughly created his own path, so he was slightly stronger than Ding Shu.
This gap was actually not very big, but in a battle that was evenly matched, this continuous accumulation would be terrifying.
Ding Shu gradually fell into a disadvantage.
“Hahaha, in a battle of equal cultivation levels, you are the first to force me into a disadvantage!” Ding Shu laughed loudly, “However, I will definitely not lose!”
“Because I am Ding Shu!” he declared proudly.
F***, what a show-off!
Ling Han also wanted to roar. ‘I won’t lose either, because I’m Ling Han!’
But now that he had disguised himself, he could only keep his mouth shut.
“Come!” Ding Shu communicated with high-level energy, and further escalated the battle.

“Do you think I’m afraid of you?” Ling Han was unafraid. He didn’t use the Heavenly Dao Flames, which had already become the symbol of “Ling Han”. Instead, he used the Black Moon Energy. In any case, this was also nine-star high-level energy. In fact, it was even stronger than the incomplete Heavenly Dao Flames.
Hong! Hong! Hong!
Yet Ding Shu had stimulated high-level energy of Fire Element, which was definitely nine stars, and was not inferior at all in a head-on clash with the Black Moon Energy.
‘F*ck! Another tie!’
Seeing the divine might of these two people, the spectators were already rendered speechless.
Too strong, they were really too strong. What kind of prodigy was this?
Imperial Son?
To hell with it. In front of these two people, they were completely trash.
The Buddhist Race was fortunate to have two supreme prodigies appear at the same time.
—Even if the Buddha Son from the thirty three Heavens came, he would still be outmatched in a battle of equal cultivation levels with them, right?
Ding Shu gritted his teeth. Even nine stars of high-level energy was unable to suppress Ling Han?
This opponent was really hard to deal with.

“Haha, try out this move!” Ding Shu became more and more frivolous, his eyes completely black. Boom, a ball of black energy suddenly burned on his right fist. It was even darker than darkness itself, and filled with destructive power.
This!
Ling Han was truly stunned. Destructive Energy, this was Destructive Energy!
How was this possible?

He had once attempted to teach the empress, the large black dog, and the others the method to communicate with Destructive Energy, but the problem was that even if he revealed his memories, the empress and the others would not be able to understand. It was like this was a heavenly book that could not be understood.
Furthermore, how had Ling Han cultivated it?
It wasn’t that his comprehension ability was high enough, but rather the Power of Dimension in his body.
In other words, the Power of Dimension was the key to cultivating Destructive Energy.
And now, in Ding Shu’s hands, Destructive Energy actually appeared as well?
What did this mean?
Hong, Ling Han’s right hand also shook, and Destructive Energy was ignited.
At first, Ding Shu was about to raise his fist to attack, but the instant he saw the Destructive Energy, he immediately stopped. There was also an indescribable shock on his face.
The two of them withdrew their fighting spirit at the same time. At this moment, they only had endless questions.
Fight my a*s!
Yi, why did you guys stop fighting?
But the spectators were completely confused. They were presently battling fiercely, so why had they suddenly stopped?
“Let’s fight, why aren’t we fighting anymore?”
“Who will win and who will lose in this manner?”
The spectators called out one after another.
Ding Shu smiled faintly, and raised his hands, “I forfeit.”
He was very carefree. He turned around and left. Then, he sent a message through divine sense, “When you’re done, come to the Jia Lan Divine Temple for a chat.”
“All right.” Ling Han nodded.

Instead, his fighting spirit was ignited.
From this aspect, he and Ling Han were really the same kind of person.
Hong!
Hong!
Hong!
The two of them clashed, both of them going all out, unleashing their own brilliance to their heart’s content.
In truth, Ling Han had still hidden a few ultimate techniques, such as... the barrage of murderous aura.
Now, it could be considered his signature move.
If he used it, it would definitely draw suspicion.
“Haha, take this!” Ding Shu laughed loudly, and charged over aggressively.
Yi?
Ling Han was shocked, because a small black figure had suddenly appeared in his mind, and was just about to wreak havoc.
‘Holy f*ck!’
The murderous aura charged towards him!
Ling Han was slightly dazed.
Ding Shu could also use murderous aura?
This was really too shocking.
It should be known that this was something he had cultivated at the mortal level, and as his cultivation level increased, not only did its might not decrease, it became more and more powerful.
This was his ultimate move, and also his signature move.
But now, this kind of signature ultimate move had actually appeared on another person, so how could Ling Han not be surprised?
This was a Mystical Power that even the Imperial Son hadn’t mastered!
Ling Han naturally knew just how terrifying the barrage of this murderous aura was.
Hurriedly, he also condensed his divine sense, which blasted towards this tiny black figure.
Peng!
A direct clash occurred between their divine senses, and the tiny black figure was instantly annihilated.
However, Ling Han was also unable to launch a counterattack.
It was a draw again!
Why was this guy’s divine sense also so powerful?
Ling Han murmured internally.
Though he was in the True Self Tier, the strength of his soul had reached the Spiritual Transformation Tier.
This was something that even the Imperial Son could not compare to.
He had not thought that Ding Shu was not the slightest bit inferior to him.
Shouldn’t a freak like him be unique?
He was stunned.
Ding Shu was not much better off either.
The murderous aura attack was actually ineffective?
Imperial Son?
So there was a treasure left behind by the Ancestral King that could resolve all negative effects?
No, he immediately shook his head.
Ling Han had clearly used his divine sense as a blade to clash head-on with him.
This did not depend on the power of the treasure, but rather on one’s own abilities.
The murderous aura barraged him; it similarly was a barrage of murderous aura.
Hiss, this was the first time he had encountered such a freak.
The two of them became even more serious.
Their opponent had actually grasped their ultimate technique, causing their hearts to throb.
The question in their minds grew larger and larger, and that was: “Who exactly are you?”
Boom!
Though they were becoming more and more careful, their battle did not become less intense because of this.
They were still clashing aggressively, and Ling Han had already roughly created his own path, so he was slightly stronger than Ding Shu.
This gap was actually not very big, but in a battle that was evenly matched, this continuous accumulation would be terrifying.
Ding Shu gradually fell into a disadvantage.
“Hahaha, in a battle of equal cultivation levels, you are the first to force me into a disadvantage!” Ding Shu laughed loudly, “However, I will definitely not lose!”
“Because I am Ding Shu!” he declared proudly.
F***, what a show-off!
Ling Han also wanted to roar.
‘I won’t lose either, because I’m Ling Han!’
But now that he had disguised himself, he could only keep his mouth shut.
“Come!” Ding Shu communicated with high-level energy, and further escalated the battle.
“Do you think I’m afraid of you?” Ling Han was unafraid.
He didn’t use the Heavenly Dao Flames, which had already become the symbol of “Ling Han”.
Instead, he used the Black Moon Energy.
In any case, this was also nine-star high-level energy.
In fact, it was even stronger than the incomplete Heavenly Dao Flames.
Hong!
Hong!
Hong!
Yet Ding Shu had stimulated high-level energy of Fire Element, which was definitely nine stars, and was not inferior at all in a head-on clash with the Black Moon Energy.
‘F*ck!
Another tie!’
Seeing the divine might of these two people, the spectators were already rendered speechless.
Too strong, they were really too strong.
What kind of prodigy was this?
Imperial Son?
To hell with it.
In front of these two people, they were completely trash.
The Buddhist Race was fortunate to have two supreme prodigies appear at the same time.
—Even if the Buddha Son from the thirty three Heavens came, he would still be outmatched in a battle of equal cultivation levels with them, right?
Ding Shu gritted his teeth.
Even nine stars of high-level energy was unable to suppress Ling Han?
This opponent was really hard to deal with.
“Haha, try out this move!” Ding Shu became more and more frivolous, his eyes completely black.
Boom, a ball of black energy suddenly burned on his right fist.
It was even darker than darkness itself, and filled with destructive power.
This!
Ling Han was truly stunned.
Destructive Energy, this was Destructive Energy!
How was this possible?

He had once attempted to teach the empress, the large black dog, and the others the method to communicate with Destructive Energy, but the problem was that even if he revealed his memories, the empress and the others would not be able to understand.
It was like this was a heavenly book that could not be understood.
Furthermore, how had Ling Han cultivated it?
It wasn’t that his comprehension ability was high enough, but rather the Power of Dimension in his body.
In other words, the Power of Dimension was the key to cultivating Destructive Energy.
And now, in Ding Shu’s hands, Destructive Energy actually appeared as well?
What did this mean?
Hong, Ling Han’s right hand also shook, and Destructive Energy was ignited.
At first, Ding Shu was about to raise his fist to attack, but the instant he saw the Destructive Energy, he immediately stopped.
There was also an indescribable shock on his face.
The two of them withdrew their fighting spirit at the same time.
At this moment, they only had endless questions.
Fight my a*s!
Yi, why did you guys stop fighting?
But the spectators were completely confused.
They were presently battling fiercely, so why had they suddenly stopped?
“Let’s fight, why aren’t we fighting anymore?”
“Who will win and who will lose in this manner?”
The spectators called out one after another.
Ding Shu smiled faintly, and raised his hands, “I forfeit.”
He was very carefree.
He turned around and left.
Then, he sent a message through divine sense, “When you’re done, come to the Jia Lan Divine Temple for a chat.”
“All right.” Ling Han nodded.

chapters.title: Chapter 4205: The same kind of person
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
This was a battle that was worthy of being recorded in the history books of the Buddhist Race.
Originally, it was just the Buddha Son Ranking Battle of the Four Heavenly Realms, and who knew how many times it had been held, but this time, both sides were too awesome, freakishly strong.
If only one of them was so domineering, then perhaps the Bodhisattvas would suspect that it was Ling Han who was here under disguise.
But both of them were so awesome?

The Bodhisattvas did not have the slightest bit of doubt, and thought that it was possible that the cultivation world had welcomed a Golden Generation again. How could they allow Ling Han to be ahead of them? And now, two more monsters had appeared.
Moreover, these two people were the disciples of the Buddhist Race!
Very good, very good. They had to be nurtured well. Who knows, it might be like how it had been in the past, one to become Emperor, and the other becoming a Pseudo-Emperor.
Of course, this time, they definitely could not allow the one who had not become the Emperor to become a demon.
Now that he won first place, Ling Han would definitely be very busy. However, he tried his best to reject the invitations. He walked quietly, and arrived at the Jia Lan Divine Temple.
This Divine Temple originally belonged to a Buddha, but this great elite had died over twenty thousand years ago. This place had always been empty, and had not found a new owner.
Thus, if they conversed here, their privacy would definitely be guaranteed.
“You’ve come.” Ding Shu’s figure appeared behind a stone pillar.
Ling Han was slightly surprised, because before this, he had not discovered the presence of Ding Shu.

This was a concealment technique, and it was extremely brilliant. If it wasn’t for the fact that Ling Han had mastered the Strange Shadow Steps, he would have suspected that he had also been in the Battle God Palace before.
“I’m a little busy, so I’m late,” Ling Han replied with a nod.
“It’s all right. This little bit of time, hoho, is not much.” Ding Shu stated calmly, an expression of vicissitudes appearing once more in his eyes.
Even if they had to wait for a day, it was nothing to cultivators. They would go into seclusion for a few years or even hundreds of years at the drop of a hat.
However, Ling Han saw more than this. The vicissitudes in Ding Shu’s eyes could be counted in tens of thousands or hundreds of millions of years.
But clearly... his flame of life had only been burning for a few dozen years, at most.
These two keywords, Destructive Energy and Power of Dimension, skipped over in Ling Han’s mind. He had already made his judgement.
“Where have you come from?” he asked.
“North Heavenly Realm,” Ding Shu said with a smile.
“Where in the North Heavenly Realm?” Ling Han continued to ask, “To be more exact, your original world!”

Hearing these words, Ding Shu’s eyes suddenly burst with iridescent light. It was as if he had become a completely different person, exuding an indescribable might, as if he was not a True Self Tier, but rather a supreme Great Emperor!
“Hehe, to be able to ask such a question, it means that we are the same kind of person.” However, he quickly returned to normal, and once again became sloppy.
“The same kind of person!” Ling Han nodded, his heart incredibly stunned.
Just like him, who had come from the Genesis World... there was actually another one!
Of course, Ding Shu definitely hadn’t come from his Genesis World. Instead, he had come from another Genesis World Genesis World, or a similar world.
Ding Shu stretched out a hand towards Ling Han, and Ling Han thought for a moment before stretching out his hand as well. The two of them shook hands.
“I have a suggestion. How about we exchange Spirit Diagrams?” Ding Shu said.
“Sure,” Ling Han said with a nod.
Neither of them said what Spirit Diagram it was, but both of them knew very well that it must be Destructive Energy. However, Ding Shu may not have called it Destructive Energy.
The two of them took out a Spirit Diagram at the same time and handed it over to the other.

Ling Han accepted it and looked at it. This was indeed a corner of the Spirit Diagram of Destructive Energy. Ding Shu had not lied to him, and he naturally had not lied to him either. This was meaningless.
The two of them knew each other’s origins, and this kind of origin could not be announced to the public.
They both had something on each other, so when they cooperated, there was much less scheming.
The two of them immediately started to comprehend it, each sitting in a corner of the Divine Temple.
A day later, the two of them walked towards each other, and traded the Spirit Diagram back.
As expected of the strongest existence in the Genesis World. This comprehension ability was too shocking.
Ling Han thought internally, and this should also be Ding Shu’s thoughts.
“Do you still have Spirit Diagrams to trade?” Ling Han asked.
Ding Shu paused, and countered with a question of his own, “Could it be that you still have Spirit Diagrams?”

“Heh, even if I don’t have it now, it doesn’t mean that I won’t be able to obtain it in the future,” Ling Han said with a smile. “If I do, I might as well inform you. If I obtain other Spirit Diagrams, I’ll exchange them with you.”
“All right,” Ding Shu nodded.

Ling Han guessed that Ding Shu had only obtained a corner of the Spirit Diagram of Destructive Energy. Otherwise, when he channeled the Destructive Energy, it wouldn’t have just wrapped around his right fist.
Of course, Ling Han had deliberately concealed his strength and didn’t unleash all of his Destructive Energy.
“That’s right, are you Ling Han?” Ding Shu suddenly asked.
Ling Han hesitated slightly, then nodded, “That’s right.”
“Ha, I knew it was you!” Ding Shu laughed loudly, “How could there be so many monsters in this world!”
Er, he had also placed himself in the category of monsters.
Ling Han walked forwards, and said, “I think you won’t be staying too long in the Buddhist Race, right?”
“Same to you.” Ding Shu went in the opposite direction. After walking far away, he spoke again, “I anticipate a real battle with you.”
“All right!” Ling Han nodded. Previously, in full public, they had all held back.
After returning, Yunshu Bodhisattva brought Ling Han back to the West Heavenly Realm. The Buddhist Race there had already gotten the news, and gave Ling Han an incredibly warm welcome.
Who would have thought that Ling Han would actually be able to obtain the first place for them?
After celebrating for a while, Ling Han pulled the large black dog aside and talked about Ding Shu.
“What!” The large black dog jumped up, “There is someone like you, the Genesis World’s leader?”
Ling Han nodded slowly, his expression very serious.
“I now suspect that Origin, Myriad Dao and Heaven Crushing may all have the same origins as us.” He communicated through divine sense, “In fact, Ding Shu is one of these three people.”
“Goodness!” The large black dog inhaled sharply, “If that is really the case, that would be too terrifying!”
A large part of Ling Han’s strength came from the Power of Dimension in his body, but since that was the case, it meant that Ding Shu could also possess the majority of Ling Han’s abilities.
“This is a powerful opponent!” the large black dog said.

That’s right. Though the battle for the Buddha Son had ended with Ding Shu taking the initiative to admit defeat, this was not Ding Shu’s true strength. If he really went all out, who knew how many powerful moves Ding Shu had grasped.

In terms of luck alone, Ding Shu had even cultivated the Imperial Scroll. In this aspect, he was superior to Ling Han. Of course, he had not obtained the Body Arts, nor perhaps had he obtained the Origin Gold. This was their opportunity after they had left the Genesis World.

“The most important thing now is to get my hands on the Imperial Scroll!” Ling Han said. For someone like Ding Shu, who had great opportunities, cultivating Body Arts at the same time was not difficult. At least, before Venerate Tier, the resources needed to accumulate for a Body Arts cultivator was not too terrifying in amount.
Thus, if he couldn’t obtain the Imperial Scroll, then when Ding Shu had cultivated Body Art, and the two of them battled again, Ling Han would definitely lose.
“I’m going to find Shi Changtian. No matter what, I have to get something out of him.”
