chapters.title: Chapter 4206: Imperial Technique obtained
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
“Hey, what are you two whispering about?” The little azure dragon approached, its expression filled with suspicion.
“Shoo, shoo, shoo, what are kids doing here!” The large black dog immediately pushed the little azure dragon aside.
“Hiss, you guys must be up to something!” The little azure dragon stomped its feet.
However, Ling Han didn’t plan to tell any outsider the secret of the Genesis World. It was fine as long as they, the residents of the Genesis World, knew.
Thus, no matter how much the little azure dragon threatened and bribed, Ling Han and the large black dog kept their mouths shut, not revealing the slightest bit.
After Ling Han replied with a few words, he ran off to find Shi Changtian.
He had already made a deal with this guy. As long as he got first place, the latter would apply and have the higher-ups agree to teach him the Six Characters Bright King Curse.

At the time, Shi Changtian had only been perfunctory with Ling Han, and had not thought that Ling Han would really succeed. However, this was indeed a great merit, allowing the Buddhist Race of the West Heavenly Realm to hold their heads high. Thus, he did not mind making this trip, to ask instructions from the three Bodhisattvas.
Only after two days, the three Bodhisattvas agreed to have Ling Han be taught the Six Characters Bright King Curse.
Ling Han entered the secret room alone. Then, Shi Changtian took out a jade-like bone.
“This was left behind by a Buddha after he passed away in meditation. The profound meaning of the Six Characters Bright King Curse is hidden in his bone, so you can comprehend it on your own.”

Ling Han hurriedly caught the bone. This was a Saint’s bone, but its murderous aura had been refined, and its essence had been extracted. Otherwise, if the slightest bit of aura was released, it was guaranteed that he would immediately be crushed into a mush of blood.
Shi Changtian left, and Ling Han began to comprehend.

He inserted his divine sense into the bone, and instantly, it was as if he had entered into another world. In a pitch-black galaxy, an old man in monk robes walked out in a cross-legged position. He suddenly opened his mouth, and shouted the roar of a lion.
The Buddhist chants were vast and mighty, each character taking form, and were completely formed from Regulations.
Only after a while, the old monk shouted loudly again. It was still the Six Characters Bright King Curse again and again.

At the same time, the old monk was also explaining how he was going to extract the heaven and earth’s energy, how he was going to infuse Regulations into it, and how he was going to clear his mind to see his true character.
Though he explained very carefully, if one wanted to truly grasp it, it all depended on one’s own comprehension ability.

Ling Han had already learnt the word “An”. Although it wasn’t very authentic, he had still established his foundations, after all. Thus, he was able to learn it very quickly. In just two days, he had already laid down the bone of the Saint, and from the stage of learning, advanced into the stage of comprehension.
This time, he went into seclusion for a whole nine days, and Ling Han finally opened his eyes.
“An!” he shouted lightly, and Regulations appeared, turning into a golden “An”.

A satisfied smile appeared on Ling Han’s face. The might of the “An” character had increased by at least threefold compared to before. The effects of using it to suppress Yin souls and dispel internal demons would naturally be greatly increased.
He continued to comprehend. Half a month later, he had already mastered the entire Six Characters Bright King Curse.

“Without the Imperial Scroll of the Buddhist Race, this Six Words Bright King Curse will ultimately not be able to unleash its full might.” Ling Han felt slightly regretful, but the Imperial Scroll was the foundation of an Imperial Clan. Even Venerate Tier elites such as the Black Cloud Bodhisattva probably wouldn’t be qualified to cultivate the Imperial Scroll, let alone him.
But to sneak into the 33 Heavens? That was too difficult.
That was the true base camp of the Buddhist Race. If one wanted to enter, they would definitely have to investigate all eighteen generations of his ancestors. He wanted to bluff his way through?
It was practically impossible.
Sigh, why wasn’t he as lucky as Ding Shu?

However, upon further thought, the Heavenly Dragon Emperor Technique was actually also an Imperial Scroll, and was incredibly unique. It was Body Arts. Throughout the generations of Ancestral Kings, only the True Dragon had reached Great Accomplishment in Body Arts, and was one of a kind.
It was not that the True Dragon was awesome, and had surpassed all other Great Emperors, but that this had been bestowed upon it by the heavens.

Ling Han ended his seclusion and returned the Saint’s bone. This naturally stunned the higher-ups of the West Heavenly Realm. He had grasped the Six Characters Bright King Curse in such a short period of time; his natural talent was chillingly strong.
He was warned that the Six Characters Bright King Curse was the precious treasure of the Buddhist Race and definitely couldn’t be taught to outsiders.
Ling Han agreed on the surface, then passed it on to the little azure dragon and the large black dog. This was their purpose for sneaking in.

However, after learning the Six Characters Bright King Curse, he wouldn’t be able to cultivate a second Imperial Technique for the time being. Thus, after some discussion, the “three brothers” decided to go out for a walk.

Now that they had a new identity as cover, they naturally did not have to worry about being hunted down. Furthermore, Ling Han was also the Buddha Son of the West Heavenly Realm. Aside from the Imperial Clans, who would dare trifle with him?
The three of them left the Stainless Planet and roamed around.

They went to many planets to search for opportunities, but while there were indeed small opportunities and occasionally, an ancient site would open, but they were all Spiritual Transformation Tier, and Minor Advanced Tier-level, and were not of much help to them.
Seven months later, they arrived at the Frost Majestic Planet.
This was a large planet, and was also a well-known trading market.

Though transactions could be done on the Galaxy Network, firstly, the Chang Clan would have to collect service charges, and secondly, they were not face-to-face, after all. There was no way to directly appraise a treasure like this. Thus, the most popular method among cultivators was still trading face-to-face.
The Frost Majestic Planet was the West Heavenly Realm’s most famous trading planet. Ling Han and the others were naturally here because of his fame.

There were a total of 18 trading cities on this planet, and the smaller trading cities numbered in the tens of thousands. Practically the moment they left the inn, they would be able to see the stalls on both sides of the streets.
After walking around for a few days, they had a small harvest, but it was only a small harvest. They did not encounter anything that could be called precious treasures.

On this day, Ling Han finished cultivating the clay fetus of True Self. He had already completely cultivated the ninth clay fetus of True Self. Now, his Body Art and mystical power had both reached ten Heavens. When their might was unleashed together, he could unleash a terrifying power that was close to 15 Heavens.
At first, he had wanted to continue his efforts, and rush up to the second form of the True Self in a single go, but after a few attempts, he had failed.
It couldn’t be helped. Starting from the True Self Tier, it was about comprehending the Dao of heaven and earth, and without enough accumulation, no matter how prodigious you were, it was useless.
Ling Han decided to simply walk around. He didn’t have a purpose, so he walked around casually.
The streets were extremely lively. There were too many people from other planets. Some were sellers, some were buyers, and some were people hired to drum up the sales. There were all kinds of people.
‘Hmm?’
Ling Han suddenly felt a strange feeling, but after taking a few steps, this feeling disappeared.
He stopped, then walked forwards again, but after taking a few steps, he stopped again, and began to retreat.
At this moment, that strange feeling came again.
What exactly was it?
Ling Han thought for a while, but couldn’t figure out where this strange feeling came from.
“Get lost, don’t stand here like a block of wood!” At this moment, a voice sounded from behind him, and then a hand pushed over.
Ling Han casually grabbed and waved his hand, and a person was picked up and tossed into the air. However, he didn’t even turn around.
“How dare you!” Behind him, several voices rang out at the same time.
A thought flashed in Ling Han’s mind. He reached into his robes, and touched something hard. It was this thing that was exuding heat, though it was negligible.
That tortoise shell from the Netherworld!

sentences.text: Editor: Henyee Translations
“Hey, what are you two whispering about?” The little azure dragon approached, its expression filled with suspicion.
“Shoo, shoo, shoo, what are kids doing here!” The large black dog immediately pushed the little azure dragon aside.
“Hiss, you guys must be up to something!” The little azure dragon stomped its feet.
However, Ling Han didn’t plan to tell any outsider the secret of the Genesis World.
It was fine as long as they, the residents of the Genesis World, knew.
Thus, no matter how much the little azure dragon threatened and bribed, Ling Han and the large black dog kept their mouths shut, not revealing the slightest bit.
After Ling Han replied with a few words, he ran off to find Shi Changtian.
He had already made a deal with this guy.
As long as he got first place, the latter would apply and have the higher-ups agree to teach him the Six Characters Bright King Curse.
At the time, Shi Changtian had only been perfunctory with Ling Han, and had not thought that Ling Han would really succeed.
However, this was indeed a great merit, allowing the Buddhist Race of the West Heavenly Realm to hold their heads high.
Thus, he did not mind making this trip, to ask instructions from the three Bodhisattvas.
Only after two days, the three Bodhisattvas agreed to have Ling Han be taught the Six Characters Bright King Curse.
Ling Han entered the secret room alone.
Then, Shi Changtian took out a jade-like bone.
“This was left behind by a Buddha after he passed away in meditation.
The profound meaning of the Six Characters Bright King Curse is hidden in his bone, so you can comprehend it on your own.”
Ling Han hurriedly caught the bone.
This was a Saint’s bone, but its murderous aura had been refined, and its essence had been extracted.
Otherwise, if the slightest bit of aura was released, it was guaranteed that he would immediately be crushed into a mush of blood.
Shi Changtian left, and Ling Han began to comprehend.
He inserted his divine sense into the bone, and instantly, it was as if he had entered into another world.
In a pitch-black galaxy, an old man in monk robes walked out in a cross-legged position.
He suddenly opened his mouth, and shouted the roar of a lion.
Ma...
Ni...
Ba...
Mi...
The Buddhist chants were vast and mighty, each character taking form, and were completely formed from Regulations.
Only after a while, the old monk shouted loudly again.
It was still the Six Characters Bright King Curse again and again.

At the same time, the old monk was also explaining how he was going to extract the heaven and earth’s energy, how he was going to infuse Regulations into it, and how he was going to clear his mind to see his true character.
Though he explained very carefully, if one wanted to truly grasp it, it all depended on one’s own comprehension ability.
Ling Han had already learnt the word “An”.
Although it wasn’t very authentic, he had still established his foundations, after all.
Thus, he was able to learn it very quickly.
In just two days, he had already laid down the bone of the Saint, and from the stage of learning, advanced into the stage of comprehension.
This time, he went into seclusion for a whole nine days, and Ling Han finally opened his eyes.
“An!” he shouted lightly, and Regulations appeared, turning into a golden “An”.
A satisfied smile appeared on Ling Han’s face.
The might of the “An” character had increased by at least threefold compared to before.
The effects of using it to suppress Yin souls and dispel internal demons would naturally be greatly increased.
He continued to comprehend.
Half a month later, he had already mastered the entire Six Characters Bright King Curse.

“Without the Imperial Scroll of the Buddhist Race, this Six Words Bright King Curse will ultimately not be able to unleash its full might.” Ling Han felt slightly regretful, but the Imperial Scroll was the foundation of an Imperial Clan.
Even Venerate Tier elites such as the Black Cloud Bodhisattva probably wouldn’t be qualified to cultivate the Imperial Scroll, let alone him.
But to sneak into the 33 Heavens?
That was too difficult.
That was the true base camp of the Buddhist Race.
If one wanted to enter, they would definitely have to investigate all eighteen generations of his ancestors.
He wanted to bluff his way through?
It was practically impossible.
Sigh, why wasn’t he as lucky as Ding Shu?
However, upon further thought, the Heavenly Dragon Emperor Technique was actually also an Imperial Scroll, and was incredibly unique.
It was Body Arts.
Throughout the generations of Ancestral Kings, only the True Dragon had reached Great Accomplishment in Body Arts, and was one of a kind.
It was not that the True Dragon was awesome, and had surpassed all other Great Emperors, but that this had been bestowed upon it by the heavens.
Ling Han ended his seclusion and returned the Saint’s bone.
This naturally stunned the higher-ups of the West Heavenly Realm.
He had grasped the Six Characters Bright King Curse in such a short period of time; his natural talent was chillingly strong.
He was warned that the Six Characters Bright King Curse was the precious treasure of the Buddhist Race and definitely couldn’t be taught to outsiders.
Ling Han agreed on the surface, then passed it on to the little azure dragon and the large black dog.
This was their purpose for sneaking in.
However, after learning the Six Characters Bright King Curse, he wouldn’t be able to cultivate a second Imperial Technique for the time being.
Thus, after some discussion, the “three brothers” decided to go out for a walk.
Now that they had a new identity as cover, they naturally did not have to worry about being hunted down.
Furthermore, Ling Han was also the Buddha Son of the West Heavenly Realm.
Aside from the Imperial Clans, who would dare trifle with him?
The three of them left the Stainless Planet and roamed around.

They went to many planets to search for opportunities, but while there were indeed small opportunities and occasionally, an ancient site would open, but they were all Spiritual Transformation Tier, and Minor Advanced Tier-level, and were not of much help to them.
Seven months later, they arrived at the Frost Majestic Planet.
This was a large planet, and was also a well-known trading market.
Though transactions could be done on the Galaxy Network, firstly, the Chang Clan would have to collect service charges, and secondly, they were not face-to-face, after all.
There was no way to directly appraise a treasure like this.
Thus, the most popular method among cultivators was still trading face-to-face.
The Frost Majestic Planet was the West Heavenly Realm’s most famous trading planet.
Ling Han and the others were naturally here because of his fame.
There were a total of 18 trading cities on this planet, and the smaller trading cities numbered in the tens of thousands.
Practically the moment they left the inn, they would be able to see the stalls on both sides of the streets.
After walking around for a few days, they had a small harvest, but it was only a small harvest.
They did not encounter anything that could be called precious treasures.
On this day, Ling Han finished cultivating the clay fetus of True Self.
He had already completely cultivated the ninth clay fetus of True Self.
Now, his Body Art and mystical power had both reached ten Heavens.
When their might was unleashed together, he could unleash a terrifying power that was close to 15 Heavens.
At first, he had wanted to continue his efforts, and rush up to the second form of the True Self in a single go, but after a few attempts, he had failed.
It couldn’t be helped.
Starting from the True Self Tier, it was about comprehending the Dao of heaven and earth, and without enough accumulation, no matter how prodigious you were, it was useless.
Ling Han decided to simply walk around.
He didn’t have a purpose, so he walked around casually.
The streets were extremely lively.
There were too many people from other planets.
Some were sellers, some were buyers, and some were people hired to drum up the sales.
There were all kinds of people.
‘Hmm?’
Ling Han suddenly felt a strange feeling, but after taking a few steps, this feeling disappeared.
He stopped, then walked forwards again, but after taking a few steps, he stopped again, and began to retreat.
At this moment, that strange feeling came again.
What exactly was it?
Ling Han thought for a while, but couldn’t figure out where this strange feeling came from.
“Get lost, don’t stand here like a block of wood!” At this moment, a voice sounded from behind him, and then a hand pushed over.
Ling Han casually grabbed and waved his hand, and a person was picked up and tossed into the air.
However, he didn’t even turn around.
“How dare you!” Behind him, several voices rang out at the same time.
A thought flashed in Ling Han’s mind.
He reached into his robes, and touched something hard.
It was this thing that was exuding heat, though it was negligible.
That tortoise shell from the Netherworld!

chapters.title: Chapter 4207: Strange change of the tortoise shell
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
This tortoise shell was a little amazing, because it could not be stored into a Spatial Tool.
But aside from that, this thing could not be any more ordinary.
And now, it was actually heating up?
‘What? Are you showing off now?’

Ling Han pulled open his clothes a little. He discovered that the tortoise shell wasn’t just hot, but the patterns on the back of the tortoise shell were also glowing slightly, but very weakly, like fireflies.

These patterns weren’t all that amazing, and they were secretly aligned with the Dao of heaven and earth and the like. If it weren’t for the fact that it couldn’t be stored into a Spatial Spirit Tool, this thing would definitely have been thrown away immediately.
Why did the tortoise shell glow and heat up? Was there no reason, or... had it been triggered by something?
Ling Han’s eyes swept over the place, but there were stalls everywhere, filled with a dazzling array of items. If it was triggered by one of the items here, the range of choice was still quite wide.
“Hey, have you gone stupid?” Behind him, someone rebuked harshly.
Ling Han turned around to take a look. There were four young people here, and they were two men and two women respectively. He smiled faintly, “What do you want?”

“You threw our Senior Brother Liu out, so could it be that you want to pretend that nothing happened?” one of the young girls rebuked. She had a ponytail, and was dressed in a long green dress. Her skin was very fair.
Ling Han gave an ‘oh’, and asked, “The guy that smacked me with his hand just now?”
F***, you are still playing the fool at a time like this?
“Brat, we are the Holy Land of Qingxuan!” A man interrupted. He was dressed in a tight-fitting suit of blue, his expression arrogant.

Ling Han smiled faintly. These four people were only in the Core Formation Tier, and in his eyes, they weren’t even worthy of being his opponents. “That was just a misunderstanding. Someone patted my shoulder, and I naturally reacted.”
“All right, we believe that this is a misunderstanding. Pay compensation!” the man in blue said.
“Senior Brother Ma!” The remaining three turned to look at the man in blue at the same time, disagreement written all over their faces.
How could this be resolved with money?

The man in the tight-fitting blue suit pressed down his hand. They were all in the Core Formation Tier, while Ling Han was in the True Self Tier. They could only use the might of the Holy Land to intimidate him. It was already good enough for him to pay some compensation. How could it be that they could give him a good beating?
Ling Han smiled, took out a few Dao Stones and handed them over. He was not in the mood to tangle with these people now.
He didn’t care if the other party was satisfied or not. In any case, he was doing as he pleased. If they continued to pester him, he wouldn’t mind using force to resolve the problem.
The man in blue looked at the five Dao Stones in his hands, his expression slightly dark.
‘That’s all? Are you dismissing a beggar?’

“Stay here and keep an eye on him. Report his whereabouts at any time. I’ll go back and ask Uncle Zhou for help,” he transmitted a message through divine sense to his Junior Brother and Junior Sisters.
The three of them were slightly hesitant. This was only a small matter; was there any need to alert the others in the sect?
“He’s at the True Self Tier, and we’re no match for him,” the man in blue said. “Keep an eye on him!”
After saying this, he picked up Senior Brother Liu, who was at the side of the road, and strode off.
There was nothing else that could be done, so the three people with the ponytails could only do as he said.

Ling Han smiled faintly. He was someone who had a halo of trouble, and would actually still cause trouble in this kind of situation. Yi, didn’t he still have the True Dragon of Fortune? Had it been eaten by a dog?
(The large black dog: “...”)
He didn’t care. After walking back and forth a few times and confirming that something here had triggered the tortoise shell, he began to search the various stalls.
Found it.
It was too obvious, because he had discovered another tortoise shell.
This was an incomplete tortoise shell, and judging from the damaged edges, the two should be a complete piece.
What a coincidence. A tortoise shell that he had obtained in the Netherworld, and he had actually pieced it together here.
Was this the effect of his luck?
He stretched out a hand to grab the tortoise shell, then asked, “Boss, how much is this?”
He did not go in a roundabout manner, and deliberately chose other things, then very casually bought the tortoise shell as well.
With his current strength and status as a Buddha Son, there was already no need for him to do so.

“This?” The stall keeper faltered for a moment. He had picked this thing up, but looking at the interesting veined patterns on the tortoise shell, it had also become part of his collection, but he had not been able to sell it all this while.
It could not be helped. There was really nothing special about this at all. Whoever bought it would be an idiot.
However, why did this tortoise shell seem to be glowing now?
“100 Dao Stones.” He placed a high bid. It was rare for someone to ask, so he naturally had to take advantage of the opening to make a killing.
Ling Han smiled, took out a hundred Dao Stones and tossed them over, “Here, take them.”

Seeing how straightforward Ling Han was, the stall keeper was naturally filled with extreme regret. Obviously, Ling Han very much wanted this tortoise shell, and he was completely capable of offering a higher price.

Ling Han was overjoyed. Previously, he had stowed away the tortoise shell on a whim. Though he could not store it into a Spatial Spirit Tool, it was no trouble to bring it with him. Of course, he still had a sliver of hope in his heart. One day, he would be able to discover the true use of the tortoise shell.
After all, it was all. Being unable to store it into a Spatial Spirit Tool could also be considered a peculiarity.

He had not thought that he would be able to piece the tortoise shell back together so quickly. Perhaps, he would be able to immediately discover its peculiarity — it was also possible that after this piece was pieced back together, it would still be an ordinary tortoise shell.
Let’s go back.
He walked back, yet discovered that the three people with ponytails were actually following him. He revealed a smil. They were keeping an eye on him; had they not given up yet?
Fine, I’m in a good mood, so I’ll play with you guys.
Ling Han was completely capable of using the Star Step to flee, instantly traveling millions and millions of miles away, but now, he was neither too fast nor too slow.
After walking for a while, he had already arrived at the inn where he was resting. He turned around, and asked, “Why haven’t your people come yet? I’ve already arrived at my destination?”
The three people with the ponytails were all very embarrassed, and none of them spoke.
However, a look of delight immediately appeared on their faces, “Uncle Zhou and Senior Brother Ma are here!”
Oh, he had brought out reinforcements?
Ling Han stood with his hands crossed behind his back, waiting quietly.
In a short while, two figures flew over.
Yi?
When he saw one of them, Ling Han instantly revealed a strange expression.
Xiu, xiu! The two of them descended, and the man in blue immediately pointed at Ling Han and said, “Uncle Zhou, it was this guy who beat Senior Brother Liu to the point that he’s still unconscious!”
Uncle Zhou immediately stepped out, heading towards Ling Han.

The man in blue sneered. Though this Uncle Zhou had entered the sect later than him, his natural talent in martial arts was too shocking. He had practically broken through to the True Self Tier with an overwhelming speed, and even the Dao Child of the present generation was dumbfounded.

By now, the higher-ups of the Holy Land of Qingxuan had already thought of switching to another Dao Child. However, this involved a very complicated internal power struggle, and was not something that could be decided in a short while.
And in order to ensure the safety of this Uncle Zhou, the Holy Land finally sent him out, to prevent him from being plotted against by the people supporting the original Dao Child.
If he could develop a good relationship with this Uncle Zhou, who knows, he may be able to achieve meteoric success in future.
Just as he was pondering, Uncle Zhou had already walked in front of Ling Han.
Beat, beat him to death!
Uncle Zhou spread open his arms. Yi, what kind of technique was this? Among the celestial techniques of the Holy Land, there wasn’t a celestial technique with such a gesture.
‘F*ck!’
The eyes of the man in blue immediately widened. That was because Uncle Zhou had not spread out his arms to attack, but was rather embracing Ling Han.
“Senior Zhou!” Ling Han laughed loudly. This Uncle Zhou was Zhou Heng.

chapters.title: Chapter 4208: The location of Needless Mountains is
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations

Ling Han’s cultivation and battle prowess had already surpassed Zhou Heng when he had been in the Genesis World. However, what he respected was Zhou Heng, just like how he had always respected Lin Luo.
Thus, in his heart, Zhou Heng would always be “Senior Zhou”, regardless of whether Zhou Heng’s cultivation level was higher or lower than his.
Zhou Heng didn’t say anything. He simply patted Ling Han’s shoulder.

Although he didn’t recognize Ling Han’s current appearance, Ling Han had already informed him of his identity through divine sense. Thus, he was also filled with excitement. It had been several years since they last met, and even though he maintained contact with Ling Han on the Galaxy Network, it had already been a long time since they had met face-to-face.
The two of them let go, and talked about some old matters. They were both happy.

The man in the blue tight-fitting outfit looked awkward. He only felt that he was just asking for punishment. He had clearly gone to ask for reinforcements, yet in the end, he had invited Ling Han’s good friend — though he had heard Ling Han address Zhou Heng as Senior Heng, but looking at the way the two of them were interacting, they were clearly good friends, so there was no such thing as seniority.
Oh no, he was in deep trouble now.
“Ma Jun!” Zhou Heng turned around and shouted at the man in blue.
“Uncle Zhou, I was wrong.” Ma Jun hurriedly knelt down. It was useless to say anything now, so he had best quickly apologize.
Zhou Heng naturally gave him a reprimand. Then, he ordered the four of them to return. He had a lot to say to Ling Han.
After they left, Ling Han talked about some secret matters, including Ding Shu’s origins.
“What!” Zhou Heng was shocked. “There are actually other Genesis Worlds?”
Ling Han nodded and said, “The so-called Genesis World is actually a rock that contains a small world. What I’m curious about now is how many more of these rocks there are.”

It would be fun if there were too many, because the body of the Genesis World’s master contained millions and millions of Power of Dimensions. When cultivating, he could easily break through the limits of martial arts and cultivate various Mystical Powers.
Then, the prodigies in the universe would really be overthrown.

“I’m sure that this is extremely limited. It’s possible that it’s just the two of you,” Zhou Heng said. To say nothing of Master of the Genesis World, which of those who had come from the Genesis World wasn’t a top-notch prodigy?
If there were a few more such small worlds, the entire cultivation world would probably be in chaos.
“If you need help with anything, feel free to ask,” Zhou Heng said. “Especially when you counterattack against the nine great Imperial Clans. Remember to invite me.”
Obviously, he also knew that Ling Han had been forced by the nine great Imperial Clans. As Ling Han’s good friend, he must also be filled with anger.
In the past, he had also been one of the strongest Heavenly Venerable Tier elites of Genesis World. Who had he been afraid of?
“All right!” Ling Han nodded earnestly, “Everyone work hard on cultivation, and this day will come!”

Zhou Heng nodded in understanding. He had obtained the complete Ancient Sun Divine Scroll from Lin Luo, as well as several Saint Techniques. If it weren’t for the fact that he still needed the cultivation resources of the Holy Land of Qingxuan, he would have been able to wander the world.
“Be careful,” he said.
“I will.” Ling Han nodded, “You too. If there are any difficulties, I can also help you.”
He knew that Zhou Heng was presently contesting for the position of Dao Child, and there was still some danger.
“Haha, you’re now the Buddha Son of the West Heavenly Realm. Your words do indeed have some weight.” Zhou Heng laughed loudly.
The two of them bade farewell. They were both proud and arrogant people, and had their own paths to walk.
After seeing Zhou Heng off, Ling Han shut himself in his room and began to study the two tortoise shells.

These two things continued to glow and heat up. Ling Han placed them on the ground, and a strange thing happened. They were like magnets, and attracted each other. They trembled slightly, and then slowly approached each other.
Ling Han didn’t stop this. A single tortoise shell was completely useless, and it was unknown what would happen after they fused into one.
Pa, the two tortoise shells came closer and closer, and finally joined back together.
Then, there was no ‘then’.

“F***, it’s over just like that?” Ling Han was greatly disappointed. Shouldn’t it have opened up a mysterious space, where he could take out a large number of treasures, or turn into a divine tortoise shell that could not be penetrated by anything?
What was this?
If he had known this earlier, he should have given Ma Jun a good thrashing. Now, he had nowhere to vent his depression.
Ling Han picked up the tortoise shell, and looked it up and down. He was defiant.
However, aside from the fact that he still couldn’t store it into his Spatial Tool, there was still nothing special about it.
“A complete tortoise shell, could it be that I have to crawl into it?” Ling Han mumbled to himself. When he finished saying these words, he was startled.
It can’t really be like this, right?
This, wearing a tortoise shell on his body, no matter how he thought about it, it was a little awkward.
“Nothing ventured, nothing gained!” Ling Han encouraged himself.

He pulled the tortoise shell over his head, and a strange scene appeared. This tortoise shell was actually only about the size of a palm. Thus, this hole was naturally very small, but when Ling Han’s head approached, he easily wormed in.
Then, with a ‘xiu’, his whole person disappeared.
This was... the inside of the tortoise shell?

Ling Han’s eyes widened in shock. This was a pitch-black galaxy, yet there were stars flickering in the distance. Some were especially bright, some were relatively dim, some were extraordinarily large, and some were slightly smaller.
This was a microcosm of the universe!
With a thought, Ling Han immediately left the millions and millions of stars behind him. In this place, he could traverse boundless distances in a single bound.
In that case, he would go to the edge of the universe to take a look.

Ling Han remembered that the Ancestral King Lingtian and the Battle Saint Emperor had all gone to the edge of the universe in search of the path to immortality. From then onwards, there was no further news. Then, would he be able to see them here?
Unfortunately, though he had come to the end of this “universe”, he had not discovered anything special.
That was because this was not a real universe, but rather a simulation.
Weng, a figure appeared, standing in the universe, indescribably tall.
However, Ling Han discovered that this person’s back was slightly hunched.
No, it wasn’t that this person was hunchbacked, but that he was carrying a tortoise shell on his back.
This was a tortoise in human form, and it still retained a sliver of its original characteristics?

“My entire life has been spent in battle, pacifying the darkness. However, my power is limited, and even if I spent my entire life, I could only suppress the darkness, but could not completely pacify it! Future generations, what I have learnt in this lifetime is buried in Needless Mountains. If you obtain it, you have to shoulder my unfinished mission and continue to eradicate the darkness.”
This tortoiseback person declared loudly, bringing with him an endless air of dominance. Even the heavens were trembling, and the stars were flickering simultaneously.
A lifetime of battle, pacifying the darkness, and Needless Mountains?
‘F*ck! This is the Descending Heaven Holy Emperor!
Heavens, this Holy Emperor was actually from the Tortoise Tribe!
Ling Han faltered upon hearing this. He hadn’t imagined that the Great Emperor, who could claim to be the most powerful being in history, was actually a member of the Tortoise Tribe.
Moreover, he hadn’t been able to obtain the secret of the Needless Mountains from the Mountain Sea Heaven. Instead, he had unexpectedly obtained it here.
Actually, it wasn’t wrong. The secret of the Needless Mountains was indeed in the Mountain Sea Heaven — a tortoise shell from Mountain Sea Heaven.
Perhaps, this tortoise shell had been shed from the body of the Descending Heaven Holy Emperor.
Just as he was complaining, stars flashed, and he saw that seven stars were aligned and twinkling together.
“So this is where Needless Mountains is?”

However, what he respected was Zhou Heng, just like how he had always respected Lin Luo.
Thus, in his heart, Zhou Heng would always be “Senior Zhou”, regardless of whether Zhou Heng’s cultivation level was higher or lower than his.
Zhou Heng didn’t say anything.
He simply patted Ling Han’s shoulder.
Although he didn’t recognize Ling Han’s current appearance, Ling Han had already informed him of his identity through divine sense.
Thus, he was also filled with excitement.
It had been several years since they last met, and even though he maintained contact with Ling Han on the Galaxy Network, it had already been a long time since they had met face-to-face.
The two of them let go, and talked about some old matters.
They were both happy.
The man in the blue tight-fitting outfit looked awkward.
He only felt that he was just asking for punishment.

He had clearly gone to ask for reinforcements, yet in the end, he had invited Ling Han’s good friend — though he had heard Ling Han address Zhou Heng as Senior Heng, but looking at the way the two of them were interacting, they were clearly good friends, so there was no such thing as seniority.

It would be fun if there were too many, because the body of the Genesis World’s master contained millions and millions of Power of Dimensions.

chapters.title: Chapter 4209: High Fiery Galaxy
paragraphs: “I recognize this place. Seven stars in a row, those are seven suns!”
In the universe, it was not uncommon for twin suns to appear, but it was extremely rare for three or even more suns to appear in a galaxy.
Thus, the seven suns formed a straight line. This place was naturally rare, and could be recognized with a single glance.
“In the High Fiery Galaxy,” Ling Han answered.

He immediately went to call the little azure dragon and the large black dog. When the two of them found out that Ling Han had found the location of Needless Mountains, they were both surprised and delighted.
Who would have thought that this would actually come so easily?
“Haha, Imperial Scroll, Grandpa Dog is here!” The large black dog rubbed its paws together in excitement.

The little azure dragon also cried out. The True Dragon only passed down the Body Arts, but did not have the Imperial Scroll of cultivation level. Thus, it was also very depressed. It had grasped so many Imperial Techniques for nothing, yet could not unleash their full might.
“Let’s go.”
Ling Han set up formations, and they began to traverse the universe.

“I say, Little Han, we’re in a rush to get the Imperial Scroll, so don’t play around anymore.” The large black dog was slightly apprehensive, because they had once encountered an accident, and the Transfer Formation had actually exploded. Thankfully, they had not entered yet. Otherwise, it would be much more fun.
“Hehe, if I don’t make the best use of my time to learn now, could it be that O would have to learn at the last moment?” Ling Han said with a smile.
Every time he arrived on a planet, he would comprehend the Transfer Formation there. On his way here, he had memorized who knew how many Transfer Formations.
“Moreover, the Needless Mountains can’t run, and it hasn’t been found for so many years. How could it be that it would be discovered by others just because we delayed it for a while?”
Er, that was true.
And just like that, Ling Han learnt all the way, and the three of them quickly headed towards the High Fiery Galaxy.
This was in the East Heavenly Realm, and Ling Han felt rueful about this. If he had known, when he had come here for the sparring tournament, he would not have returned to the West Heavenly Realm.
After spending a total of two months, they finally arrived at the High Fiery Galaxy.
They walked out of the Transfer Formation and immediately felt the scorching heat.

In the High Fiery Galaxy, because there were seven suns hanging high in the skies at all times, the temperature here was astonishingly high. Ordinary living beings would not be able to survive at all.
However, for cultivators who cultivated fire-element cultivation techniques, this was a good place. The Source Power of Fire boiled, and was easier to comprehend.

Hence, there were cultivators on this planet, and a Transfer Formation was deliberately built. Every day, a considerable number would come. Of course, there were also a considerable number that left, because the seven suns shone at the same time, and their might was too terrifying. If one stayed here for too long, they would be poisoned by fire.
“Little Han, we’ve arrived at the High Fiery Galaxy, but where is the Needless Mountains?” the large black dog asked.

Ling Han was also a little dazed. That was because he was in the tortoise shell universe, and had only seen seven stars aligned. He had confirmed that Needless Mountains was in the High Fiery Galaxy, but now that he was here, how was he supposed to find Needless Mountains? This was a problem.

“I don’t know either.” He spread out his hands. Needless Mountains definitely wouldn’t stand upright in the galaxy like that. Otherwise, after so many years, they would have long since been found. Thus, the key was still on the tortoise shell.

He took out the tortoise shell. Weng, the veined patterns on the tortoise shell all lit up, and then became incredibly bright, shooting towards the skies. Even the brilliance of the seven suns could not conceal it.
“Yi, a treasure!”
“A treasure has appeared!”

Though Ling Han and the others had deliberately found a place where there was no one, the light emitted by the tortoise shell was too dazzling, and had also covered the glory of the suns, so how could it not attract the attention of others?
Instantly, those who were cultivating nearby all followed the tracks, and those in the distance also discovered it, and were also rapidly rushing over.
“F***, stupid tortoise, why are you so high-profile?” The large black dog was so infuriated that he almost threw the tortoise shell. However, the location of Needless Mountains was still
on it, so no matter how angry he was, he had to endure it.
“Hand over the treasure!” At this moment, the person closest to them had already arrived.
“Scram!” the large black dog turned around and chided.
“Humph, what an arrogant tone!” That person immediately charged over.
They were fighting over a treasure, after all, so why was there so much blabbering?
The large black dog humphed, and with a wave of his paw, pa, that person was immediately sent flying. He was no match at all.

This was natural. That person was only in the Core Formation Tier, and he didn’t even take a closer look at the cultivation levels of both sides before rashly charging forward. Wasn’t that just courting death?

Xiu, xiu, xiu! More people flew over, but with a precedent, none of them made another move. Instead, they chose to wait. When there were more people, they would battle again. This was also a good choice.
“What’s wrong? This is our family’s treasure, so are you guys planning to snatch it by force?” the large black dog shouted.

“Hehe, young man, when you’re out in the world, remember not to show off your wealth. Otherwise, who else would one rob if not you?” an elder said. His upper body was bare, and there were veined patterns on his skin. They were crimson red in colour, and were still squirming, as if they were flowing with lava.
The large black dog chuckled, and said, “Since that’s the case, I’m relieved. Come, let’s rob
them!”
“Robbery!” the little azure dragon howled. This was something he loved the most.
Everyone was stunned. Yi, what was going on here?
Shouldn’t they be robbing these three people? Why was it that the tables were turned now?
“Let’s go!”
The large black dog and little azure dragon immediately charged out, unleashing their battle prowess as they mercilessly defeated their enemies.
Most of the people here were at the Core Formation Tier. There were True Self Tier elites, but there were only four of them. Even if three of them were at the fourth form of the True Self
Tier, in front of the little azure dragon and the large black dog, they were still defeated one-
sidedly.
In just a few minutes, these people had collapsed all over the ground.
“I’ve been poor recently,” the large black dog mused ruefully as he ransacked the others.

“I have to earn some extra income.” The little azure dragon nodded in agreement. This made the people lying on the ground feel so depressed that they wanted to vomit blood. ‘You guys have gone too far. You’ve already won and snatched, yet you’re still saying such
words to anger them.’
Weng!

Right at this moment, an indescribable aura appeared. The seven suns in the sky seemed to be controlled by an invisible force, forcefully deviating from their original positions. If they were connected with a brush stroke, it was actually a human figure!
The three suns were in a straight line, forming the head and body, while the other four suns had to be distributed farther away. These were the limbs.
Boom, the seven suns all spewed out flames, then instantly cooled down and disappeared. A massive human figure appeared, lying in the galaxy. It was indescribably huge. One eye was
even larger than the sun.

The present galaxy had become dark, but in the next instant, multiple streaks of divine light bloomed, and multiple flowers bloomed furiously. Every single flower was as large as a star. Upon a closer look, those divine clouds and flowers were actually formed from Regulations, representing the order of heaven and earth.
Hiss, this was too shocking!
Pa, pa, pa! Everyone knelt down, involuntarily, unable to control themselves at all.

“Descending Heaven, Holy Emperor!” Only Ling Han did not kneel. Though his Primal Chaos Celestial Core had long since turned into alchemic fluid, and had now become the flesh and blood of the True Self, the abilities that he should possess had not disappeared. Instead, it had fused into Ling Han’s body, and became even more stable.
He mumbled to himself. This indescribably colossal body was none other than the Descending Heaven Holy Emperor’s corpse!

chapters.title: Chapter 4210: Startling the Universe
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
Who would have thought that the so-called saying of Needless Mountains contained the inheritance of the Descending Heaven Holy Emperor, but it was practically the burial ground of the Holy Emperor!

The remains of this Holy Emperor had always been here, but they had never manifested. It was as if they were transparent, and it was only when they were stimulated by the tortoise shell that he finally reappeared in the world.
The body of a Great Emperor!
Ling Han had seen the skin of a Pseudo-Emperor before. It was already world-shakingly powerful, and now... this was the skeletal remains of a true Great Emperor. Just how terrifying would it be?
Even though he had already been dead for countless years, the power of the Great Emperor was superior to the Regulations. Who knew what other tricks he could use after death.
Right at this moment, the tortoise shell suddenly dimmed, and then lit up again. However, this time, it was not soaring into the skies, but rather curled up, wrapping around Ling Han.
Ling Han immediately discovered that there was a force pulling him towards the skies.
“Old Black, Four-Legged Snake!” He hurriedly stimulated the ley lines and grabbed the little azure dragon and the large black dog.
Wrapped in light, xiu, the three of them soared into the sky.
“Ah—”
The large black dog and little azure dragon let out cries at the same time. This speed was too fast, making them feel extremely uncomfortable.
Ling Han, on the other hand, was fine. He was wrapped in that light, and did not feel anything strange at all.
Xiu, they instantly became a small dot, and then disappeared without a trace.
At this moment, the might of the Great Emperor’s aura finally disappeared as well. Everyone scrambled to their feet, their faces still pale. They had not recovered from their shock.
“A body of millions and millions of meters tall, this is a Saint!” A figure from the older generation exclaimed in a trembling voice.
What? The remains of a Saint had appeared?
The others were all astounded. What kind of concept was the corpse of a Saint?

The Saint could be said to be the embodiment of the Regulations, and the fact that it could become millions and millions of meters tall was due to the support of Regulations. It could be claimed that even if a single hair fell from the Saint’s body, that would still be a supreme precious treasure. Not only could it be used to comprehend Dao, it could even be used as a Spirit Tool.
Now that a complete Saint had appeared, just how valuable was this?
Moreover, there might even be Saint Techniques and Saint Tools!
After a moment of shock, everyone started to post a piece of news on the Galaxy Network. They said that a Saint’s corpse had appeared in the High Fiery Galaxy.
It had to be admitted that some people were indeed very despicable.

They themselves didn’t have the ability to fight for the treasures left behind by the “Saint”, so they simply exposed it to the Galaxy Network, letting everyone know. They didn’t want Ling Han and the others to enjoy it alone.
“The corpse of a Saint has appeared?”

This immediately caused a commotion on the Galaxy Network. At the beginning, this was only limited to Venerate Tier-level forces. In fact, even many Holy Lands were not moved. After all, the Holy Lands themselves had Saint-level inheritances, and unless it was confirmed that they could obtain the inheritances of the Saint, there was absolutely no need for them to be rash.
However, when the nearest Venerate Tier elites rushed over, the situation was completely out of control.
‘Holy f*ck! This isn’t the corpse of a Saint! Which idiot has such poor eyesight?’
“Great Emperor’s corpse, Great Emperor’s corpse!”
With these words, the whole universe shook. Not only did the members of the Holy Lands all move out, even the Imperial Clans were completely unable to sit by and watch.

The Great Emperor was an overlord that could only appear once in every era, and was synonymous with invincibility. Just look at how the Imperial Clan that had been left behind after the death of the Great Emperor was still the strongest force in the world, no matter how many years had passed. It was clear just how powerful the Great Emperor was.
And now, the corpse of a Great Emperor had actually appeared in the universe?

In just half a day, several Saints had already arrived. However, even though the Great Emperor had already died, and even though countless years had already passed, the might that he exuded was still extremely terrifying. They were not allowed to approach him at all. Otherwise, even Saints would explode and die.
Another day later, the Saints that were further away also arrived, one after another. When it came to traversing through the Void, Saints surpassed Venerate Tiers by who knew how many times.
However, no matter how many Saints there were, it was useless. In front of Imperial Might, even Saints were as helpless as weeds.
“What? Three people have already entered?”
“They were enveloped by the light that was released from a tortoise shell, and that was why they flew towards the Great Emperor’s corpse. They did not shatter.”
“Those three people... are suspected to be the new Buddha Son of the West Heavenly Realm, as well as his two brothers, who are collectively known as the Three Milk Tea Brothers?”
“Milk, Three Milk Tea Brothers!”
Hearing the combination name of Ling Han and the others, even the Saint was stunned for a moment.
On the third day, another Saint arrived. However, he was even more powerful than all of the Saints gathered together—not himself, but rather the Imperial Weapon that he had brought with him!
The Ziwei Imperial Clan’s Divine Fluid Saint.
“Greetings, friend!” The other Saints all greeted him.

The Divine Fluid Saint was slightly arrogant. His strength was already incredibly powerful, and he more so possessed the Imperial Weapon, a weapon that could easily kill even Saints. Thus, he simply nodded casually before turning his attention to the corpse of the Great Emperor in the universe.
Another while later, an incredibly powerful Saint also arrived.
The Golden Cauldron Imperial Clan’s Rainbow Saint.
“Brother Divine Fluid, did you discover anything?” the Rainbow Light Saint asked.

The Divine Fluid Saint’s expression was arrogant toward the other Saints, but when he faced the Rainbow Light Saint, who was also from the Imperial Clan, he withdrew this attitude, and said slowly, “From appearance, this looks very much like that legendary person.”
“Who?”
“The Descending Heaven Holy Emperor!”
Hiss!

Instantly, there was a sharp intake of breath. Ordinary Saints lacked understanding of Great Emperors, but the Imperial Clans had deep roots, and had not fallen for millions and millions of years, so they naturally had astonishing information.

The Imperial Clans all knew that the Descending Heaven Holy Emperor wasn’t the Great Emperor of the Human Race, but rather the Demon Race. It was an ordinary tortoise, and it had only become a Great Emperor that had suppressed an era after experiencing thousands of tribulations.
Thus, the Divine Fluid Saint came to this conclusion when he saw the tortoise shell on the back of the Great Emperor’s corpse.

“A few days ago, the Mountain Sea Heaven opened, and now, the Descending Heaven Holy Emperor’s remains have suddenly appeared. There is definitely a link between the two,” the Rainbow Light Saint immediately said.
“M-hm,” the Divine Fluid Saint replied with a nod.
“Why don’t we join forces?” the Rainbow Light Saint suggested.

The Divine Fluid Saint immediately looked tempted. If the entire body of a Saint could be considered a treasure, or a Saintly medicine, then the Great Emperor was even more so. His blood could even allow a Saint to live a second life!

Saints were divided into a total of nine minor levels of cultivation level. Right now, he was only standing on the fourth level. Theoretically speaking, there was already no possibility for him to advance any further. However, if he could obtain the Great Emperor’s blood, then it was possible for him to advance a step further, or even a few steps in fact.
“The problem is, will just the two Imperial Weapons work?” he asked darkly.

The might of the Imperial Weapon was equivalent to an Ancestral King coming back to life. Of course, it could resist the might of the Great Emperor’s corpse, but if it was activated by a Saint, how long could it last?
At that time, the Imperial Weapon would suddenly become ineffective. At that time, Imperial Might would sweep over them, and even Saints would be crushed into mush.

“Indeed, two Imperial Weapons aren’t enough insurance,” the Rainbow Light Saint said with a nod. “Three is enough. We’ll take turns activating it, and it’ll be enough to keep the Imperial Weapons in a semi-resuscitating state.”
—It was enough to resist the Imperial Might, and there was no need for the Imperial Weapon to fully awaken. Semi-resuscitation would be enough. This would greatly reduce the pressure on the Saint.
They waited, and after a while, the third Imperial Clan Saint arrived.
The Fire Cloud Imperial Clan’s Fire Leaving Saint.

chapters.title: Chapter 4211: Inner World
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
The three Saints agreed immediately, and immediately brought their clansmen with them, heading towards the stars.
Weng! The Divine Fluid Saint unleashed his Imperial Weapon first. It was only a semi-resuscitated weapon, and it would be fine as long as it could withstand Imperial Might.
The Imperial Weapon protected them, resisting the aura of the Great Emperor as they continued to advance.

They had already arrived in front of the Great Emperor’s corpse. However, this Great Emperor corpse was spread out across a few galaxies, and was incredibly huge. In front of this kind of existence, the distance of 30 meters could be considered close, and 300,000 meters could also be considered close.

“The Descending Heaven Holy Emperor battled his whole life, and has strength that shakes the heaven and earth. The Imperial Weapon he wields is the Black Permanence Sword. It is forged from Eternity Origin Gold, and this material can be ranked in the top ten of all ultimate materials,” the Divine Fluid Saint said, his eyes filled with greed.
The ultimate ingredients that could be used to forge an Imperial Weapon, and to be ranked in the top ten among those, just how valuable was that?

Because there were too few clashes between Imperial Weapons, it was impossible to truly rank them. Thus, there was no difference in ranking among the top ten. The Eternity Origin Gold was completely possible to be the strongest ultimate material.

The Rainbow Light Saint nodded as well. Though he too held an Imperial Weapon in his hands, this belonged to the Golden Cauldron Imperial Clan. It did not belong to him alone. Even if he could be invincible with the Imperial Weapon, if he betrayed the Golden Cauldron Imperial Clan, the Imperial Weapon would automatically awaken and fly back to the Golden Cauldron Imperial Clan.
However, it would be a completely different story if he could obtain the Imperial Weapon that belonged to the Descending Heaven Holy Emperor.

The Descending Heaven Holy Emperor had long since died, and he hadn’t left behind any descendants or bloodline. Thus, as long as one obtained his Imperial Weapon, they would become the true owner of the Imperial Weapon.
Of course, he still needed to obtain the Imperial Scroll of the Descending Heaven Holy Emperor. Otherwise, he wouldn’t be able to activate the Imperial Weapon.
The problem was, with how big the Emperor’s corpse was, how were they supposed to find the Imperial Weapon, the Imperial Scroll and how were they supposed to take the Emperor’s corpse away?
They had to hurry. If the other Saints from the Imperial Clans also arrived here, the competition would become incredibly intense.
“There!” They circled around, and the Fire Leaving Saint pointed at the Descending Heaven Holy Emperor’s right pinky.

To the Descending Heaven Holy Emperor, this was only a finger, but to the outside world, it was even larger than a planet. However, the tip of his finger turned into a mass of Primal Chaos, as if it could be passed through.
“The three people from before must have entered from here,” the Rainbow Light Saint deduced.
“They probably obtained the token of the Holy Emperor, and that’s why the remains of the Holy Emperor directly absorbed them in,” the Divine Fluid Saint speculated.
“Let’s go in quickly,” the Fire Leaving Saint said.

They flew toward the little finger. However, the Imperial Might might became even more terrifying here, and even the semi-resuscitated Imperial Weapon couldn’t withstand it. The Divine Fluid Saint was forced to completely resuscitate the Imperial Weapon.

However, even though a Saint was controlling the Imperial Weapon, it was still extremely straining. It could only last for about five minutes. After the three Saints brought the juniors for a certain distance, the Fire Leaving Saint took over the job and activated the Jade Water Sword.
After travelling for a while longer, they felt that it was impossible for them to pass through this area in the remaining time, so they could only retreat.
“No, we still need more Imperial Weapons.” There was nothing else they could do. They could only continue to wait.

On Ling Han’s side, the three of them were picked up by the tortoise shell, and entered into the galaxy at an incredibly fast speed, directly entering through the little finger of the Descending Heaven Holy Emperor. Then, the tortoise shell quickly dimmed.

“Wa!” The little azure dragon and the large black dog, the two brothers in distress, immediately sprawled out on the sidelines and vomited madly. Previously, they were being carried away at speeds that exceeded their limits, and had no protection at all. It was as if their internal organs were about to run out on their own.
Meanwhile, Ling Han stood up and observed his surroundings.
He could clearly see that he had entered into the body of the Descending Heaven Holy Emperor. His position was on the little finger of his right hand, but now?
This was an ordinary forest, where the sun shone brightly.
However, Ling Han could tell with a single glance that this was one of the seven suns of the High Fiery Galaxy. It had a unique purple-coloured brilliance shining.
A world had evolved inside the corpse of a Great Emperor?

Ling Han took a deep breath. No matter how strange it was, this was the best chance for him to obtain the Imperial Scroll. Otherwise, which Imperial Clan could he go to steal something that was the ultimate treasure of the clan?
“The two of you... are you done throwing up?” He turned around and asked the little azure dragon and the large black dog.

“That’s about it,” the large black dog said weakly. He had just stood up, and after taking two steps, he sprawled out on one side and started to vomit again, “Let Grandpa Dog vomit for a while longer.”

Finally, the dog and dragon rested for half a day’s time, and only then did they feel slightly better. They could walk, but when they walked, their bodies were swaying, as if they had suffered a serious illness, and were incredibly weak.

“If I can’t obtain the Imperial Scroll this time, then Grandpa Dog will definitely curse this Descending Heaven Holy Emperor to death!” The large black dog gritted his teeth. He had really lost half his life.
“I’ve never suffered like this in my life!” the little azure dragon also moaned repeatedly.
“All right, hurry up and follow,” Ling Han said, leading the way ahead.

This was the inside of a Great Emperor’s body, but because it had developed a world, it no longer had a terrifying pressure. Otherwise, if they were so close to a Holy Emperor’s body, it was guaranteed that eveb Saints would explode.

“This can’t be considered a world, because the Emperor’s corpse is too colossal. It can only be said to be a space inside him.” Ling Han thought for a moment, and felt that this kind of explanation was more appropriate.
“Who cares if it’s a world or an internal space? Let’s hurry up and get the Imperial Scroll,” the large black dog said.
“However, where should we go?” Ling Han flew into the sky. The Regulations here were no different from the outside world, and there was no terrifying gravity suppression, so he could fly freely.
He looked around, but could not see anything unusual.
‘Oh, right.’
He took out the tortoise shell. It was no longer blindingly bright, but every veined pattern was still glowing slightly, interweaving into incredibly complex patterns.
“Er, no way?”
Ling Han gritted his teeth, and once again slipped into the tortoise shell, but this time, he did not see anything.
It was obviously not to be used like this.
This tortoise shell had led them here, and had also led them into the corpse of the Holy Emperor. Then, it should continue to guide them step by step, to find the inheritance of the Holy Emperor.
“How should I use it?” Ling Han mumbled.
“Dripping blood,” the little azure dragon suggested.
“That’s right.” Ling Han’s eyes lit up. He could give it a try.
“Hey, hey, hey, why are you staring at Grandpa Dragon?” The little azure dragon was a little hairy.
“You are a descendant of the True Dragon, and your bloodline is pure. The effects of your blood should be extremely good,” Ling Han said.
“Come, Four-Legged Snake. Don’t be stingy, donate some,” the large black dog said from the side.

The little azure dragon hurriedly fled. “Get lost, whose blood isn’t blood! Grandpa Dragon’s blood is extremely precious, and when Grandpa Dragon becomes a Saint, it’ll be able to revive the dead. How can it be wasted like this?”
“Precisely because the effects are good, I have to use yours!” Ling Han chased after him.
“Little Han, this is a good chance for a battle. Whoever loses will donate their blood,” the little azure dragon howled. It wasn’t afraid of Ling Han.

The man and dragon began to fight fiercely, and the little azure dragon also returned to its original form. He was still suited to battle in dragon form, as it could allow him to unleash his strongest battle prowess.

“F*ck! The murderous aura attacks, the battle prowess suppression, the black light of illusion...” the little azure dragon screamed in agony. Ling Han unleashed his ultimate moves, suppressing it in the shortest amount of time.
“Little Han, you are too despicable!”
He was forced to bleed.

He was still suited to battle in dragon form, as it could allow him to unleash his strongest battle prowess.
“F*ck!
The murderous aura attacks, the battle prowess suppression, the black light of illusion...” the little azure dragon screamed in agony.
Ling Han unleashed his ultimate moves, suppressing it in the shortest amount of time.
“Little Han, you are too despicable!”
He was forced to bleed.

chapters.title: Chapter 4212: Zhu Dongkui
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
The little azure dragon watched from the sidelines, its eyes plaintive.
His blood had been rubbed on the shell of the tortoise, and it was a pool of red.
Weng, the tortoise shell actually began to spin, and then a streak of light shot out, shooting into the distance.
“You two, why are you letting me bleed so much? Just a little bit is enough.” When the little azure dragon saw this, it immediately complained.

“Er, who knows, you might have to rub it again in the future. Thus, it’s better to have a short-term pain than a long-term pain. I’ll do it all in one go, to prevent you from tormenting you a few more times,” the large black dog said seriously.
“Then I’ll have to thank you,” the little azure dragon said through gritted teeth.
The large black dog felt a little guilty. Previously, it was him who had shouted that it was not enough, and he had to release more.
“Let’s go, let’s go. The Imperial Scroll is waiting for us.” It tried to change the topic.
“Old Black, this isn’t over!” The little azure dragon’s resentment was very strong.
The three of them set off, heading in the direction indicated by the pillar of light.

This place was incredibly vast, and furthermore, it was the inside of the corpse of a Great Emperor, so it naturally could not be measured with common sense. There were green mountains and clear waters along the way. After travelling for three days, they took out their tortoise shell and were once again pointed in a direction.
“Yi, we’re close!”
They discovered that this tortoise shell was pointing directly at a valley ahead of them.
The three of them descended, and entered into the valley, but very carefully.
“Hahaha!” The large black dog suddenly laughed.
“Ol’ Black, what’s wrong with you!” the little azure dragon hurriedly rebuked. ‘You’re too scary, laughing so suddenly. Don’t you know that you can scare people to death in this kind of situation?’
The large black dog hurriedly covered his mouth, cocked his head, and said, “Strange, Grandpa Dog suddenly felt like laughing, and couldn’t control himself from laughing out loud.”
“Idiot!” The little azure dragon shook its head, then burst into laughter as well.
“What’s so funny?” The large black dog jumped up.
“I just find it funny!” The little azure dragon was still laughing.
Ling Han moved, and held down the dog and dragon. He frowned slightly, and said, “There seems to be something off about the situation.”
“What’s not right?” The little azure dragon bared its teeth in a grin.
“That’s right. What’s off about it?” The large black dog’s mouth was also crooked, and he was all smiles.
“Something’s very wrong,” Ling Han said. This was because he also felt an urge to laugh. However, in this situation, there should be nothing that could trigger his laughter.
Thus, there was something off about this valley.

However, precisely because of this, it meant that the tortoise shell had not pointed blindly. The outside world was too ordinary. Only when there was a disparity, would it mean that they were closer to the Imperial Scroll.

With Ling Han’s reminder, the little azure dragon and the large black dog both became serious, but the smile at the corners of their mouths couldn’t be suppressed no matter what. Their expressions appeared very funny, both cautious and wanting to grin widely.
They continued to walk, and they hadn’t walked too far when they saw a figure appear before them. This person’s back was facing them.
What? There was actually another person here?
Furthermore, looking at his slightly trembling body, it seemed like he was speaking.
“... Hahaha, isn’t it funny?”
They walked closer, and finally heard what that person was saying.
However, right at this moment, this person suddenly turned around, facing the three of them.
Ya, and a handsome man at that. He had an imposing, intimidating appearance.
“Who are you?” the little azure dragon shouted.

“Now that you have entered into my, Zhu Dongkui’s territory, shouldn’t you take the initiative to announce your name?” That handsome man said. The moment the words left his mouth, he couldn’t help but hold his chin, “Aiya, I seem to have spoken my own name!”
“Hahaha, another slip of the tongue!” However, he immediately laughed loudly, filled with the spirit of self-amusement.
“Crazy!” the little azure dragon said in a low voice to Ling Han and the large black dog.
“Hey, hey, hey. Four-Legged Snake, what are you babbling about?” Zhu Dongkui immediately shouted.
“I’m a True Dragon, and you’re the Four-Legged Snake. Your entire family are Four-Legged Snakes!” The little azure dragon was enraged, and it raised its claws in rebuke.

“True Dragon?” Zhu Dongkui scratched his head, “In the past, I have indeed raised a descendant of the Dragon Race. His bloodline is quite pure, and he has cultivated to Saint Tier. Unfortunately, he died of old age a very long time ago.”
‘Holy f*ck! Is this real?!’
Ling Han and the others exchanged looks, all thinking that this man was boasting. Raising a Saint-level beast pet? Did he think he was a Great Emperor!
No, this was the corpse of a Great Emperor. This person couldn’t be the Descending Heaven Holy Emperor, a sliver of his divine sense that had yet to dissipate, right?
That was possible.
“Senior, do you have anything for us?” The large black dog rubbed his paws together, an expectant expression on his face.
“Looking at how sneaky you are, I can tell at a glance that you are not a good person,” Zhu Dongkui said, then laughed loudly, “This is a good analogy!”
Good your head!
“Senior, why are you here?” Ling Han asked.
“Oh, waiting for someone to issue a challenge.” Zhu Dongkui counted, “How many years have I been waiting here? 100 million years? One billion years? Sigh, I can’t remember.”
“Hahahaha, I actually can’t remember clearly. What a joke.”

Ling Han felt apprehensive. This Zhu Dongkui loved to laugh so much, was it because of the environmental influence of this place, or was it that he loved to laugh in the first place, which had affected the environment?
If it was the latter, then this guy’s strength was too inconceivable.
“Which one of you is going to challenge me?” Zhu Dongkui asked, all smiles. It was as if he maintained a cheerful mentality at all times.
“Him.” The little azure dragon and the large black dog pointed at Ling Han at the same time.
Since this Zhu Dongkui had been placed here by the Holy Emperor, his abilities were definitely powerful to the extreme. It must be Ling Han. They did not want to be beaten.
Ling Han smiled, and said, “Senior’s martial arts skills are unparalleled, so I’m definitely no match for you.”
“Hahaha, how could I, Zhu Dongkui, possibly bully a junior? Don’t worry, I will suppress my cultivation level to the same level as you!” Zhu Dongkui laughed loudly.
“All right!”
Ling Han nodded, and immediately charged over.
“F***!” Zhu Dongkui humphed lowly. This brat was really too direct.
However, he was extremely powerful, so he naturally wouldn’t be wounded. He immediately humphed lowly and suppressed his cultivation level. Then, he delivered a palm strike at Ling Han.
Peng!
The two of them exchanged a blow, and Zhu Dongkui immediately let out a surprised exclamation. His figure was forced into continuous retreat.
“Brat, you actually cultivated Body Art at the same time!” he said.
“Hehe.” Ling Han merely chuckled.
Zhu Dongkui shouted lightly, and counterattacked, delivering another palm strike.
Ling Han was naturally happy to clash head-on with him. Power was his strength in the first place, and within the same cultivation level, it could be claimed that he was peerless.
Peng!
In this exchange, both Ling Han and Zhu Dongkui retreated at the same time, though Zhu Dongkui retreated slightly further than Ling Han.
Ling Han was astonished to discover that his opponent’s power had increased by a significant amount. It was as if he had also fused these two powers together.
“Senior, you’re shameless!” he immediately said.
“Hahaha, what shamelessness!” Zhu Dongkui shook his head, as he continued to attack, “I have cultivated Body Arts in the first place, but I had not channelled it previously.”

Ling Han only protested slightly, and did not take it to heart too much. That was because though Zhu Dongkui had also cultivated Body Art, he was clearly inferior to him. He should have only reached Ninth Heaven. Thus, when the two powers were fused, he was still slightly weaker than him.
Let’s battle!
