chapters.title: Chapter 4213: Seven Saints Arrive
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
Ling Han and Zhu Dongkui clashed fiercely.
After Ding Shu, Ling Han encountered another opponent that could be considered troublesome.

Zhu Dongkui was extremely strong, and his power was only slightly inferior to Ling Han’s. However, he had grasped the Imperial Technique, as well as the Imperial Scroll. This was enough to increase his battle prowess by nine Heavens!
As for Ling Han?
Even if he channelled the Imperial Technique, it could only increase his battle prowess by seven Heavens.
With this addition and decrease, it was shockingly Zhu Dongkui’s battle prowess that was slightly over one Heaven stronger than Ling Han.
Ling Han was instantly suppressed.
What!
The little azure dragon and the large black dog both paled. This was the first time they had seen Ling Han being suppressed in a battle of equals.
What kind of existence had this Zhu Dongkui been all those years ago? He was really too strong, wasn’t he?

—This was definitely not a real person. Even the Ancestral King only had a lifespan of 10 million years. Even if he lived a second life, it would only be 20 million years, at most, which was still a long way off 100 million years.
Thus, this Zhu Dongkui should have been transformed from the thought of the Descending Heaven Holy Emperor.
Yi, could it be that he was an opponent on the Holy Emperor’s Imperial Path from long ago?

With this in mind, the little azure dragon and the large black dog inhaled sharply at the same time. At that time, this Great Emperor’s journey was really too bumpy, wasn’t it? Even his opponent was so powerful.
If even the Holy Emperor’s opponent from all those years ago couldn’t be razed to the ground, then what right did he have to obtain the inheritance of the Descending Heaven Holy Emperor?
F***, this was too freakish.
Yet Ling Han’s fighting spirit soared. This opponent was strong enough, so he should be able to unleash his full potential and temper himself.
Weng! The murderous aura surged forth.
However, this was completely ineffective.

Ling Han finally understood. His opponent wasn’t a real person, and he was only formed from a sliver of intent from the Ancestral King. Thus, he naturally wouldn’t be struck by the murderous aura. He already had this guess, and unleashing the murderous aura attack was only to prove it.
Similarly, he could not weaken his opponent’s battle prowess either, for the same reason.
However, his ability to neutralize attacks would not be affected, because this originated from himself, and would not change based on whether his opponent was human or otherwise.
Thus, though Zhu Dongkui’s battle prowess was over one Heaven stronger than him, he could only suppress him for a while, but could not wound him at all.
Both sides were still evenly matched.
“Yi, you actually cultivated this kind of Mystical Power!” Zhu Dongkui showed a hint of surprise, “Hahaha, you really gave me a shock!”
Ling Han’s attacks changed drastically. It was clear that his techniques were unchanged, but there was a natural charm to them. Every move and every form was filled with ethereality.

“Haha, a pleasant surprise, this is really a pleasant surprise!” Zhu Dongkui laughed loudly, “You have already begun to walk your own path, which is something to be happy about! However, this path is long, and filled with deviations, so it is not easy to walk.”
Ling Han smiled. This was natural. If they had a peaceful journey, how could there only be one Great Emperor in an era?
“Let me experience the might of a descendant like you.” Zhu Dongkui’s aura also changed.

Previously, though he was strong, his moves were actually a little stiff. It was as if he had only brought the powerful Imperial Technique here, and his own comprehension was not included in it. But now, he seemed to have walked his own path just like Ling Han.
Every move and action was filled with intelligence.
His battle prowess had increased inconceivably.
How many?
Three Heavens!
Hiss!
In his hands, the Imperial Technique could actually increase might by twelve Heavens.
This was practically inconceivable. It was as if this Imperial Technique was created by him, so it could unleash its strongest might.
No way?
A deduction rose up in Ling Han’s heart, but his fighting spirit did not weaken in the slightest. Instead, it became even higher.
Defeating this kind of opponent would be more interesting.

Furthermore, even if Zhu Dongkui’s battle prowess had increased further by three Heavens, he was still within the range of Ling Han’s abilities. He could not be wounded at all, and was only being suppressed even more thoroughly.

“The Primal Chaos Regulations is indeed powerful!” Zhu Dong Kui exclaimed ruefully. “But it’s really strange. Without becoming an Ancestral King, how did you manage to grasp this kind of supreme Regulations?”
He appeared slightly puzzled.
A thought flashed in Ling Han’s head, “Senior, my ability to disperse attacks is Primal Chaos Regulations?”

“That’s right. This is the strongest path of defense in the world.” Zhu Dongkui nodded, and couldn’t help but grin widely and laugh loudly, “Strange, strange, really strange. What kind of freak are you, brat?”

The two of them continued to battle. However, one had the advantage in battle prowess, while the other had an invincible defense. In a battle at the same cultivation level, it was truly too difficult to determine the victor.
Of course, this was unless one side was completely exhausted.
Ling Han used all his ultimate moves, one after another, but even the Imperial Technique was like child’s play in front of Zhu Dongkui. He could easily unravel it, and it was completely ineffective.

“Haha, found it!” There was a loud laugh, and seven Saints appeared at the same time, floating in midair. The Regulations all turned into golden lotuses, auspicious clouds, fortune clouds, and the like, supporting them.
Aside from the seven Saints, there was also a large group of their juniors.
“Come over here!” The Fire Leaving Saint was the first to move, grabbing out at Ling Han.
“Hahaha, to dare make a move in front of me, Zhu Dongkui, are you tired of living?” Zhu Dongkui cast Ling Han aside, and stepped forwards to greet the Fire Leaving Saint.
Pa! He lashed out with his palm, instantly blocking the Fire Leaving Saint’s attack. In fact, the strike still had some energy left, and continued to attack the Fire Leaving Saint.
The Fire Leaving Saint unleashed another strike, and only then did the might of this strike completely dissipate.
He couldn’t help but feel astonished. This person was actually a Saint?
But you are a great Saint, so what the heck do you mean by exchanging blows with a True Self Tier?
“Friend, may I ask how should I address you?” the Fire Leaving Saint asked.
“Are you stupid!” Zhu Dongkui rebuked. He had introduced himself right off the bat.

The Fire Leaving Saint naturally knew that his opponent was called Zhu Dongkui. However, he didn’t have any recollection of this name, so he asked Zhu Dongkui how he should be addressed. This question was about the title of a Saint.
His expression changed drastically. As a Saint, he had actually been insulted?
Moreover, he was a Saint of the Imperial Clan!
“Friend, you’ve gone too far!” he said balefully.
Zhu Dongkui laughed loudly, “I am responsible for standing guard here. Whoever comes, I will treat them the same. If they can take a hundred moves from me, they would be able to pass.”
Ling Han was instantly speechless, “Senior, didn’t you say that I would only be able to pass if I defeated you?”
“Oh, that was just teasing you,” Zhu Dongkui said casually.
What the heck!
Ling Han felt like he was about to go crazy. Was this very fun? Very fun!

“All right, then let this Saint experience a few moves from my friend,” the Fire Leaving Saint said calmly. He pressed down with his palm again, and lotus flowers bloomed all over the sky. The Regulations of heaven and earth appeared, turning into tens of thousands of divine chains that descended down on Zhu Dongkui.
“Too weak!” Zhu Dongkui humphed, and with a casual wave of his hand, the heaven and earth immediately regained its clarity.
Hiss!
The seven Saints inhaled sharply at the same time, a stunned expression on their faces.
They were both Four-Star Saints, but Zhu Dongkui’s grasp of Regulations was forcibly much higher than the Fire Leaving Saint.
“Humph!” The Fire Leaving Saint made another move. This time, he was serious.
Hong, a fire dragon appeared, completely made up of Regulations of Fire, roaring towards Zhu Dongkui.
Ling Han was stunned. The might of this fire dragon was only slightly inferior to the complete Heavenly Dao Flames. It could burn even Saints to death.

Ling Han used all his ultimate moves, one after another, but even the Imperial Technique was like child’s play in front of Zhu Dongkui.
He could easily unravel it, and it was completely ineffective.
“Haha, found it!” There was a loud laugh, and seven Saints appeared at the same time, floating in midair.
The Regulations all turned into golden lotuses, auspicious clouds, fortune clouds, and the like, supporting them.
Aside from the seven Saints, there was also a large group of their juniors.
“Come over here!” The Fire Leaving Saint was the first to move, grabbing out at Ling Han.
“Hahaha, to dare make a move in front of me, Zhu Dongkui, are you tired of living?” Zhu Dongkui cast Ling Han aside, and stepped forwards to greet the Fire Leaving Saint.
Pa!
He lashed out with his palm, instantly blocking the Fire Leaving Saint’s attack.
In fact, the strike still had some energy left, and continued to attack the Fire Leaving Saint.
The Fire Leaving Saint unleashed another strike, and only then did the might of this strike completely dissipate.
He couldn’t help but feel astonished.
This person was actually a Saint?
But you are a great Saint, so what the heck do you mean by exchanging blows with a True Self Tier?
“Friend, may I ask how should I address you?” the Fire Leaving Saint asked.
“Are you stupid!” Zhu Dongkui rebuked.
He had introduced himself right off the bat.
The Fire Leaving Saint naturally knew that his opponent was called Zhu Dongkui.
However, he didn’t have any recollection of this name, so he asked Zhu Dongkui how he should be addressed.
This question was about the title of a Saint.
His expression changed drastically.
As a Saint, he had actually been insulted?
Moreover, he was a Saint of the Imperial Clan!
“Friend, you’ve gone too far!” he said balefully.
Zhu Dongkui laughed loudly, “I am responsible for standing guard here.
Whoever comes, I will treat them the same.
If they can take a hundred moves from me, they would be able to pass.”
Ling Han was instantly speechless, “Senior, didn’t you say that I would only be able to pass if I defeated you?”
“Oh, that was just teasing you,” Zhu Dongkui said casually.
What the heck!
Ling Han felt like he was about to go crazy.
Was this very fun?
Very fun!
“All right, then let this Saint experience a few moves from my friend,” the Fire Leaving Saint said calmly.
He pressed down with his palm again, and lotus flowers bloomed all over the sky.
The Regulations of heaven and earth appeared, turning into tens of thousands of divine chains that descended down on Zhu Dongkui.
“Too weak!” Zhu Dongkui humphed, and with a casual wave of his hand, the heaven and earth immediately regained its clarity.
Hiss!
The seven Saints inhaled sharply at the same time, a stunned expression on their faces.
They were both Four-Star Saints, but Zhu Dongkui’s grasp of Regulations was forcibly much higher than the Fire Leaving Saint.
“Humph!” The Fire Leaving Saint made another move.
This time, he was serious.
Hong, a fire dragon appeared, completely made up of Regulations of Fire, roaring towards Zhu Dongkui.
Ling Han was stunned.
The might of this fire dragon was only slightly inferior to the complete Heavenly Dao Flames.
It could burn even Saints to death.

chapters.title: Chapter 4214: Suppressing Saints
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
Zhu Dongkui strode forwards, and greeted the fire dragon. He grabbed hold of the fire dragon in a single move, then exerted force with both hands. Pa, this fire dragon was forcibly torn apart by him.
F***, this was too violent, wasn’t it?
Ling Han felt his head go numb from watching. Just how strong was this Zhu Dongkui?

No, no, no, this Zhu Dongkui should have been formed from a sliver of intent from the Descending Heaven Holy Emperor. Even a sliver of intent was so powerful. It was really unimaginable just how powerful this Holy Emperor had once been.
Zhu Dongkui threw away the fire dragon, and continued to charge towards the Fire Leaving Saint. Brandishing his palms, endless Regulations turned into swords that shot towards the Fire Leaving Saint.
Just how strong was he?
In the case of True Self Tier, the Imperial Technique could unleash a battle prowess of 12 Heavens in his hands. In the case of Saint Tier, this similarly far surpassed the standard battle prowess.
Hong! Hong! Hong!
In just a few moves, the Fire Leaving Saint was suppressed. In a battle of equal cultivation levels, Zhu Dongkui was unbelievably strong.
It was only seventeen moves, and Zhu Dongkui shot out a kick, and the Fire Leaving Saint was sent flying.

The Fire Leaving Saint steadied himself. There was a trace of blood at the corner of his lips, and there was a footprint on his chest. Compared to the holy image of a lotus blooming beneath his feet, and auspicious red clouds entwined all over his body, this was incredibly obvious.
“Next,” Zhu Dongkui said calmly.
The Fire Leaving Saint had been defeated, and he had only used 17 moves.
No wonder Zhu Dongkui dared to say that as long as one could last a hundred moves from him, he would be able to pass. Just how difficult was that?
It should be known that those that could become Saints, which one of them was not a prodigy among prodigies?

The remaining six Saints remained silent. Their battle prowess was not much different from the Fire Leaving Saint. Whether they were stronger or weaker, the difference was extremely small. Thus, the Fire Leaving Saint had lost in 17 moves. If it was them, the result would also be similar.
Then what need was there to seek his own humiliation?
However, the inheritance of the Great Emperor was given up just like that?

“Humph, I haven’t lost yet!” The Fire Leaving Saint summoned his Imperial Weapon. ‘F*ck! I’m a member of the Imperial Clan. With the Imperial Weapon in my hands, I’m the strongest in the world, so why do I have to abide by your rules?’
Zhu Dongkui swept an eye over it, and said, “Imperial Weapon!”
“That’s right!” the Fire Leaving Saint said coldly. “Hand over the inheritance of the Descending Heaven Holy Emperor. Otherwise, don’t blame me for being ruthless!”
“Hahahaha!” Zhu Dongkui laughed loudly, as if there was no one else present. It was as if he did not take the Fire Leaving Saint seriously at all.
This caused the Fire Leaving Saint to feel even more furious. He was wielding the Imperial Weapon, and in an era when there were no Emperor in the world, he could be considered the strongest.
You dare to look down on me?
Weng, the Imperial Weapon immediately revived, emitting an Imperial Might that was indescribably terrifying.
The Great Emperor was invincible in the world.
“I’ll ask you again. Where is the inheritance of the Holy Emperor?”
Zhu Dongkui bared his teeth in a grin, and actually took the initiative to charge out. His palms struck out rapidly, blasting towards the Fire Leaving Saint.
This was his answer.

“You’re seeking death!” the Fire Leaving Saint said with a cold chuckle. He brandished the Jade Water Sword, unleashing an incredibly bright slash. It was as if it could even illuminate the darkest corner of the universe.
The Imperial Weapon unleashed its might, slashing towards a Saint. What suspense was there left in this?
The Rainbow Light Saint and the others all shook their heads. They felt that Zhu Dongkui was truly unreasonably arrogant, yet the result was him seeking his own demise.
Guang!
A sound rang out, like the beginning of the universe, resounding throughout the world.
What!
Everyone couldn’t help but feel numb, because they saw an inconceivable scene.
—Zhu Dongkui stretched out his right hand, and blocked the Jade Water Sword.
‘F*ck! That’s an Imperial Weapon! A genuine Imperial Weapon isn’t a replica!’
This strike from the Imperial Weapon was equivalent to the attack of a Great Emperor. Which Saint could withstand it?

Everyone could clearly see that there were Regulations floating on Zhu Dongkui’s right hand, and there was also a dark yellow high-level energy. It was the compounding of these two powers that had blocked the Imperial Weapon.
It should be known that why was the Imperial Weapon so powerful that it could kill Saints?

That was because after the Imperial Weapon had been refined by the Great Emperor, it could stimulate the Regulations of the highest level, and suppress any opponent with Regulations. Whether you are a Saint or not, you would only be turned into dust!

However, Zhu Dongkui was actually able to stimulate the highest level Regulations. This naturally gave him the ability to oppose the Imperial Weapon, and the nine-star high-level energy cancelled out the destructive power of the Imperial Weapon itself, reaching a perfect balance.
All of a sudden, all the Saints were trembling.
To parry an Imperial Weapon with his bare hands, what kind of freak was this?
Only an Ancestral King could do this!
—They actually took the initiative to provoke an Ancestral King. Wasn’t that just seeking their own death?

At that time, Buddha Doga was only a Pseudo-Emperor, and he had practically slaughtered all the Saints in the world. If an Ancestral King appeared, Saints? Even if all the Saints of all the Imperial Clans came with their Imperial Weapons, they would only be defeated by the Ancestral King, one after another.
The fact that a Great Emperor was invincible was definitely not just empty words.
However, how could a Great Emperor appear from within the corpse of a Holy Emperor?
Hiss!
All of a sudden, the Saints understood.
“This is the manifestation of the Holy Emperor’s divine sense!”

No wonder he was overwhelmingly powerful. In a battle of equal cultivation levels, even the Saint had been defeated by him in seventeen moves. It should be known that the Imperial Son was synonymous with being invincible among his peers, then what about the true Great Emperor?
“Greetings, Lord Holy Emperor!” The seven Saints bowed at the same time, and those juniors of the Imperial Clans all knelt down.
The Great Emperor stood high above the Nine Heavens, and the rest were mediocre. No one could stand on equal footing with them.
“Hahaha, what Holy Emperor? I am Zhu Dongkui !” Zhu Dongkui casually shook his hand, and the Jade Water Sword bounced back. He stood, arms crossed behind his back, his expression enchanting.

Unfortunately, everyone knew that this was only formed from a sliver of divine sense of the Holy Emperor. Following the appearance of the Holy Emperor’s corpse, this sliver of divine sense would most likely begin to dissipate as well. It definitely wouldn’t last long.
The power of heaven and earth naturally had its own channeling rhythm. When a person died, their Dao would disappear. This was something that even the Great Emperor’s power could not change.
“If you want to pass, you only need to block a hundred moves from me.” Zhu Dongkui laughed loudly. Actually, there was clearly nothing funny about this, but he just liked to laugh.

The Saints were still fine, but those juniors were all grinning. Because they knew that they could not laugh, fearing that they would anger the embodiment of this Holy Emperor, they were holding back very hard, even tearing up.
“Senior, what about us?” Ling Han asked.
“Oh, you guys have passed.” With a casual wave of Zhu Dongkuii’s hand, shua, Ling Han and the others were swept up by him, turning into a ball of light. Xiu, they flew off to who knows where.
The seven Saints didn’t dare to stop him. The Holy Emperor was right in front of them, so even if this was just a sliver of divine sense, who would dare to mess around?
They did indeed have the Imperial Weapons in their possession, but at most, it was only for self-protection. They wanted to suppress a Holy Emperor?
You’ve got to be joking, right?
“We definitely can’t block a hundred moves from a Holy Emperor.”
“Go and call the Golden Generation over. They all have the potential to become Emepror, so they should be able to stop him.”
“Agreed!”
The seven Saints all nodded. If the Golden Generation could not even block a hundred moves from the Holy Emperor, then what right would they have to attempt the Imperial Path?
They first exited the corpse of the Holy Emperor. This place had completely blocked the Galaxy Network’s signal, so they definitely had to leave first.
“Quick, those three juniors are already aheadof us.”
“Is the Buddhist Race so lucky this time? They actually found such an outstanding talent!”
“Should we suppress them?”

“The waters of the Buddhist Race are very deep, but as long as we don’t trifle with the Buddhist Race from outside the 33 Heavens, it’s fine. As for the Buddhist Race from the four Heavenly Realms, it’s fine to suppress them for a bit.”

chapters.title: Chapter 4215: Longing
paragraphs: Ling Han and the others were enveloped by a streak of light, and began to traverse at an extremely fast speed.
They could see very clearly that the three of them had passed through the right arm of the corpse of the Holy Emperor and arrived in the left arm.
Then, they discovered that this was another scene of lush mountains and clear waters.
It was ordinary and unremarkable, just like before.
“Come, continue scouting the way with your tortoise shell,” the large black dog said.

Their speed was far inferior to that of Saints. Thus, if they wanted to explore this place once, they would need at least ten days to half a month, and in the case of Saints, they probably wouldn’t even need half a day’s time.
Thus, the tortoise shell’s guidance was extremely crucial to them.
Weng, after rubbing on the blood, the tortoise shell began to glow again.
“Look, your blood hasn’t gone to waste, right?” the large black dog said to the little azure dragon as he pointed at the tortoise shell.
“Get lost!” The little azure dragon’s expression was dark. He actually dared to talk about this with him.
They followed the light, and after another three days, they finally arrived at the finishing line. This time, the light was pointing at the summit.

They left, and had not taken a few steps, when a strong longing surged up in his heart. Ling Han couldn’t help but think of the empress, Hu Niu and the other beautiful wives, as well as Ling Jianxue, Ling Xi, and his other children.
“Flower underpants, white underpants, black underpants...” Meanwhile, the large black dog’s eyes were hazy, and it felt like it was about to cry.
“Father!” The little azure dragon’s face was also filled with longing.
F***, he had been affected again!
“An... Ma... Ni... Ba... Mi... Gu...!” Ling Han immediately shouted out the Six Characters Bright King Curse loudly, which was thought-provoking, directly penetrating into the depths of the mind.
The three of them were startled at the same time, and the longing that lingered in their hearts instantly dispersed.
“It made people laugh before, but this place makes people involuntarily miss the treasures in their hearts,” Ling Han said with a frown.
“Haha, Old Black, so the most precious thing in your heart is actually your underpants!” The little azure dragon laughed loudly.
Yet the large black dog was unconcerned, and swayed his behind, “Otherwise, what do you think?”

The little azure dragon hurriedly used its claws to block in front of its face, saying, “Stop swaying. Grandpa Dragon doesn’t have a dog’s eyes, so I’m going to go blind!” It was also rendered speechless. At first, it had thought that it had grasped a sore point of the large black dog. Unexpectedly, the large black dog was completely shameless, and this couldn’t do anything to it at all.
The three of them all recited the six words of the ‘Six Characters Bright King Curse’ in their minds, and then headed up the mountain.
It wasn’t long before they arrived at the summit.
There was a person seated here. Her hair was extremely long, and her back was slender. It should be a woman.
“Senior.” Ling Han spoke up.
This person stood up, her figure graceful, her figure enchanting, but when she turned around, Ling Han, Ling Han and the others were all gaping widely.
That was because this was not a woman, but rather a man.
However, he was really handsome, and was filled with a feminine air. Thus, from the back, one would completely misunderstand his gender.

“Sigh, long-lasting yearning, short-lasting yearning, yearning brings calamity,” this effeminate man said slowly. Even his voice was very neutral. Without looking at his face, it was completely impossible to distinguish whether he was male or female.
“Greetings, Senior,” Ling Han clasped his hands and said. This should also be a manifestation of a sliver of divine sense from the Descending Heaven Holy Emperor.
“Block a hundred moves from me. If you succeed, you will pass, but if you fail, you will die,” the feminine man said.
Alright, though he was a little feminine, he was at least more honest, and was much better than Zhu Dongkui.
Ling Han stepped forward and said, “Please provide guidance, Senior.”
“Humph, I’ll choose!” the feminine man said. He then pointed at the large black dog, and said, “You go first.”
“Ah?” The large black dog gritted his teeth. He was the first?

It was slightly anxious. This was manifested from a sliver of thought of the Holy Emperor. Though his personality was completely different from the previous Zhu Dongkui, it was sure that his abilities would not be much different.
Furthermore, this guy was too vicious. He would die if he could not block hundred moves from him. That was too dangerous, wasn’t it?
“Can Little Black choose not to fight?” the large black dog asked cautiously.
“Those who I call out will be killed,” the feminine man stated calmly, his face filled with longing again.
Helpless, the large black dog had no choice but to step forward and say, “Senior, you have to be gentle. Little Black can’t withstand any damage!”
Ling Han and the little azure dragon felt like throwing up. This large black dog was far too
shameless.
The feminine man did not speak further, and immediately charged over.
The large black dog let out a strange cry, and brandished his paws to parry.

It was actually not weak. For better or worse, it was a Nine Cauldrons Fusion Cauldron. Furthermore, it had also cultivated Body Art and Imperial Technique, so its battle prowess was stronger than even a great many Imperial Sons.
Thus, even though the feminine man was incredibly powerful, it was still extremely difficult for him to defeat the large black dog in 100 moves at the same cultivation level.
The large black dog was riddled with wounds, yet he finally managed to withstand 100 strikes. “Scram!” The feminine man kicked the large black dog, sending him flying.
“Next, you.” The feminine man pointed at the little azure dragon.
“Come!” Though the little azure dragon had a bad mouth, it was only verbal. It was still very headstrong, and immediately charged towards the effeminate man.
He didn’t launch a long-distance attack. Instead, he directly rammed into him, making full use of Body Arts’s advantage.
“En?” The feminine man appeared slightly surprised, but as he delivered a palm strike, the power of his strike instantly increased further.
F***, fighting with the people here, Body Arts did not actually have an advantage, because if you used the power of Body Arts, your opponent would also use it, or not use it at all.
Boom!
In terms of power, the little azure dragon was evenly matched with its opponent, but when it came to Imperial Technique, the little azure dragon was far inferior.
Thankfully, there was only a gap of two Heavens.
The little azure dragon’s physique was sturdy, and it could withstand blows. The gap of two Heavens of battle prowess could only suppress him, but couldn’t cause serious injury.

Of course, this was only because the effeminate man hadn’t truly become serious yet. Otherwise, if the Imperial Technique unleashed might of 12 Heavens, the little azure dragon would probably be severely wounded in an instant. After all, he didn’t have the ability to
disperse attacks.
Very quickly, a hundred moves had passed, and the little azure dragon had also withstood it. “You.” The feminine man finally pointed at Ling Han.
Ling Han gave a soft shout, and unleashed his full battle prowess as he charged towards his
opponent.

The feminine man gave another ‘yi’. He had not thought that these every single person from these three “people” would actually be stronger than the last. At this time, he instead showed a smile, and waved his hands. His battle prowess had suddenly increased greatly. Sure enough, the stronger one was, the stronger he would be.

This should also be formed from a sliver of intent from the Descending Heaven Holy Emperor. However, his battle style was completely different from Zhu Dongkui’s. He was more skilled in close-quarter combat. His arms, elbows, and knees had all become his weapons, and if one was hit, it would be like being hit by the Origin Gold, so the destructive power was practically
off the charts.
Even if Ling Han’s physique was tough, and he could still dissolve the power, he still felt extremely pained after being elbowed and bumped a few times like this.
Most importantly, in his hands, the Imperial Technique could unleash a might that surpassed
Perhaps, this was the true might of the Imperial Technique.
Ling Han thought internally. The Imperial Technique had been created by the Great Emperor,
and only the Great Emperor could truly unleash its full might, because that was a path that the Great Emperor had personally created.
Without this kind of comprehension, how could the Imperial Technique unleash its pinnacle
might?

Boom, the feminine man was incredibly aggressive. As his figure rose into the air, four streaks of light shot out from his body, turning into Dragon, Tiger, Vermillion Bird, Black Tortoise, and charged towards Ling Han.

Ling Han couldn’t help but think of the empress, Hu Niu and the other beautiful wives, as well as Ling Jianxue, Ling Xi, and his other children.
“Flower underpants, white underpants, black underpants...” Meanwhile, the large black dog’s eyes were hazy, and it felt like it was about to cry.
“Father!” The little azure dragon’s face was also filled with longing.
F***, he had been affected again!
Ma...
Ni...
Ba...
Mi...
Gu...!” Ling Han immediately shouted out the Six Characters Bright King Curse loudly, which was thought-provoking, directly penetrating into the depths of the mind.
The three of them were startled at the same time, and the longing that lingered in their hearts instantly dispersed.
“It made people laugh before, but this place makes people involuntarily miss the treasures in their hearts,” Ling Han said with a frown.
“Haha, Old Black, so the most precious thing in your heart is actually your underpants!” The little azure dragon laughed loudly.
Yet the large black dog was unconcerned, and swayed his behind, “Otherwise, what do you think?”
The little azure dragon hurriedly used its claws to block in front of its face, saying, “Stop swaying.
Grandpa Dragon doesn’t have a dog’s eyes, so I’m going to go blind!” It was also rendered speechless.
At first, it had thought that it had grasped a sore point of the large black dog.
Unexpectedly, the large black dog was completely shameless, and this couldn’t do anything to it at all.
The three of them all recited the six words of the ‘Six Characters Bright King Curse’ in their minds, and then headed up the mountain.
It wasn’t long before they arrived at the summit.
There was a person seated here.
Her hair was extremely long, and her back was slender.
It should be a woman.
“Senior.” Ling Han spoke up.
This person stood up, her figure graceful, her figure enchanting, but when she turned around, Ling Han, Ling Han and the others were all gaping widely.
That was because this was not a woman, but rather a man.
However, he was really handsome, and was filled with a feminine air.
Thus, from the back, one would completely misunderstand his gender.
“Sigh, long-lasting yearning, short-lasting yearning, yearning brings calamity,” this effeminate man said slowly.
Even his voice was very neutral.
Without looking at his face, it was completely impossible to distinguish whether he was male or female.
“Greetings, Senior,” Ling Han clasped his hands and said.
This should also be a manifestation of a sliver of divine sense from the Descending Heaven Holy Emperor.
“Block a hundred moves from me.
If you succeed, you will pass, but if you fail, you will die,” the feminine man said.
Alright, though he was a little feminine, he was at least more honest, and was much better than Zhu Dongkui.
Ling Han stepped forward and said, “Please provide guidance, Senior.”
“Humph, I’ll choose!” the feminine man said.
He then pointed at the large black dog, and said, “You go first.”
“Ah?” The large black dog gritted his teeth.
He was the first?
It was slightly anxious.
This was manifested from a sliver of thought of the Holy Emperor.
Though his personality was completely different from the previous Zhu Dongkui, it was sure that his abilities would not be much different.
Furthermore, this guy was too vicious.
He would die if he could not block hundred moves from him.
That was too dangerous, wasn’t it?
“Can Little Black choose not to fight?” the large black dog asked cautiously.
“Those who I call out will be killed,” the feminine man stated calmly, his face filled with longing again.
Helpless, the large black dog had no choice but to step forward and say, “Senior, you have to be gentle.
Little Black can’t withstand any damage!”
Ling Han and the little azure dragon felt like throwing up.
This large black dog was far too
shameless.
The feminine man did not speak further, and immediately charged over.
The large black dog let out a strange cry, and brandished his paws to parry.
It was actually not weak.
For better or worse, it was a Nine Cauldrons Fusion Cauldron.
Furthermore, it had also cultivated Body Art and Imperial Technique, so its battle prowess was stronger than even a great many Imperial Sons.
Thus, even though the feminine man was incredibly powerful, it was still extremely difficult for him to defeat the large black dog in 100 moves at the same cultivation level.
The large black dog was riddled with wounds, yet he finally managed to withstand 100 strikes.
“Scram!” The feminine man kicked the large black dog, sending him flying.
“Next, you.” The feminine man pointed at the little azure dragon.
“Come!” Though the little azure dragon had a bad mouth, it was only verbal.
It was still very headstrong, and immediately charged towards the effeminate man.
He didn’t launch a long-distance attack.
Instead, he directly rammed into him, making full use of Body Arts’s advantage.
“En?” The feminine man appeared slightly surprised, but as he delivered a palm strike, the power of his strike instantly increased further.
F***, fighting with the people here, Body Arts did not actually have an advantage, because if you used the power of Body Arts, your opponent would also use it, or not use it at all.
Boom!
In terms of power, the little azure dragon was evenly matched with its opponent, but when it came to Imperial Technique, the little azure dragon was far inferior.
Thankfully, there was only a gap of two Heavens.
The little azure dragon’s physique was sturdy, and it could withstand blows.
The gap of two Heavens of battle prowess could only suppress him, but couldn’t cause serious injury.
Of course, this was only because the effeminate man hadn’t truly become serious yet.
Otherwise, if the Imperial Technique unleashed might of 12 Heavens, the little azure dragon would probably be severely wounded in an instant.
After all, he didn’t have the ability to
disperse attacks.
Very quickly, a hundred moves had passed, and the little azure dragon had also withstood it.
“You.” The feminine man finally pointed at Ling Han.
Ling Han gave a soft shout, and unleashed his full battle prowess as he charged towards his
opponent.
The feminine man gave another ‘yi’.
He had not thought that these every single person from these three “people” would actually be stronger than the last.
At this time, he instead showed a smile, and waved his hands.
His battle prowess had suddenly increased greatly.
Sure enough, the stronger one was, the stronger he would be.
This should also be formed from a sliver of intent from the Descending Heaven Holy Emperor.
However, his battle style was completely different from Zhu Dongkui’s.
He was more skilled in close-quarter combat.
His arms, elbows, and knees had all become his weapons, and if one was hit, it would be like being hit by the Origin Gold, so the destructive power was practically
off the charts.
Even if Ling Han’s physique was tough, and he could still dissolve the power, he still felt extremely pained after being elbowed and bumped a few times like this.
Most importantly, in his hands, the Imperial Technique could unleash a might that surpassed
Perhaps, this was the true might of the Imperial Technique.
Ling Han thought internally.
The Imperial Technique had been created by the Great Emperor,
and only the Great Emperor could truly unleash its full might, because that was a path that the Great Emperor had personally created.
Without this kind of comprehension, how could the Imperial Technique unleash its pinnacle
might?
Boom, the feminine man was incredibly aggressive.
As his figure rose into the air, four streaks of light shot out from his body, turning into Dragon, Tiger, Vermillion Bird, Black Tortoise, and charged towards Ling Han.

chapters.title: Chapter 4216: Imperial Son Xuan
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations

No matter how one looked at it, this effeminate man had cultivated the First Form of the True Self Tier to perfection. If there was anything lacking, it was that his Body Art was slightly inferior to Ling Han, and his mystical power was also slightly inferior, but with the boost of the Imperial Technique, his battle prowess completely overwhelmed Ling Han.

Boom, the Divine Beasts, the Azure Dragon, the White Tiger, the Vermillion Bird, the Black Tortoise were all formed from Regulations as their bones, with high-level energy as their bodies. Their divine might was awe-inspiring, and they possessed incredibly terrifying destructive power.

If it was the little azure dragon or the large black dog, they would probably have been defeated long ago. Even if the little azure dragon’s physique was extremely tough, it wouldn’t be able to withstand it. After all, the gap between their battle prowess was too wide.
However, Ling Han could disperse all attacks within a gap of six Heavens. This kind of attack could only cause him light injury, but could not cause him serious injury.
The battle was incredibly intense, but in truth, it was difficult to decide the victor.
Ling Han used this feminine man as a whetstone, and continued to walk his own path.

Previously, he had also considered Zhu Dongkui as a qualified rival, but it was a pity that he had been interrupted by the seven Saints while he was still fighting. He hoped that he could improve further this time round.
Not long after, the hundred moves were completed, but Ling Han didn’t stop. The feminine man also didn’t stop, and the two of them were still fighting extremely intensely.

Ling Han was filled with enlightenment. He was no longer limited to the Imperial Techniques, Saint Techniques and Venerate Tier Techniques. He could use whatever he wanted, as he willed it, but his battle prowess was steadily improving.
Why were Zhu Dongkui and the feminine man so strong?
Because they had all walked their own paths, and that was why the celestial technique used from their hands was able to be so powerful.
As expected, what truly belonged to one would be the very strongest.
Of course, the truly powerful ones weren’t Zhu Dongkui and the feminine man, but rather the Descending Heaven Holy Emperor. All of this was formed from his divine sense.
Ling Han had only taken a small step on this path, but compared with countless prodigies, he was already far, far ahead.
—Most prodigies would never be able to take this step in their entire lifetime.
It should be known that taking the first step was actually the most difficult.

Ling Han already had a clear plan. He would first merge various techniques, then take advantage of their strengths to make up for their weaknesses, and refine the celestial technique that truly belonged to him.

Actually, he had already walked this kind of path before, when he was in the Genesis World. However, the two were completely different systems of power, with different Regulations of heaven and earth. There was not much reference value.
However, since he had a successful experience, would this still be difficult for Ling Han?
At this moment, he couldn’t help but think, ‘What about Ding Shu?’
The other party should also be like him, the overlord of a Genesis World. Then, he must have also walked his own path, and reached the peak of the world.
Thus, though Ding Shu had yet to walk his own path in this world, he was sure that this would not trouble him for too long.
Moreover, he also possessed the Imperial Scroll!
Ling Han felt pressured, but this caused his fighting spirit to soar, filled with motivation.
He felt that he had made some progress again, but just how difficult was the Imperial Path? Furthermore, he was only a True Self Tier cultivator. Thus, this progress was extremely negligible.

Yet Ling Han was satisfied. The difficulty of the Imperial Path was so great that even top grade Saints would find it difficult to make the slightest progress. Looking at the whole world, it was clear from just how few Pseudo-Emperors there were, that even if the heaven and earth did not allow the appearance of a new Ancestral King, it was still difficult for top grade Saints to become Pseudo-Emperors.
Weng, a powerful aura suddenly appeared.
Ling Han was shocked, and suddenly stopped.
When he stopped, the feminine man also stopped, and turned his head to look.
A man in a golden robe appeared in the sky above the mountain peak. He looked to be in his early twenties, and his features were sharp and angular.
Sect Master level!
Ling Han used his eye technique to scan over him, and couldn’t help but feel shocked.
He was too young!
Though it was a piece of cake for cultivators to change their appearance at will and make themselves young, under normal circumstances, who would do that?
The most important thing for cultivators was their abilities, and their cultivation level, not their looks.
Looking around the world, what Sect Master wasn’t a white-haired and white-bearded elite?

This man now looked to be only in his early twenties, which meant that he was at the peak of his life, and was at the prime of his vitality. In future, he would still be able to shine for quite a long time.
This astonished Ling Han. He was too young.
Moreover, there were dragons and phoenixes intertwined on this man’s shoulders, and there was also divine springs surging beneath his feet. Ling Han had never seen such a strange phenomenon before.
“Oh, his Regulations is close to perfection!” The effeminate man showed a hint of admiration, but it was only for an instant. He was filled with melancholy again, exuding a strong longing.

The golden-robed man did not even cast a second look at Ling Han. That was a kind of disdain that came from deep within his bones. He was like a True Dragon that could move unhindered in the Nine Heavens. Would he even cast a second look at an ant on the ground?
“Senior, this junior is Lin Xuan. Please provide guidance,” he said to the feminine man. He bowed slightly, and put on a respectful attitude.
—This was the divine sense of a Great Emperor.
Lin Xuan!
Ling Han was shocked. This guy was Imperial Son, the strongest Imperial Son of the Fire Cloud Imperial Clan, one of the Golden Generation.
He thought of the gentle man’s evaluation of Lin Xuan: Regulations was close to perfection!
Hiss, from the True Self Tier onwards, one would start cultivating Regulations. This guy had cultivated Regulations to near perfection, so his battle prowess was naturally terrifying.

Ling Han had seen a member of the Golden Generation before, but he had never fought him before. The True Dragon Abyss did not allow it, so Ling Han had no way to judge the overall strength of the Golden Generation, but the words “Regulations was close to perfection” was enough to show the freakish talent of the Golden Generation.

Moreover, the Golden Generation didn’t have any shortcomings, and they were nurtured with the power of their entire clan. Not only were they skilled in cultivation, but they were also extremely powerful in Body Art.
Ling Han had killed Lin Lang. If the latter knew his true identity, this guy would probably make a move.
—After the seven Saints entered, the little azure dragon and the large black dog had changed their appearances again.
The feminine man nodded, and delivered a palm strike at Ling Han and the others first. Xiu, the three of them were wrapped in a streak of light, and began to traverse at extreme speed.
Then, he charged towards Lin Xuan.
Xiu, Ling Han and the others traversed through the Great Emperor’s corpse at an extremely fast speed. This time, they travelled from his left arm to his left leg.
The environment here was different. It was foggy, and visibility was extremely low.
“I wonder what’s going on with the people standing guard here,” the large black dog mumbled. “One moment, they’re laughing, and the next, they’re filled with melancholy. They’re all freaks.”
Ling Han had been walking, yet he suddenly stopped in his tracks. “Old Black, what did you say just then?”
“They’re all freaks?”
“No, the first line.”
“One moment you’re smiling, and the next moment you’re filled with melancholy?” The large black dog was slightly confused. ‘Why are you asking this?’
Ling Han pondered for a moment. After a while, he asked, “Don’t you guys find this strange?”
“Strange, of course it’s strange.” The little azure dragon immediately said, “We’re inside the body of a Holy Emperor, so don’t you think it’s strange?”

Ling Han shook his head, and said, “Although the two people who guarded the entrance were both very strong, and were in fact so strong that no one could defeat them, it was precisely because of this that the problem arose.”
“What problem?”
“Their battle prowess is practically equal, then what is the difference between passing a stage and passing a few stages?”

chapters.title: Chapter 4217: Seven Emotions
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
The large black dog scratched his head, “Little Han, what do you want to say? Why doesn’t Grandpa Dog understand?”

“According to my estimation, there are seven suns here, and that probably corresponds to seven places, all of which are guarded,” Ling Han said. “If the abilities tested on every stage are different, then it would be meaningful.”

“The problem is, though the person guarding the stage is extremely strong, and has practically reached the strongest level in a single cultivation level, the test is still to block a hundred moves. Then what is the significance of passing seven stages and passing the first stage?”
“Eh?” The little azure dragon and the large black dog exchanged a look, both feeling a little strange.
That’s right, what was the meaning of this?
If one could pass the first stage, they would definitely be able to pass the second and third stages. Then, to say nothing of seven stages, even seven hundred stages would be the same.

“Furthermore, we have also fallen into a misconception.” Ling Han continued, “We have obtained the tortoise shell, and this is the key to opening Needless Mountains. Thus, we naturally think that the treasure should belong to us, and we should also be in the lead.”
“Isn’t it?” The large black dog was confused.

Ling Han shook his head, and said, “We can only say that we were lucky to obtain these two tortoise shells. However, the Descending Heaven Holy Emperor is looking for a successor, so how can it be that his successor only needs to be lucky enough?”
Hearing his words, the little azure dragon and the large black dog were both unsure.

If the only requirement was just luck, the Descending Heaven Holy Emperor would have been able to pick an heir when he was still alive. He could simply toss the Imperial Scroll and Imperial Technique over. In any case, there was no need for him to teach them.
“Little Han, you are almost driving Grandpa Dog crazy. What’s your focus?” the large black dog sighed.
Ling Han smiled, and said, “I’ll give you guys a hint. First, it’s happiness, followed by longing, and then there are a total of seven stages.”
“Pei, that was clearly Grandpa Dog’s words,” the large black dog called out. Previously, Ling Han had a flash of inspiration, and that was precisely because he had heard his muttering.
An idea came to the little azure dragon, and it said, “Could it be that the emotions of anger, sorrow, grief and others would follow?”
“Probably.” Ling Han nodded.
“Seven Emotions and Six Desires!” The large black dog also came to a realization1.
“That’s right,” Ling Han said darkly. “Zhu Dongkui represents joy, and the second man represents longing, which is two of the seven emotions. I believe that the remaining five should be next.”
“Even so, what does that mean?” the large black dog asked.
Weng! Right at this moment, a powerful divine sense suddenly swept over.

Without another word, Ling Han directly grabbed the little azure dragon and the large black dog, using the Imminent Skyline to cover a distance. Then, he drew out the Void Beast hide, enshrouding all three of them.
Xiu, a figure appeared. It was Lin Xuan.

He stood with his arms crossed behind his back. Dragons and phoenixes intertwined, and an underground spring gushed out. The phenomenon was astonishing, but his handsome face was emotionless, only filled with endless coldness. He swept his gaze around, and his eyes actually shot out golden light.
As the golden light swept over them, the Regulations of heaven and earth were actually outlined, displaying their profoundness.
This was far too astonishing. Even Saints would covet such a Mystical Power.
“Not here?” Lin Xuan murmured. He clearly sensed that there were three living beings here, but he rushed over at the first instant, yet actually didn’t find anyone.
He frowned slightly, but immediately stretched out his brow again. With a single step, he was already boundlessly far away.
“You guys are lucky.” Only the lingering sound echoed.
In the distance, Ling Han and the others appeared.
“F***, this old brat wants to kill us?” The large black dog jumped up. Just now, Lin Xuan was filled with killing intent.
“Naturally,” Ling Han said with a nod. “Right now, we’re fighting over the Imperial Scroll. If we’re killed, he’ll have three fewer competitors.”
“We are members of the Buddhist Tribe, and he dares to make a move?” The large black dog was still slightly disbelieving.

“He naturally wouldn’t dare to touch the real Buddha Son.” Ling Han shook his head, and said, “However, the Buddha Sons of the East, South, West and North Heavenly Realms... Heh, strictly speaking, they’re not much different from the Holy Lands.”
“Moreover, this can also be considered a Mystery Realm. As long as he doesn’t say anything, who would dare to say that he is the murderer?”
The large black dog slapped his thigh, “F***, this old brat is too despicable. We didn’t steal his sister’s underpants, did he have to be so ruthless?”

Ling Han did not speak. The Golden Generation was aiming to become Emperor, and no matter how stunningly talented you were, only one Ancestral King would appear in each generation. Whoever managed to snatch this great fortune of heaven and earth, the others could only withdraw dejectedly.
Thus, when Lin Xuan thought that Ling Han and the others had a chance of competing for the throne, he decided to eliminate the three of them in advance.

“Imperial Clan Clan! Imperial Clan! F*ck, when Grandpa Dog becomes an Emperor, I’ll erase all of them!” the large black dog said in displeasure. “The world is so chaotic, and just because of the existence of these Imperial Clans, they think they’re superior to others, causing the world to be unjust.”
Ling Han nodded. However, as long as one was a human, they would have their own selfish motives. Even if this generation completely suppressed the Imperial Clans, what about the future?
There was no Great Emperor that could eternally rule the world. Thus, after the dynasty changed, the new Great Emperor would naturally still leave behind a new Imperial Clan, beginning a new cycle.
“Forget it, let’s not discuss this.” He waved his hand, “If we continue fighting like this, we probably won’t get any results. Instead, it will increase the danger.”
“Brat, what you mean is that the main focus of the Imperial Scroll inheritance is on the issue that we had previously discussed?” the large black dog asked doubtfully.
“I think so. Of course, it is also possible that after passing seven stages, you would be able to obtain the Imperial Scroll.” Ling Han said with a smile.
The large black dog almost went crazy. “Brat, can you say something for certain?”
Ling Han shrugged and said, “I’m not the Descending Heaven Holy Emperor, so how can I give you a guarantee?”
“All right. Even if we know that the seven stages represent seven different emotions, so what?” the large black dog asked.

Ling Han pondered for a moment before saying, “Whether it’s Zhu Dongkui or the man from the second stage, they’re all manifestations of a sliver of divine sense from the Descending Heaven Holy Emperor. Does this mean that the Descending Heaven Holy Emperor severed the thought that represented his seven emotions?”
“Oh my goodness, without emotions, what meaning would there be?” The large black dog immediately stuck out his tongue.
“Every Great Emperor has walked their own path. Who knows, this Holy Emperor may be the one to sever his emotions and become an Emperor?” Ling Han said with a smile.
“So you’re saying that we also have to sever our seven emotions to be able to obtain the inheritance of the Descending Heaven Holy Emperor?” the little azure dragon interrupted.
“Not necessarily.” Ling Han shook his head.
“F***, if you continue to talk nonsense, do you believe that Grandpa Dog will bite you?” The large black dog was about to go crazy.
“You guys wait for a while.”
Ling Han retrieved his tortoise shell and pulled it over his head.
Yi, what are you doing?
“Little Han, do you want to pretend to be Celestial Turtle?” the little azure dragon immediately said with a smile.
Ling Han ignored him. He had already entered into the space inside the tortoise shell, and that familiar galaxy appeared once more.
He began to accumulate his emotions, and imagined how Zhu Dongkui would look like. Then, he laughed loudly, his whole person surrounded by joyful emotions.
At the beginning, he had done it on purpose, but after releasing his emotions, he was really laughing out loud. It was purely natural.
Xiu, xiu, xiu! Instantly, several streaks of light shot over and landed on him.

The large black dog scratched his head, “Little Han, what do you want to say?
Why doesn’t Grandpa Dog understand?”
“According to my estimation, there are seven suns here, and that probably corresponds to seven places, all of which are guarded,” Ling Han said.
“If the abilities tested on every stage are different, then it would be meaningful.”
“The problem is, though the person guarding the stage is extremely strong, and has practically reached the strongest level in a single cultivation level, the test is still to block a hundred moves.
Then what is the significance of passing seven stages and passing the first stage?”
“Eh?” The little azure dragon and the large black dog exchanged a look, both feeling a little strange.
That’s right, what was the meaning of this?
If one could pass the first stage, they would definitely be able to pass the second and third stages.
Then, to say nothing of seven stages, even seven hundred stages would be the same.
“Furthermore, we have also fallen into a misconception.” Ling Han continued, “We have obtained the tortoise shell, and this is the key to opening Needless Mountains.
Thus, we naturally think that the treasure should belong to us, and we should also be in the lead.”
“Isn’t it?” The large black dog was confused.
Ling Han shook his head, and said, “We can only say that we were lucky to obtain these two tortoise shells.
However, the Descending Heaven Holy Emperor is looking for a successor, so how can it be that his successor only needs to be lucky enough?”
Hearing his words, the little azure dragon and the large black dog were both unsure.
If the only requirement was just luck, the Descending Heaven Holy Emperor would have been able to pick an heir when he was still alive.
He could simply toss the Imperial Scroll and Imperial Technique over.
In any case, there was no need for him to teach them.
“Little Han, you are almost driving Grandpa Dog crazy.
What’s your focus?” the large black dog sighed.
Ling Han smiled, and said, “I’ll give you guys a hint.
First, it’s happiness, followed by longing, and then there are a total of seven stages.”
“Pei, that was clearly Grandpa Dog’s words,” the large black dog called out.
Previously, Ling Han had a flash of inspiration, and that was precisely because he had heard his muttering.
An idea came to the little azure dragon, and it said, “Could it be that the emotions of anger, sorrow, grief and others would follow?”
“Probably.” Ling Han nodded.
“Seven Emotions and Six Desires!” The large black dog also came to a realization1.
“That’s right,” Ling Han said darkly.
“Zhu Dongkui represents joy, and the second man represents longing, which is two of the seven emotions.
I believe that the remaining five should be next.”
“Even so, what does that mean?” the large black dog asked.
Weng!
Right at this moment, a powerful divine sense suddenly swept over.
Without another word, Ling Han directly grabbed the little azure dragon and the large black dog, using the Imminent Skyline to cover a distance.
Then, he drew out the Void Beast hide, enshrouding all three of them.
Xiu, a figure appeared.
It was Lin Xuan.
He stood with his arms crossed behind his back.
Dragons and phoenixes intertwined, and an underground spring gushed out.
The phenomenon was astonishing, but his handsome face was emotionless, only filled with endless coldness.
He swept his gaze around, and his eyes actually shot out golden light.
As the golden light swept over them, the Regulations of heaven and earth were actually outlined, displaying their profoundness.
This was far too astonishing.
Even Saints would covet such a Mystical Power.
“Not here?” Lin Xuan murmured.
He clearly sensed that there were three living beings here, but he rushed over at the first instant, yet actually didn’t find anyone.
He frowned slightly, but immediately stretched out his brow again.
With a single step, he was already boundlessly far away.
“You guys are lucky.” Only the lingering sound echoed.
In the distance, Ling Han and the others appeared.
“F***, this old brat wants to kill us?” The large black dog jumped up.
Just now, Lin Xuan was filled with killing intent.
“Naturally,” Ling Han said with a nod.
“Right now, we’re fighting over the Imperial Scroll.
If we’re killed, he’ll have three fewer competitors.”
“We are members of the Buddhist Tribe, and he dares to make a move?” The large black dog was still slightly disbelieving.
“He naturally wouldn’t dare to touch the real Buddha Son.” Ling Han shook his head, and said, “However, the Buddha Sons of the East, South, West and North Heavenly Realms...
Heh, strictly speaking, they’re not much different from the Holy Lands.”
“Moreover, this can also be considered a Mystery Realm.
As long as he doesn’t say anything, who would dare to say that he is the murderer?”
The large black dog slapped his thigh, “F***, this old brat is too despicable.
We didn’t steal his sister’s underpants, did he have to be so ruthless?”
Ling Han did not speak.
The Golden Generation was aiming to become Emperor, and no matter how stunningly talented you were, only one Ancestral King would appear in each generation.
Whoever managed to snatch this great fortune of heaven and earth, the others could only withdraw dejectedly.
Thus, when Lin Xuan thought that Ling Han and the others had a chance of competing for the throne, he decided to eliminate the three of them in advance.
“Imperial Clan Clan!
Imperial Clan!
F*ck, when Grandpa Dog becomes an Emperor, I’ll erase all of them!” the large black dog said in displeasure.
“The world is so chaotic, and just because of the existence of these Imperial Clans, they think they’re superior to others, causing the world to be unjust.”
Ling Han nodded.
However, as long as one was a human, they would have their own selfish motives.
Even if this generation completely suppressed the Imperial Clans, what about the future?
There was no Great Emperor that could eternally rule the world.
Thus, after the dynasty changed, the new Great Emperor would naturally still leave behind a new Imperial Clan, beginning a new cycle.
“Forget it, let’s not discuss this.” He waved his hand, “If we continue fighting like this, we probably won’t get any results.
Instead, it will increase the danger.”
“Brat, what you mean is that the main focus of the Imperial Scroll inheritance is on the issue that we had previously discussed?” the large black dog asked doubtfully.
“I think so.
Of course, it is also possible that after passing seven stages, you would be able to obtain the Imperial Scroll.” Ling Han said with a smile.
The large black dog almost went crazy.
“Brat, can you say something for certain?”
Ling Han shrugged and said, “I’m not the Descending Heaven Holy Emperor, so how can I give you a guarantee?”
“All right.
Even if we know that the seven stages represent seven different emotions, so what?” the large black dog asked.

Ling Han pondered for a moment before saying, “Whether it’s Zhu Dongkui or the man from the second stage, they’re all manifestations of a sliver of divine sense from the Descending Heaven Holy Emperor.
Does this mean that the Descending Heaven Holy Emperor severed the thought that represented his seven emotions?”
“Oh my goodness, without emotions, what meaning would there be?” The large black dog immediately stuck out his tongue.
“Every Great Emperor has walked their own path.
Who knows, this Holy Emperor may be the one to sever his emotions and become an Emperor?” Ling Han said with a smile.
“So you’re saying that we also have to sever our seven emotions to be able to obtain the inheritance of the Descending Heaven Holy Emperor?” the little azure dragon interrupted.
“Not necessarily.” Ling Han shook his head.
“F***, if you continue to talk nonsense, do you believe that Grandpa Dog will bite you?” The large black dog was about to go crazy.
“You guys wait for a while.”
Ling Han retrieved his tortoise shell and pulled it over his head.
Yi, what are you doing?
“Little Han, do you want to pretend to be Celestial Turtle?” the little azure dragon immediately said with a smile.
Ling Han ignored him.
He had already entered into the space inside the tortoise shell, and that familiar galaxy appeared once more.
He began to accumulate his emotions, and imagined how Zhu Dongkui would look like.
Then, he laughed loudly, his whole person surrounded by joyful emotions.
At the beginning, he had done it on purpose, but after releasing his emotions, he was really laughing out loud.
It was purely natural.
Xiu, xiu, xiu!
Instantly, several streaks of light shot over and landed on him.

chapters.title: Chapter 4218: Getting a feel for the way
paragraphs: It was effective!
Ling Han stopped, and he went back to thinking about the feminine man’s appearance. Instantly, feelings of longing enveloped Ling Han like rain.
He missed the empress, Hu Niu, as well as his family and friends that were still in the Genesis World inside his body. There was not the slightest bit of falsehood.
Xiu, xiu, xiu! Another few streaks of light shot over.
Ling Han wanted to continue, and follow up with grief.

He thought about how his family and friends had still died from old age and illness along the way. He thought about how a dimension in the Genesis World had been devoured by Hysteria, and millions and millions of living beings had suffered. He was both furious and sorrowful.
However, this did not stimulate the light.
“Could it be that we definitely have to pass through those few stages?” Ling Han murmured. In the next instant, Ling Han retreated out of the world inside the tortoise shell.
“Little Han, what did you do?” the large black dog shouted. “Just now, several streaks of light shot into your body, and it was two times at that.”
“En, the second ray of light entered through your a**,” the little azure dragon interrupted. Peng, the consequence of having a bad mouth was being stomped flat.
“Little Han, Grandpa Dragon isn’t playing around with you!” he screamed.
Ling Han chuckled. This Four-Legged Snake had never learnt its lesson, and he had to teach him a lesson from time to time.
“Come, let’s continue,” he said.
“Yi, you still want to continue?” The large black dog felt that it was strange. Weren’t you the one who said that the multiple stages were meaningless?
“The situation has changed,” Ling Han said.
The three of them continued onwards. With the tortoise shell to guide them, they soon arrived at the banks of a lake. An intense battle was presently taking place here.
However, before they had even come close, a feeling of fury rose up in them, and they wanted nothing more than to blast a hole into the heaven and earth.
Fury!
Ling Han experienced this kind of fury, as he looked towards that fierce battle.

The two battling parties were an incredibly rough-looking man and a lanky man in his twenties, respectively, and it could be determined with a single glance that the rough- looking man was the guard here.
That was because his face was filled with fury, and every move he made seemed as if he wanted to take someone down with him.
The guards here were all incredibly emotional.
“Who’s that guy?” The little azure dragon pointed at the slender man.
Ling Han shook his head, and said, “I don’t know him. However, with a cultivation level at Sect Master-level, and with how young he is, he must be one of the members of the Golden Generation.”

“This is too shameless. Those old b@stards couldn’t compete with us, so they sent out the Golden Generation, whose cultivation level is so much higher than ours!” the large black dog said in displeasure.
As he spoke, the battle between the gruff man and the slender man had also ended. Clearly, the hundred moves were over.
The gruff man waved his hand, and the slender man was immediately swept by a ray of light, which rapidly disappeared.
“Should we wait?” The large black dog said, “Who knows, this old brat might be guarding us from the other side.”

Ling Han thought for a moment, then said, “The chances of that are not very high, because Lin Xuan is already at the forefront. What this person is thinking now should be to catch up to Lin Xuan as soon as possible, and not come to snipe the three of us ‘minor characters’.”
Although this sounded extremely uncomfortable, it was very much in line with the truth. In fact, it was also beneficial to them.
“All right, let’s go.”
The three of them rushed up to fight. The little azure dragon and the large black dog went first, while Ling Han went last.
Similar to before, others would pass in 100 moves, but Ling Han didn’t have any restrictions on his techniques. As long as he wanted to, he could continue fighting.
This was possibly because he had obtained the tortoise shell.
Ling Han didn’t waste such an opportunity either. He would use this kind of elite to temper himself.
The battle continued until he was riddled with wounds, and only then did Ling Han call a halt. Then, he was sent to the next location.

Though he was sure that Imperial Son would not be guarding them here, but just to be safe, Ling Han still summoned the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower. Worse come to worst, he would release the Heavenly Dao Flames. Who cares if you are Imperial Son or not, I will burn you to death one by one.
But thankfully, his prediction had not been wrong. There was no one standing guard here for them.
The three of them left a little, and then Ling Han entered into the world of the tortoise shell, fully burning with anger.
In the area of fury, there was really no need to build up feelings. In an instant, he had entered into a state of fury, because he had encountered too much injustice.

-In the Genesis World, he had reached the peak, sweeping aside all enemies, but in this world, his cultivation level could not be considered very strong at all. Even if he was invincible among his peers, so what? Whether it was Spirit Transformation True Lord, Sect Master-
level, or Venerate Tier-level, they could easily defeat him.
Moreover, there was also the noble Imperial Clans, which caused him to leave the Nine Suns Holy Land, and he was forced to separate from his beautiful wives.
Xiu, several streaks of light entered his body. He had succeeded.

Ling Han retreated out of the tortoise shell world. He had an enlightenment. His previous judgement had been wrong. The Descending Heaven Holy Emperor hadn’t severed his seven emotions, but rather refined his emotions, building his emotions to the pinnacle, so his path
was based on pinnacle emotions.
This was also a kind of path to dao.

Realization dawned on him. The Descending Heaven Holy Emperor had reached the extreme both in emotion and Dao. The Descending Heaven Holy Emperor should be an extremely loyal and emotional person, and such people could only watch as their comrades aged one by one in their lifetime of battle. Yet, he still had to continue fighting. What kind of grief was this? However, the Descending Heaven Holy Emperor had spent his whole life suppressing the darkness, and this impressed Ling Han greatly. This was a great love for heaven and earth.
“Come, let’s go to the next location.”
They continued to set out, and when they were heading towards the fourth location, they sensed that a powerful aura would occasionally sweep by in the skies.
“Golden Generation!”

Ling Han and the others were all certain that it was definitely the Golden Generation that had come. Only they could withstand a hundred moves from the thought manifestations of the Holy Emperor. Otherwise, there would only be Chi Menghan, the Imperial Son from the Golden Silk Moth Clan and a few other prodigies.

Now, Ling Han and the others were already too far behind. Thus, the Golden Generation didn’t even bother with them. They were in a rush to catch up to Lin Xuan, who was at the forefront. They definitely couldn’t allow the inheritance of the Holy Emperor to fall out of their hands. If one could simultaneously cultivate two Imperial Scrolls, just how strong would he become?

It should be known that no matter how many Imperial Techniques you cultivated, the Imperial Technique would only be able to unleash its full might when boosted by the corresponding Imperial Scroll. Thus, the benefits of cultivating an additional Imperial Scroll
were obvious.

Moreover, for prodigies that were worthy of becoming Emperor, reading the Imperial Scroll was equivalent to revisiting the path that a Great Emperor had walked. Though it could not be copied, one could still obtain a great amount of experience, and the significance of reference
was too great.
This was good too. Ling Han and the others could secretly make a fortune.
A few days later, they finally found the fourth place.
This was... fear.
The moment they arrived, fear rose up from the bottoms of their hearts, as if they were about
to face an unknown prehistoric monster.
A Great Emperor could also feel fear?
This was natural. As long as they were human, how could they be unafraid?
Ling Han also felt fear. This wasn’t a humiliation. On the other hand, being ignorant and
fearless was the most fatal thing. It was possible that he wouldn’t even know how he had died.
However, people like him could overcome fear, and not be influenced by fear.
Fighting under such emotions, Ling Han and the others were slightly detained, but they
finally defeated these negative emotions, and passed the test.
At this moment, they were teleported to the lower abdomen of the corpse of the Holy
Emperor.
Ling Han entered the tortoise shell world at the first instant. He unleashed his fear, not hiding it at all, but he still overcame his fear, successfully stimulating a few more streaks of light.

chapters.title: Chapter 4219: Lotus Platform, Needless Mountains
paragraphs: At this time, there was already no more Imperial Sons rushing over from behind.
The members of the Golden Generation either chose not to come here at all, or had already arrived in front of them.
Ling Han and the others were also happy to relax. There was no need for them to hide.
This fifth emotion was worry.
It was not difficult to pass, but the difficulty lay in how to express such emotions.
Whether it was positive or negative emotions, people shouldn’t be influenced.

Ling Han was naturally worried. With so many Imperial Clan elites working together to hunt him down, as well as the Battle God Palace in hot pursuit, how could he not be worried at all? However, he turned his worries into motivation.

Ling Han already understood the Descending Heaven Holy Emperor’s intentions. In this way, he told those who came later that people couldn’t be influenced by emotions, and they had to become the masters of their emotions.
The pinnacle lay in emotiton, and was not to be trapped in emotions.
This Holy Emperor had great intelligence.
Thinking of this, Ling Han couldn’t help but smile. What Emperor would not have great intelligence?
Fine, let’s go to the sixth stage.
The sixth stage was the chest of the Holy Emperor’s corpse, then going by that deduction, the final stage was the head of the Holy Emperor’s corpse.
Did the Holy Emperor’s Scroll exist in his mind?
Ling Han and the others were all filled with anticipation. Using the tortoise shell as a guide, they found their destination a few days later.
This was grief.
On the path of martial arts, who hadn’t sent off their family, friends, and even lovers?
To Ling Han, the emotion of grief was much weaker. Thus, he spent a very long time to capture this kind of emotion, and finally managed to stimulate the resonance of the tortoise shell.
All right, there was only the last stage left.
They arrived at the head of the Holy Emperor’s corpse. This was the seventh stage.
The moment they arrived, the three of them discovered that this was a vast ocean.
Was this the mind of the Holy Emperor?

But it should be known that once a person died, the mind would dry up, and even the Great Emperor would not be an exception. Thus, this was far from the mind of the Holy Emperor when he had been alive, but had already degenerated countless times over.
Hiss, countless years later, the mind could still be so majestic. As expected of an overlord that had suppressed an era.

Ling Han and the others were all rueful. Only Spiritual Transformation Tier elites could materialize their consciousness. If they died now, their mind would immediately die, and couldn’t be entered at all.
With the guidance of the tortoise shell, they flew on the surface of the sea. This took a few more days, and an island appeared ahead of them.
“This island is so special,” the little azure dragon said. “Why does it look a little like a lotus flower?”
“It’s a lotus flower!” Ling Han said with certainty.
This was a massive lotus flower, but now, it had lost all signs of life. Its petals had lost all luster, and had become pitch-black. From afar, it looked both like an island and a mountain.
Hiss, this couldn’t be the Needless Mountains, right?

They landed, and a small seedpod had already formed in the centre of the lotus flower, turning into a massive platform. At this time, there were a great many people on the platform, and they were all youngsters that looked to be in their twenties. There were men and women among them, handsome and energetic, their auras captivating.
“Golden Generation!”
Ling Han saw Lin Xuan, as well as Imperial Son Kui. As for the other Imperial Sons and Imperial Daughters, his eyes narrowed. He didn’t recognize any of them.
Seeing Ling Han and the others walk over, these Imperial Sons and Imperial Daughters all swept a cold glance over them, completely unmoved.
As they saw it, even if Ling Han and the others had outstanding natural talent, their cultivation level was still too far off, so they were not qualified to even look at them.

Lin Xuan, on the other hand, cast an extra glance at Ling Han. For some reason, he would feel killing intent whenever he saw Ling Han. This was a kind of hatred that came out of nowhere and was completely unreasonable. However, when one had reached the height that Lin Xuan had, he believed that there must be heaven’s will in the unseen world. Thus, he did not mind killing Ling Han either.

However, he didn’t make a move, because there was still a sliver of divine sense of the Descending Heaven Holy Emperor here. If this thought didn’t disappear, then even if a Saint brought the Imperial Weapon over, they would have to bow their heads, not daring to fight.
The Great Emperor was invincible in the world.
The final test was the shock of seven different emotions.

In this place, everyone was extremely nervous, as if something colossal was about to happen, making them uneasy. Even if it was the Golden Generation, so what? The gap in cultivation level was too wide, so they would still be deeply affected.
Meanwhile, Ling Han and the others were confused. Why were these people all here?

“Little Han, looks like you have guessed correctly. Even if you pass seven stages, you would not be able to obtain the inheritance of the Holy Emperor.” The large black dog communicated through divine sense.
