chapters.title: Chapter 4220: The Imperial Scroll appears
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations

The Imperial Clan was arrogant. They were the descendants of Great Emperors, and they also had the Imperial Weapon keeping watch. Basically, there were also Saints in their clan. This was the basis for their pride.

Meanwhile, the Imperial Son was especially proud. If nothing unexpected happened, they had a very high chance of becoming Saints. In an era when there was no Emperor in the world, Saints were the representatives of the strongest battle prowess.
The Golden Generation, one of the strongest among the Imperial Sons, or possibly the strongest generation in history. They looked down on everyone, including the Imperial Sons that came after them.
Thus, what was Ling Han, the Buddha Son of the West Heavenly Realm, worth in the eyes of the Golden Generation?
An ant!

Ling Han, the large black dog, and the little azure dragon looked at each other. They all hid their anger deeply. There was too much of a gap between their cultivation levels, so what did it matter if they were angered?
“These b@stards, just wait and see. Grandpa Dog will eventually make all of you kneel down and proclaim your conquest,” the large black dog communicated through divine sense.
Ling Han and the little azure dragon didn’t speak, but in their hearts, they obviously said the same thing.

All the Imperial Sons did not speak further. Some were impatient, and flew out of the lotus platform, to search once more in the vast sea. Some chatted with that terrified young man, trying to get some information, while others continued to sit cross-legged, appearing to be in no hurry at all.
After Ling Han and the others waited for two days, they left quietly. Then, they immediately used the Void Beast hide to cover themselves.
Xiu, xiu! Immediately, three figures followed them.
Imperial Son Yuan, Imperial Son Yuan and another that Ling Han and the others did not recognize, but he was naturally another member of the Golden Generation.
“They have treasures that can hide their tracks,” Lin Xuan said calmly. Previously, he had wanted to kill Ling Han and the others, but when he arrived, he had lost track of those three people.
“Let me take a look,” the unknown Imperial Son said. His forehead split open, and a slit eye appeared. It suddenly exploded with divine light that shot out in all directions.

“Brother Ming’s Void Eye can see through all falsehoods, and is comparable to Saint Tier. I am sure that in front of you, those three ants would have nowhere to hide.” Imperial Son Yuan clapped his hands, smiling.
The Imperial Son smiled faintly, appearing to be completely unconcerned, but there was an expression of pride on his face.
However, after scanning the surroundings, he didn’t discover anything.
This was a little awkward.

Killing intent instantly rose up in the Imperial Son Ming’s heart. At first, he was completely unconcerned about taking the lives of three ants. He had only chased after them for the sake of obtaining the token of the Descending Heaven Holy Emperor. However, when he swept his gaze over the surroundings, he did not find Ling Han and the others. This caused him to fly into a humiliated rage. Naturally, killing intent overflowed from him.
A mere ant actually dared to embarrass him?
However, where were they?
The Imperial Son Ming looked towards the depths of the great ocean again, but with this look, he gave a muffled humph, and the light that had shot out from his slitted eye instantly dimmed.

“Brother Ming!” Imperial Son Xuan and Imperial Son Yuan both called out at the same time. They were not really concerned about Imperial Son Ming, but rather that Imperial Son Ming was the best candidate to find Ling Han and the others.
The Imperial Son shook his head, saying, “The Holy Emperor’s mind can’t be offended. My soul light was almost destroyed!”

When these words fell, both Imperial Son Xuan and Imperial Son Yuan were solemn. They were inside the corpse of a Great Emperor, so who cared if they were members of the Golden Generation or not? In front of Imperial Might, they were like ants.
They were unwilling to give up, and after searching a few more times, they could only reluctantly return.
At this moment, Ling Han and the others were in the sea.
They did not dive into the deep sea, and merely allowed the ocean waters to submerge them.
“As expected, the seawater can conceal our tracks,” Ling Han said with a smile.

“The Great Emperor’s mind has great power even after death!” The large black dog nodded as well. Then, he suddenly said, “Little Han, that mysterious sea of blood that contains the corpses of countless Saints... could it also be the Great Emperor’s mind?”
Ling Han pondered for a moment. That was an unsolved mystery. Even if the Saint brought the Imperial Weapon with him, he wouldn’t be able to withstand it.
Could it be the Great Emperor’s mind?

But what Great Emperor would be so bloodthirsty, and have killed so many Saints? Furthermore, it was definitely impossible that there would be so many Saints in a single era. It should be the accumulation of several dozen generations.
The problem was, could even a Great Emperor be able to live for such a long time?
Thus, no one could solve this mystery, unless a new Emperor appeared, and he could charge in alone. Only then would he be able to understand its secrets.
Ling Han did not speak further. He entered into the world of the tortoise shell, and began to play out the last emotion of the Seven Emotions.
Shock.
To him, panicking was an extremely rare thing. Thus, he mulled over it for a very, very long time before he finally found the feeling.
Instantly, several pillars of light attacked.

Pa, Ling Han instantly fell out of the world of the tortoise shell. Then, he suddenly discovered that this tortoise shell was moving on its own. Multiple patterns were changing, as if it was relating some supremely mysterious principle.
The little azure dragon and the large black dog approached at the same time, staring at each other closely.
“Imperial Scroll!”
After a long while, they called out at the same time.

As it turned out, the Imperial Scroll was actually with them all this while, but the divine item kept itself hidden, and would not manifest at all. Only when the Emperor’s corpse appeared, and they played out the seven emotions, did the Imperial Scroll finally appear.

It was also possible that the Imperial Scroll should be inside the Great Emperor’s corpse. The tortoise shell was only a vessel, and one had to pass seven stages before it would appear through the tortoise shell.
En, the latter deduction should be more logical.
Ling Han thought to himself. Then, he hurriedly suppressed these distracting thoughts, focusing his full attention on the Imperial Scroll.

The Imperial Scroll was the true effort of a Great Emperor, and was a summary of the path that he had taken. Thus, if one cultivated the Imperial Scroll, the chances of becoming a Saint was much higher than cultivating the cultivation technique of a Saint.
However, if one was completely immersed in the Imperial Scroll, they definitely could not possibly become an Emperor.
—If one had walked before them, that would only be an imitation. The heaven and earth would not favour this kind of imitator.
Thus, for those who had ambitions to become Emperor, Imperial Scrolls could only be used as reference.
Ling Han only used the Imperial Scroll as a means to stimulate the Imperial Technique, and it was only for the sake of increasing his battle prowess.
Obtaining the Imperial Scroll would make up for the last shortcoming in his battle prowess.
After a whole three days, the tortoise shell finally managed to fully perform the Imperial Scroll. Next, it began to perform something new.
This time, it was the Imperial Technique.

The Descending Heaven Holy Emperor had suppressed the darkness all those years ago, and his battle prowess was publicly acknowledged as one of the top three or even the strongest in history. Just how powerful was the Imperial Technique that he had created?
“Ice Moon Saber!”

This was the first Imperial Technique Technique, but it wasn’t a saber technique. After reaching the cultivation level of Great Emperor, one no longer needed to rely on external items. They themselves were the strongest.

Thus, this Ice Moon Saber was a technique that could be displayed through fist techniques, palm techniques, and so on. When it was delivered, it would turn into a divine saber that could destroy everything.
After the Ice Moon Saber, the tortoise shell began to evolve into the Imperial Scroll again.
“You only have one Imperial Technique?” the large black dog asked in slight defiance.
Ling Han smiled, “If it is considered an ultimate move, one would be enough.”
“Haha, let’s see who can grasp the Imperial Scroll first,” the little azure dragon immediately said.
“All right!”
The three of them sat down in cross-legged positions, and began to comprehend.

However, the Imperial Scroll was really too hard to understand. This was the Imperial Scroll in which a Great Emperor had condensed the path he had walked, and used a method of simplification to teach this kind of comprehension to others.

chapters.title: Chapter 4221: Re-cultivating the four cultivation levels
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
Ling Han suddenly felt appreciation. Why couldn’t he become an Ancestral King by copying the Imperial Scroll?

Because the Imperial Scroll would not allow one to fully comprehend the Dao of the Ancestral King, there were some mysteries that could not be explained through words or even in the form of seals, and could only be comprehended by oneself.
Thus, the Great Emperors had all walked out on their own, and not one of them had been taught.
He suppressed these thoughts, and fully comprehended the profoundness of the Imperial Scroll.

The Descending Heaven Holy Emperor was a descendant of the Tortoise Race, so logically speaking, the Black Tortoise being aligned with Earth, he should have been more skilled in the Regulations of Earth. However, in reality, the Holy Emperor had comprehended the Regulations of Water, reaching the pinnacle through the Regulations of Water.

However, Saints could use Regulations, but in the case of Great Emperors, they had already reached the extent of crushing Regulations. Thus, when one had reached the cultivation level of Great Emperors, they could easily use whatever Regulations they wanted, so what difference did it make?
The Imperial Scroll was the path that the Great Emperor had walked, and not the comprehension that the Great Emperor had experienced when he had been at his peak.
Ling Han sat as still as a rock. In the first two months, he did not have the slightest idea. The Imperial Scroll was like a heavenly book, and he did not know where to start at all.
“This really is like a tortoise. No matter how strong you are, you won’t know where to exert your strength.”
Ling Han mocked, then swept away all kinds of negative emotions. Using the Six Characters Bright King Curse to clear his mind, he began from the beginning again.
In the blink of an eye, another three months had passed.
Ling Han finally had some comprehension. Then, with endless enlightenment, he finally had a preliminary grasp of this Imperial Scroll.
He started from the Foundation Building Tier and started from the beginning again, determined to sweep aside all imperfections on the path of cultivation.
This step was naturally very fast. In a mere three days, he had completed the cultivation of the Foundation Building Tier, and advanced into the Cauldron Forging Tier.
The Cauldron Forging Tier took Ling Han nine days. Then, he stepped into the Core Formation Tier.

This took a long time. After spending one and a half months’ time, he finally reached the True Self Tier again. Spending another month’s time, he reached the end of the first form of the True Self Tier.
This time, he had already cultivated all the cultivation levels above Celestial Path, using the Imperial Scroll to re-cultivate.

chapters.title: Chapter 4222: Invitation from the Imperial Clan
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
After Ling Han returned to the Stainless Planet, the first thing he did was naturally to collect his cultivation resources.
After such a long time, he had also stabilized his foundations, and could now break through to the Second Form. These cultivation resources were just in time to support him in taking this step.
After returning to his room, Ling Han began to cultivate in seclusion, attempting to break through to the second form of the True Self Tier.
The first form was clay fetus, and the second form was stone fetus.
This was a transformation of the soul.

Ling Han was surrounded by cultivation resources. There were Dao Stones, natural treasures, and so on. He took a deep breath, and the Dao Stones instantly dimmed. The natural treasures also paled in an instant. He had absorbed more than half of the essence.
“Forming Stone Fetus!”
Ling Han humphed lowly. The True Self of Destruction was the first one again, and from the clay fetus onwards, he advanced towards the stone fetus.
Weng, around him, multiple Regulations descended.

Creating the clay fetus was a process of “self-consciousness”. One only had to brand Regulations as their bones, and the waters of the alchemy pool as their blood and flesh, and this did not involve the outside world. However, True Self Tier was the beginning of comprehending heaven and earth, so how could they possibly stay in their own world all the time?
Thus, it was necessary to use the Regulations of heaven and earth to construct the Stone Fetus.
Ling Han’s eyes were tightly shut, but his hands were continuously channelling, grabbing Regulations after Regulations and pressing them into his body, becoming nourishment for the clay fetus.
This was a spiritual body that fed on Regulations.
When he had grabbed enough Regulations, the clay fetus shone brightly, and underwent a qualitative change.
—It was advancing towards the Stone Fetus.
Boom, the power of heaven and earth surged over, condensing towards the True Self of Destruction, boosting the process of transformation.
A whole three days passed, and this process finally stopped. The True Self of Destruction had already turned into a Stone Fetus.

Ling Han couldn’t help but feel that it was a pity. Only when he had just broken through to the second form would he be able to have such high speed. The next eight clay fetuses would have to slowly evolve over a long period of time to become stone fetuses.
Of course, with the supply of natural treasures, the time needed for this process would be greatly shortened.

Thus, cultivators were extremely eager to obtain natural treasures. With a large amount of resources, even a pig could become a prodigy. And for those that didn’t, even prodigies would also disappear among the masses.
Ling Han came out of seclusion. He came to the mountains to test his current strength.
“With this breakthrough, Body Art and mystical power have both leaped to Fifteenth Heaven. With the combined effort of the two, my base power has easily reached 20 Heavens.”

Ling Han revealed a smile. He tapped out a finger, and weng, the True Self of Destruction in his mind immediately responded, grabbing the Regulations of heaven and earth and fusing them into this attack.
Peng!
A mountain peak was instantly obliterated, and the broken mountain peak was directly annihilated, not leaving the slightest bit behind.
This was Destructive Energy!
Ling Han nodded. Only when one came to the second form of the True Self Tier would the uniqueness of the True Self Tier truly be reflected.

He delivered a casual strike, and the stone fetus of True Self Tier stood up to respond. It grabbed the heaven and earth Regulations to boost its power, as well as high-level energy, greatly increasing its battle prowess.
“Just what level has my battle prowess now reached?”

Ling Han was curious. He channelled the Imperial Scroll, then used the Ice Moon Saber, boosting it with high-level energy of ice. The True Self of Destruction also grabbed the Regulations and combined them together. Boom, he punched out explosively, and the heavenly saber appeared, slashing forwards.
Boom, the heavenly saber swept past, and a great mountain ahead of him was directly split open, forming an extremely long canyon.
“Hiss!”

Even Ling Han himself was given a scare. It should be known that the mountain rocks here had all been reinforced by the Buddhist Race. Even if it was not an important place of the Buddhist Race, it was still the Stainless Planet, after all.
“The power of this attack... has reached the level of 31 Heavens!”

Ordinarily, even if he had cultivated the Imperial Scroll, and cast the Imperial Technique, the Imperial Scroll could boost his battle prowess by nine Heavens, so with base power of twenty Heavens, the ultimate battle prowess should only be 29 Heavens.
Now, however, his battle prowess had already reached 31 Heavens.
“This is the result of the participation of the True Self of Destruction.”
“No wonder, starting from the True Self Tier, power is still very important, but its weight in battle prowess is decreasing.”
Ling Han nodded. Even if he did not cultivate Body Art, that would only decrease his battle prowess by a mere five Heavens, which was far inferior to an Imperial Technique.
He returned, only to see a young monk waiting for him.
“Lord Buddha Son.” When the little monk saw him, he hurriedly said, “Lord Changtian invites you over.”
Ling Han nodded, and followed him to see Shi Changtian.

“What is it?” Ling Han asked. Though his cultivation level was lower, the status of Buddha Son was transcendent, and was only beneath the three Bodhisattvas. Thus, there was no need for him to act like a junior in front of Shi Changtian.
—Even if he wanted to, he could not. This was the rule of the Buddhist Race, and Shi Changtian would not allow it either.
“Hehe, a few Imperial Clans have hosted an auction, inviting you to attend,” Shi Changtian said smilingly, taking out an invitation and handing it over.
Ling Han caught it, and couldn’t help but grit his teeth, “What extravagance.”

This piece of paper was made from pulp that had been kneaded from Saintly Tree bark, and the ink used to write the invitation was the blood of a Venerate Tier-level elite. There was a powerful pressure, and if an ordinary True Self Tier cultivator suddenly accepted it, they would probably be suppressed to the point of directly kneeling down.

He swept an eye over it, and sure enough, this was an invitation. Four great Imperial Clans had jointly hosted an auction, and were widely inviting the Dao Child and Imperial Sons of the world to attend.

“It just has to be at this time, interesting,” Ling Han murmured. When he had obtained the Imperial Scroll, no one had witnessed it, but in the hearts of Lin Xuan and the other Imperial Sons, they were probably all wondering if he had obtained the Imperial Scroll.
Even if it was just suspicion, with how important the Imperial Scroll was, they were willing to test it out.

Although the Buddhist Race of the West Heavenly Realm wasn’t as important as the Imperial Clans, they were still a branch of the Buddhist Race, after all. He was sure that the other Imperial Clans wouldn’t dare to act recklessly. At the very least, they would have to have reason and evidence to be able to make things difficult for him.
All right, let’s go and take a look.

Ling Han was presently in desperate need of natural treasures to increase his cultivation level. Since it was an auction hosted by the Imperial Clans, there should be a considerable amount of good stuff.
He put away the invitation, signalled his departure to Shi Changtian, and returned to his quarters.

He had initially planned to bring along the little azure dragon and the large black dog. However, Ling Han didn’t interrupt them as they were at a crucial moment of comprehending the Imperial Scroll. Instead, he set off on his own.

This was a grand event on the level of Imperial Son. The Buddhist Race of the West Heavenly Realm also placed considerable importance on this event. Accompanied by the Dragon Elephant Bodhisattva, space was directly torn open, and he brought Ling Han towards the Liangsen Planet.
Liangsen Planet, this was the home planet of the Seven Luminaries Imperial Clan. The auction this time would be held here.

Ling Han soon saw a familiar face—Cheng Qing, the Imperial Son of the Thousand Spirit Imperial Clan. However, this Imperial Son didn’t retain the memories of the True Dragon Abyss. His eyes merely swept over Ling Han, before retracting.
—Even if he retained them, it was useless. Now, even Ling Han’s appearance and spiritual wave had changed. It would be strange if he could recognize him.
There was also Chi Menghan, Chi Mengshan, the sisters, and Chi Dao, this internally showy guy. Most importantly, he saw something even more familiar in Chi Mengshan’s arms.
Pervert pig!
This lecherous pig was being embraced by the little loli, and looked to be incomparably comfortable. Occasionally, it would even nudge the little loli’s chest.
Fortunately, the little loli hadn’t developed yet. Otherwise, this would be extremely serious harassment.
F***, why was the pervert pig here?

There was also Chi Menghan, Chi Mengshan, the sisters, and Chi Dao, this internally showy guy.
Most importantly, he saw something even more familiar in Chi Mengshan’s arms.
Pervert pig!
This lecherous pig was being embraced by the little loli, and looked to be incomparably comfortable.
Occasionally, it would even nudge the little loli’s chest.
Fortunately, the little loli hadn’t developed yet.
Otherwise, this would be extremely serious harassment.
F***, why was the pervert pig here?

chapters.title: Chapter 4223: Might of Ding Shu
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
The origins of the pervert pig was also very mysterious.
It clearly did not have the slightest bit of battle prowess, yet could not be harmed at all. It was unbelievably amazing.

This guy had also followed Ling Han to the Nine Suns Holy Land, but from some unknown day on, it had suddenly disappeared. Right until this moment, it was actually being embraced by Chi Mengshan, which naturally surprised Ling Han.

Right at this moment, the little pervert pig also looked over, and stared at Ling Han. He actually showed an expression of understanding, as if he was saying, ‘Little guy, even if you change your appearance, I will still recognize you.’
Ling Han didn’t want to expose his identity, so he turned around.
As he turned around, he saw another familiar face.
The Buddha Son of the North Heavenly Realm, Shi Tianyun. Of course, his true identity was the overlord of another Genesis World, Ding Shu.
When he saw Ling Han, Ding Shu immediately bared his teeth, waved his hand, and said, “Ling Han!”
‘Holy f*ck!’
Ling Han really wanted to strangle him to death. ‘Are you doing this on purpose? Are you?’
Hearing the words ‘Ling Han’, the people in the surroundings immediately began to search everywhere.
“Ling Han?”
“Ling Han actually dares to appear again?”
Naturally, it was impossible for them to find Ling Han.
Ding Shu instantly became the target of everyone’s attention. Countless people looked at him, and all of them wore unfriendly expressions, demanding an explanation from him.
“Oh, I was just randomly calling out,” Ding Shu said lazily.
“Don’t you know that this evil thief is the public enemy of the Imperial Clans?” Shi Yuanzhen immediately said. He had almost been killed by Ling Han, so he naturally hated Ling Han to the core.

“Hey, hey, hey. Since when can you represent all the Imperial Clans?” The silver-haired little lolita immediately objected, “At least, Donglin Imperial Clan doesn’t think that Ling Han is an enemy. On the contrary, he is also my sister’s future husband!”
“Aiyo!”
The little loli had spoken too quickly, and was immediately suppressed. Chi Menghan gave her a heavy knock on the head.
“Chi Menghan, don’t keep knocking on my head, I’ll become stupid!” the little loli protested. Then, she spread out her hands, “Brother-in-law, where are you? Come and take in this fierce woman.”
Everyone was speechless. Looks like this little girl was a professional at screwing over her sister.
“Shut up!” Chi Menghan’s pretty face flushed slightly, and she began to suppress this girl who was an expert at screwing over her sister.
Shi Yuanzhen turned his attention back to Ding Shu. “Apologize!”
“Ha, apologize?” Ding Shu picked his ears, “Who do you think you are?”
Hiss!

Everyone was surprised. Ling Han was unruly and disrespectful towards the Imperial Clans, and that was why he had ended up in exile at the ends of the world. You, a mere Buddha Son of the North Heavenly Realm, could it be that you want to make the same mistake?
The Buddhist Race was indeed awesome. No Imperial Clan was willing to trifle with them, but if it was just the North Heavenly Realm branch, who would take it seriously?
“Looks like the North Heavenly Realm is expert at producing stubborn people,” Xu Jie said coldly.

“It’s not that I’m looking down on you guys, but in my eyes, you’re all trash!” Ding Shuwas truly outrageously bold. He began to mock them, “If you have the ability, go and defeat Ling Han on your own, but using the force behind you to suppress others? Hehe.”
This caused all the Imperial Sons to frown in anger. However, at that time, Ling Han was indeed like a demon king, causing them to all develop a strong psychological trauma.

“Humph, that evil thief is only slightly superior because he has cultivated Body Arts, and that is why he has a slight advantage in Core Formation Tier. However, this is the era of the True Self Tier, so the advantage of Body Arts is no longer there,” Guan Yuanming said calmly, his words filled with disdain towards Ling Han.

All the Imperial Sons nodded. They had already advanced into True Self Tier, and could actively channel Regulations to boost their battle prowess. Furthermore, Imperial Techniques could only truly unleash its might from True Self Tier onwards.
If they encountered Ling Han again, they would have a definite chance of winning.
Ding Shu chuckled and said, “Ling Han has been forced to wander the world by you people, and it’s impossible for him to appear again. Naturally, you people can say whatever you like.”
“What is it? Are you still not convinced?” Shi Yuanzhen asked balefully.

“In my eyes, you’re all just trash. What’s there to complain about?” Ding Shu shook his head and smiled at Shi Yuanzhen. “I specialize in dealing with all kinds of dissatisfaction. Come, I’ll beat you into submission!”

If it was not for the fact that this person did not look much like Ling Han, whether it was his appearance or the undulations of his soul, everyone would think that he was Ling Han in disguise. Otherwise, what idiot would take the risk of offending the great Imperial Clans to speak up for Ling Han?
Ling Han was also slightly surprised, because Ding Shu was aware of his identity, yet still wanted to step out. What did this guy want to do?

Shi Yuanzhen was extremely furious. In the hearts of all the Imperial Clans, the Buddha Sons of the four Heavenly Realms were not worthy of being their equal at all. At most, they were just a little bit stronger than the Dao Child of the Holy Land.
And now, Ding Shu actually dared to publicly challenge him?
“You really don’t know the immensity of heaven and earth!” he said balefully, and strode out.

Ling Han was already a thing of the past, yet there was actually someone summoning him back into presence. How preposterous. What was even more infuriating was that this person actually dared to provoke him.
If he didn’t teach him a lesson, how would he be able to vent his anger?
Ding Shu, meanwhile, was still laidback, as if he did not take an Imperial Son to heart.
In everyone’s eyes, this was too arrogant. Shi Yuanzhen was the Imperial Son, and if it was anyone else, they would feel like they were facing a great enemy.
Did he think that he was the Golden Generation?
Only Ling Han knew that Ding Shu definitely had that kind of strength. He was not the Golden Generation, but it was possible that he was even stronger than the Golden Generation.
This was both an affirmation of Ding Shu, as well as a recognition of himself, because in Ling Han’s eyes, he was too similar to Ding Shu.
“Soon, you will kneel on the ground and repent,” Shi Yuanzhen said balefully. He finally made his move.
Boom, he shot out a palm strike, which turned into a blood-coloured giant hammer, that smashed towards Ding Shu.
He had also advanced into the second form of the True Self Tier. This blood hammer was completely formed from Regulations, and naturally came with a high-level energy, possessing terrifying might.
Ding Shu shook his head, and mumbled, “Really f weak!”
Peng, he delivered a palm strike, and Shi Yuanzhen was sent flying.
When he mumbled, everyone thought that he was showing off, but when they saw that Shi Yuanzhen was actually sent flying with a single strike, everyone felt a chill run down their backs.
Heavens, what kind of monster was this?
As the Imperial Son, he had actually been sent flying with a single strike?
Was it because this guy’s cultivation level was too high?
No, no, no. Everyone shook their heads. Ding Shu was clearly the second form of the True Self Tier.
This was the most terrifying part.
Being able to instantly defeat the Imperial Son at the same cultivation level, hiss, this guy was chillingly strong!
“Ling Han!” Several Imperial Sons exclaimed in astonishment.
If it wasn’t Ling Han, would there be a second such terrifying guy in this world?

However, whether it was appearance or soul fluctuation, this guy was completely different from Ling Han. Furthermore, why would Ling Han be so outrageously bold? He was clearly wanted by the Imperial Clans, yet still dared to come over in such a grand manner?
Hiss, there was actually a freak in this world that could match Ling Han?

All the Imperial Sons were extremely depressed. They had finally made it into the True Self Tier with much difficulty, and finally managed to kick Ling Han out of the tournament. This generation should belong to Imperial Sons like them, but just how much time had passed, and yet another super freakish prodigy had appeared.
“Ah!” In the distance, Shi Yuanzhen charged back. He was extremely furious.
Peng!
He had not even charged over, when he was sent flying with a kick.
Ling Han made his move.

chapters.title: Chapter 4224: Two freaks
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
Everyone was dumbfounded.
What was going on?
Why had Shi Yuanzhen been sent flying again? Furthermore, he had not been sent flying by the same person.
As the Imperial Son, was he really that weak?

It was not just the Imperial Clans here. There were also a great many Dao Child and Holy Daughters. After seeing this scene, they all had a thought in their minds — they must have encountered a false Imperial Son.
Otherwise, how could he possibly be so weak?

The Imperial Son was equivalent to being invincible among his peers, but now in a battle of equals, the Imperial Son was sent flying back and forth like a blade of grass. Heh, wasn’t this the biggest joke in the world?

“Buddha Son of West Heavenly Realm!” Someone recognized Ling Han. After all, the reason why Ling Han had been invited was because the Imperial Clans wanted to obtain something from him, or rather find out something, so they would naturally pay more attention to him.
Hearing these words, even more people exclaimed in shock, their expressions extremely strange.
What was going on?
The two people that had dealt with Shi Yuanzhen like he was their grandson were actually both from the Buddhist Race?
F***, was it the Imperial Son that was too weak, or was it the Buddhist Race that was more heaven-defying!
“Shi Xinming, why did you attack?” an Imperial Son shouted. He was Tao Wenbin of the Red Lotus Imperial Clan.
Ling Han smiled faintly and said, “The Buddhist Race of the four Heavenly Realms are a family, so of course we’re brothers in arms!”
Hearing these words, everyone’s expressions became even stranger.

That’s right. The Buddhist Race of the four Heavenly Realms were indeed of the same origin, and were a family, but the problem was that Ding Shu was already completely on the upper hand, and had thrashed Shi Yuanzhen as if he was just playing around. Did he still need Ling Han’s help?
‘You’re clearly showing off!’
However, what was going on with the Buddhist Race? They were so freakish that even the two Buddha Sons were freakishly powerful.

If it was claimed that they had come from the Buddhist Race from the Thirty Three Heavens, that would still be acceptable. The Buddhist Race was also an Imperial Clan, and they were a colossal force at that. Who knew how deep their roots were.
However, even the Buddhist Race branch of the four Heavenly Realms was this awesome?
How could this be believed?

That was because the Buddhist Race of the four Heavenly Realms was only equivalent to the existence of the Holy Land. At most, there would only be a few more Imperial Techniques, but without the boost of the Imperial Scroll, the Imperial Techniqueswould not be able to show their full might.
Ling Han naturally had his own considerations for making a move.

Did he hate Shi Yuanzhen? Of course he did. Then, if Ding Shu alone displayed heaven-defying strength, he would definitely draw suspicion. Whether he was Ling Han in disguise or not, after all, the possibility of this was still there, no matter how small it was.
However, the appearance of two heaven-defying freaks naturally erased this kind of possibility.
This was helping Ding Shu, and also helping Ling Han himself.
“The Buddhist Race’s dignity does not allow for blasphemy!” Ling Han said calmly, taking the moral high ground.
—The reason why I have moved was to safeguard the dignity of the Buddhist Race, not for personal gain.

Ding Shu, meanwhile, laughed loudly. He was naturally aware of Ling Han’s identity. He was clearly venting his personal anger, yet still appeared so open and aboveboard, which he could not help but laugh. In any case, he had always acted as he pleased.
Shi Yuanzhen got back to his feet again. There was a trace of blood at the corner of his lips, and his expression was so furious that he wanted to devour someone.
Two times, two consecutive times, and he had been instantly defeated by two people respectively. How could he endure this?
If he could not get his pride back, how would he be able to survive in the Imperial Son circle in future?

“You guys, are you courting death?” he said balefully. Boom, a terrifying aura was suddenly released from his body, which solidified and boiled, interweaving into blazing flames. His body was also rapidly expanding, turning into a giant that was three hundred meters tall.
He ignited his Imperial Bloodline.
“It’s really strange, people like you. How can there be so much Imperial Blood to burn?” Ding Shu mumbled. Then, he turned to Ling Han and asked, “Do you want to do it, or should I?”
“Whatever.” Ling Han spread his hands, appearing to be completely unconcerned.

“None of you will be able to escape!” Shi Yuanzhen charged over. His left hand delivered a palm strike at Ling Han, while his right hand attacked Ding Shu. As his hands descended, it was as if heaven and earth were collapsing, and endless meteors were falling, as if doomsday was coming.
It was as if these meteors had eyes of their own. Half of them shot towards Ling Han, while the other half shot towards Ding Shu.
Ling Han crossed his arms behind his back, and was in no rush to make a move. Meanwhile, Ding Shu looked laidback, and even stretched out his hand yo dig around in his ear.
This?
Just how much do you guys look down on Shi Yuanzhen?
That’s right. Previously, you all had indeed defeated Shi Yuanzhen in an instant, but now, he had burnt his Imperial Bloodline, which was equivalent to a Great Emperor in his youth.
Would a Great Emperor... lose to someone at the same cultivation level?
The meteors were the first to crash down, and like a violent storm, they shot towards Ling Han and Ding Shu.
Peng, peng, peng! A massive sound of impact was continuously heard, and even the ground was trembling. However, it was incredibly tenaciously holding on, and did not collapse.

This was the home planet of the Imperial Clan, and it had been strengthened by the Ancestral King in the past. To say nothing of them, even if it was a battle between Saints, it would be impossible to destroy this planet without battling for dozens or even hundreds of years.
Hence, this was completely capable of allowing True Self Tiers to go all out in battle.

After the meteor shower was over, Shi Yuanzhen’s two giant hands finally came crashing down. This was a finishing blow. Even if Ling Han and Ding Shu had survived the meteor shower, this blow would still be able to smash the two of them into a pancake.

Shua, right at this moment, a fist suddenly shot into the skies, accompanied by multiple flowers blooming. It was domineering, yet did not have the slightest bit of fire in it. At the same time, a massive palm had also struck towards the skies, marked with dense seals, Buddhist might spreading out.
“Wu!” Shi Yuanzhen gave a muffled humph, and his whole person was pushed backwards. Then, he retreated continuously.
He was shocked. Not only had this attack of his been neutralized, he himself had also been sent backwards.
These two opponents... were freakishly strong!

This was natural. Even if he ignited his Imperial Bloodline, which of Ling Han and Ding Shu was weaker than him? It was hard to predict the outcome of a one-on-one battle, and he still wanted to fight one against two. Then, would it still be reasonable for him to be undefeated?
“Thousand Flower Fists!”
“Divine Kasyapa Palm!”

Everyone exclaimed in shock. These two celestial techniques originated from the Buddhist Race, so it wasn’t strange for them to be recognized. However, what was strange was that these two celestial techniques were only Venerate Tier-level.
Hiss, they had only used a Venerate Tier celestial technique to send Shi Yuanzhen, who was burning Imperial Blood, backwards. This, this, this, this was like a dream.

At this point, everyone no longer had any doubts. It was not that Shi Yuanzhen was weak, but rather that Ling Han and Ding Shu were too strong, strong to the point of surpassing common sense, capable of challenging the Golden Generation.
Shi Yuanzhen had already steadied his footing, and his face alternated between green and white. He had never imagined that even after combusting his Imperial Blood, he would still be unable to win.
Was he going to sustain this slap to his pride?
“Heh, everyone was invited here, so there’s no need to ruin the peace,” an Imperial Son stepped forward to mediate the situation.
“Yes, yes.”
Even more people joined in, one after another, trying to mediate the fight.

Ling Han also knew that there was no way he could kill Shi Yuanzhen here. However, after causing him such great humiliation and bringing such humiliation, this guy’s future days would definitely not be easy.
Thus, Ling Han merely smiled, and went with the flow.
Ding Shu was even more casual. Furthermore, he had just mocked all the Imperial Sons as trash, and now, he was completely unscathed. This was already a great victory.
The two of them exchanged a smile before striding forward.

Just how much do you guys look down on Shi Yuanzhen?
That’s right.
Previously, you all had indeed defeated Shi Yuanzhen in an instant, but now, he had burnt his Imperial Bloodline, which was equivalent to a Great Emperor in his youth.
Would a Great Emperor... lose to someone at the same cultivation level?
The meteors were the first to crash down, and like a violent storm, they shot towards Ling Han and Ding Shu.
Peng, peng, peng!
A massive sound of impact was continuously heard, and even the ground was trembling.
However, it was incredibly tenaciously holding on, and did not collapse.
This was the home planet of the Imperial Clan, and it had been strengthened by the Ancestral King in the past.
To say nothing of them, even if it was a battle between Saints, it would be impossible to destroy this planet without battling for dozens or even hundreds of years.
Hence, this was completely capable of allowing True Self Tiers to go all out in battle.
After the meteor shower was over, Shi Yuanzhen’s two giant hands finally came crashing down.
This was a finishing blow.
Even if Ling Han and Ding Shu had survived the meteor shower, this blow would still be able to smash the two of them into a pancake.
Shua, right at this moment, a fist suddenly shot into the skies, accompanied by multiple flowers blooming.
It was domineering, yet did not have the slightest bit of fire in it.
At the same time, a massive palm had also struck towards the skies, marked with dense seals, Buddhist might spreading out.
“Wu!” Shi Yuanzhen gave a muffled humph, and his whole person was pushed backwards.
Then, he retreated continuously.
He was shocked.
Not only had this attack of his been neutralized, he himself had also been sent backwards.
These two opponents... were freakishly strong!
This was natural.
Even if he ignited his Imperial Bloodline, which of Ling Han and Ding Shu was weaker than him?
It was hard to predict the outcome of a one-on-one battle, and he still wanted to fight one against two.
Then, would it still be reasonable for him to be undefeated?
“Thousand Flower Fists!”
“Divine Kasyapa Palm!”
Everyone exclaimed in shock.
These two celestial techniques originated from the Buddhist Race, so it wasn’t strange for them to be recognized.
However, what was strange was that these two celestial techniques were only Venerate Tier-level.
Hiss, they had only used a Venerate Tier celestial technique to send Shi Yuanzhen, who was burning Imperial Blood, backwards.
This, this, this, this was like a dream.
At this point, everyone no longer had any doubts.
It was not that Shi Yuanzhen was weak, but rather that Ling Han and Ding Shu were too strong, strong to the point of surpassing common sense, capable of challenging the Golden Generation.
Shi Yuanzhen had already steadied his footing, and his face alternated between green and white.
He had never imagined that even after combusting his Imperial Blood, he would still be unable to win.
Was he going to sustain this slap to his pride?
“Heh, everyone was invited here, so there’s no need to ruin the peace,” an Imperial Son stepped forward to mediate the situation.
“Yes, yes.”
Even more people joined in, one after another, trying to mediate the fight.
Ling Han also knew that there was no way he could kill Shi Yuanzhen here.
However, after causing him such great humiliation and bringing such humiliation, this guy’s future days would definitely not be easy.
Thus, Ling Han merely smiled, and went with the flow.
Ding Shu was even more casual.
Furthermore, he had just mocked all the Imperial Sons as trash, and now, he was completely unscathed.
This was already a great victory.
The two of them exchanged a smile before striding forward.

chapters.title: Chapter 4225: Divine Beast Hide
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
Ling Han and Ding Shu left, but the shock that they had caused remained. It was still brewing and spreading, causing even more people to be stunned.
As it turned out, there were actually so many freaks in this world.
Ling Han was really a thing of the past. Even if he had come out of some unknown corner, could his cultivation level still keep up with the current strongest generation?
The Imperial Clans were also stunned. Unfortunately, these two people were both from the Buddhist Race, and there was no possibility of recruiting them at all, which made them sigh in disappointment.

Though the Buddhist Race of the four Heavenly Realms was not very strong, they were a branch of the Buddhist Race, after all. It was fine to suppress them appropriately, but to publicly get rid of a top-notch heir of their clan, the Buddhist Race of the Thirty-Three Heavens would probably fly into a thunderous rage.
—The waters of the Buddhist Race were too deep. Up until now, no one had been able to determine the true strength of the Buddhist Race. For example, how many Saints were there?
“Damn it, could it be that the two of them would monopolize the limelight?” An Imperial Son was indignant.
“In a battle of equal cultivation levels, probably no one would be able to suppress them.”
“Golden Silk Moth and Chi Menghan may be able to put up a fight, but it’s also difficult for them to win.”
“One can only rely on their cultivation level to suppress them.”

All the Imperial Sons and Imperial Daughters had a short exchange of words, and their expressions were all gloomy. They had always been synonymous with being invincible among their peers, and now, they could only look up at two people of the same age, which made them feel very displeased.
Thankfully, at least Ling Han and Ding Shu could be considered Imperial Sons, and did not bring shame to the whole circle of Imperial Sons.
The main focus this time was the auction. When more or less everyone had arrived, the auction segment began.

The auction items were mostly suitable for cultivators below the Spiritual Transformation Tier, but occasionally, Venerate Tier-level treasures would appear, and many Venerate Tiers would fight over them, calling out astronomical bids.

However, a treasure of this level was not something that could be paid for with Dao Stones. It was basically a barter, depending on what type of treasure the auctioneer wanted. It was either a Great Herb, a cultivation technique, a secret technique, or a top grade Divine Metal.

The auction would continue for a total of 10 days, and treasures of the climax level would appear every day. Some of them were so valuable that even Ling Han was envious. Unfortunately, there was no way he could win over Venerate Tier elites.
He also took out alchemical pills for auction. With his current alchemy abilities, he naturally concocted quite a number of extremely precious alchemical pills, which caused a fight.
Especially when it was a few Venerate Tier-level alchemical pills that had been auctioned off for an astronomical price, which made Ling Han overflow with profit.
That’s right. He could attend more of this kind of auction.
Because all the Imperial Clans didn’t connect to the Galaxy Network, Ling Han naturally could avoid exposing the weakness in his identity with his “Ling Han” account.
In the blink of an eye, nine days had passed, and the auction had entered into the last day.

Though there had been climax-level treasures appearing a few days ago, everyone knew that the items being auctioned today would definitely be even more precious. There would be climax-level treasures appearing.
Ling Han also had a large amount of spare cash in his hands, and was waiting to throw it around like crazy.
Sure enough, the first item being auctioned was a Venerate Tier-level treasured medicine that could extend the lifespan of even Venerate Tier elites by 3000 years.
Venerate Tier elites could theoretically live for 100,000 years, and 3,000 years was equivalent to an ordinary person’s lifespan of three years. This was naturally extremely precious.

In truth, this treasure was also completely suitable for True Self Tier, Core Formation Tier, and so on. It could increase the life force of cultivators, and in martial arts, they would naturally be able to advance even further.
However, with Venerable Tier elites participating, especially a few old Venerate Tiers whose lifespans were already close to drying up, who would dare compete with them?
What they were fighting over was not treasures, but rather their lives!
Thus, none of the younger generation tactfully participated in the contest, and allowed the senior Venerate Tier elites to argue with flushed faces.
“Qi Buyan, you’re clearly only 80,000 years old. You’re still far from death. Why are you fighting with me?”

“Pei, I suffered internal injuries when I was young, and in recent years, I’ve always had a resonance with the heavens. I realized that my lifespan is about to end, and you took good care of yourself. Now, you’re only 90,000 years old. At least, you can still live for a few thousand years. What’s the point of competing with me!”

“All of you shut up. Just look at all of you. Your vitality is still boiling, but as for me? I have already entered a period of deterioration of my vitality, and my lifespan is less than a hundred years.”
“Humph, who doesn’t have a limited lifespan? There’s nothing much to say. The one who makes the highest bid wins.”

At this time, those Venerate Tier elites were completely shameless. With their own lives at stake, any kind of friendship was useless. They all increased the bid fiercely. In any case, if they died, so what if they had a pile of treasures?

Finally, this Great Herb was bought by the Sea Spirit Venerate. Not only did he take out a Venerate Tier precious tool, he also added a great many Dao Stones, and promised to help the seller three times.

When the Great Herb was delivered into his hands, the Sea Spirit Venerate swallowed it without a second word. His life essence immediately became much more vigorous, and the other senior Venerates were all extremely envious.
However, the Great Herb had already been consumed. They could only hope that this kind of treasured medicine that could extend lifespan would appear again in the future.

Unfortunately, this kind of treasured medicine was really too rare. If it was not for the fact that its medicinal effects were not enough, it could only extend the lifespan of Saints by two to three years, at most, even Saints would probably take part in the competition. In that case, all Venerate Tiers would have to step aside.
To snatch the life of a Saint, the Great Herb was equivalent to poison.
Ling Han himself was not interested in this kind of Great Herb, but he very much wanted to make a move, because the Nine Mountains Venerate was also running out of lifespan.

‘I have to find a chance to return to the Nine Suns Holy Land, and teach the Imperial Scroll to the old man as well as Luan Xing, and the others,’ he murmured inwardly. If he had the Imperial Scroll’s help, would the old man be able to take another step further, and break through to become a Saint?

If Nine Mountains became a Saint, then he would be able to gain another nine hundred thousand years of lifespan, which was equivalent to having nine more lifetimes. Furthermore, he would also be able to become Ling Han’s incredibly solid backer.
Saint-level beings were beings that even the Imperial Clans would have to be wary of.

That’s right. The Imperial Weapon was capable of killing Saints, but what Saint would foolishly take on the Imperial Weapon head-on? If a Saint went all out to play dirty with you, just see which Imperial Clan would not have a massive headache. They could only hide in their Imperial Clans.

The Battle God Palace was proof of this. Their Killing Saint was completely shameless, hiding in the shadows and ambushing his enemies. Whether it was Saints, Venerate Tiers, or even Foundation Building Tiers, they would kill anyone they encountered. Thus, even the Imperial Clans were unwilling to provoke such an enemy.
The logic was the same. If elites no longer worried about the future, and shamelessly played dirty, even the Imperial Clans would not be able to bear it.

“Next, it’s a piece of beast hide.” After a few more treasures were auctioned off, the auctioneer waved his hand, and a female attendant brought out a brocade plate. There was a pitch-black beast hide laid out on it, but one could clearly see that it was not complete.
In that instant, Ling Han’s heart beat wildly.
Spirit Diagram of Destructive Energy!
It must be. That texture, that incomplete sense of familiarity.

The auctioneer was also a Venerate Tier elite. Otherwise, he wouldn’t be able to suppress the situation at all. He smiled faintly, and said, “According to the appraisal of my clan, this is a piece of beast hide that originated from the Primitive Age. It can even be traced back to when heaven and earth first began, and belongs to the most ancient Divine Beast.”
Everyone’s interest was piqued upon hearing this.

“However, the seals on it... are far from being as old as this. After careful appraisal by my clan, they should be about ten million years old. There would be some errors, but at most, it would only be one to two million years of difference,” the auctioneer continued.

chapters.title: Chapter 4226: Exchange
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
About ten million years ago?
Everyone flipped through history. However, a considerable number of people looked confused.

“That’s right. That is a lapse in history.” The auctioneer nodded, “It is rumored that there was a Great Emperor in that era, but there was also a storm of darkness, which caused a great catastrophe. In fact, in the North Heavenly Realm...”

He didn’t continue, but everyone knew that it was at that time that the North Heavenly Realm damaged their fortune, causing the overall overall level of cultivation of an entire Heavenly Realm to drop drastically. From then onwards, the North Heavenly Realm had become the weakest of all four Heavenly Realms.
Something that could affect a Heavenly Realm, and the effects had continued for so many years, what kind of great event had happened all those years ago?
There were great elites who had been studying historical records, and there were even people who were tracing back time, but up until now, this was still a great mystery.
Then, could this piece of beast hide possibly expose this lapse in history?
Ling Han knew very well that this was definitely not a historical record, but the fifth corner of the Destructive Energy Spirit Diagram!

“I have to clarify first. Though this beast hide originates from the Divine Beast, the divine essence within has long since been refined. If you want to refine it into a Spirit Tool, hoho, that would be absolutely impossible,” the auctioneer said with a smile.

This caused some Venerate Tier elites to be disappointed. They indeed wanted to move, and obtain the hide to refine it into a tool, or use it to comprehend the Heavenly Dao. Because a Divine Beast was born by nature, it was naturally the closest to Dao.
However, it had already lost its divine essence, so what use was it?
“Now, this beast hide only has the characteristic of being sturdy. If it is wrapped around one’s body, it would be difficult for sharp weapons to cause harm,” the auctioneer said.

This caused all the Venerates to shake their heads. For cultivation levels like theirs, aside from Venerate Tier precious tools that could increase battle prowess, their attacks stimulated the Regulations of heaven and earth, so how could they allow a sharp weapon to strike them?
Thus, this effect of the beast hide was equivalent to nothing.
Good!

Meanwhile, Ling Han was cheering internally. He hoped that the auctioneer would lower the value of this piece of beast hide as much as possible. In that way, there would be no need for him to worry that it would be fought over by those Venerate Tier elites.

“However, no matter what, this is still the skin of a Divine Beast. Furthermore, the seals are incredibly mysterious. Who knows, it may contain an earth-shattering secret.” The auctioneer changed the topic. He could not keep talking about shortcomings.
However, many of the people here were the Venerate Tier elites of Imperial Clans. If he deliberately didn’t speak of its shortcomings, he would also attract great trouble in the future.
“Alright, the starting bid is 1,000,000 Dao Stones,” the auctioneer said.
A million Dao Stones was not a small sum, but if it was used to buy a piece of Divine Beast hide, it was not a loss either.
“1,000,000.” A Venerate Tier elite said with a smile, then said, “I’m buying it for collection. It’s at least a Divine Beast hide.”
This caused all the Venerate Tier elites to laugh as well, but no one placed a bid. Without divine essence, what use was a Divine Beast hide other than for show?
Oh, that’s right. Make some clothes out of this beast hide for his grandson, so he could use it to protect himself?
F***, then it might as well be a Substitution Seal. What need was there for a million Dao Stones? Do you think that Venerate Tiers could easily obtain a large number of Dao Stones?
“1,100,000.” Someone raised the bid.
It was not Ling Han, but Ding Shu.
Ling Han’s heart clenched. How could he have forgotten about this guy?
Others might not be able to tell how valuable this hide was, but Ding Shu had cultivated Destructive Energy, so how could he not know the use of this hide?

That Venerate Tier whose bid had been increased was startled. He had not thought that there would be a junior competing with him. He thought for a moment, and couldn’t help but smile in spite of himself. In any case, it was just playing around, so there was no need for him to lower himself to the level of a junior.
He did not speak, and gave up the competition.
“It’s already 1,100,000. Is there anyone else bidding?” The auctioneer swept his gaze over the masses, slightly displeased. For better or worse, this was still a Divine Beast hide.
Fine then.
“1.2 million,” Ling Han said.
“1,300,000.” There was no need for the auctioneer to start the bidding, and Ding Shu immediately increased the bid, appearing to be determined to win.
“1.4 million.”
“1.5 million.”
Ling Han opened his mouth, and Ding Shu immediately increased the bid again, aggressively.
Yi, wasn’t it said that the Buddhist Race of the four Heavenly Realms were a family, and would love and support each other?
Everyone was watching the show. They had not thought that this piece of Divine Beast hide would actually be the most fiercely contested between the two Buddha Sons of the Buddhist Race.
Yi, was this really some kind of treasure? Otherwise, why would they be fighting so fiercely over it?

However, even the great elites of the Imperial Clans didn’t notice anything off. Otherwise, how could they possibly put it up for auction? From this aspect, it didn’t seem to have any value to be contested over in the auction.
“2,900,000.” Shi Yuanzhen spoke up, becoming the third competitor.
What was going on?
Everyone faltered for a moment before coming to a realization.

Shi Yuanzhen had been horribly defeated by Ling Han and Ding Shu, and his reputation had been ruined. He could not get his revenge in terms of battle prowess, so he had to come at this time to disgust the two of them.
“3,000,000.” Ding Shu was completely unconcerned, showing his wealth.
“3.5 million.” Shi Yuanzhen began to increase the bid greatly.
“Four million.” Ding Shu immediately followed, not giving Ling Han the chance to speak.
“4.5 million!”

A thought flashed in Ling Han’s head. What need was there for him to compete with Ding Shu? He had cultivated a total of four corners of Destructive Energy Spirit Diagram, and one of the corners was used for the exchange with Ding Shu, while the other was what he had gotten from Ding Shu in exchange. Thus, he still had two corners of Spirit Diagram that he could use for another trade.
Thus, so what if this corner of the Spirit Diagram was given to Ding Shu? He could completely trade for it.
In this way, it was a win-win situation.
Good.
Ling Han didn’t say anything else. If Ding Shu couldn’t compete with Shi Yuanzhen, it wouldn’t be too late for him to place another bid.

Shi Yuanzhen increased the bid a few times, pushing the price of the Divine Beast hide up to six million Dao Stones. He did not dare to continue playing, fearing that Ding Shu would suddenly give in. Then, he would be compelled to pay for this piece of beast hide.
“Six million once.”
“Six million twice.”
“Six million, going thrice.”
“Deal.”
The auctioneer made the final bid. If it was six million, it just barely met his expectations.

Afterward, a few more treasures were placed on the stage. However, Ling Han wasn’t interested in any of them. Those were only celestial techniques. He no longer lacked them. Unless he was given the Imperial Scroll, even an Imperial Technique would find it very difficult to attract his interest.
After all, he had already obtained quite a number of Imperial Techniques, so it was already enough.

If it was the Imperial Scroll, the more it was, the better. This was a path that a Great Emperor had walked before, and had great reference value. Unfortunately, the Imperial Scroll was the foundation of an Imperial Clan. Who would put it up for auction?
‘Sigh, I can only look for other people like the Descending Heaven Holy Emperor,’ Ling Han thought.
The auction this time round had ended successfully, and Ling Han immediately went to find Ding Shu.
“There is indeed more than one corner of Spirit Diagram you possess!” Without waiting for Ling Han to speak, Ding Shu spoke first.
Otherwise, Ling Han wouldn’t have given up so easily. Now, he was definitely here to trade.
Ling Han smiled faintly, and said, “You’re so smart, so there’s no need for me to say anything else. Let’s trade.”
“I haven’t learnt it yet!” Ding Shu emphasized.
“It’s all right. You haven’t learnt mine either,” Ling Han said with a smile. “We can trade back when I’m done. Isn’t that the same?”
“Your words make a lot of sense. I actually can’t refute them.” Ding Shu sighed. He kept feeling that something was off.
Yi, wasn’t it he who had bought this Spirit Diagram? Why was it Ling Han who would learn it first?
However, he couldn’t refuse the temptation of exchanging Spirit Diagrams with Ling Han, so he could only nod in agreement.

They indeed wanted to move, and obtain the hide to refine it into a tool, or use it to comprehend the Heavenly Dao.
Because a Divine Beast was born by nature, it was naturally the closest to Dao.
However, it had already lost its divine essence, so what use was it?
“Now, this beast hide only has the characteristic of being sturdy.
If it is wrapped around one’s body, it would be difficult for sharp weapons to cause harm,” the auctioneer said.
This caused all the Venerates to shake their heads.

For cultivation levels like theirs, aside from Venerate Tier precious tools that could increase battle prowess, their attacks stimulated the Regulations of heaven and earth, so how could they allow a sharp weapon to strike them?
Thus, this effect of the beast hide was equivalent to nothing.
Good!
Meanwhile, Ling Han was cheering internally.
He hoped that the auctioneer would lower the value of this piece of beast hide as much as possible.
In that way, there would be no need for him to worry that it would be fought over by those Venerate Tier elites.
“However, no matter what, this is still the skin of a Divine Beast.
Furthermore, the seals are incredibly mysterious.
Who knows, it may contain an earth-shattering secret.” The auctioneer changed the topic.
He could not keep talking about shortcomings.
However, many of the people here were the Venerate Tier elites of Imperial Clans.
If he deliberately didn’t speak of its shortcomings, he would also attract great trouble in the future.
“Alright, the starting bid is 1,000,000 Dao Stones,” the auctioneer said.
A million Dao Stones was not a small sum, but if it was used to buy a piece of Divine Beast hide, it was not a loss either.
“1,000,000.” A Venerate Tier elite said with a smile, then said, “I’m buying it for collection.
It’s at least a Divine Beast hide.”
This caused all the Venerate Tier elites to laugh as well, but no one placed a bid.
Without divine essence, what use was a Divine Beast hide other than for show?
Oh, that’s right.
Make some clothes out of this beast hide for his grandson, so he could use it to protect himself?
F***, then it might as well be a Substitution Seal.
What need was there for a million Dao Stones?
Do you think that Venerate Tiers could easily obtain a large number of Dao Stones?
“1,100,000.” Someone raised the bid.
It was not Ling Han, but Ding Shu.
Ling Han’s heart clenched.
How could he have forgotten about this guy?
Others might not be able to tell how valuable this hide was, but Ding Shu had cultivated Destructive Energy, so how could he not know the use of this hide?
That Venerate Tier whose bid had been increased was startled.
He had not thought that there would be a junior competing with him.
He thought for a moment, and couldn’t help but smile in spite of himself.
In any case, it was just playing around, so there was no need for him to lower himself to the level of a junior.
He did not speak, and gave up the competition.
“It’s already 1,100,000.
Is there anyone else bidding?” The auctioneer swept his gaze over the masses, slightly displeased.
For better or worse, this was still a Divine Beast hide.
Fine then.
“1.2 million,” Ling Han said.
“1,300,000.” There was no need for the auctioneer to start the bidding, and Ding Shu immediately increased the bid, appearing to be determined to win.
“1.4 million.”
“1.5 million.”
Ling Han opened his mouth, and Ding Shu immediately increased the bid again, aggressively.
Yi, wasn’t it said that the Buddhist Race of the four Heavenly Realms were a family, and would love and support each other?
Everyone was watching the show.
They had not thought that this piece of Divine Beast hide would actually be the most fiercely contested between the two Buddha Sons of the Buddhist Race.
Yi, was this really some kind of treasure?
Otherwise, why would they be fighting so fiercely over it?
However, even the great elites of the Imperial Clans didn’t notice anything off.
Otherwise, how could they possibly put it up for auction?
From this aspect, it didn’t seem to have any value to be contested over in the auction.
“2,900,000.” Shi Yuanzhen spoke up, becoming the third competitor.
What was going on?
Everyone faltered for a moment before coming to a realization.
Shi Yuanzhen had been horribly defeated by Ling Han and Ding Shu, and his reputation had been ruined.
He could not get his revenge in terms of battle prowess, so he had to come at this time to disgust the two of them.
“3,000,000.” Ding Shu was completely unconcerned, showing his wealth.
“3.5 million.” Shi Yuanzhen began to increase the bid greatly.
“Four million.” Ding Shu immediately followed, not giving Ling Han the chance to speak.
“4.5 million!”
A thought flashed in Ling Han’s head.
What need was there for him to compete with Ding Shu?

He had cultivated a total of four corners of Destructive Energy Spirit Diagram, and one of the corners was used for the exchange with Ding Shu, while the other was what he had gotten from Ding Shu in exchange.
Thus, he still had two corners of Spirit Diagram that he could use for another trade.
Thus, so what if this corner of the Spirit Diagram was given to Ding Shu?
He could completely trade for it.
In this way, it was a win-win situation.
Good.
Ling Han didn’t say anything else.
If Ding Shu couldn’t compete with Shi Yuanzhen, it wouldn’t be too late for him to place another bid.
Shi Yuanzhen increased the bid a few times, pushing the price of the Divine Beast hide up to six million Dao Stones.
He did not dare to continue playing, fearing that Ding Shu would suddenly give in.
Then, he would be compelled to pay for this piece of beast hide.
“Six million once.”
“Six million twice.”
“Six million, going thrice.”
“Deal.”
The auctioneer made the final bid.
If it was six million, it just barely met his expectations.
Afterward, a few more treasures were placed on the stage.
However, Ling Han wasn’t interested in any of them.
Those were only celestial techniques.
He no longer lacked them.
Unless he was given the Imperial Scroll, even an Imperial Technique would find it very difficult to attract his interest.
After all, he had already obtained quite a number of Imperial Techniques, so it was already enough.
If it was the Imperial Scroll, the more it was, the better.
This was a path that a Great Emperor had walked before, and had great reference value.
Unfortunately, the Imperial Scroll was the foundation of an Imperial Clan.
Who would put it up for auction?
‘Sigh, I can only look for other people like the Descending Heaven Holy Emperor,’ Ling Han thought.
The auction this time round had ended successfully, and Ling Han immediately went to find Ding Shu.
“There is indeed more than one corner of Spirit Diagram you possess!” Without waiting for Ling Han to speak, Ding Shu spoke first.
Otherwise, Ling Han wouldn’t have given up so easily.
Now, he was definitely here to trade.
Ling Han smiled faintly, and said, “You’re so smart, so there’s no need for me to say anything else.
Let’s trade.”
“I haven’t learnt it yet!” Ding Shu emphasized.
“It’s all right.
You haven’t learnt mine either,” Ling Han said with a smile.
“We can trade back when I’m done.
Isn’t that the same?”
“Your words make a lot of sense.
I actually can’t refute them.” Ding Shu sighed.
He kept feeling that something was off.
Yi, wasn’t it he who had bought this Spirit Diagram?
Why was it Ling Han who would learn it first?
However, he couldn’t refuse the temptation of exchanging Spirit Diagrams with Ling Han, so he could only nod in agreement.

chapters.title: Chapter 4227: Slander
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
After Ling Han obtained the fifth corner of the Destructive Energy Spirit Diagram, he immediately began to cultivate.
He was already accustomed to this. Merely a day later, he had completed his cultivation.
By this time, he could already clearly deduce that there were a total of nine parts of the Spirit Diagram of Destructive Energy.
He had already obtained five, and was still missing four portions.

Because they were at Liangsen Planet, Ling Han didn’t test out the new might of Destructive Energy. Instead, he went to find Ding Shu, and traded for the original Spirit Diagram of Destructive Energy.

In fact, if he didn’t trade, he would definitely have a greater advantage. It would be equivalent to obtaining a Spirit Diagram of Destructive Energy for nothing, but this wasn’t Ling Han’s character.
Ding Shu also sighed ruefully, and said, “Though we are destined to become competitors in future, that would not hinder our personal relations, right?”
“That’s right.” Ling Han nodded.
“All right.” Ding Shu stretched out his hand, and shook Ling Han’s hand. They exchanged a smile.
Ling Han returned to his room, only to see that a guest had already arrived.

This was a young man with an imposing aura. He looked to be in his mid-twenties, and was dressed in a blue warrior suit. His nose was clear and his eyes were bright, and he was overwhelmingly handsome.
His hair was jet-black, but upon closer look, every single strand of hair was glowing. They were actually multiple seals!
What a terrifying guy!
Ling Han immediately made his judgement. This was a True Self Tier elite, but had reached the fourth form, and his abilities were temporarily unknown.
“Let me introduce myself. My name is Lin Yun,” the young man said with a faint smile.
‘Lin Yun?’

The Imperial Son of the Fire Cloud Imperial Clan, ranked second, and first was naturally Lin Xuan, a member of the Golden Generation. Although Lin Yun wasn’t as freakish as Lin Xuan, he was still considerably stronger than Lin Lang’s generation, and could be called the Silver Generation.

Ling Han did not have a good impression of the Lin Clan. However, he was presently Shi Xinming, and had no animosity with the Fire Cloud Imperial Clan. Of course, he could not possibly show animosity for no reason.
“Hello.” Ling Han nodded.
‘F*ck! That’s it?’

Lin Yun felt a little awkward. ‘I can be considered your senior, at least. Now that I’ve humbled myself to come here, you didn’t even say please sit down or serve me a cup of tea. Aren’t you being too arrogant?’
How arrogant.
He calmed himself down and said, “I want to know if you obtained the inheritance of the Descending Heaven Holy Emperor.”
‘Here it comes.’

Ling Han thought internally. He knew that the Imperial Clan elites definitely hadn’t invited him over purely for the sake of the auction. Instead, they were obsessing over the inheritance of the Descending Heaven Holy Emperor.

However, he was a Buddha Son, after all, and they weren’t sure whether he had obtained the inheritance of the Holy Emperor or not. Thus, they could only use this method to probe him. Otherwise, they might directly kidnap him and search through his divine sense.
“So what if I did? So what if I didn’t?” he asked calmly. “What does it have to do with Brother Lin?”ree
He showed an obvious hostility, because this involved his privacy, so he had every reason to express his displeasure.

Lin Yun laughed loudly, pressed his hands down, and said, “Brother Shi, don’t be nervous. I have no malicious intent! Name your price. As long as you are willing to hand over the Imperial Scroll, my Lin Clan can teach you three Imperial Techniques!”
Imperial Technique!
This was too alluring. Even if Ling Han was the Buddha Son of West Heavenly Realm, obtaining an Imperial Technique was still extremely difficult.
Three Imperial Techniques... was probably enough to make a Dao Child betray the Holy Land.
Yet Ling Han was completely unconcerned. The Imperial Technique was only a manifestation of the Imperial Scroll. How could it compare to the Imperial Scroll?
Furthermore, did he still lack Imperial Techniques?
It was given for free, and he did not mind learning it, but to use the Imperial Scroll in exchange for it was really too funny.
Ling Han smiled faintly, “Brother Lin, do you think that I have the upper hand in this deal?”
“Of course,” Lin Yun nodded proudly.

“Alright,” Ling Han said with a smile. This made Lin Yun feel delighted, but his next words almost made Lin Yun’s nose twist in anger, “Then how about I give Brother Lin three Imperial Techniques, and Brother Lin let me see the Imperial Scroll of the Lin Clan?”
Why don’t you just f go to the heavens?

Just how valuable was the Imperial Scroll of the Lin Clan? That was the foundation of the Lin Clan, and even among the Lin Clan, the number of people that could cultivate the Imperial Scroll of the Lin Clan could be counted on one hand.

Even for him, not only could he only obtain the part of the Imperial Scroll that corresponded to a certain cultivation level, the Saints of the clan had also placed a restriction in his mind. If any external force touched the memories of the Imperial Scroll, his mind would immediately explode.
“Humph, you’ve gone too far!” he immediately said.

Ling Han spread his hands and said, “So strange. It’s my advantage that you gave me three Imperial Techniques to trade for the Imperial Scroll, but I have gone too far for giving you three Imperial Techniques to take a look at the Lin Clan’s Imperial Scroll?”
“Are you an idiot or are you an idiot?”
Lin Yun was enraged. ‘You dare to insult me right in front of me?’
“Shi Xinming, don’t be ungrateful!” he said balefully.

Ling Han shook his head, and said, “I’m truly sorry. I didn’t obtain the inheritance of the Holy Emperor. Those members of your Golden Generation have all arrived before me, so obtaining the inheritance of the Holy Emperor should also be you people from the Imperial Clans. What does it have to do with me?”
Lin Yun looked at Ling Han balefully, and after a long while, he nodded, “Since you insist on going your own way, fine, bear the consequences.”
He strode off.
Ling Han smiled eerily. No matter what, he would not hand over the Imperial Scroll, and would definitely not compromise.
So what if he had offended the Imperial Clans? It was not as if he had not offended them before. Worse come to worst, he could just change his identity again.
Only after a while, someone came to find Ling Han again.
An Imperial Son of the Thousand Spirit Imperial Clan, but not Cheng Qing.
He was very polite, and had Ling Han name his own price. As long as he was willing to share the inheritance of the Holy Emperor, anything was negotiable.

Meanwhile, Ling Han wore a troubled expression, and said, “I’m truly sorry. I’ve already reached an agreement with the Lin Clan just then, and I’ve already received many benefits from them. I’ve already handed over all of my gains from the corpse of the Holy Emperor.”
The Imperial Son nodded, and said, “All right, I understand.”
He turned around and left. It was obvious that he had gone to report to the higher-ups of the clan. This was a serious matter.
After another while, the third Imperial Clan member arrived.

This time, it was the Imperial Daughter, who had come. She was as beautiful as a fairy, but her abilities were also astonishingly strong. She belonged to the Silver Generation, and was a generation older than Baili Che and the others. However, in terms of age, she was only about fifty years older than them.

For cultivators, especially those with higher cultivation levels, to say nothing of fifty years, even a hundred years would be like the snap of a finger. Thus, strictly speaking, whether it was the Golden Generation, the Silver Generation, or Baili Che’s generation, they were all from the same generation.
However, the Golden Generation was too freakish, and they had to separate them out, which was why they were called the Golden Generation and the Silver Generation.
Though this person was an Imperial Daughter, her purpose for coming was the same. She wanted Ling Han to share the Imperial Scroll with him.

In any case, Ling Han had already slandered the Lin Clan, so he naturally didn’t mind throwing some more slander at them. Thus, he used the same excuse to refuse—he had made a deal with the Lin Clan, and handed over all his gains without leaving anything behind.
Two clans, three clans, and very soon, all the Imperial Clans found out. The Lin Clan had beaten them to it, and obtained the inheritance of the Holy Emperor.

In truth, the Imperial Clans did not mind sharing this Imperial Scroll. In any case, it was only for reference purposes, as long as the Imperial Scroll was not taught to outsiders, that was fine. But you, the Lin Clan, actually want to keep it all for yourself? That could not be allowed!
All of a sudden, the Lin Clan became the target of all.
