chapters.title: Chapter 4228: Forced
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
This was naturally slander.
No matter how the members of the Lin Clan tried to explain, it was useless. When it involved the Imperial Scroll, anyone would rather believe it to be true than not.
Finally, the Venerate Tier elite from the Lin Clan Clan personally stepped out, demanding that Ling Han give an explanation in public.
Ling Han stepped out, and said with a smile, “Apologies, I was just joking with everyone. I did not gain anything from the corpse of the Holy Emperor.”
‘F*ck! Is this a joke?’
The Fire Cloud Imperial Clan was almost angered to death. ‘You’ve troubled the Lin Clan so badly, and you want to remove yourself from this matter by saying this was just a joke?’

But what could they do about it? Though Ling Han had screwed them over, he still acted in the position of a junior. He said that it was a joke, and the Lin Clan had not lost anything because of this. Could it be that they wanted to beat Ling Han to death because of a joke?

Don’t think that the Buddhist Race of the West Heavenly Realm was not the Buddhist Race. After all, Ling Han still had the title of Buddha Son. If they went too far, that would be looking down on the Buddhist Race.
No Imperial Clan would be willing to shoulder this responsibility.

Added with the fact that the Dragon Elephant Bodhisattva had stepped out to apologize to the great Imperial Clans on Ling Han’s behalf, acting like an elder that was protecting his junior, so what could the Lin Clan do about it?
And just like that, the farce disappeared without a trace.
But just the night before Ling Han was about to leave with the Dragon Elephant Bodhisattva, an uninvited guest paid Ling Han a visit.
This was called an uninvited guest because he had barged in without Ling Han’s permission.
Lin Xuan was the most outstanding member of the Fire Cloud Imperial Clan. His natural talent in cultivation was also the strongest in history, and he was a member of the Golden Generation.

“I’ll give you one last chance. Hand over the Imperial Scroll,” Lin Xuan said calmly. His expression was gentle, but coupled with the intertwining of dragons and phoenixes on his body and the strange phenomenon of Spiritual Springs appearing beneath his feet, it formed a great pressure.

Without waiting for Ling Han to speak, he continued, “I am destined to become Emperor, and becoming my enemy is an unwise move! I can easily kill you. Furthermore, at most, a few days later, I may not even remember your name after killing you.”
“Your natural talent in cultivation is not too bad, but in my eyes, you are like an ant. The gap is as wide as the sky!”

“Your only value is to hand over the Imperial Scroll, and when I become Emperor in the future, even if it is just this little bit of kindness, it would be enough to allow you to run rampant in the world, and no one would dare touch you!”
“Moreover, the Imperial Scroll is only worth studying for me. Even if I don’t have it, it can’t stop me from achieving Dao!”
“Thus, to become my enemy, or have me owe you a favor... If you can still be considered smart, you should know what choice you have to make.”
Lin Xuan stood proudly in front of Ling Han, like an emperor giving alms to Ling Han.
Ling Han was furious. This guy was too conceited.

“Hehe, so what if you’re the Golden Generation?” He revealed a disdainful smile, “You were only born about a hundred years earlier than me. If we had the same cultivation time, I would be able to beat you up with one hand. Do you believe me?”

Lin Xuan wasn’t angered, and he said, “Your self-deceiving words are completely meaningless, and it’s also impossible for you to anger me. I’ve already said that you’re only an ant on the ground, while I’m the True Dragon from the Nine Heavens. Do you think that the True Dragon will become angry just because an ant on the ground is baring its fangs and brandishing its claws at him?”
“Unworthy, you’re not worthy!”
He spoke matter-of-factly, as if he was merely stating a fact.

Indeed, he had the right to be proud. The Golden Generation was comparable to the Great Emperors of the past. Furthermore, he was a whole two major cultivation levels higher than Ling Han. This was an absolutely one-sided suppression, and a world of difference.
Ling Han remained silent, a faint smile on his face.
Everything was up to the future.
At present, he was indeed no match for Lin Xuan, but the gap between the two of them would only continue to shrink. One day, he would beat up this bastard.
Just wait and see.
“Imperial Scroll!” Lin Xuan shouted lightly. Weng, this exploded in Ling Han’s mind.
Ling Han couldn’t help but tremble, blood gushing from all his apertures.

Lin Xuan was too strong. He was Sect Master-level, and was already qualified to be called a great elite. This kind of elite only had to give out a light shout, and it would be enough to kill a True Self Tier.
Ling Han’s body was as straight as a spear. His strength was indeed inferior, but in terms of willpower, he was definitely not the slightest bit inferior.
“Humph, pointless resistance!” Lin Xuan sneered. Boom, there was no need for him to make a move at all. His divine sense was like a mountain, pressing down on Ling Han.
Even if Ling Han’s physique was astonishing, under the pressure of the Sect Master-level divine sense, every bone in his body was still trembling.
Lin Xuan hadn’t used his full power yet. Otherwise, he could kill Ling Han with a single thought.
“Kneel!” Lin Xuan said balefully. ‘Aren’t you arrogant? Then I’ll make you lose all face and leave behind a humiliation that will never be erased.’

“Imperial Son Xuan, you have gone too far!” The Dragon Elephant Bodhisattva’s voice rang out. He had come with Ling Han in the first place with the intention of protecting him, so how could he just sit by and watch?
Lin Xuan was slightly startled, but was completely unconcerned, “So it is Dragon Elephant Bodhisattva.”
“You can leave now,” the Dragon Elephant Bodhisattva said calmly.
“What if I say no?” Lin Xuan said with a smile. He was actually unafraid of even Venerate Tier elites.

The Dragon Elephant Bodhisattva couldn’t help but feel angry. It’s true that you’re the Imperial Son, and the Golden Generation is indeed awesome, but I’m a Venerate Tier, after all, and a three-star one at that. There’s a gap of a major tier between us, so what right do you have to act arrogant in front of me?
“Don’t force me to make a move,” he said. Though his tone was still relatively calm, there was already a hint of anger in his tone.
Lin Xuan finally smiled, “I was just joking. How could I dare to disobey a Venerate Tier’s command?”
He waved his hand, turned and left.

Lin Xuandared to act so wantonly because he was from the Imperial Clan and that he himself was a Sect Master. Thus, he could trample all over Ling Han as he pleased. He didn’t even care about Dragon Elephant Bodhisattva.
Good! Good! Good!

Now, he had to swallow this anger.
After a day, the Dragon Elephant Bodhisattva brought Ling Han back to the Stainless Planet.

He pretended to be cultivating in seclusion, then built a Transfer Formation for himself. He left the Stainless Planet, then changed his appearance, and headed all the way to the Nine Suns Planet.

No matter how the members of the Lin Clan tried to explain, it was useless.

Ling Han stepped out, and said with a smile, “Apologies, I was just joking with everyone.
I did not gain anything from the corpse of the Holy Emperor.”
‘F*ck!
Is this a joke?’
The Fire Cloud Imperial Clan was almost angered to death.
‘You’ve troubled the Lin Clan so badly, and you want to remove yourself from this matter by saying this was just a joke?’
But what could they do about it?
Though Ling Han had screwed them over, he still acted in the position of a junior.
He said that it was a joke, and the Lin Clan had not lost anything because of this.
Could it be that they wanted to beat Ling Han to death because of a joke?
Don’t think that the Buddhist Race of the West Heavenly Realm was not the Buddhist Race.
After all, Ling Han still had the title of Buddha Son.
If they went too far, that would be looking down on the Buddhist Race.
No Imperial Clan would be willing to shoulder this responsibility.

Added with the fact that the Dragon Elephant Bodhisattva had stepped out to apologize to the great Imperial Clans on Ling Han’s behalf, acting like an elder that was protecting his junior, so what could the Lin Clan do about it?
And just like that, the farce disappeared without a trace.
But just the night before Ling Han was about to leave with the Dragon Elephant Bodhisattva, an uninvited guest paid Ling Han a visit.
This was called an uninvited guest because he had barged in without Ling Han’s permission.
Lin Xuan was the most outstanding member of the Fire Cloud Imperial Clan.
His natural talent in cultivation was also the strongest in history, and he was a member of the Golden Generation.
“I’ll give you one last chance.
Hand over the Imperial Scroll,” Lin Xuan said calmly.

His expression was gentle, but coupled with the intertwining of dragons and phoenixes on his body and the strange phenomenon of Spiritual Springs appearing beneath his feet, it formed a great pressure.

I can easily kill you.

This guy was too conceited.

chapters.title: Chapter 4229: Old Black is Wounded
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
Towards Ling Han, this disciple of his, the Nine Mountains Venerate felt both admiration and gratitude.

Actually, there were quite a few disciples that garnered his admiration. It was fine as long as their natural talent was good, but Ling Han wasn’t only one-sided asking for favors from him. He was also helping him back. For example, the special crystal he had obtained at the Blood Sea contained a sliver of the Dao of a Great Emperor.
Ling Han gave it to him without the slightest hesitation. Though it did not help him advance into Saint Tier, it allowed him to rush up from Seven Star Venerate Tier to Nine Stars in a single go.
And now, it was an Imperial Scroll!
Imperial Scroll, what kind of concept was that?
Whoever possessed the Imperial Scroll would be able to create a Pseudo Imperial Clan. Compared to the true Imperial Clan, they were only lacking an Imperial Weapon.

However, given enough time, Ling Han might be able to find the Descending Heaven Holy Emperor’s Imperial Weapon. As long as he cultivated the Imperial Scroll, what need would he have to worry about not being able to grasp the corresponding Imperial Weapon?

However, it was alsothis precious Imperial Scroll that Ling Han had given it to him without hesitation. He had even traveled millions and millions of kilometers, taking the risk of being discovered by the Imperial Clans.
How could the Nine Mountains Venerable not be touched?
If it could be said that he had previously purely admired Ling Han’s natural talent, then now, the relationship between the two of them was a little like Master and disciple, father and son.
“Good child!” The Nine Mountains Venerate didn’t say anything to express his gratitude. He simply patted Ling Han’s shoulder and said this.
Ling Han only smiled, and immediately moved to leave.
He didn’t have the Nine Mountains Venerate send him off. Perhaps the elites of the Imperial Clans were monitoring the old man, and this would expose his whereabouts.
Thus, another two months later, Ling Han finally returned to Stainless Planet.
On the Galaxy Network, discussions about him and Ding Shu were extremely heated.
The two Buddha Sons were too awesome!
The Imperial Son, Shi Yuanzhen, was instantly defeated. Even after burning Imperial Blood, he was no match. What did this mean?

This generationof Imperial Sons had already been trampled under the feet of Ling Han and Ding Shu. If one wanted to stand against them at the same cultivation level, the only one who could do so would have to be the Golden Generation.
“No, no, no. You guys are exaggerating too much about Shi Xinming and Shi Tianyun’s strength. They are indeed strong, but they are definitely no match for the Golden Generation.”

“That’s right. Putting aside the fact that there is no absolute fairness in the cultivation world, with a gap of two major tiers, it is possible that they would never be able to catch up to the Golden Generation in terms of cultivation level in this lifetime. Against them, the only result would be death.”

“That’s right. It’s extremely likely that when they have just advanced into Saint Tier, the competition among the Golden Generation geniuses would already be concluded, and a new Emperor would already be born.”
“Although natural talent is important on the path to becoming Emperor, it’s the same for time. There’s almost a hundred years between them. Just what kind of colossal gap is this?”
“Hehe, to say nothing of the Golden Generation, they should first sweep aside the Silver Generation first.”
“Haha!”

However, there were also a great many people who were not optimistic about Ling Han and Ding Shu, and thought that with the Golden Generation having long since achieved Sect Master-level, and even those weaker members were Spirit Transformation Tier, that was why Ling Han and Ding Shu seemed invincible.

There was a voice now, and that was hoping that some Imperial Son of the Silver Generation could make a move, and test out the strength of Ling Han and Ding Shu. Who knows, he might be able to burst the bubble with a single poke.

It could not be helped. Though Ling Han and Ding Shu were also Buddha Sons, they were not from the Buddhist Land. In the hearts of the world, the impression that the Imperial Son was invincible among his peers was unbreakable.

Ling Han was completely unconcerned. He merely focused on increasing his own cultivation level. On one hand, he was stimulating more clay fetuses to advance towards the level of stone fetus, and on the other, he was cultivating Body Art at the same time, trying to complete the True Self Tier chapter of the Heavenly Dragon Emperor Technique as soon as possible.

Large events happened all the time in the universe. There were awesome rookies that appeared out of nowhere, and there were also prodigies that had been renowned for a long time that died dejectedly. This was a tumultuous era, and the opening of the True Dragon Abyss was even more proof that heaven and earth were already prepared to welcome a new Emperor.

Only one Ancestral King could appear in each era, and this Ancestral King would rule over the entire universe for an incredibly long time. Thus, for all the prodigies, this was the only chance they would have in this lifetime.
In other words, this was the worst era, and also the best era.

Half a year’s time passed in the blink of an eye. Ling Han had only formed a new Stone Fetus, and this was under the condition that the Buddhist Race had supplied him with an ocean of resources. If he relied on himself alone, the time would be extended tenfold.
The higher one’s cultivation level, the more difficult it was to advance. This was an ironclad rule.
Even if he was the Buddha Son, and all the resources were freely supplied to him, the Buddhist Race still had to have so many cultivation resources that could bear his expense.

It had already been a month since Ling Han had received any more cultivation resources. It wasn’t that the Buddhist Race had turned hostile against him, but that they had depleted all of their cultivation resources.
Did he really think that natural treasures could be found anywhere?

The Buddhist Race of the West Heavenly Realm had their own Herb Planet, but there was still four years until the earliest batch of Celestial medicines could be harvested. In the short term, he could not depend on this.
Ling Han looked at the ocean of Dao Stones in his Spatial Tool, and couldn’t help but have the thought of going out to play.
Wasn’t it a great waste not to use such a large number of Dao Stones?
He wasn’t a miser. Moreover, he could only obtain more Dao Stones if his strength improved. This was a very simple logic.

He left quietly. In any case, his formation skills was already at Great Accomplishment level, so it was too easy for him to go to other planets. Then, he would buy the connecting device, connect it to the Galaxy Network, and begin his search.
Were there any large-scale auctions? Were there any Saint-level historical sites that had opened?
However, the universe seemed to have become peaceful all of a sudden. There was actually no major event, which made Ling Han feel gloomy.
After roaming around for a few days, Ling Han returned to the Stainless Planet.
“Little Han, come fight me!” The little azure dragon ran over to ask for a beating again.

He was now cultivating the Imperial Scroll, and thought that he was in no way inferior to Ling Han in any aspect. Thus, he would frequently come to spar with Ling Han, determined to clear his name as the legitimate son of the True Dragon — invincible!

Unfortunately, faced with Ling Han, he was really at a disadvantage in all aspects. Even in the Body Arts domain that he was most proficient in, Ling Han was still slightly stronger than him, what more in other areas.
Peng, peng, peng! After fighting for a while, the little azure dragon collapsed onto the ground.
It was a complete defeat!

“Why? Why? Why?” The little azure dragon began to doubt himself. He was clearly the legitimate son of the True Dragon, which could be said that he simultaneously cultivated two Imperial Scrolls, so his battle prowess should be invincible in this world.
Why couldn’t he defeat Ling Han?
Ling Han patted his shoulder, and said, “It’s fine. You have a lot of time. Think about it slowly.”
The little azure dragon immediately gave him the middle finger.
En, being able to make such a move meant that the blow he had suffered was not too heavy. Next time, he could torture him even harder.

The two of them came back from the wilderness, and had not even entered the main doors of the Divine Temple, when they saw a young man dressed in a white monk’s robe sitting cross-legged at the foot of the steps. He had a bald head, which shone brightly.
“You guys have finally returned!” A voice rang out, filled with hatred.
Yi, this person was?
Peng!
Before Ling Han and the little azure dragon could speak, a figure flew over and crashed heavily onto the ground, raising a cloud of dust.
“Old Blackie!”

Ling Han and the little azure dragon called out at the same time. What had been thrown out was the large black dog. The human figure that he had taken form in was covered in blood, and it was obvious that he had been severely injured. He was currently in a coma.
Ling Han and the little azure dragon were instantly enraged.

chapters.title: Chapter 4230: Shi Mie
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
“Shi Yongyun!” Ling Han looked towards the top of the stairs. There was a young man standing there, looking down at him from above.

Shi Yongyun, and he came from the Buddhist Land of the thirty three Heavens. Previously, he had wanted to compete for the position of Buddha Son of the West Heavenly Realm. However, he was horribly defeated by Ling Han, causing him to leave with resentment. Unexpectedly, he made a comeback.

However, Ling Han did not believe that Shi Yongyun could defeat the large black dog. The large black dog that had simultaneously cultivated two Imperial Techniques was completely capable of suppressing the majority of Imperial Sons, and was definitely not someone that Shi Yongyun could match.
Thus... Ling Han turned to look at the white-robed monk who was seated not too far away.
“You were the one who did it?” he asked calmly.

“That’s me.” The white-robed monk’s eyes had initially been closed, but when he heard Ling Han’s words, he finally opened them. His eyes were as gentle as jade, and there was an indescribable power exuding from them. One would immediately feel at ease upon seeing them.
The Buddhist Race was most skilled at controlling souls.

Ling Han humphed. His willpower was as firm as iron, and he had also cultivated the Six Characters Bright King Curse, so how could he possibly be affected? He clenched his fists, and ka, ka, ka, his knuckles cracked loudly.
“No matter who you are, if you hurt my friend, there is only battle left.”
The white-robed monk recited a Buddhist chant, “I am Shi Mie, and have come to ask for guidance.”
Boom, he stood up, his aura beginning to boil.

In the beginning, though he was sitting there in a cross-legged position, it was as if he did not exist at all. There was not the slightest bit of aura leaking out, but now that he had stood up, his aura began to surge madly like a tsunami.

Weng, a Buddha Halo appeared behind his head, but it was not golden like the others, but rather as black as ink, and what formed the Buddha Halo was not pure light of energy, but rather a black snake that kept spinning.
‘F*ck! Is this really Buddhist Race? Why is he so eerie?’
“Little baldy, let me fight you!” The little azure dragon was the first to charge out. Although he usually bickered with the large black dog, they were actually on extremely good terms.
“Ignorance!” Shi Mie moved. He shot out a fist, which shot towards the little azure dragon.
Peng!
The little azure dragon took it head-on, but the moment it came into contact, it was sent flying.
The gap in battle prowess was too wide.

“Wa!” The little azure dragon spat out a mouthful of blood. Although his physique was tough, the power of the heaven and earth Regulations and high-level energy that was contained in the attack from Shi Mie was too much for his physique to withstand.
Thankfully, this could only be considered light injuries.

Ling Han couldn’t help but frown. He was naturally familiar with the little azure dragon’s strength. If he used an Imperial Technique, his ultimate battle prowess would be around 27 Heavens, but in the case of Shi Mie, the battle prowess of that punch just now was 31 Heavens, and the latter clearly hadn’t used the Imperial Technique.
“I’ll do it!” Seeing that the little azure dragon still wanted to charge out, Ling Han stretched out a hand to stop it.

The little azure dragon was furious, but he finally came back to his senses, and said to Ling Han, “Be careful, this guy is at the fourth form of True Self Tier. Moreover, he belongs to the prodigy category.”

An ordinary cultivator of the fourth form of the True Self Tier would only have the raw power of 12 Heavens, and would not be able to grasp the Imperial Techniques and Saint Techniques. His battle prowess would only be 15 heavens at most. However, Shi Mie came from the Buddhist Land, so he naturally could not be this kind of weakling.
Ling Han nodded, and walked forwards, “Just because you come Buddhist Land from the Thirty three Heavens, you can bully the weak with your superior strength, and do as you please?”
He wasn’t just saying this to Shi Mie and Shi Yongyun. He was also saying this to the Buddhist Race of the West Heavenly Realm.
The three of them were Buddha Sons and Pseudo Buddha Sons, but right at their own doorstep, they were blocked, and the large black dog was severely injured. What was going on here?
If the higher-ups of the Buddhist Race of the West Heavenly Realm did not allow this, would Shi Yongyun and Shi Mie still dare to do this?
This made Ling Han especially furious.

“Hahaha!” Shi Yongyun laughed loudly, “Idiot, do you know what Buddhist Land means? Fine, I’ll give you an analogy. In the mortal world, those that walk out from the Imperial Capital are higher up in status!”
“Furthermore, do you know who Brother Mie is?”
“Brother Mie’s grandfather is the Mysterious Heaven Buddha!”

The Buddha was a Saint, and the direct descendant of a Saint from the Imperial Clan was indeed awesome. No wonder even Black Cloud and the other Bodhisattvas didn’t appear, because how could they afford to offend a Buddha?
—The Bodhisattvas naturally had to listen to the Buddha, and the West Heavenly Realm Branch naturally had to listen to the Buddhist Land.
“Shi Xinming, bear with it for the moment and let this matter go.” At this moment, Ling Han heard Yunshu Bodhisattva’s divine sense transmission in his mind.
That’s right, Venerates were great elites, so even if they closed their eyes and meditated, how could they not sense what was happening at the foot of this mountain gate?
However, these Bodhisattvas did not stop them previously, and insisted on interfering at this time. Wasn’t it clear that they wanted Shi Yongyun and Shi Mie to commit the crime?
Bear with it?

Swallow his ange, and allow the large black dog to suffer this beating for nothing? Furthermore, Shi Yongyun had clearly come back for revenge this time round. Even if he was willing to swallow his anger, would he let the matter go?
That’s right. In front of the eyes of three Bodhisattvas, it was absolutely impossible that he would be severely injured. At most, he would only be humiliated.
However, for Ling Han, this was unacceptable.
He could be defeated, he could lose, but he would definitely not compromise.
This was his belief. If his belief collapsed, what was the point of talking about becoming a Saint?
Ling Han suddenly laughed madly, his laughter filled with fury.
The world was unjust? Then he would be the one to raze it to the ground.
With a battle cry, he charged towards Shi Mie.
“Ignorant!” Shi Mie humphed coldly, and stretched out his left hand, pressing forwards.
Weng! An indescribably pitch-black hand materialized in the air and swatted down at Ling Han.
“Scram!” Ling Han roared. The Ice Moon Saber slashed out, transforming into an ice-cold heavenly saber that slashed at the pitch-black giant hand.
Peng!
With a slash of the saber, that giant hand was immediately sliced open, as if the darkness had been split open, and light reappeared.
“Yi?” Shi Mie showed a hint of surprise, “I have underestimated you.”
He had only channeled the Saint Technique in that attack just now, but his battle prowess was still as high as 31 Heavens. He had not thought that it would still be broken by Ling Han.
It didn’t matter. He was from the Buddhist Land, and he also had an ancestor who was a Buddha.
Boom, he threw another punch, and an indescribable Buddhist might surged out, making people involuntarily want to kneel down and repent for their crimes.
The heavenly saber was immediately shattered, but when the attack landed, Ling Han had already used his movement technique to dodge.
After this strike, Ling Han had a complete understanding of Shi Mie’s strength.

—The original power was about twenty-five Heavens, and using the Saint Technique, he would have the battle prowess of thirty-one Heavens, while with Imperial Technique, he would be able to rush up to thirty-four Heavens.

To be honest, Shi Mie wasn’t all that outstanding. His basic power was still inferior to the level of the Holy Land’s Dao Child, but he was still five Heavens above Ling Han. It couldn’t be helped. He was the peak stage of the fourth form of the True Self Tier. He was superior to Ling Han by slightly more than two minor cultivation levels.
However, if Ling Han could unleash his full power, he was sure that defeating Shi Mie wouldn’t be too difficult. In fact, it wouldn’t be a problem for him to kill Shi Mie.
However, could he unleash his full power?

There were three Bodhisattvas standing guard here. He only had to use the black light of illusion or weaken Shi Mie’s battle prowess by three Heavens, and he was sure that the Black Cloud Bodhisattva and the others would immediately recognize his true identity.
If a Venerate Tier elite made a move, his only fate would be death.

chapters.title: Chapter 4231: Falling Out
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
Thus, Ling Han had deep reservations.
He couldn’t use any techniques that would expose his identity, so it was naturally more difficult to defeat Shi Mie on this basis.
Boom!
Shi Mie wouldn’t be reserved with him. After gaining an advantage with a single strike, he immediately launched an offensive.
Hong! Hong! Hong!
His offensive was swift and fierce, wanting to suppress Ling Han in the shortest time possible.
“Good one, Big Brother Mie!” Shi Yongyun called out from the sidelines. However, in the depths of his heart, he was jealous of Shi Mie, and even looked down on him slightly.

—If he could obtain the same cultivation resources and cultivation techniques as Shi Mie, to say nothing of the fact that he would have long since advanced into Spiritual Transformation Tier, even if they were both in the Fourth Form of the True Self Tier, his battle prowess would still be stronger than him by three Heavens.
Humph, if it was not for the fact that he had a grandfather who was a Buddha, who does he think he is?
Ling Han’s figure was as slippery as a fish, and he was always able to escape between Shi Mie’s attacks.

His strategy was very simple. Shi Mie’s maximum battle prowess of 34 Heavens would have to depend on the use of Imperial Technique. Once it fell to the level of Saint Technique, Shi Mie would only be equivalent to him, and could the Imperial Technique be continuously used?

Thus, Ling Han wanted to exhaust Shi Mie’s use of Imperial Techniques. At that time, he would launch a powerful counterattack. With his endless reserves of mystical power, he would definitely be able to make Shi Mie cry.
Hong! Hong! Hong!

In order to ensure that Shi Mie continued to deliver high-intensity attacks, Ling Han would launch a powerful counterattack whenever his opponent’s attacks slacked off the slightest. Shi Mie didn’t dare to relax at all, and he channeled the Imperial Technique at all times.
After such a long time, he also realized that something was off.
Why was he still unable to apprehend Ling Han?
If this continued, his power would be greatly exhausted, and he would no longer be able to channel the Imperial Technique.

On the surface, he was still completely on the upper hand. As he shot out a punch, expanses of black clouds spread out. The divine chains of order were also as black as ink, traversing through the black clouds, possessing boundless destructive power.
However, Ling Han continued to twist and turn, and not a single divine chain of order could touch him. No matter how powerful your attacks were, so what?
Shi Mie’s eyes turned, and he suddenly pounced at the little azure dragon and the large black dog.
Ling Han cursed internally, and hurriedly leaped out to intercept him.
Peng!
This time, he could no longer dodge Shi Mie’s attacks, and clashed head-on with him.
“Wa!” Ling Han spat out a mouthful of blood, his face pale.

In truth, he was the one who had had taken the initiative to spit out a mouthful of blood. He could disperse attacks within a gap of six Heavens. Even if the Imperial Technique was fierce and had terrifying destructive power, it would not be enough to make him throw up blood.
However, dispersing attacks was an ability that belonged to “Ling Han”, so he naturally couldn’t expose it.
Shi Mie finally gained a substantial advantage. He couldn’t help but reveal a cold smile, saying, “I heard that you obtained the inheritance of the Descending Heaven Holy Emperor.”
Ling Han instantly came to a realization.
No wonder Shi Mie had come. He had not just come to stand up for Shi Yongyun. His true motive was for the inheritance of the Holy Emperor, and standing up for him was only a pretext.
And why didn’t the three Bodhisattvas make a move?

Obviously, these three also had designs on the inheritance of the Holy Emperor. However, because of their status, it would not be proper for them to demand it from Ling Han. Thus, for them, this was also a chance. As long as Ling Han handed over the inheritance of the Holy Emperor, how could the three of them not be able to see it with their abilities?
Good! Very good!
Ling Han instantly understood, and killing intent instantly rose up in his eyes.

For the time being, he would no longer be able to get any cultivation resources in the Buddhist Race, and it was even more possible that the three Bodhisattvas would make things difficult for him because of this. If he did not hand over the inheritance of the Holy Emperor, they would not give him any cultivation resources.
Since that was the case, they would just have to become hostile.
Ling Han instantly felt like leaving. He couldn’t stay here any longer. However, he wouldn’t leave so easily.
He sent a divine sense message to the little azure dragon, telling it of his decision and telling it to prepare.
“F*ck, do you have to play so hard?” the little azure dragon grumbled. However, it still picked up the large black dog and prepared to flee at any moment.

“Shi Xinming, do you really think you are some Buddha Son?” Shi Mie sneered, “Wrong, very, very wrong. There is only one Buddha Son, and he is in the Buddhist Land of Thirty Three Heavens. Furthermore, let me tell you, in front of the real Buddha Son, you are not even worth a scallion!”
Boom!
As he attacked Ling Han, he continued to launch a flurry of attacks.
Ling Han roared loudly, clashing head-on with Shi Mie with every move. It was as if his anger had been stoked, and he had lost all reason.
“Don’t be defiant. In front of the Golden Generation, you are nothing but trash!” Shi Mie scoffed, and delivered another attack at Ling Han.

Ling Han approached. Weng, the murderous aura activated. Although Shi Mie had a grandfather who was a Buddha Son, he wasn’t a Buddha Son, so how could he possibly obtain a treasure that could dispel the negative effects? He was instantly hit.

However, before he could grab his head and scream, Ling Han’s series of attacks had already arrived, instantly reducing his battle prowess by three Heavens. Then, he brandished the Ice Moon Saber. At the same time that the heavenly saber shot out, the Primal Chaos Divine Lightning also shot out.
Underthe negative effects, just how much had Shi Mie’s battle prowess declined?

Shua! The heavenly saber slashed down, instantly splitting Shi Mie into two. Boundless ice energy surged over, and his two halves were instantly frozen. Peng! They were shattered by the subsequent impact, turning into millions and millions of particles.
Weng! Light surged, and it was as if time had been reversed. Shi Mie had actually come back to life.
Substitution Seal.
Peng! The Primal Chaos Divine Lightning followed behind, and with a single strike, Shi Mie’s head was instantly obliterated.
He died again.
However, his grandfather was a Saint. Even if he wasn’t a Buddha Son, the Substitution Seal could be effective more than once, and he had come back to life once more.
At this moment, the three Bodhisattvas finally came back to their senses and appeared one after another.

They had really not foreseen that Ling Han, who had been at a disadvantage all this while, would suddenly explode, and kill Shi Mie in an instant, and twice at that! Thankfully, Shi Mie had the Substitution Seal. Otherwise, they really did not know how they were supposed to explain this to the Mysterious Heaven Buddha.
“Stop!” they all shouted.
“I was just waiting for you guys!” Ling Han unhesitatingly summoned the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower. Boom, the Heavenly Dao Flames surged, rolling towards the three Bodhisattvas.
“Not good!” At this moment, the expressions of the three Bodhisattvas changed drastically. These were the highest grade Regulations of Fire, which could burn even Saints to death!

—In a moment of desperation, their judgement was also slightly off. This Heavenly Dao Flames had already been “diluted”. Saints would definitely not burn to death, but it would be enough to severely injure or even burn Venerate Tiers to death.
They wanted to flee, but in order to save Shi Mie, they had charged over with all their might to stop him. How were they supposed to flee?
It was too late to tear open space.
Boom, the Heavenly Dao Flames instantly swept over, surrounding the three Bodhisattvas.
Ling Han didn’t even cast a second look at them. Instead, he set his eyes on Shi Mie.
Shi Mie couldn’t help but feel a chill in his heart, from head to toe.

On the surface, it looked like he had died twice, but in truth, he had not died once. It was the Substitution Seal that had taken effect on his behalf. Otherwise, coming back from death would be a reversal of destiny, and even Saints could not possibly accomplish that.
Thus, he had witnessed his own death twice, though those two versions of himself had been manifested from the Substitution Seal.
Now, the three Venerate Tier elites were trapped, but this bringer of misfortune was targeting him again.
Who would save him?

“Not good!” At this moment, the expressions of the three Bodhisattvas changed drastically.
These were the highest grade Regulations of Fire, which could burn even Saints to death!
—In a moment of desperation, their judgement was also slightly off.
This Heavenly Dao Flames had already been “diluted”.
Saints would definitely not burn to death, but it would be enough to severely injure or even burn Venerate Tiers to death.
They wanted to flee, but in order to save Shi Mie, they had charged over with all their might to stop him.
How were they supposed to flee?
It was too late to tear open space.
Boom, the Heavenly Dao Flames instantly swept over, surrounding the three Bodhisattvas.
Ling Han didn’t even cast a second look at them.
Instead, he set his eyes on Shi Mie.
Shi Mie couldn’t help but feel a chill in his heart, from head to toe.
On the surface, it looked like he had died twice, but in truth, he had not died once.
It was the Substitution Seal that had taken effect on his behalf.
Otherwise, coming back from death would be a reversal of destiny, and even Saints could not possibly accomplish that.
Thus, he had witnessed his own death twice, though those two versions of himself had been manifested from the Substitution Seal.
Now, the three Venerate Tier elites were trapped, but this bringer of misfortune was targeting him again.
Who would save him?

chapters.title: Chapter 4232: Buddha moves
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
Shi Mie shivered. Though his battle prowess was superior to Ling Han, he did not have the slightest bit of fighting spirit.

He had already died twice in a row, and he still hadn’t walked out of this kind of trauma. Moreover, even Venerate Tiers had been trapped and released terrifying screams, which caused him to lose all his confidence.
How could he possibly defeat such a demon?

Ling Han didn’t waste any time. He charged over again, and the barrage of murderous aura blasted out, making Shi Mie unable to form an effective resistance at all. He threw out an iron fist, and Regulations shone, like when heaven and earth had just been created.
Peng! Shi Mie was killed again.
He “revived” again, but his face was already extremely pale, because he knew that the Substitution Seal could only take effect a total of three times.
If he was killed again, he would really die.
“Don’t kill me, we can talk things over,” he said fearfully.
Ling Han completely ignored him. After a series of attacks, Shi Mie was once again killed. This time, he was unable to come back to life.
‘Huh? He’s dead?’
Ling Han was already prepared, and delivered another series of attacks. Unexpectedly, Shi Mie was already dead.
With a wave of his hand, he grabbed the Spatial Tool that had exploded from Shi Mie’s body. Then, he immediately tossed out the formation foundations, instantly forming the Transfer Formation.

“Let’s go!” He grabbed the little azure dragon, and the little azure dragon carried the large black dog. The formation immediately channeled, and as a flash of light swept past, they instantly disappeared.

Right at this moment, boom, a terrifying aura rippled over, and a large hand stretched out from who knows where. With a single press, the Heavenly Dao Flames were instantly extinguished. Though the three Venerate Tier elites were all riddled with wounds, none of them died.
The weakened version of the Heavenly Dao Flames could burn Venerate Tier elites to death, but definitely couldn’t insta-kill them.
And it should be known that from the moment Ling Han summoned the Heavenly Dao Flames, to the moment he killed Shi Mie, it may seem long, but in truth, it had only been two to three seconds.
Venerate Tier elites were Venerate Tier elites, after all, so how could they be killed so easily?
This large hand took advantage of the opening to grab out at Ling Han and the others, yet missed by a slight margin.

Xiu, a figure appeared out of thin air. It was a skinny old monk, his white beard reaching all the way to his lower abdomen. His whole face was covered with wrinkles, exuding an endless air of decay, as if he should have long since decayed.
However, it was this old monk that made the three Bodhisattvas show a respectful expression. Disregarding the fact that they were injured, they all knelt down, “Greetings, Lord Bright Sun!”
Bright Sun Buddha, a Saint-level being!
The old monk ignored him, and merely stared at the place where Ling Han had disappeared. His gaze was like a pillar, as if he had transmigrated through space.
“Lord, have you found that unfilial brat?” Yunshu Bodhisattva asked with a strong killing intent.
Even the three of them had almost been killed. If he wasn’t an unfilial brat, then what was he?
The old monk showed a hint of surprise, because he had captured Ling Han’s soul fluctuation. In an instant, he had jumped to the next planet, but all of a sudden, this soul fluctuation disappeared.
This was too strange.
That’s not right.
Realization dawned on the old monk. When he spoke, his voice was extremely hoarse, “This boy has cultivated the soul transformation technique, and can no longer be traced.”
“He is Ling Han!” Black Clouds Bodhisattva said. “In the last few moves, the technique he used was Ling Han’s signature ultimate technique.”

“You’re saying that Ling Han actually dared to fake his identity and become a Buddha Son in our race?” Yunshu Bodhisattva asked in disbelief. Just how outrageously bold was he to dare to do such a thing?

“This despicable brat!” The Dragon Elephant Bodhisattva was seething with rage—he didn’t shave his head, and he kept his hair that represented the ties to the mortal world. The three Venerate Tier elites were all tricked by this evil brat and severely wounded. If it weren’t for the Bright Sun Buddha, they could only wait for death.

The old monk humphed, and said, “You people have truly disappointed me. A True Self Tier cultivator almost overturned this place! Humph, the three of you are to personally set off in pursuit. If you don’t bring this brat’s corpse back, there’s no need for you to come back either!”
“Yes, milord!” The three Bodhisattvas bowed in respect. They couldn’t care less about their severe injuries, and immediately set off in pursuit.
Whether it was because of the command of the Buddha, or because they themselves had suffered great humiliation, they were determined to apprehend Ling Han.

The old monk’s eyes swept over, and paused slightly on Shi Yongyun. However, it was as if he had glanced at an ant. He had no intention of speaking at all. With a step, he had already disappeared from sight.
Shi Yongyun almost wet himself in fright. Just now, Ling Han had unleashed his might and killed Shi Mie, making him extremely terrified, fearing that Ling Han would kill him as well.
He didn’t have a Substitution Seal.
Thankfully, the Bright Sun Buddha appeared in the nick of time, scaring Ling Han away, and also saving the three Venerate Tier elites, which also allowed him to escape from danger.
After letting out a sigh of relief, Shi Yongyun wore a distressed expression again.
Shi Mie was the reinforcement that he had called out. Though the other had ulterior motives in the first place, he had died here, so how could he be exonerated?
His grandfather was a Buddha, so how could he withstand his thunderous fury?
What could he do? What could he do?
Only by killing Ling Han would he be able to offset some of his crime. At the very least, he would not have to pay with his life.
His eyes lit up. He was determined to kill Ling Han at all costs. Otherwise, he wouldn’t have a good life in the future.

After Ling Han and the others completed the teleportation, they immediately changed their appearance, including their soul fluctuations. Even the large black dog was awoken by Ling Han’s Six Characters Bright King Curse, to have him change his appearance first.

He did not see the Bright Sun Buddha, but sensed that indescribably vast aura, and it was not like he did not know that there was a Buddha there. Thus, it was naturally easy to guess the identity of this person.

Though there was already a planet separating them, if the Saint was to make a move, he would still be able to easily catch up to them. Thus, it was necessary for them to immediately change their appearance.
Right at this moment, an incredibly colossal face appeared in the skies. It was indescribably old, but its face was the size of a planet, exuding an incredibly terrifying aura.
“S-Saint!”
This planet had Venerate Tier elites, yet they were so terrified that they broke out in a cold sweat. Who wouldn’t be afraid of a Saint that had manifested his physical body with the fury of thunder?
If a Saint unleashed their might, they were capable of instantly shattering this planet into pieces. Aside from Venerate Tier elites, even Sect Master elites could only wait helplessly for death.

This face looked down on the planet, its eyes cold. It was as if all life were ants in its eyes. In this moment, everyone on the entire planet felt a chill run down their spines, feeling an indescribable fear.
When one had reached the height of Saint, they could really do as they pleased.
Thankfully, it was only a few seconds, and this face suddenly disappeared. Only then did everyone breathe a sigh of relief.
Ling Han also stared at the sky. Though he had never seen it before, he was certain that this was the Bright Sun Buddha.

“Let’s go!” He didn’t need to use the Transfer Formation on the planet at all, and he had already figured out its structure long ago. With a wave of his hands, formation foundations fell one after another. He, the little azure dragon, and the large black dog were instantly wrapped in white light, and began to traverse again.
After traversing over a dozen times in a single go, Ling Han finally stopped. By now, they were already far away from the Stainless Planet.

chapters.title: Chapter 4233: Island of the Sky
paragraphs: After ingesting a large amount of treasured medicine, the large black dog’s recovery speed was extremely quick.

“F***, Grandpa Dog is displeased that I did not manage to kill that b@stard with my own hands!” When the large black dog found out that Shi Mie was dead, he felt slightly appeased, but also slightly depressed.
Ling Han smiled faintly, and said, “It’s fine. There’s another person you can kill.”
“Shi Yongyun?” The large black dog’s eyes lit up.

“That’s right. I deliberately left him alive and didn’t kill him.” With Ling Han’s abilities, it was really easy for him to kill Shi Yongyun by following up with a single punch. However, he didn’t do that because he wanted the large black dog to personally vent his anger.
“All right. From today onwards, Grandpa Dog will properly cultivate, and beat up that b@stard in future.” The large black dog’s fighting spirit was reignited.
“I’ll heal my injuries first.”
Ling Han walked out of his room and casually sat in the courtyard. He raised his head to look at the sky, and began to ponder how he was going to go next.
He had never thought that his days as a spy in the Buddhist Race would end just like that.
“Looks like my acting skills are still not enough,” Ling Han mocked. However, if he could really tolerate this, then would he still be Ling Han?
“Little Han, how’s Old Black?” The little azure dragon returned. He had gone to investigate the situation.
“Much better.” Ling Han nodded, “How are things on your side?”
“He, too exciting!” The little azure dragon laughed loudly.

The Buddha Son defected, and this was naturally a huge scandal. The Buddhist Race of the West Heavenly Realm wanted to hide this, but that battle previously had happened suddenly, and the Buddhist Race had not made any preparations at all. Hence, how could they possibly hide the matter as they wished?
Thus, the entire universe knew.
When everyone found out that the Buddha Son of the West Heavenly Realm was Ling Han, they were all stunned.
F***, so it was this guy!

In the past, when Ling Han fled to the ends of the world, everyone thought that he would be withdrawing from the stage of the prodigy contest. Who would have thought that he would be able to do as he liked? Without a word, he had become the Buddha Son, and appeared grandly in front of the Imperial Clans.
Just look, Shi Yuanzhen had been taught a lesson by Ling Han, and who knew what kind of expression he would have when he found out the truth.

“Please tell me the extent of Shi Yuanzhen’s psychological trauma!” someone joked on the Galaxy Network. This actually caused a great many people to heckle him, and they even began to calculate obediently the extent of his trauma.
However, everyone now knew that Ling Han actually possessed such a profound art of disguise. Even Venerate Tier elites couldn’t tell anything was off.
With this lesson, if Ling Han still wanted to disguise himself and enter into the ranks of the Imperial Clans, that would be as difficult as ascending the heavens.
“Sigh, now that my background has been exposed, how would I be able to scheme in future er, how would I be able to survive?” Ling Han mused ruefully.
“In the future, it’ll be up to Grandpa Dragon,” the little azure dragon said without any sense of shame.
“Hehe.”
After a few days, the large black dog fully recovered, and Ling Han and the little azure dragon felt much more at ease.

At this time, they decided to leave, and went to buy a connection device. They planned to take a look at the current situation. In any case, they would run after connecting, and there was no need to worry about their whereabouts being leaked.
“Yi!”
“The Island of the Sky has opened.”
Ling Han faltered upon hearing this. Right now, the only thing that was flooding the Galaxy Network was the words ‘Island of the Sky’.
What the hell was this?
After searching for a while, all the information about the Island of the Sky appeared.

The Island of the Sky was the private property of the Dongfang Clan, and the Dongfang Clan was a Venerate Tier-level force. In the universe, they could be considered a great force, but could not be considered top-notch. Above them, there was still the Holy Lands and the Imperial Clans.
The Dongfang Clan ruled over a galaxy, and in this galaxy, there was a planet that produced a unique Celestial medicine.
-Evolution Fruit.
What was the use?

It could help True Self Tier martial artists promote evolution, such as from Clay Fetus to Stone Fetus, Stone Fetus to Silver Fetus, Silver Fetus to Gold Fetus, and what was even more amazing was that after the fourth form of True Self Tier, the Evolution Fruit could also give martial artists a chance at the fifth transformation!

Everyone knew that the one could break through at the fourth form of True Self Tier, but after advancing into the Spirit Transformation Tier like this, one would lose the possibility of advancing further, and would not be able to advance into the level of Sect Master Tier.
If he wanted to become a Sect Master, he would at least have to reach the fifth form of the True Self Tier.

Thus, all martial artists who aspired to become Sect Masters would be filled with yearning for the Evolution Fruit, what more those who wanted to become Venerate Tiers, Saints, and there were even some who wanted to become Emperor.
In that case, he wouldn’t just need the fifth form. He might need the sixth, seventh, or even the eighth or ninth form.

No matter how prodigious you were, being able to complete the fifth form and sixth form with your own strength, wouldn’t it be even better with the help of the Evolution Fruit? Furthermore, it was possible that you could break through your limits or something of the
sort.
Thus, the significance of the Evolution Fruit could be imagined.
The problem was, how could such an important Celestial medicine be grasped by a Venerate
Tier force?

Hehe, in truth, this had indeed caused the Imperial Clans to fight over it. In fact, they had even caused such a commotion that they had almost started fighting over it with the Imperial Weapon in hand. After paying a great price, the Imperial Clans finally agreed to sit down and
negotiate peacefully.

Since no one could take it all for themselves, fine, they might as well just share it. It was better to leave it to the Dongfang Clan to manage. When the Evolution Fruit ripened, they would discuss how to divide it among themselves.
Gradually, the range of distribution also went from the Imperial Clans to Holy Lands, and then further to all True Self Tiers.

Because only True Self Tiers could stimulate the manifestation of the Evolution Fruit, those with higher cultivation levels wouldn’t be of much use at all. It was because of this that this had become a major gathering shared by the entire universe.
Of course, the majority of the Evolution Fruits would still fall into the hands of the Imperial
Clans. Firstly, the descendants of the Imperial Clans were stronger, and secondly, the pressure exerted by the Imperial Clans was there. If they started to buy them, how many people would
dare not to sell them?
“Little Han?” The large black dog looked over.
Ling Han nodded, “We naturally have to go for such a good thing.”
“Alright, we, the Three Milk Tea Brothers, are going to cause a reign of terror again!” the
large black dog shouted.
“Trash, tremble!” The little azure dragon was also very excited.
Because those above the True Self Tier would be useless even if they entered the Island of the

Sky, as they would not be able to obtain the Evolution Fruit at all. Furthermore, this would also cause an unjust contest. Thus, the great Imperial Clans had long since reached an agreement. In this kind of contest, only those at the True Self Tier would be able to enter.
Who would dare disobey the command of the Imperial Clans?
“Taking advantage of this opportunity, it’s time to kill some people!” Ling Han said calmly.
Imperial Sons like Shi Yuanzhen and Xu Jie were on his agenda. They had been jumping around for so long, and this time, he was going to kill all of them.
“All right!” The little azure dragon and the large black dog were also rubbing their fists, their
killing intent blazing.
They set out, and were teleported all the way. Very soon, they had arrived at the Sky Planet.
The Sky Planet, the territory of the Dongfang Clan, and also the location of the Island of the
Sky.

The Island of the Sky was an amazing place - if it was not amazing, how could it produce something as amazing as the Evolution Fruit? This island floated in the skies, and was incredibly huge. Furthermore, this island was constantly shrouded by Regulations of the highest level, and even Saints would not be able to barge in by force.

Of course, one could still enter with the help of an Imperial Weapon. However, this was meaningless, as the most valuable item on the island in the sky was the Evolution Fruit. When the Evolution Fruit ripened, the supreme Regulations would temporarily dissipate, and this would last for a period of time. Then, it would reappear. Thus, there was absolutely no need to forcefully enter.

Thus, all martial artists who aspired to become Sect Masters would be filled with yearning for the Evolution Fruit, what more those who wanted to become Venerate Tiers, Saints, and there were even some who wanted to become Emperor.
In that case, he wouldn’t just need the fifth form.
He might need the sixth, seventh, or even the eighth or ninth form.
No matter how prodigious you were, being able to complete the fifth form and sixth form with your own strength, wouldn’t it be even better with the help of the Evolution Fruit?
Furthermore, it was possible that you could break through your limits or something of the
sort.
Thus, the significance of the Evolution Fruit could be imagined.
The problem was, how could such an important Celestial medicine be grasped by a Venerate
Tier force?
Hehe, in truth, this had indeed caused the Imperial Clans to fight over it.
In fact, they had even caused such a commotion that they had almost started fighting over it with the Imperial Weapon in hand.
After paying a great price, the Imperial Clans finally agreed to sit down and
negotiate peacefully.
Since no one could take it all for themselves, fine, they might as well just share it.
It was better to leave it to the Dongfang Clan to manage.
When the Evolution Fruit ripened, they would discuss how to divide it among themselves.
Gradually, the range of distribution also went from the Imperial Clans to Holy Lands, and then further to all True Self Tiers.
Because only True Self Tiers could stimulate the manifestation of the Evolution Fruit, those with higher cultivation levels wouldn’t be of much use at all.
It was because of this that this had become a major gathering shared by the entire universe.
Of course, the majority of the Evolution Fruits would still fall into the hands of the Imperial
Clans.
Firstly, the descendants of the Imperial Clans were stronger, and secondly, the pressure exerted by the Imperial Clans was there.
If they started to buy them, how many people would
dare not to sell them?
“Little Han?” The large black dog looked over.
Ling Han nodded, “We naturally have to go for such a good thing.”
“Alright, we, the Three Milk Tea Brothers, are going to cause a reign of terror again!” the
large black dog shouted.
“Trash, tremble!” The little azure dragon was also very excited.
Because those above the True Self Tier would be useless even if they entered the Island of the
Sky, as they would not be able to obtain the Evolution Fruit at all.
Furthermore, this would also cause an unjust contest.
Thus, the great Imperial Clans had long since reached an agreement.
In this kind of contest, only those at the True Self Tier would be able to enter.
Who would dare disobey the command of the Imperial Clans?
“Taking advantage of this opportunity, it’s time to kill some people!” Ling Han said calmly.
Imperial Sons like Shi Yuanzhen and Xu Jie were on his agenda.
They had been jumping around for so long, and this time, he was going to kill all of them.
“All right!” The little azure dragon and the large black dog were also rubbing their fists, their
killing intent blazing.
They set out, and were teleported all the way.
Very soon, they had arrived at the Sky Planet.
The Sky Planet, the territory of the Dongfang Clan, and also the location of the Island of the
Sky.
The Island of the Sky was an amazing place - if it was not amazing, how could it produce something as amazing as the Evolution Fruit?
This island floated in the skies, and was incredibly huge.
Furthermore, this island was constantly shrouded by Regulations of the highest level, and even Saints would not be able to barge in by force.
Of course, one could still enter with the help of an Imperial Weapon.
However, this was meaningless, as the most valuable item on the island in the sky was the Evolution Fruit.
When the Evolution Fruit ripened, the supreme Regulations would temporarily dissipate, and this would last for a period of time.
Then, it would reappear.
Thus, there was absolutely no need to forcefully enter.

chapters.title: Chapter 4234: Finding a team
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
“Are we just going to swagger over like this?” the large black dog asked.
“So what? Whoever dares to stop us, we’ll kill them all!” the little azure dragon said with killing intent.
Pa, Ling Han slapped him, “Don’t spout nonsense.”
The secret that they could disguise themselves had already been exposed, so if the three of them left together, that would be too obvious.
“Old Black, take off your underpants!” Ling Han said to the large black dog first.
The large black dog’s legs trembled in fright, “Little Han, after so many years, are you finally going to make a move on Grandpa Dog?”
Ling Han’s expression darkened, and he said, “F*ck! You’re only wearing a pair of iron underwear. Even if I don’t know you, I’ll still recognize your perverted appearance, all right?”

“How is Grandpa Dog perverted?” the large black dog murmured to himself. As he took human form, he drew out his pants and put them on. His expression was filled with reluctance, “Grandpa Dog is by nature bold and unrestrained, and loves freedom.”
“That’s called perverted!” Ling Han and the little azure dragon shouted at the same time.
The large black dog was instantly rendered speechless. ‘You guys are really too coordinated.’

“And you, don’t become a child again.” Ling Han turned to the little azure dragon and said, “You’re only a five- or six-year-old toddler, yet your cultivation level has already reached the True Self Tier. Even the Golden Generation isn’t as awesome as you.”
“Can’t I? Grandpa Dragon is the descendant of a True Dragon!” The little azure dragon puffed its chest out proudly.
Pa, he suffered another slap.
“If you want to be captured by the Imperial Clans, then you can continue,” Ling Han said.
The little azure dragon was exasperated, so it could only enlarge its body slightly, becoming an elegant young man in his twenties. However, his face was still filled with childishness.
“Show off!” Ling Han and the large black dog said at the same time. This Four-Legged Snake had always disguised itself as a little boy. Wasn’t it trying to show that he was “young”?
He was so young, yet had such a high cultivation level. This was naturally shocking. Thus, he was the standard show-off.
“This is much better.” Ling Han nodded. These two guys were finally not so conspicuous. Otherwise, they would really be discovered in a crowd.

“Let’s go, let’s go, let’s go.” The large black dog and little azure dragon were both in high spirits. They were going to the Island of the Sky to beat up the Imperial Sons, and they were currently filled with anger.
“Wait,” Ling Han said.
“What is it now?” the large black dog asked.
Ling Han sighed, “Just now, I only corrected a flaw that could be seen through with a single glance from you guys, but if the three of us are together, we are still too big a target.”
“Then should we split up?” the little azure dragon asked.
Ling Han smiled and said, “Sure. However, there’s another method that can make us smaller targets.”
“What way?” the little azure dragon and the large black dog asked at the same time.
“Infiltrate into another team,” Ling Han said.
“Che.” The little azure dragon and the large black dog waved their hands, and here they thought that Ling Han had some brilliant idea.
However, this was indeed feasible.
“Let’s go.”
They walked around, looking for teams that they could join.
This wasn’t difficult, because even though some clans were powerful, it didn’t mean that there were invincible elites in True Self Tier. Thus, they naturally needed external help.
They had not walked too far, when the three of them heard beckoning shouts.

They went over to take a look. The party that was recruiting was the Tang Clan, a Venerate Tier-level force. However, there was only one woman in this generation, and her name was Tang Rong. She was quite famous, because she was the seductive beauty ranked ninety-first on the Exquisite Leaderboard.
Don’t think that 91st was too low. Just how big was the universe? The hundred beauties that had been chosen naturally all had exquisite beauty.

Thus, there was actually no shortage of suitors and protectors by Tang Rong’s side, but it was also because of the problem of cultivation level that some people were unable to enter the Island of the Sky and could not help even if they wanted to.

The Tang Clan offered a very high reward. If they could obtain the Evolution Fruit, each person would be rewarded with a Venerate Tier-level technique, and even if they couldn’t obtain the Evolution Fruit, they would still be rewarded with thirty thousand Dao Stones.
Though this kind of reward was completely not taken seriously by Ling Han and the others, for the majority of True Self Tiers, it was a temptation that could not be resisted.
“I’ll choose this one,” Ling Han said. He only needed a disguise to cover himself.

“Yi, you found this Tang Rong as soon as you started searching. Furthermore, she is ranked on the Exquisite Leaderboard. Did you do it on purpose?” The large black dog’s eyes were filled with suspicion.
“It’s definitely deliberate!” the little azure dragon said with absolute certainty.
“Scram!” Ling Han naturally denied it.
No matter what, they had to register their personal information before applying for the position.

“Sister Rong, with me here, we don’t need these weaklings at all!” When Ling Han and the others were registering, a man’s voice was heard. Not only did they hear it, but the other applicants also heard it clearly.

Everyone instantly turned to look, only to see that the speaker was a handsome young man in embroidered robes. His eyes were especially bright, and there was a haughty expression on his face. When he saw everyone turn to look at him, not only did he not feel the slightest bit of guilt, but a smile instead curled up the corners of his lips.
“What is it? I called you weaklings, and you are still unconvinced?” He began to mock them.

“Yi Tianfeng, are you here to help or to undermine me?” There was a woman in red standing beside him. She was really as beautiful as peach blossoms, especially her peach blossom eyes. The moment she looked at someone, hearts would melt.

Though this woman was wearing a slightly looser red dress, her beautiful curves could not be concealed no matter what. A breeze blew over, and the dress stuck to her body, completely outlining her seductive figure.
She was Tang Rong, a seductive beauty on the Exquisite Leaderboard.
Everyone glanced at her, and couldn’t help but feel their hearts flutter. The anger that had just arisen instantly dissipated completely.

Yi Tianfeng smiled, and said, “Sister Rong, I’m not exaggerating in the slightest. As for these people, they are only there as a show of strength. If we really come to blows, even if they join forces, they won’t be a match for me alone.”
“Such an arrogant tone!” someone couldn’t help but say.
“What a familiar scene,” Ling Han murmured. This scene seemed familiar.
“Don’t spout nonsense!” Another person stepped out, pulling back the person who had spoken earlier, “That is Yi Tianfeng!”
“What Yi Tianfeng?”
“Yi Tianfeng, ranked in 8000s of True Self Tier on the Galaxy Network.”
“Hiss!”
When Galaxy Network’s ranking was brought up, everyone inhaled sharply.

Ordinary cultivators would not be able to touch the Imperial Son’s level at all. Thus, the Galaxy Network Ranking was the most authoritative ranking of battle prowess for them. In the whole universe, hewas ranked in the 8000s. Hiss, powerful!
Yi Tianfeng meanwhile was proud. As he saw it, everyone’s behaviour was too normal, and was completely within his expectations, “8231.” He emphasized.
8231st and 8999th were both in the 8000s, but there was a whole gap of over six hundred in ranking. How could they be the same?
“Pu!” The large black dog and little azure dragon laughed together. Just from this emphasis, it was clear just how strong Yi Tianfeng’s vanity was.
“What are you laughing at?” Yi Tianfeng looked over, his expression filled with disdain.

chapters.title: Chapter 4235: Entrance
paragraphs: The little azure dragon and the large black dog were both troublemakers, so how could they possibly cower? They immediately rolled up their sleeves and prepared to fight.
However, before they could step out, two large hands stretched out and pressed down on their shoulders respectively.
The two of them didn’t even need to turn around to know that it was definitely Ling Han who was stopping them.
-We have come to blend in with the team, not to fight.
With this in mind, the little azure dragon and the large black dog both deflated. Whatever, they’d think about it after entering the Island of the Sky.
“Humph!” Yi Tianfeng’s eyes swept over them coldly, naturally taking Ling Han and the others’ retreat for a natural reaction.
He was one of Galaxy Network’s top-ranked elites, so how awesome was he? If Ling Han and the others didn’t back down, that would really be strange.

“All right, hurry up and complete the registration. I have heard that the Island of the Sky would open in at most two days’ time,” Tang Rong said. She actually did not like Yi Tianfeng’s arrogance, but was also disdainful of the cowardice of others.
With that said, with a flutter of her sleeve, she turned and left.
Yi Tianfeng smirked coldly, swept an eye over everyone, and hurriedly followed.
Though everyone was displeased, with a Galaxy Network elite in the team, their chances of survival would also be greatly increased. For this reason, they tolerated it.
“This brat is really displeasing.” The large black dog sneered.
“That’s right. I really want to beat him up.” The little azure dragon nodded.

Meanwhile, Ling Han smiled. When one had reached a height that he had, he really couldn’t be bothered to lower himself to the level of a minor character like Yi Tianfeng. If he wanted to fight, it would be Lin Xuan and the other members of the Golden Generation. Those like Shi Yuanzhen were only qualified to be killed by him, and could no longer be considered his match.

However, most of the Silver Generation’s elites were still at the True Self Tier, and most of them were at the fourth form of the True Self Tier or even the fifth form of the True Self Tier. They looked forward to obtaining the Evolution Fruit to break through their limits. Thus, on this trip, the Silver Generation should be Ling Han’s strongest opponent.
“Compared to the Silver Generation, my weakness is my cultivation level. I haven’t even completely formed the Stone Fetus yet.”

In the first place, the Imperial Son was synonymous with being invincible among his peers. Then, the Imperial Sons had the advantage in cultivation level, and were members of the Silver Generation at that. How could it be easy to defeat them?
“I wonder if I can stimulate ley lines on the Island of the Sky. If I can, then I’ll have another trump card.”

Ling Han raised his head to look at the skies. From here, he could see the Island of the Sky. A colossal island that floated in midair, enshrouded by the Regulations of the highest level, turning into incredibly magnificent pillars of light and divine clouds, presenting an intoxicating sight.
However, while this scene was beautiful, it was also incredibly dangerous. If a Venerate Tier cultivator approached, they would be instantly killed, and even Saints would not be able to pass through.
Only when it truly opened, would the supreme Regulations dissipate, and an entrance would appear, which would be entered through a special passageway.
After Ling Han and the others registered their information, they rested nearby. It was expected that the Island of the Sky would open tomorrow or the day after tomorrow.
After a night, they looked at the skies again, and saw that the Regulations that enshrouded the Island of the Sky were like flowers in full bloom, blooming all at once.
The Island of the Sky had officially opened!
Everyone hurriedly went to the entrance, and queued up to enter.
The first to enter would definitely be the Imperial Clans. No one would be able to compete with them, and would not dare to compete at all.

After the Imperial Clans, it was the Holy Land’s troops, and after the Holy Land’s troops, it was the Venerate Tier forces’ turn. The hierarchy was strict, and no one dared to challenge this hierarchy.

There were elites keeping watch to remove any unqualified parties. The main purpose was not to find Ling Han and the others, but to see if any force had brought in cultivators that had surpassed the True Self Tier. That was definitely not allowed. Once it was found, then not a single member of this force would be able to enter into the Island of the Sky.
Thus, aside from those forces that wanted to try their luck at the beginning, no other force dared to do so afterwards.
After waiting for half a day, it was finally the Tang Clan’s turn.
Ling Han could see very clearly that there was someone at the entrance who was examining identities, and that was a Venerate Tier.
Why wasn’t it a Saint?
Hehe, to have a Saint do such a thing? Just ask which Saint would be so shameless!
In truth, Venerate Tier elites were already powerful enough. With a single glance, practically all kinds of disguises could be seen.

The Imperial Clans were still fine. Every Imperial Son and Imperial Daughter had the intention to be invincible. They practically did not bring their attendants with them, so it was especially easy to investigate their identities. However, when it came to the Holy Lands, especially the Venerate Tier forces, they brought even more people.
Tang Rong’s team, for example, had a total of 105 people. It was practically grand and
majestic.
Under such circumstances, it was impossible for that Venerate Tier elite to examine them in detail one by one. He could only sweep his gaze over them.
Ordinarily, this was already enough, but the Soul Forming Technique was also incredibly awesome, and a single glance from a Venerate Tier elite... could not see through it!

Shua, Ling Han and the others all felt a powerful consciousness sweep over their bodies. Even their minds trembled slightly, but this consciousness swept over them, and did not stop, nor did it come back to them.
That Venerate Tier waved a hand, indicating that everyone could leave.
Tang Rong took the lead, and walked into a Transfer Formation.
If one wanted to enter the Island of the Sky, this was the only path that corresponded to the entrance created by the retreat of the supreme Regulations.
Over a hundred people majestically entered into the Transfer Formation. Xiu, with a flash of white light, they immediately disappeared.
There was a blur in front of their eyes, and they had already arrived on a plain. There were tall trees all around them, and their branches were like the vines of a great snake, covering the sky
and sun.
This was the Island of the Sky.
Looking back, there was no Transfer Formation. This would only appear when the Island of
the Sky was about to close.
“Little Han, how is it?” The large black dog communicated through divine sense.
Ling Han nodded, “No problem. I have already memorized the structure of the formation. As long as the seal caused by the Regulations is unlocked, I can return to the Sky Planet at any
time.”
The little azure dragon and the large black dog instantly bared their mouths in a grin. Now, they had nothing to worry about.
“Let’s go.” With Tang Rong’s command, everyone advanced.
There were teams that had entered here first from all directions, but now, none of them had any intention of provoking each other. If there was no conflict of interest, what was the point
of fighting?

For the moment, Ling Han and the others had no intention of leaving the team. Every time the Island of the Sky opened, it would last for three years. After three years, the island would close, and the Evolution Fruits that had not been harvested in time would all wilt and fall.
Thus, there was a lot of time, so he might as well observe the situation first.

This island was very big. In fact, it could even be considered astonishingly huge. It was about a quarter of the size of the Sky Planet. Furthermore, there was suppression from the supreme Regulations here. Not only could they not fly, even their speed of movement had greatly
decreased.
Thus, even a True Self Tier cultivator would need at least one to two years to completely search the entire floating island.
On the way, Yi Tianfeng continuously courted Tang Rong’s favour, while Tang Rong ignored him, causing everyone to feel secretly pleased. Who asked you to look down on others? Now
you’ve suffered retribution.
Because the Island of the Sky was too big, though a great many people had entered, once they were spread out on the island, it still seemed vast and empty.
The group advanced, and after a few days, they finally had some gains.
Evolution Fruit!
There was a strange plant growing on the ground. It was only three feet tall, and only bore a
single fruit. It was vermilion-red in colour, and the size of a fist. There were golden streaks on the skin of the fruit, intertwining to form complex veined patterns.
“We’ve finally reaped some rewards!” Tang Rong said with a smile. It had only been five days,
yet they had already obtained their first Evolution Fruit. If they could maintain this rate for three years, just how great would their rewards be?
“Hehe, this is mine!” A man’s voice rang out from the sidelines.
