From here, he could see the Island of the Sky.
A colossal island that floated in midair, enshrouded by the Regulations of the highest level, turning into incredibly magnificent pillars of light and divine clouds, presenting an intoxicating sight.
However, while this scene was beautiful, it was also incredibly dangerous.
If a Venerate Tier cultivator approached, they would be instantly killed, and even Saints would not be able to pass through.
Only when it truly opened, would the supreme Regulations dissipate, and an entrance would appear, which would be entered through a special passageway.
After Ling Han and the others registered their information, they rested nearby.
It was expected that the Island of the Sky would open tomorrow or the day after tomorrow.
After a night, they looked at the skies again, and saw that the Regulations that enshrouded the Island of the Sky were like flowers in full bloom, blooming all at once.
The Island of the Sky had officially opened!
Everyone hurriedly went to the entrance, and queued up to enter.
The first to enter would definitely be the Imperial Clans.
No one would be able to compete with them, and would not dare to compete at all.
After the Imperial Clans, it was the Holy Land’s troops, and after the Holy Land’s troops, it was the Venerate Tier forces’ turn.
The hierarchy was strict, and no one dared to challenge this hierarchy.
There were elites keeping watch to remove any unqualified parties.
The main purpose was not to find Ling Han and the others, but to see if any force had brought in cultivators that had surpassed the True Self Tier.
That was definitely not allowed.
Once it was found, then not a single member of this force would be able to enter into the Island of the Sky.
Thus, aside from those forces that wanted to try their luck at the beginning, no other force dared to do so afterwards.
After waiting for half a day, it was finally the Tang Clan’s turn.
Ling Han could see very clearly that there was someone at the entrance who was examining identities, and that was a Venerate Tier.
Why wasn’t it a Saint?
Hehe, to have a Saint do such a thing?
Just ask which Saint would be so shameless!
In truth, Venerate Tier elites were already powerful enough.
With a single glance, practically all kinds of disguises could be seen.
The Imperial Clans were still fine.
Every Imperial Son and Imperial Daughter had the intention to be invincible.
They practically did not bring their attendants with them, so it was especially easy to investigate their identities.
However, when it came to the Holy Lands, especially the Venerate Tier forces, they brought even more people.
Tang Rong’s team, for example, had a total of 105 people.
It was practically grand and
majestic.
Under such circumstances, it was impossible for that Venerate Tier elite to examine them in detail one by one.
He could only sweep his gaze over them.
Ordinarily, this was already enough, but the Soul Forming Technique was also incredibly awesome, and a single glance from a Venerate Tier elite... could not see through it!
Shua, Ling Han and the others all felt a powerful consciousness sweep over their bodies.
Even their minds trembled slightly, but this consciousness swept over them, and did not stop, nor did it come back to them.
That Venerate Tier waved a hand, indicating that everyone could leave.
Tang Rong took the lead, and walked into a Transfer Formation.
If one wanted to enter the Island of the Sky, this was the only path that corresponded to the entrance created by the retreat of the supreme Regulations.
Over a hundred people majestically entered into the Transfer Formation.
Xiu, with a flash of white light, they immediately disappeared.
There was a blur in front of their eyes, and they had already arrived on a plain.
There were tall trees all around them, and their branches were like the vines of a great snake, covering the sky
and sun.
This was the Island of the Sky.
Looking back, there was no Transfer Formation.
This would only appear when the Island of
the Sky was about to close.
“Little Han, how is it?” The large black dog communicated through divine sense.
Ling Han nodded, “No problem.
I have already memorized the structure of the formation.
As long as the seal caused by the Regulations is unlocked, I can return to the Sky Planet at any
time.”
The little azure dragon and the large black dog instantly bared their mouths in a grin.
Now, they had nothing to worry about.
“Let’s go.” With Tang Rong’s command, everyone advanced.
There were teams that had entered here first from all directions, but now, none of them had any intention of provoking each other.
If there was no conflict of interest, what was the point
of fighting?
For the moment, Ling Han and the others had no intention of leaving the team.
Every time the Island of the Sky opened, it would last for three years.
After three years, the island would close, and the Evolution Fruits that had not been harvested in time would all wilt and fall.
Thus, there was a lot of time, so he might as well observe the situation first.
This island was very big.
In fact, it could even be considered astonishingly huge.
It was about a quarter of the size of the Sky Planet.
Furthermore, there was suppression from the supreme Regulations here.
Not only could they not fly, even their speed of movement had greatly
decreased.
Thus, even a True Self Tier cultivator would need at least one to two years to completely search the entire floating island.
On the way, Yi Tianfeng continuously courted Tang Rong’s favour, while Tang Rong ignored him, causing everyone to feel secretly pleased.
Who asked you to look down on others?
Now
you’ve suffered retribution.
Because the Island of the Sky was too big, though a great many people had entered, once they were spread out on the island, it still seemed vast and empty.
The group advanced, and after a few days, they finally had some gains.
Evolution Fruit!
There was a strange plant growing on the ground.
It was only three feet tall, and only bore a
single fruit.
It was vermilion-red in colour, and the size of a fist.
There were golden streaks on the skin of the fruit, intertwining to form complex veined patterns.
“We’ve finally reaped some rewards!” Tang Rong said with a smile.
It had only been five days,
yet they had already obtained their first Evolution Fruit.
If they could maintain this rate for three years, just how great would their rewards be?
“Hehe, this is mine!” A man’s voice rang out from the sidelines.

chapters.title: Chapter 4236: Might of a Beauty
paragraphs: Shua, everyone simultaneously turned to look towards the left.
There was a young man standing there, his hands clasped behind his back. Merely from the way he was posing, he was already showing a bearing of high status.
“Scram!” Yi Tianfeng immediately humphed. He was an elite ranked in the 8000s in the Galaxy Network.
The young man smiled faintly, “Leave the Evolution Fruit and this woman behind. The others can get lost.”
Yi Tianfeng was furious. ‘I already told you to get lost, yet you’re still blabbering nonsense?’
He immediately wanted to make a move, but when he thought about it, if he made a move like this, how could he show how strong he was?
“You guys go,” he turned around and said to Ling Han and the others.
Everyone exchanged looks. Yi, why was it them again?
Fine, so be it. There were over a hundred of them, so how could it be that they could not kill a single person?

Xiu, xiu, xiu! Immediately, thirteen people leaped out, pouncing towards that young man. “You overestimate yourself!” The young man sneered, and finally stopped standing with his hands behind his back. He stretched out his left hand, and pressed forwards lightly. Instantly, the Regulations of heaven and earth condensed, turning into a giant silver claw that grabbed out at the thirteen people.
The thirteen people all activated their Regulations, greeting the incoming attack with their strongest stance.

But it was really as that young man had said. They had overestimated their own abilities. Peng, under the barrage of the silver claw, those thirteen people all released terrible cries, and then were mercilessly crushed into a mush of blood.
Hiss!

Seeing this scene, those who had not stepped forwards all felt a chill run down their spines. Thirteen of them working together were actually no match for a single blow from this young man, and they were all insta-killed. Then what did it matter even if they stepped up?
It was just a matter of making a few more moves, and they would all die.

Though they had received money from the Tang Clan, and wanted to work for Tang Rong, there was absolutely no way they would insist on charging head-on when they clearly knew that they would definitely die.

Yi Tianfeng shuddered. Previously, he had already mocked Ling Han and the others as weaklings, and that was the truth as well. Though these people were all True Self Tiers, some of them were only in the First Form, and there were only a few in the Fourth Form. Even if they joined forces, they would not be a match for him.
However, could he insta-kill thirteen with a single strike?
He wasn’t sure, but his Galaxy Network ranking of 8000s still gave him great confidence that he would definitely win.
Yi Tianfeng stepped out, and asked, “Who exactly are you?”
“Block ten moves from me, and only then would you be qualified to know my name,” the young man declared proudly.
“How arrogant!” Yi Tianfeng shouted loudly, and charged towards his opponent. Boom!
The moment the two of them took over, they both unleashed their full power. Regulations turned into divine chains, and divine lightning. Light exploded madly, terrifying without bounds.
Everyone had no choice but to retreat. The battle prowess of both sides was too terrifying. Even a single shockwave was too much for them to bear.
All of a sudden, the battle stopped.
“You can actually block ten moves from me. Very well, you are qualified to know my name.” This young man declared proudly, “I am Bu Tianyi.”
“What, Bu Tianyi!” Suddenly, a commotion arose in the crowd.
“Bu Tianyi, ranked in the 6000s on the Galaxy Network!”
“Hiss!”

Yi Tianfeng’s expression also changed drastically. His greatest pride was in his Galaxy Network ranking. This was the source of his confidence, but the other man was ranked in the 6000s, which was about 2000 places higher than him.

Even if Galaxy Network ranking couldn’t represent full strength, there would be discrepancies within 500 ranks in actual battle, at most. If it was more than 500, then it would be impossible to make a comeback.
How could he be so unlucky? He had encountered such an elite right off the bat!

“All right, the Evolution Fruit is yours!” Yi Tianfeng was very decisive. There was absolutely no chance of winning against this kind of elite, and this was the Island of the Sky. It was sealed off by the supreme Regulations, and communication with the outside world was completely blocked. Thus, when it was time to cower, he had to be honest and admit defeat. Bu Tianyi laughed loudly, and said, “Is there something wrong with your ears? Like I said, the Evolution Fruit and this beauty have to stay!”

Yi Tianfeng humphed and said, “Although your Galaxy Network is ranked around 2000 places higher than me, you mightn’t necessarily win if we battle to the death. Even if you win, you’ll have to pay a huge price.”
With a shake of his right hand, a large black saber appeared in his hand. However, there were golden patterns on the saber’s blade, exuding a terrifying aura.
Bu Tianyi couldn’t help but narrow his eyes. This saber exerted a very strong pressure on him.

“I never thought that you would actually possess a high-quality Four Star Spirit Tool!” he said. He pondered slightly, then continued, “All right, leave the Evolution Fruit behind, and you guys can get lost!”
“Let’s go.” Yi Tianfeng waved a hand.
“Wait!” Tang Rong suddenly spoke up, “I will not hand over the Evolution Fruit.”

“Sister Rong, that is Bu Tianyi. We are no match for him!” Yi Tianfeng said. Even if he possessed the Night Demon Saber, and at most, a battle between him and Bu Tianyi would end up with both of them coming off seriously injured, but that was definitely not the result
he wanted.
Tang Rong ignored him. Instead, she took graceful steps, and headed towards Bu Tianyi, “You killed my followers, I want you to pay with your life.”
Bu Tianyiwas taken aback, then laughed loudly, “Actually, I don’t believe in the words that those with big breasts have no brains, but now that I have seen you, I believe it.”
Shua!

A silvery light flashed past, and Tang Rong had already begun her attack. A silver sword appeared in her hand, and as the sword swept out, its brilliance was boundless, as if it wanted to forcefully slice apart the heaven and earth.
What!
Bu Tianyi was shocked, and hurriedly summoned his own Spirit Tool to parry.
Boom, with a loud bang, he was forcefully sent backwards, his feet forcibly digging out a deep groove in the ground. His face was pale, and with a ‘wa’, he spat out blood.

F***, when they saw this scene, everyone was incredibly stunned. Who would have thought that this seductive beauty on the Exquisite Leaderboard was actually a hidden elite? And in terms of expressions, Yi Tianfeng was naturally the most expressive.
He had always considered himself as the top elite in the team, putting on airs and acting cool. Now, it was equivalent to having been slapped heavily in the face, causing his face to flush
red.
Tang Rong did not yield even though she had the upper hand. The silver sword slashed out, its brilliance soaring into the skies.
Bu Tianyi was completely outmatched, and was soon suppressed. Shua, blood sprayed out, and his right arm was forcefully severed.
He screamed in pain, no longer daring to continue fighting. Hurriedly, he turned around and
left.
However, he had only taken a few steps when his body trembled, and his eyes instantly lost
focus.
Tang Rong shot forwards like an arrow, and as the silver sword swept past, peng, a human
head shot into the skies.
She was taken aback. Why did Bu Tianyi not resist at all?
However, she did not notice anything off, and could only think that it was because Bu Tianyi was completely focused on fleeing, and had completely forgotten to parry.
She sheathed her sword, and stood proudly, her bearing captivating.
But this time, no one dared to have any more devious thoughts about her.
Strength!
Tang Rong had used her powerful abilities to prove that she was not just a pretty face, but rather a great elite that could slash one who was in the 6000s on the Galaxy Network.
To defeat Bu Tianyi, those ranked higher than him could do so, but to sever one of his arms in
such a short period of time, and then behead him with a single strike, the person definitely had to be ranked in the top thousand.
This kind of elite was more or less on the level of the Holy Land’s Dao Child, Holy Daughter, so naturally, no one dared to have any evil thoughts.
Yi Tianfeng was embarrassed. He had bragged for a long time, yet in the end, he had been slapped in the face. This was too embarrassing.

chapters.title: Chapter 4237: Fu Jingyuan
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
“Little Han, have you taken a fancy to this girl?” the large black dog communicated through divine sense.
“Hehe.” Ling Han merely chuckled.

“If you didn’t take a fancy to this girl, why did you come to help?” the large black dog asked. How could it be that it couldn’t tell? In the end, it was Ling Han who had unleashed the murderous aura, causing Bu Tianyi to be dazed, and beheaded by Tang Rong with a single strike?
“Those who commit murder should be killed,” Ling Han said calmly. He paused, then continued, “Also, can’t you tell that Tang Rong looks very much like someone?”
“Yi!” With such a reminder from him, the large black dog suddenly came to a realization, “The little girl, Tang Yun’er!”

“They’re most likely from the same clan,” Ling Han said with a nod. He had felt a sense of familiarity after witnessing Tang Rong’s attacks. Add to that the surname of Tang, and he was able to come up with this deduction.

“That’s right, we should give her a hand,” the large black dog said with a nod. Although Tang Yun’er was unreliable, she had helped them many times before. Of course, she had also received many benefits, such as the Ancient Sun Divine Scroll as well as many Saint Techniques.
“No wonder Grandpa Dog felt a sense of familiarity. As it turned out, what this little girl used just now was the Fallen Leaf Sword Technique!”

The Fallen Leaf Sword Technique was one of the four Saint Techniques that Ling Han had obtained after passing the final test set up by the Ancient Sun Saint. He taught it to the empress, Lin Luo, and the others without reservations. Even Tang Yun’er had a copy of it.

When he taught them, he did not impose any restrictions, saying that the Saint Technique could not be taught to outsiders. In his eyes, the one in charge in cultivation was the person, and not the technique.
—Even if everyone in the world cultivated the Imperial Scroll and Imperial Techniques, Ling Han believed that he was also the strongest.
Ling Han only felt that this world was really small. He had just randomly found a team to fool around with. He had not thought that he would actually encounter Tang Yun’er’s clansman.
Tang Rong accepted the Evolution Fruit, and led the team onwards.

Everyone was slightly embarrassed. ‘F*ck! You’re one of the top 1000 elites of the Galaxy Network, and you clearly have the ability to defeat the majority of people. Yet, you still insist on looking for bodyguards like us. If we encounter danger, we’ll be completely useless. How can we endure this?’
At this moment, even Yi Tianfeng had become silent, as if he had suffered a heavy blow. However, only a day later, he became lively again, fawning on Tang Rong at all times, incredibly cordial.
“Hehe, this guy has overcome his pride as a man. How shameless,” the large black dog said with a smile.

Ling Han nodded. Previously, when Yi Tianfeng had courted Tang Rong, he should have fallen for her beauty. Of course, Tang Rong’s Venerate Tier-level background would definitely add points to her as well, but now, Tang Rong could still become a good wife that could help him on the path of martial arts, or even be a backer for him, so she naturally had even more value to be courted.
“Little Han, when are we going to fly solo?” the large black dog asked. They couldn’t stay in the team forever, right?
“I haven’t completely grasped the ley lines here yet. Let’s wait a few more days,” Ling Han replied.

There were also ley lines on the Island of the Sky, but they were suppressed by the paramount Regulations, so it was extremely difficult to sense them. Thus, Ling Han was still in the process of familiarizing himself with them, and had not reached the point where he could stimulate them.
“Alright.” The little azure dragon and the large black dog both nodded.

This time, they had come with the intention of killing Imperial Sons, so they naturally had to increase their battle prowess as much as possible. Otherwise, what would they do if they encountered the Silver Generation?

The team continued to advance, searching for Evolution Fruits. However, though Evolution Fruits were a specialty of the Island of the Sky, they were not cabbages that could be found just anywhere on the streets, so how could they be easily obtained?
In the next few days, they found nothing.

Everyone was a little anxious. Entering a Mystery Realm represented danger, and this place was no exception. Aside from facing competitors, there were also native creatures on the island. They were all ferocious beasts that had not developed intelligence, and were extremely vicious.
In these few days, they had encountered a few. Thankfully, both Tang Rong and Yi Tianfeng were strong enough, allowing them to pass without any mishaps.
“Ang!”
A beastly roar rang out, and a colossal creature leaped out.
“Green-toothed Tiger!” everyone exclaimed in astonishment.

This was a fierce tiger. It was thirty meters long, and its two sharp fangs protruded from its lips. They were as long as five meters, and were green in colour. This was also where it got its name from as Green-toothed Tiger.
Ferocious beasts didn’t have intelligence, and they all acted based on their instincts. In the eyes of this ferocious beast, Ling Han and the others were its food.
Faced with food, they naturally had to attack.
Everyone hurriedly approached, but this fierce beast was extraordinarily strong. With a roar, everyone’s faces turned pale, and their legs almost went weak.
Shua, this fierce tiger suddenly flicked its tail, its tail like a steel whip. With a sweep, a considerable number of people were sent flying.
Peng! Peng! Peng!
After a chaotic battle, everyone was defeated. Even Tang Rong and Yi Tianfeng were no match.
“Retreat!” Tang Rong did not try to be stubborn. In any case, they were not fighting over the Evolution Fruit, so there was absolutely no need for her to put her life on the line.
They retreated, but this fierce beast was hot on their heels. This was food that was close at hand.
Ling Han turned around to take a look. Weng, a terrifying aura surged out.
Zhi!
This Green-toothed Tiger immediately stopped in its tracks. It instinctively sensed something fearful, and this overwhelmed its need to eat.

Though everyone felt it strange, why had this fierce beast given up on pursuing them? However, they were naturally more than happy to see such a result. How could they possibly care about the reason? Hurriedly, they exerted all their strength, fearing that this fierce beast would chase after them again.
Meanwhile, Tang Rong frowned slightly. This was too illogical, but no matter how smart she was, she could not guess the reason behind it.
After fleeing far enough, they rested for a while, then continued onwards.
Boom!

A powerful wave suddenly surged over from their left side, giving everyone a scare. Thankfully, when it reached near them, the power of the wave had already been exhausted, and did not have any effect on them.
“Who ambushed us?”
“How detestable!”
Everyone was angered. They were walking around peacefully, and furthermore, they were not fighting over the Evolution Fruit, so who had offended them?
They were so angry that they wanted to seek justice. This had gone too far.
Following the traces of the attack, they soon saw two groups of people engaged in an intense battle.
To be more precise, there were a dozen over people ganging up on a single person.
“Not good!” Immediately, someone exclaimed in shock. Pointing at the person that was being ganged up on, he exclaimed, “That, that is Fu Jingyuan!”
That was a young man dressed in black. His face was very thin, but his eyes were extraordinarily large, and the ratio was extremely unreasonable.
“Hiss, could it be Fu Jingyuan from the Black Demon Holy Land?”
“Heavens!”
This drew a sharp intake of breath, and a great many people’s faces turned pale.

The majority of Imperial Clans and Holy Lands were all very overbearing. It could not be helped. Their abilities were clear for all to see, but some forces were not only overbearing, they would also commit murder at the drop of a hat. It could be claimed that they were notorious.

This Black Demon Holy Land was one of them, and Fu Jingyuan was the current Dao Child of the Black Demon Holy Land. He had only debuted over a hundred years ago, but the number of lives he had taken was uncountable.
However, Fu Jingyuan was very smart. He killed people like they were nothing, yet never trifled with the Imperial Clans and other Holy Lands. Thus, he had always lived very comfortably.
“His Galaxy Network raning... is 62nd!”
“Let’s go!”

“Little Han, have you taken a fancy to this girl?” the large black dog communicated through divine sense.
“Hehe.” Ling Han merely chuckled.
“If you didn’t take a fancy to this girl, why did you come to help?” the large black dog asked.
How could it be that it couldn’t tell?
In the end, it was Ling Han who had unleashed the murderous aura, causing Bu Tianyi to be dazed, and beheaded by Tang Rong with a single strike?
“Those who commit murder should be killed,” Ling Han said calmly.
He paused, then continued, “Also, can’t you tell that Tang Rong looks very much like someone?”
“Yi!” With such a reminder from him, the large black dog suddenly came to a realization, “The little girl, Tang Yun’er!”
“They’re most likely from the same clan,” Ling Han said with a nod.
He had felt a sense of familiarity after witnessing Tang Rong’s attacks.
Add to that the surname of Tang, and he was able to come up with this deduction.
“That’s right, we should give her a hand,” the large black dog said with a nod.
Although Tang Yun’er was unreliable, she had helped them many times before.
Of course, she had also received many benefits, such as the Ancient Sun Divine Scroll as well as many Saint Techniques.
“No wonder Grandpa Dog felt a sense of familiarity.
As it turned out, what this little girl used just now was the Fallen Leaf Sword Technique!”
The Fallen Leaf Sword Technique was one of the four Saint Techniques that Ling Han had obtained after passing the final test set up by the Ancient Sun Saint.
He taught it to the empress, Lin Luo, and the others without reservations.
Even Tang Yun’er had a copy of it.
When he taught them, he did not impose any restrictions, saying that the Saint Technique could not be taught to outsiders.
In his eyes, the one in charge in cultivation was the person, and not the technique.
—Even if everyone in the world cultivated the Imperial Scroll and Imperial Techniques, Ling Han believed that he was also the strongest.
Ling Han only felt that this world was really small.
He had just randomly found a team to fool around with.
He had not thought that he would actually encounter Tang Yun’er’s clansman.
Tang Rong accepted the Evolution Fruit, and led the team onwards.
Everyone was slightly embarrassed.
‘F*ck!
You’re one of the top 1000 elites of the Galaxy Network, and you clearly have the ability to defeat the majority of people.
Yet, you still insist on looking for bodyguards like us.
If we encounter danger, we’ll be completely useless.
How can we endure this?’
At this moment, even Yi Tianfeng had become silent, as if he had suffered a heavy blow.
However, only a day later, he became lively again, fawning on Tang Rong at all times, incredibly cordial.
“Hehe, this guy has overcome his pride as a man.
How shameless,” the large black dog said with a smile.
Ling Han nodded.
Previously, when Yi Tianfeng had courted Tang Rong, he should have fallen for her beauty.

Of course, Tang Rong’s Venerate Tier-level background would definitely add points to her as well, but now, Tang Rong could still become a good wife that could help him on the path of martial arts, or even be a backer for him, so she naturally had even more value to be courted.
“Little Han, when are we going to fly solo?” the large black dog asked.
They couldn’t stay in the team forever, right?
“I haven’t completely grasped the ley lines here yet.
Let’s wait a few more days,” Ling Han replied.
There were also ley lines on the Island of the Sky, but they were suppressed by the paramount Regulations, so it was extremely difficult to sense them.
Thus, Ling Han was still in the process of familiarizing himself with them, and had not reached the point where he could stimulate them.
“Alright.” The little azure dragon and the large black dog both nodded.
This time, they had come with the intention of killing Imperial Sons, so they naturally had to increase their battle prowess as much as possible.
Otherwise, what would they do if they encountered the Silver Generation?
The team continued to advance, searching for Evolution Fruits.
However, though Evolution Fruits were a specialty of the Island of the Sky, they were not cabbages that could be found just anywhere on the streets, so how could they be easily obtained?
In the next few days, they found nothing.
Everyone was a little anxious.
Entering a Mystery Realm represented danger, and this place was no exception.
Aside from facing competitors, there were also native creatures on the island.
They were all ferocious beasts that had not developed intelligence, and were extremely vicious.
In these few days, they had encountered a few.
Thankfully, both Tang Rong and Yi Tianfeng were strong enough, allowing them to pass without any mishaps.
“Ang!”
A beastly roar rang out, and a colossal creature leaped out.
“Green-toothed Tiger!” everyone exclaimed in astonishment.
This was a fierce tiger.
It was thirty meters long, and its two sharp fangs protruded from its lips.
They were as long as five meters, and were green in colour.
This was also where it got its name from as Green-toothed Tiger.
Ferocious beasts didn’t have intelligence, and they all acted based on their instincts.
In the eyes of this ferocious beast, Ling Han and the others were its food.
Faced with food, they naturally had to attack.
Everyone hurriedly approached, but this fierce beast was extraordinarily strong.
With a roar, everyone’s faces turned pale, and their legs almost went weak.
Shua, this fierce tiger suddenly flicked its tail, its tail like a steel whip.
With a sweep, a considerable number of people were sent flying.
Peng!
Peng!
Peng!
After a chaotic battle, everyone was defeated.
Even Tang Rong and Yi Tianfeng were no match.
“Retreat!” Tang Rong did not try to be stubborn.
In any case, they were not fighting over the Evolution Fruit, so there was absolutely no need for her to put her life on the line.
They retreated, but this fierce beast was hot on their heels.
This was food that was close at hand.
Ling Han turned around to take a look.
Weng, a terrifying aura surged out.
Zhi!
This Green-toothed Tiger immediately stopped in its tracks.
It instinctively sensed something fearful, and this overwhelmed its need to eat.
Though everyone felt it strange, why had this fierce beast given up on pursuing them?
However, they were naturally more than happy to see such a result.
How could they possibly care about the reason?
Hurriedly, they exerted all their strength, fearing that this fierce beast would chase after them again.
Meanwhile, Tang Rong frowned slightly.
This was too illogical, but no matter how smart she was, she could not guess the reason behind it.
After fleeing far enough, they rested for a while, then continued onwards.
Boom!
A powerful wave suddenly surged over from their left side, giving everyone a scare.
Thankfully, when it reached near them, the power of the wave had already been exhausted, and did not have any effect on them.
“Who ambushed us?”
“How detestable!”
Everyone was angered.
They were walking around peacefully, and furthermore, they were not fighting over the Evolution Fruit, so who had offended them?
They were so angry that they wanted to seek justice.
This had gone too far.
Following the traces of the attack, they soon saw two groups of people engaged in an intense battle.
To be more precise, there were a dozen over people ganging up on a single person.
“Not good!” Immediately, someone exclaimed in shock.
Pointing at the person that was being ganged up on, he exclaimed, “That, that is Fu Jingyuan!”
That was a young man dressed in black.
His face was very thin, but his eyes were extraordinarily large, and the ratio was extremely unreasonable.
“Hiss, could it be Fu Jingyuan from the Black Demon Holy Land?”
“Heavens!”
This drew a sharp intake of breath, and a great many people’s faces turned pale.
The majority of Imperial Clans and Holy Lands were all very overbearing.
It could not be helped.
Their abilities were clear for all to see, but some forces were not only overbearing, they would also commit murder at the drop of a hat.
It could be claimed that they were notorious.
This Black Demon Holy Land was one of them, and Fu Jingyuan was the current Dao Child of the Black Demon Holy Land.
He had only debuted over a hundred years ago, but the number of lives he had taken was uncountable.
However, Fu Jingyuan was very smart.
He killed people like they were nothing, yet never trifled with the Imperial Clans and other Holy Lands.
Thus, he had always lived very comfortably.
“His Galaxy Network raning... is 62nd!”
“Let’s go!”
Everyone said.
That was a murderous demon king, and definitely could not be trifled with.
In fact, they could not even be seen by the other party, or they would be unlucky should Fu Jingyuan’s murderous nature kick in.

“Gaga, since you’re already here, why are you running?” Xiu, with a flash, Fu Jingyuan had already appeared in front of them, and the heads of the dozen over people that had ganged up on him previously had all exploded, and were presently throwing up blood madly from their severed necks and limbs.

chapters.title: Chapter 4238: Hope
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
Fu Jingyuan stood there, his expression calm. It could not be seen at all that he had just coldly killed a dozen over people.
Everyone’s expressions were ashen. He was ranked 62nd on the Galaxy Network, so strong that they could only despair.
If this kind of elite wanted to kill them, how would they be able to stop him?

Even Tang Rong’s pretty face was pale. Firstly, her abilities were outmatched, and secondly, in terms of background, he had the Holy Land as his backer, so there was absolutely no need for him to take the Tang Clan to heart.
More importantly, this was the Island of the Sky. After entering, they had lost contact with the outside world. As long as they were silenced, there was no way others could find the murderer.
In this place, Fu Jingyuan was like a fish in water. He could fully display his murderous nature, and have no scruples.
“How do you want to die?” Fu Jingyuan asked. “In this aspect, I’m actually very amicable. I’m willing to satisfy you 100%. If the way you die is especially creative, I’ll even remember you.”
No one spoke. This was a lunatic, and a powerful lunatic at that, leaving them with only despair.
The Island of the Sky was so huge, so why had they encountered him?
“Hehe, Grandpa Dog wants to live until I die of old age. How about it?” the large black dog said.
Everyone looked over, their eyes filled with admiration. To be able to speak so frankly and confidently in front of Fu Jingyuan, this courage alone was enough to make others give him a thumbs up.
Meanwhile, Fu Jingyuan laughed loudly, then shook his head, “Apologies, this wish of yours is probably difficult to realize. I am not accustomed to waiting so long for one person.”
The large black dog sighed, “Looks like we can’t be friends happily.”
“Obviously not,” Fu Jingyuan nodded.
“Since we can’t be friends, then we can only meet again,” the large black dog said. Then, he beckoned everyone over, “Let’s go, let’s go.”
‘You can do that?’
Everyone thought. Hurriedly, they turned and left. If they could get rid of this murderous demon king like this, that would be great.
“Who told you to leave?” Fu Jingyuan immediately turned hostile, revealing a baleful killing intent.
“These legs are Grandpa Dog’s own legs. If I want to leave, do you think you can stop me?” the large black dog said.
Fu Jingyuan smiled, “Then there is nothing else I can do. I can only break your legs first.”
“Hahahaha, break your legs!” The little azure dragon suddenly burst into laughter.
This guy had an easily tickled sense of humor, and was easily amused by himself.
“Four-Legged Snake, do you want to die?” the large black dog said viciously.
“Hahahaha!” The little azure dragon merely roared with laughter.
Seeing that the two of them were actually arguing, Fu Jingyuan showed a hint of anger.

He enjoyed killing people, and he enjoyed even more admiring the terrified expressions on the faces of those who were killed before they died. However, these two people were actually laughing and joking?
‘Humph, are you people looking down on me?’
“You’re seeking death!” Fu Jingyuan moved. Shua, he delivered a palm strike, slashing towards the little azure dragon and the large black dog at the same time.
“Small snake flicks its tail!” The large black dog immediately turned around, and then shot out a kick.
Peng!
The kick landed on the palm strike, and this palm strike was immediately shattered.
Yi?
When everyone saw this, a sliver of hope rose up in them. Perhaps, perhaps, they still had a chance of survival.

Fu Jingyuan was also taken aback. He had not thought that his attack would actually be unsuccessful. However, he did not take it to heart. That attack just now was only a casual move, and had only unleashed less than one-tenth of his battle prowess.
“No wonder you dared to be insolent in front of me. As it turned out, you do have some abilities.” He said calmly, “However, I only used one-tenth of my power in that attack just now.”
“Grandpa Dog only used 1%,” the large black dog immediately said. F***, who didn’t know how to show off?
‘F*ck! Can you exaggerate any further?’
Fu Jingyuan humphed upon hearing this. He didn’t like bickering, and fighting was his forte.
He charged over, bringing with him boundless killing intent.

The large black dog approached. Peng! The two of them immediately engaged in an intense battle. However, the large black dog’s disadvantage was also immediately revealed. Its battle prowess was only at 25 Heavens, but Fu Jingyuan’s battle prowess was as high as 27 Heavens.
In just a few moves, the large black dog’s only option was to dodge. It didn’t dare to face Fu Jingyuan head-on.
However, this caused everyone’s eyes to widen in disbelief.

It should be known that the large black dog was only in the second form of the True Self Tier, but Fu Jingyuan was in the peak stage of the fourth form, leading by a whole two minor levels. Then, if the large black dog’s cultivation level could match his, would the outcome of the battle still be like this?

Fu Jingyuan naturally knew this as well. Involuntarily, his killing intent intensified. This enmity had naturally been formed, so he was even more determined to kill the large black dog, to prevent it from becoming a great threat to him in future.
‘Die!’
His attacks became even more rapid. In fact, he even activated the Saint Technique, allowing his battle prowess to rise to the peak battle prowess of 30 Heavens.
This caused the large black dog to be unable to even withstand a single blow. If he came into contact with such a violent attack, he would either be killed or injured.
“Little Han, save me!” The large black dog couldn’t hold on any longer, and he called out for Ling Han to save him.
He had never been a dog that cared about his pride.
Ling Han smiled, and strode off.
Peng!
He exchanged a blow with Fu Jingyuan. Teng, teng, teng! Fu Jingyuan immediately took a few steps back, while Ling Han merely swayed slightly.
Hiss!
Seeing this scene, everyone inhaled sharply.
Ling Han actually had the upper hand. Heavens!

Tang Rong’s eyes lit up. She couldn’t help but recall how they had encountered that Green-toothed Tiger previously. They had been outmatched and fled, but that ferocious beast had only chased a few steps before coming to an abrupt stop, as if it had been frightened by some existence.
And when Bu Tianyi was fleeing, he suddenly paused, and was easily killed by her.
From the look of things now, this must have been Ling Han’s secret move.
She was both stunned and curious. How could Ling Han’s strength be so strong that he could even force back a Dao Child? It should be known that this guy was only the second form of the True Self.

Fu Jingyuan was naturally even more astonished. He had already unleashed his full power, yet he had actually been sent flying by a single punch from Ling Han. This caused his heart to beat wildly, and a cold chill to rise up in his heart.
So strong.
He was a bloodthirsty person, yet he was also extremely afraid of death. When he realized that he was no match for Ling Han, he immediately turned around and fled with his movement technique.
Ling Han smiled and said, “Since you’re already here, why are you running?”
He stretched out a hand and pressed down. Boom, an Earth Dragon suddenly shot out of the ground, blocking Fu Jingyuan’s path.
In these few days, he was already able to communicate with the ley lines. At the moment, he was still unable to use the Star Steps, but summoning the Earth Dragon was no problem.
“Piss off!” Fu Jingyuan roared as he charged at the Earth Dragon.
Peng!
He exchanged blows with the Earth Dragon, but what was shocking was that he actually did not manage to shatter the Earth Dragon, and only managed a draw.
As Ling Han advanced into the True Self Tier, the Earth Dragon that he summoned also became more powerful.
Fu Jingyuan paled in shock. What kind of celestial technique was this? How could it possibly last for such a long time?
Ling Han clasped his hands behind his back, and slowly walked forwards. He asked with a smile, “The victor is yet to be decided, so why are you in such a rush to leave?”

Fu Jingyuan did not reply. He merely attacked madly, wanting to shatter the Earth Dragon as soon as possible, so that he could gain the chance to escape. However, the battle prowess of the Earth Dragon was as high as thirty Heavens, which was equivalent to his strongest battle prowess. How could he shatter it in a short while?

chapters.title: Chapter 4239: Insta-killed with a single strike
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
Everyone looked at how hard Fu Jingyuan was fighting, while Ling Han was walking with his hands clasped behind his back, looking very relaxed. They couldn’t help but feel a sense of absurdity.
Gods, this guy was too fierce, wasn’t he?

After much effort, Fu Jingyuan finally shattered the Earth Dragon. After all, this was only condensed from Earth Qi, and lacked flexibility. It could not possibly be as powerful as an actual cultivator.
However, Ling Han was already close at hand.
“Who are you?” he asked darkly. At this moment, he calmed down instead.
Being able to become the Dao Child of the Holy Land, his temperament naturally passed the test.
“We are—” the large black dog called out loudly.
“Three Milk Tea Brothers!” the little azure dragon continued.
Pu!
Quite a few people spluttered. ‘F*ck, can’t the two of you be more reasonable? The Three Milk Tea Brothers? That is really hilarious.’

However, Fu Jingyuan couldn’t laugh at all. Ordinary cultivators couldn’t possibly come into contact with the circle of the Imperial Clans. Although Fu Jingyuan was not capable of befriending Imperial Sons, with the strength of the Black Demon Holy Land, he could still learn some secrets.
The Three Milk Tea Brothers?

Hiss, weren’t these the three guys who had just caused a stir with the Buddhist Race in the West Heaven Realm? Furthermore, the Buddha Son of the West Heavenly Realm was actually Ling Han under a false identity.
Ling Han!
Fu Jingyuan’s expression was slightly bitter, and he asked, “Are you Ling Han?”
What, Ling Han!

Though the Three Milk Tea Brothers were very impressive in the Imperial Son’s circle, but in the circle of the general public, it had not spread to the extent that it was deeply ingrained in the hearts of the people, but the words ‘Ling Han’... rang loudly in their ears.
Everyone was shocked. This guy was Ling Han?
That Ling Han that was wanted by the nine great Imperial Clans?
Meanwhile, Tang Rong showed a hint of understanding. No wonder Ling Han had helped her time and time again. As it turned out, he was Ling Han.
—She naturally found out about Ling Han from her younger sister.
Ling Han smiled faintly and said, “You guessed correctly. However, there’s no reward.”

Fu Jingyuan’s expression was very complicated. When Ling Han’s name rang throughout the universe, he was actually disdainful of it, because Ling Han had only been in the Core Formation Tier at the time, while he was already in the fourth form of the True Self Tier.
With such a large gap in cultivation level, did he need to take Ling Han seriously? No matter how prodigious he was, he would still be able to kill him with a single slap.
But just how many years had passed?

Ling Han had already become the second form of the True Self, and what was even more terrifying was the fact that this guy’s battle prowess was actually superior to his, though it was only slightly superior.
The legendary Ling Han was also proficient in formations. That’s right, the dragon-shaped attack just now was Earth Qi transforming into a dragon through formations.
“Brother Ling, please let me off the hook.” Fu Jingyuan lowered his stance, and took the initiative to admit defeat.
Meanwhile, Ling Han said calmly, “Those people who died by your hand, when they begged you for mercy, did you spare one of them?”
Fu Jingyuan was instantly rendered speechless.
Of course, he didn’t. If he did, would the legend of him being a murderous demon king still circulate?
He was just that cold-blooded and heartless!

With such a question, Fu Jingyuan also knew that this matter could not possibly be resolved peacefully. Silently, he drew out the Spirit Tool. It was a completely black flag, and there was a skull drawn on it, vivid and lifelike.

“Ling Han, compared to me, your battle prowess has only surpassed me by one Heaven. If you want to kill me, hoho, you may not be able to do as you wish!” Fu Jingyuan said, straightening his back once more.
Since things couldn’t be settled peacefully, the only option was to battle. Cultivators were all prepared for this.
“Is that so?” Ling Han smiled. He nodded, and said, “If I can’t kill you within three moves, I’ll let you go.”
Hearing these words, Fu Jingyuan’s eyes involuntarily lit up.

chapters.title: Chapter 4240: Coincidence
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
Tang Rong ignored the large black dog. She took out a jade box and handed it over to Ling Han.
Yi?
Ling Han knew that there were Evolution Fruits inside. Previously, when he had harvested them, he had seen Tang Rong place them into this jade box.
The others also knew, and they all looked envious, but not one of them dared to mess around.
F***, this guy was Ling Han!
“I think that you need the Evolution Fruit more than I do right now,” Tang Rong said. “Moreover, the Tang Clan owes you a huge favor!”
Saint Technique!

As long as the Tang Clan was given enough time, there would eventually come a day when they would become a Saint-level clan. Even though it had only improved by a single level, in the strictly hierarchical world of martial arts, this improvement was equivalent to a revolution.
Thus, the Tang Clan indeed owed Ling Han a huge favor — only Ling Han would teach the Saint Technique to them, so generous that it was unbelievable.
Ling Han pondered for a moment before accepting the jade box.

At present, he indeed needed the Evolution Fruit to rapidly increase his cultivation level. After all, he was only in the second form, so it was not difficult for him to crush a third-generation Imperial Son like Shi Yuanzhen. However, if he encountered the Silver Generation, he definitely would not be able to defeat them at this stage.
The fact that the Imperial Son was invincible among his peers was not just empty words.
“Let’s go.” Ling Han waved at the large black dog and little azure dragon, and they left the group, setting out on their own.
“Little Han, that woman is scheming!” The large black dog couldn’t help but start to gossip.
Ling Han didn’t reply. Faced with this kind of topic, it was best to ignore it. As the large black dog talked, he would feel bored.

“If it weren’t for that fruit-delivering action, we would have left without a second thought. At that time, we would naturally have nothing to do with each other anymore,” the large black dog began to analyze the situation. “But what about now? It seems like you owe her a favor, so you’ll think about her from time to time. That way, your impression of her will become deeper and deeper.”
“That makes sense!” The little azure dragon clapped its hands and nodded repeatedly.
Ling Han rolled his eyes, “Shouldn’t you guys be thinking about how to increase your cultivation level?”
“Hehe.” The large black dog and little azure dragon both laughed. They had hit the nail on the head.

“Next, let’s go our separate ways,” the little azure dragon said. “The three of us together can’t increase the chances of finding the Evolution Fruit, and each of us is especially good at fighting. It’s not worth it to put us together.”
“That’s right,” the large black dog nodded in agreement.
“All right.” Ling Han nodded as well, “Come, let’s share the Evolution Fruits. We will disband here, and when the Island of the Sky shows signs of closing, we will meet back here.”

“There’s no problem for us to meet up here, but as for this Evolution Fruit... hehe, it’s a token of goodwill from her, so I don’t want it.” The large black dog turned back into his original form. He waved his paw, and for once, he wasn’t greedy.
“Grandpa Dragon doesn’t want it either, it will feel hot in my hands,” the little azure dragon said.
With that said, these two guys ran off.
Ling Han shook his head. He opened the jade box, and there were a total of three Evolution Fruits inside. He took one out, and directly began chewing on it.
The fruit of the Evolution Fruit was very soft. With a single bite, it was completely juicy, and instantly filled his mouth. It was sweet, with a hint of sourness. It was extremely delicious.

In just a few bites, Ling Han had eaten all the Evolution Fruits. Instantly, he felt a warm feeling in his abdomen, and a surge of energy surged into his mind, stimulating the Regulations, stimulating a clay fetus to transform into a Stone Fetus.
Ling Han hurriedly channeled the cultivation technique to cooperate. When this energy was completely exhausted, the conversion of the clay fetus into the Stone Fetus was already one third complete.
Not bad.
Ling Han nodded. Merely this effect was enough to satisfy him.
He also felt a mysterious energy slumbering in his body. This should take effect after he reached the peak stage of the fourth form of the True Self Tier, helping him advance into the fifth form.
Ling Han was naturally very confident in breaking his limits, but if there was external help, he naturally wouldn’t mind.
He took out the second Evolution Fruit and continued to gnaw on it.
Only when natural treasures were used on oneself, would they be considered worth it.
After he digested the three Evolution Fruits, his third clay fetus also successfully advanced into the Stone Fetus.
“Hu, there are still six clay fetuses left.” Ling Han broke into a smile. “Going by that account, with another eighteen Evolution Fruits, I would be able to cultivate to the end of the second form.”
“Let’s go.”
He activated his movement technique and shuttled back and forth on this vast island, searching for the Evolution Fruit.

At the same time, he also continued to communicate with the ley lines. If he could succeed, not only would his speed increase greatly, but he would also be more efficient when he searched for Evolution Fruits.

However, the ley lines here were suppressed by the Regulations of the highest level, so it was really too difficult to communicate. Seven days passed in a row, and Ling Han did not manage to harvest a single Evolution Fruit, and his grasp of the ley lines had also improved very little.
Boom!
Sounds of battle suddenly traveled over from ahead of him Ling Han hesitated slightly, but still continued onwards.

In this kind of Mystery Realm, there was no need to meddle in other people’s business. That was because there were really too many people that had entered, and there was no way to manage them at all. However, since they were in front of him, there was no need for Ling Han to deliberately take a different path. If he did, he would be at a disadvantage.
After taking a few steps, he saw both sides of the battle.

On one side was a fierce beast, a Black Back Bear. There was a streak of golden brown fur on its back, as if it had been split into two, but in the midst of battle, this streak of golden brown fur shone, exuding a terrifying aura, boosting its astonishing battle prowess.
On the other side were people.
Yi?
Ling Han couldn’t help but smile. He had really searched high and low for him, yet found him without much effort.
This person was Xu Jie, an the Imperial Son.

Among those people that had targeted Ling Han the most, Shi Yuanzhen, Xu Jie, and Guan Yuanming were the three people who jumped around the most happily. They were also the three people that Ling Han definitely had to kill. He had not thought that he would encounter one so soon.
Ling Han glanced at it. This Black Back Bear was very fierce, its battle prowess reaching as high as 30 Heavens, slightly stronger than even Xu Jie.

It could not be helped. Though Xu Jie was the Imperial Son, and had the aptitude to be invincible among his peers, Xu Jie had just advanced into the third form of the True Self Tier, after all. Even if he used the Imperial Technique, his battle prowess would only be limited to the battle prowess of twenty nine Heavens, which was slightly inferior to this fierce beast.
However, the Imperial Son would naturally not retreat so easily. So what if there was a gap of battle prowess of one Heaven? He was trying his best to turn the tables.
—There were too many accidents in battle, and it was not definite that the one with the highest battle prowess would win.
Seeing Xu Jie’s perilous situation, Ling Han decided to make a move.
How could Xu Jie be allowed to die in the hands of a vicious beast? Even with the Substitution Seal, he would still not allow it. This would deprive him of the joy of revenge.
Xiu, Ling Han charged out. His target was naturally the Black Back Bear.
He suppressed his battle prowess, and only unleashed the power of the 29 Heavens. However, with the addition of a powerful helper like him, Xu Jie’s situation instantly improved greatly.
This Imperial Son only glanced at Ling Han, and did not thank him.
The Imperial Clan was high and noble, and the Imperial Son was more so a dragon above the Nine Heavens. How could he express thanks so easily?
Obtaining a favor from the Imperial Clan, wasn’t that enough for you to brag about?
He didn’t recognize Ling Han, because Ling Han was still in disguise.
‘Die!’

chapters.title: Chapter 4241: Beaten to burst
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
The two of them worked together, and forced the Black Back Bear to retreat under great difficulty.
After all, wild beasts only didn’t have intelligence, but they weren’t really stupid. After spending so much effort, it still couldn’t kill its prey. Of course, it would go find other food.
Xu Jie’s expression was filled with pride. He glanced at Ling Han, and asked, “Which Holy Land are you from?”
Aside from the Holy Land’s Dao Child, even if the others reached the fourth form of the True Self Tier, they wouldn’t be able to possess battle prowess of 29 Heavens.
“Nine Suns Holy Land.” Ling Han smiled faintly.
Xu Jie’s heart involuntarily clenched. F***, why was it so coincidental?
“Your abilities are not too bad, so you are qualified to stay by my side,” he said calmly, his expression filled with pride.
In his eyes, this was naturally giving Ling Han enough face.
Even though their strength was now equal, he had just advanced into the Third Form of the True Self Tier, and still had a lot of room for improvement. Furthermore, he was also an Imperial Son!
The title of Imperial Son was already powerful enough, and could crush everything else.
“That won’t do.” Ling Han shook his head.
“En?” Xu Jie’s eyes widened in a glare, instantly revealing anger.
‘You actually dare to refuse my kindness?’
‘Don’t you know who I am?’
Right at this moment, shua, Ling Han threw a punch at Xu Jie.
He was a Body Arts practitioner, and throwing such a punch from close quarters was indescribably fast. Furthermore, Xu Jie would never have imagined that Ling Han would suddenly attack him.
—Otherwise, why did you help me just now? It doesn’t make sense, right?
At this moment, Xu Jie’s expression was extremely colourful. He was stunned, confused, angered and humiliated. He, a dignified Imperial Son, was actually going to be slapped in the face?

He wanted to parry, but he wasn’t a Body Arts user, so how could his speed be so fast? If he wanted to parry, it would definitely be too late. Thus, he could only stimulate the Regulations, turning it into a shield of Regulations in front of his face.
As he saw it, his battle prowess was on par with Ling Han’s. Even if he couldn’t use his full defense in a hurry, it shouldn’t be difficult for him to block this punch.
Peng!

The iron fist arrived, and the shield of Regulations blocked it. However, Xu Jie was horrified to discover that the shield of Regulations was instantly shattered. The iron fist continued to attack, ruthlessly smashing into his face.
It hurt!
This was Xu Jie’s first reaction. Then, he was sent flying.
He fell heavily onto the ground, and felt that his whole face had become numb, and he could not feel it at all.
Hiss, he inhaled sharply. Firstly, it was pain, and secondly, it was shock.
The shield of Regulations that he had set up was actually broken with a single punch from Ling Han? Was this something that a battle prowess of twenty nine Heavens could accomplish?
No, this battle prowess was at least higher than his by three Heavens.
However, Xu Jie flew into a thunderous rage.
He was the Imperial Son, so when had he ever suffered such humiliation, or been slapped in the face like this?
“You’ve gone mad!” He jumped up, humiliated and furious.
“Are you surprised? Are you shocked?” Ling Han asked with a smile.
“You are seeking death!” Xu Jie gritted his teeth, his expression filled with hatred.
Ling Han smiled faintly and said, “This place has cut off communication. Who do you plan to ask for help from?”

Xu Jie’s expression changed drastically. He was not the only member of the Xu Clan to enter this place. The strongest was naturally Xu Youque of the Silver Generation, but if he was together with Xu Youque, how could the Evolution Fruit they obtained be shared with him?
Thus, he chose to act alone. With his battle prowess, identity, and the Substitution Seal, he was naturally filled with confidence. He didn’t think that he would encounter any trouble.
However, it hadn’t been long, and he had already been targeted for no reason.
“Who the hell are you?” He touched his face. F*ck, his chin had been knocked crooked, and he was in great pain.
Ling Han smiled faintly, and said, “Aren’t you despicable? You don’t even know who attacked you after being beaten.”
“Less nonsense. Hurry up and tell me your name,” Xu Jie shouted loudly.

This person was from the Nine Suns Holy Land. Could it be that he was here to stand up for Ling Han? Or was it that he had deliberately said this, so that the Nine Suns Holy Land would take the blame for this?
All of a sudden, his thoughts flew.
“Hehe, don’t think so hard!” Ling Han shot forwards like an arrow, and struck out with both fists.
Peng! Peng! Peng!
Xu Jie hurriedly parried, but Ling Han’s battle prowess was as high as 31 Heavens, so how could he be a match?
He went all out, yet was completely unable to resist. The gap in battle prowess was too wide.
What a familiar battle style.
Xu Jie was taken aback, then realization dawned on him, “You are Ling Han!”
Ling Han cracked a smile, “That’s right. You’ve finally thought of it.”
Xu Jie couldn’t help but feel his scalp go numb. It was actually Ling Han!

When he had been in the Core Formation Tier, Ling Han had been able to thrash Imperial Sons like them, and after advancing into the True Self Tier, Ling Han’s advantage had not weakened in the slightest, and was completely maintained.

In a battle of equal cultivation levels, Ling Han was the strongest, followed by Imperial Sons like them. Even the Silver Generation was no match for him, so they could only depend on the Golden Generation.
And now, he had encountered this bringer of misfortune.
Without the advantage of a superior cultivation level, how could he possibly be a match for Ling Han?

“The Imperial Clan is very impressive, isn’t it? They can target whoever they like!” Ling Han’s iron fist blasted out madly. With a single punch, Xu Jie screamed repeatedly, “Isn’t it just a few Saints keeping watch, and an Imperial Weapon protecting the clan?”
“If we’re really talking about abilities, who the f*ck do you think you are?”
Ling Han was furious. He had been forced to leave the Nine Suns Holy Land, and in the Buddhist Race, he had also been bullied by the main branch from the Buddhist Land.
Why?
Just because of the words Imperial Clan.
“Ling Han, I’m warning you, don’t go too far!” Xu Jie said through gritted teeth, unwilling to weaken his stand.

“Too far?” Ling Han couldn’t help but laugh. “Do you guys have the right to say the word ‘too far’? When you guys were bullying others, why didn’t you think of the word ‘too far’? You’re really making me laugh my head off.”
“Do you really want to fight the Imperial Clan to the death?” Xu Jie shouted. He could feel Ling Han’s determination to kill him.
Ling Han chuckled and said, “The nine great Imperial Clans have joined forces to hunt me down. Do you think I still need to be grateful to you?”

“Humph, you don’t understand at all!” Xu Jie said. “If you kill me, it won’t be as simple as just hunting you down. Even the Saints of my clan will spare no expense to predict your whereabouts. No matter how big the universe is, there will be no place for you to hide!”
“Alright, I’ll wait.” Ling Han nodded, appearing to be completely unconcerned, as he continued to pummel him with his fists.
Xu Jie was still a little confused, “Then why did you help me previously?”
“Ya, you’re going to be severely injured or even killed by a fierce beast. Won’t that decrease the pleasure of my revenge?” Ling Han said with a smile.
‘F*ck you!’
Xu Jie felt an urge to curse. So that was the reason?

“Ling Han, don’t be too arrogant!” he roared. “To say nothing of the Golden Generation, the members of the Silver Generation are either in the fourth form or even in the fifth form of True Self Tier, or they have already advanced into Spirit Transformation Tier. Any single one of them would be able to kill you easily.”
“Unfortunately, you won’t be able to see it!” Ling Han’s killing intent was cold. Destructive Energy was activated, wrapped around his fist, and blasted towards Xu Jie.
Peng!
With a single punch, Xu Jie’s head exploded.

Ling Han waited. He would wait for Xu Jie to revive, and then kill him a few more times. Members of Imperial Clans were really troublesome. With the Substitution Seal, he would have to kill him a few times.
However, after waiting for a long time, he still didn’t see Xu Jie revive.
Yi?
Ling Han found this strange. Could it be that Xu Jie’s Substitution Seal had already been used up before this? Otherwise, he would have been revived long ago.

chapters.title: Chapter 4242: Silver Generation
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
Ling Han searched Xu Jie, and soon, aside from his Spatial Tool, he also found a Peach Tree Seal.
This was hanging from Xu Jie’s neck. There were mysterious veined patterns on the wooden seal, and there was also a Saint-level aura.
Substitution Seal.
Although Ling Han hadn’t obtained the Substitution Seal before, he could confirm with a single glance that this was the Substitution Seal.
However, the Substitution Seal was clearly hanging on Xu Jie’s neck, so why didn’t it take effect?

“The Substitution Seal isn’t truly capable of actual revival. Instead, it’s used to deceive heaven and earth, using a fake body to withstand a fatal strike,” Ling Han murmured. “This kind of technique can only be mastered by the Imperial Clan. It’s not something that can be done just by reaching the Saint Tier. It might involve the Imperial Weapon.”
“Of course, the Saint’s blood essence is the most powerful. It’s said that some of the Saint’s blood essence has to be expended in its creation.”
“There shouldn’t be any mistake with the Substitution Seal, so the reason should be me.”
“Destructive Energy?

A thought flashed in Ling Han’s head. Destructive Energy was incredibly domineering, and its level could possibly reach 10 stars. It was something that all the Great Emperors had never touched before. Thus, Destructive Energy had blasted over, and even Substitution Seal was ineffective?
Was that possible?
“In the past, have I used Destructive Energy to kill the Imperial Son before?”
Ling Han couldn’t remember clearly. After all, he hadn’t paid much attention to it at that time.
“It’s also possible that it’s because the Destructive Energy that I’ve grasped is becoming stronger and stronger, and that’s why it’s extraordinarily effective.”
“Looks like I’ll have to kill a few more Imperial Sons to find out.”

Ling Han was even more curious about the Destructive Energy. Merely the quality of 10 stars made Destructive Energy extremely mysterious, and previously, it had already been proven that the Destructive Energy had an extremely outstanding effect on killing Yin souls, allowing Ling Han to battle even with a disadvantage of a major tier.
Now, even the Substitution Seal was ineffective?
If that was really the case, then it was incredibly awesome.
“Right now, there’s still a Ding Shu that possesses Destructive Energy.”
“He and I are both rulers of the Genesis World, and it was also because of this that I managed to grasp Destructive Energy. I’m sure that Ding Shu is the same.”
“What’s the relationship between the two?”
Ling Han wracked his brains, but without more clues, what was the point even if he wracked his brains?
Forget it, he would continue to look for the Evolution Fruit.

Ling Han didn’t think that he was invincible. To say nothing of the Silver Generation, even the majority of Dao Child from Holy Lands had battle prowess that was above his. However, a Dao Child didn’t have a Great Emperor-level treasure that could resist his murderous aura and his ability of weakening battle prowess, so he could still defeat them easily.
But it was a different story for the Silver Generation. They were Imperial Sons, and had a great many treasures.
As Ling Han searched for the Evolution Fruit, he flipped through Xu Jie’s Spatial Tool. Hiss, as expected of the Imperial Son. He really had a lot of good stuff on him.
Unfortunately, there was no Evolution Fruit.
Ling Han searched everywhere on the Island of the Sky. In these three months, he had harvested another two Evolution Fruits, but did not encounter any other Imperial Sons.
“It’s done!”
He suddenly smiled, showing an expression of delight.
—At this point, he had finally completely grasped the ley lines in this place. He could use the Star Steps, and could also use the ley lines as tentacles to scout in all directions.
“Evolution Fruit, Evolution Fruit, Evolution Fruit, I got it!”
Ling Han’s figure flashed, and he had already disappeared from where he was standing. When he reappeared, he was already 1500km away.

In the outside world, the distance of 1500 kilometers was only a few steps away for the True Self Tier. However, there was the supreme Regulations suppressing them here, so while everyone’s speed couldn’t be said to be crawling, it really wasn’t that fast.
Thus, Ling Han’s speed was practically heaven-defying.
In front of him, there was a short plant that was gently swaying in the breeze. There was an Evolution Fruit hanging from the tree.
Ling Han reached over and plucked the Evolution Fruit. Now, he could also push the fourth clay fetus to the level of Stone Fetus.
“Hmm?”
A figure rapidly swept over. It was a young man with a lanky figure. His forehead was very protruding, like a bird’s beak.
However, he definitely couldn’t be underestimated just because of his appearance. Seals continuously exploded around this person, creating an astonishing scene.
“Leave the Evolution Fruit behind and sever your own arm. Then, get lost!” the young man said calmly, as if he were merely talking about an extremely ordinary matter.
Ling Han bared his teeth in a grin, “What if I say no?”
“Then leave both your life and the Evolution Fruit behind,” the young man said with a calm expression. He didn’t take Ling Han seriously at all.
Ling Han shook his head, and said, “I want the Evolution Fruit, and I have no intention of handing over my life.”
Boom, the young man immediately moved. He was incredibly decisive, and shot out a palm strike. The Regulations formed into a fierce tiger that charged towards Ling Han.
‘So powerful!’
Ling Han immediately retreated. This person’s battle prowess was at least 40 Heavens, far above his own.
Boom!

The ferocious tiger arrived, smashing a massive deep pit into the ground. There were still Regulations rising from it, turning into sabers, swords, axes, and halberds. Its destructive power was still incredibly terrifying.
“Silver Generation?” Ling Han asked calmly, not showing any respect.
This young man was slightly surprised. He had actually failed with a single strike?
He humphed, and said, “I am Baili Yun.”
Baili? The Ziwei Imperial Clan.
“Oh, I’ll remember that,” Ling Han said with a nod.
Baili Yun couldn’t help but laugh in spite of himself, “Could it be that you think you can still escape from me?”
“What’s so difficult about that?” Ling Han asked with a smile.

“You don’t know what you’re talking about!” Baili Yun said coldly. He pressed out his right hand. Xiu, xiu, xiu! The Regulations turned into pillars that surrounded Ling Han. “You’re like a turtle in a jar, trapped with nowhere to go.”
Meanwhile, Ling Han laughed loudly, “Let me teach you a lesson. You have to know that there will always be someone stronger than you.”
He activated the Star Steps, and xiu, he instantly disappeared.
‘Hmm?’
Baili Yun faltered upon this. He hadn’t imagined that Ling Han would still be able to escape from his siege.
“Star Steps!” Realization immediately dawned on him. As a member of the Silver Generation, he was naturally knowledgeable. Then, he nodded, “So, you are Ling Han!”

He was still a little surprised, because there was a Venerate Tier elite investigating outside, and this still allowed Ling Han to sneak in. This brat’s art of disguise was really amazing. No wonder such a huge joke had happened in the Buddhist Race of the West Heavenly Realm, to actually take Ling Han into Buddhist Race as a Buddha Son.
“Alright, then I’ll get rid of you.” He took out a copper coin, and recited a chant. Then, he threw it into the sky, and after drawing an arc, it landed on the ground.
“There!” He picked up the copper coin and headed in a certain direction.
If Ling Han could discover the direction he was heading in, he would definitely be surprised, because he was presently in this direction, and the distance was not too far either.
In this place, though he could use the Star Step, he could not teleport too far either. 4000 km was his limit.
It could not be helped. The Regulations of the highest level was suppressing him.

Ling Han continued to gnaw on the Evolution Fruit as he calculated in his mind. The Silver Generation was indeed powerful. His battle prowess had already soared to 40 Heavens, and at this stage, he was completely capable of beating him up. In fact, the Silver Generation had the ability to kill him.
Thus, if he wanted to become stronger, and if he wanted to do so in a short amount of time, he would need a large amount of Evolution Fruits.
After ingesting this fruit, Ling Han began to transform the fourth clay fetus, advancing it to become a Stone Fetus.
