“You’re like a turtle in a jar, trapped with nowhere to go.”
Meanwhile, Ling Han laughed loudly, “Let me teach you a lesson.
You have to know that there will always be someone stronger than you.”
He activated the Star Steps, and xiu, he instantly disappeared.
‘Hmm?’
Baili Yun faltered upon this.
He hadn’t imagined that Ling Han would still be able to escape from his siege.
“Star Steps!” Realization immediately dawned on him.
As a member of the Silver Generation, he was naturally knowledgeable.
Then, he nodded, “So, you are Ling Han!”
He was still a little surprised, because there was a Venerate Tier elite investigating outside, and this still allowed Ling Han to sneak in.
This brat’s art of disguise was really amazing.
No wonder such a huge joke had happened in the Buddhist Race of the West Heavenly Realm, to actually take Ling Han into Buddhist Race as a Buddha Son.
“Alright, then I’ll get rid of you.” He took out a copper coin, and recited a chant.
Then, he threw it into the sky, and after drawing an arc, it landed on the ground.
“There!” He picked up the copper coin and headed in a certain direction.
If Ling Han could discover the direction he was heading in, he would definitely be surprised, because he was presently in this direction, and the distance was not too far either.
In this place, though he could use the Star Step, he could not teleport too far either.
4000 km was his limit.
It could not be helped.
The Regulations of the highest level was suppressing him.
Ling Han continued to gnaw on the Evolution Fruit as he calculated in his mind.
The Silver Generation was indeed powerful.
His battle prowess had already soared to 40 Heavens, and at this stage, he was completely capable of beating him up.
In fact, the Silver Generation had the ability to kill him.
Thus, if he wanted to become stronger, and if he wanted to do so in a short amount of time, he would need a large amount of Evolution Fruits.
After ingesting this fruit, Ling Han began to transform the fourth clay fetus, advancing it to become a Stone Fetus.

chapters.title: Chapter 4243: Counter-Ambush
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
Just when Ling Han refined the medicinal effects of the Evolution Fruit, Baili Yun was also approaching.
However, 4000km could be considered a considerable distance for him at present, so his progress wasn’t fast.
‘Hmm?’
Ling Han suddenly felt a sense of danger. Instinctively, he immediately used the Strange Shadow Steps and entered into the shadows.

This was the most impressive concealment technique of the Battle God Palace. Moreover, he could move slowly. The Strange Shadow Steps definitely had a part to play in the fact that the Battle God Palace had such a renowned vicious reputation.
Xiu, a figure streaked over, and Baili Yun’s figure appeared. He swept his gaze around, and frowned slightly. He had clearly sensed Ling Han’s aura here, so why had he suddenly disappeared?
Could it be that this brat just happened to leave?
So coincidental?
Ling Han saw this clearly, and was internally surprised. He had clearly used the Star Steps to arrive here, so how had Baili Yun managed to follow him here?
‘Alright, since you’re here.’
Ling Han approached Baili Yun from behind. He wanted to catch him off guard?
Hehe, I’ll let you have a taste of being ambushed.
Baili Yun took out a copper coin. Xiu, he threw it into the sky. He wanted to once again determine the location of Ling Han.
Pa, the copper coin fell to the ground. His eyes swept over it, and his expression instantly changed.
—The target was behind him, and it was very close at that!
Boom!
Right at this moment, Ling Han charged out, throwing out both fists. Destructive Energy boiled, and he instantly exploded with complete battle prowess.
In his haste, Baili Yun did not manage to organize a decent counterattack in time. He could only stimulate his divine sense, and lay out a shield of Regulations behind him.
Peng, there was a loud bang, and the energy exploded, turning into a mushroom cloud.

The shield of Regulations just barely managed to block Ling Han’s fists, but it itself had also been shattered. There was still a sliver of power that swept past, passing over Baili Yun’s scalp, and instantly, a great many strands of hair fell off.
Ling Han’s attack missed, and he didn’t linger in battle at all. Using the Star Steps, he instantly disappeared.
Baili Yun did not immediately give chase. Instead, he panted heavily with lingering fear.
Just now, if his strength had been slightly weaker, or if his reaction had been slightly slower, his mind would definitely have been obliterated.
He had the Substitution Seal, so he naturally couldn’t be killed with a single strike. However, just thinking about it made him break out in a cold sweat.
A majestic Imperial Son, a Silver Generation elite at that, was almost ambushed and killed!
It should be known that he had come to ambush Ling Han.

“This brat, what movement technique has he mastered that can actually hide his tracks under my senses?” He was extremely confused. How strong was his senses? Even a great many Spiritual Transformation Tier cultivators couldn’t escape his senses, so how could someone whose cultivation level was lower than his do it?
“Kill him! I definitely have to kill him!”
“He comes from an ordinary background, yet can be so powerful. He must be hiding a great secret. If I can obtain it, who knows, I may be able to surpass the Golden Generation!”

A glimmer of ambition flickered in his eyes. They were all Imperial Sons, yet they had been categorized into different grades. In the eyes of outsiders, the Silver Generation was already shining brilliantly, but he was internally displeased.
—Above silver, there was gold!
He had only been born a few years later, and he was destined to be inferior to those people?
In the clan, any top-notch cultivation resources would definitely be given priority to Baili Tian. No one asked him if he needed them at all.
He was going to make a comeback. He was going to become Emperor; he was not resigned to this!
“Rat, I will definitely find you!” Baili Yun took out a copper coin, and once again began to predict Ling Han’s whereabouts.
Xiu, Ling Han’s figure appeared.
“Can that guy’s copper coins predict my position?” he murmured. He refused to believe that the Imperial Son had nothing better to do and was tossing copper coins around in boredom.
Moreover, it was also because Baili Yun had tossed out the copper coin that he had become alert.
“It took Baili Yun about half an hour to travel 4000 km. Hehe, then let him travel for a while longer.”
Ling Han used the Star Steps and continued to teleport.
Very quickly, he had already left Baili Yun far behind, and on his way, he actually discovered another Evolution Fruit.
“You take your time.”

Ling Han continued to absorb the medicinal effects, but with Baili Yun’s disturbance, the Evolution Fruit from before had not taken full effect. Thus, Ling Han’s fourth clay fetus was still a bit off from completely becoming a Stone Fetus.
This grudge... was huge!
Ling Han thought to himself as he nibbled on the new Evolution Fruit.
This time, he successfully formed the fourth Stone Fetus.
“Evolution Fruit, I need more Evolution Fruits.”
Using the ley lines as eyes and ears, he searched for the Evolution Fruit.

Although he was being suppressed by the Regulations of the highest level, he could only stimulate the ley lines within the 4000 km radius, but this efficiency was still a hundred times higher than others.
“I’ve got it!”
“I found another one.”
“Haha.”
In a mere three days, Ling Han found another four Evolution Fruits. Not only was the fifth Stone Fetus formed, but even the sixth clay fetus was in the process of transforming.
“My current strength... both powers at eighteen Heavens. If I explode both at the same time, I can reach the level of 23 Heavens.”
Ling Han tested his strength. In this way, his maximum battle prowess could reach 34 Heavens.
“I am still no match for the Silver Generation, even if it’s the weakest.”

The Silver Generation with the lowest cultivation level was the fourth form of the True Self Tier, and battle prowess exceeded 40 Heavens. In fact, there were even those at the fifth form of True Self Tier among them. Then, their battle prowess could possibly be unfathomable.
“I’ll search again!”

Ling Han continued to search for the Evolution Fruit, and Baili Yun finally caught up to him. This time, he was on full alert, but Ling Han didn’t plan to ambush him at all. He fled at the first instant, making Baili Yun wait there stupidly for a long time. In the end, he made a prediction with the copper coin, and when he discovered that Ling Han had already run far away, he almost vomited blood.

The more this was the case, the more Baili Yun was unwilling to give up. He still stayed close behind Ling Han. He had always thought that there would come a time when one would be careless, and he only needed to get a chance, and that would be enough to make Ling Han be consigned to eternal damnation.

Ling Han didn’t mind. His cultivation level was rapidly increasing, and his battle prowess was already not far from 40 Heavens. If he could advance into the third form, he would immediately turn around and fight Baili Yun.
What was this!
Yi?
He was using the ley lines to search for the Evolution Fruit when he made an unexpected discovery.
With a thought, Ling Han immediately rushed over.
Shi Yuanzhen’s expression was filled with pride, and he said calmly, “Leave the Evolution Fruit behind, and get lost immediately!”
In front of him, there were four young people, three men and one woman. All of them were filled with heroic spirit, and were quite extraordinary.

“What gives you the right!” A man in green robes appeared to be very angry. This Evolution Fruit had been painstakingly harvested after they had killed a fierce beast, so what right do you have to ask for it with just a few words?
“Why?” Shi Yuanzhen couldn’t help but laugh in spite of himself. “Because I’m Shi Yuanzhen!”
“Shi Yuanzhen?” The green-robed man looked at a loss. ‘Are you very powerful?’
“Shi Yuanzhen!” His companion, a purple-robed young man, exclaimed, his expression changing drastically. “Imperial Son!”

“Oh, I remember now. It was that Imperial Son that had been instantly defeated by two Buddha Sons respectively with a single move!” The only woman, who was wearing a red dress, immediately called out, looking a little naive.
Instantly, Shi Yuanzhen looked furious.

chapters.title: Chapter 4244: Don’t even recognize an old friend?
paragraphs: To be defeated by Ling Han and Ding Shu, and in an instant at that, this was Shi Yuanzhen’s pain!
And now, this woman in red actually exposed his shortcoming right to his face, which naturally caused Shi Yuanzhen’s killing intent to rise.
The Imperial Clan was overbearing in the first place, what more when this was a Mystery Realm. Killing someone to prevent him from leaking the secret would be completely fine.
“You’re seeking death!” Shi Yuanzhen said balefully. He raised his right hand, and mystical power condensed, turning into a white ball of light.
“Oh no, he’s in a humiliated rage, and wants to kill us to keep the secret!” The three men and one woman were all shocked.

The Imperial Son was invincible among his peers, and this had long since become deeply ingrained in their hearts like an iron rule. Thus, these four people naturally paled in shock. “Die!” Shi Yuanzhen waved his hand. Boom, that ball of light shot out, and then suddenly exploded. Boom, a terrifying energy shot out, blasting towards the four of them.
The four of them hurriedly joined forces to parry, but the Imperial Son was really too strong. They only managed to parry for a short while, and all of them spat out blood as they were sent flying.
Pa, pa, pa, pa! The four of them were thrown all over the ground, all of them pale.
They were all terrified. Were they going to die here?
“If you dare make another move, I will crush this Evolution Fruit!” The green-robed man was very resolute. He gripped the Evolution Fruit in his hand, and threatened Shi Yuanzhen.
This was their only hope. Regardless of whether it was useful or not, they would try everything they could.
Shi Yuanzhen looked coldly at him. After a while, he said, “All right. You can put down the Evolution Fruit and get lost.”
“No, all four of us will leave!” the green-robed man said.
Shi Yuanzhen smiled, “Do you have four Evolution Fruits?”

The green-robed man was rendered speechless. He naturally didn’t have four Evolution Fruits. Such a good thing would naturally be eaten immediately after obtaining one. He didn’t plan to sell it for money, so what was the point of saving it?
“This was obtained by the four of us together, so we naturally have to trade it for the safety of four people,” he emphasized.
Shi Yuanzhen shrugged and said, “Fine, I’ll give you a chance. You can choose any person you want, and I’ll let them leave safely.”
How could the green-robed man make a decision like this?
He didn’t want his companion to die, nor did he want to die himself. What could he do?
When Shi Yuanzhen saw this, he couldn’t help but chuckle coldly. He was naturally doing this on purpose. He wanted to see the darkness of human nature.
Xiu, right at this moment, a figure appeared, as if he had appeared out of thin air. He was right next to the green-robed man, and stretched out a hand, snatching the Evolution Fruit.
No one had expected this scene, and they were all extremely dumbfounded.
What was going on?
Who are you?
Ling Han smiled faintly, and said, “The palm of your hand and the back of your hand are both flesh, so it’s hard to make a decision, right? Fine, I’ll help you.”
Yi, don’t be so familiar. We don’t even know each other.
The green-robed man was dumbfounded, and did not know how to answer at this moment.
Meanwhile, Shi Yuanzhen showed a hint of killing intent, and asked balefully, “Who are you?”
“Me?” Ling Han smiled faintly, and said, “We’re already old friends. Your words truly make me sad.”
Old friends?

Shi Yuanzhen looked at Ling Han, yet could not recognize him no matter how hard he tried. He said calmly, “All right. Bring the Evolution Fruit over, and I can consider whether I should befriend you or not.”
The Evolution Fruit changed hands, and he naturally had no intention of paying any more attention to the green-robed man. In his eyes, this was already a dead man.
Ling Han smiled faintly, and walked towards Shi Yuanzhen.
Meanwhile, the green-robed man and the others were trembling in fear. Their lives were no longer in their hands.
“Here.” Ling Han stretched out his right hand, and the Evolution Fruit was presently held in his hand.

Shi Yuanzhen also stretched out his hand, but it was not to grab at the Evolution Fruit. Instead, it was to grab at Ling Han’s neck. His fingers instantly turned black, as if they had become refined metal.
It was as if Ling Han hadn’t seen him, and he didn’t dodge or evade.
F***, was this guy an idiot?

The green-robed man and the others were all in despair. At first, they had still held onto a sliver of hope, but even if your strength is higher than the heavens, would you still be able to turn the situation around with someone holding onto your neck?
Meanwhile, Shi Yuanzhen’s expression was cold. Was this really an idiot?
His hand had already made contact, but with a zi, flashes of lightning flickered. He felt his right hand go numb, and involuntarily, bounced back.
‘So powerful!’
Shi Yuanzhen immediately looked wary. This person was not really stupid, but was extremely strong, and that was why he dared to take such a risk.
“Who exactly are you?” he asked again.
“Sigh, I already said we were old friends. You are really too heartless.” Ling Han shook his
head.
Shi Yuanzhen gave a soft exclamation, and directly launched an attack.
Ling Han laughed loudly, and brandished his fists to greet the incoming attack.
Peng!
It was only a single strike, and Shi Yuanzhen was sent flying. He was completely unqualified
to match Ling Han.
“Ling Han!” He finally recognized him.
In the past, he had been sent flying by this punch. Although Ling Han’s identity at the time was the Buddha Son of West Heavenly Realm, after the truth was revealed, he naturally
understood.
Ling Han cracked a smile, “That’s right, it’s your Grandpa Ling.”
“Damn it!” Shi Yuanzhen roared loudly, burning his Imperial Blood at the first instant.
He was extremely decisive, because he knew that he was no match for Ling Han. If he did not use his trump card, that would only be courting death.

His power was originally around 16 Heavens, and now, it had suddenly leaped to 25 Heavens. The improvement could be considered extremely shocking, and if he used Imperial Techniques, his maximum battle prowess would soar directly to 34 Heavens. Unfortunately, Ling Han’s battle prowess was also 34 Heavens, so he was still unable to gain
the upper hand.
Hong! Hong! Hong!

The two of them battled fiercely, both of them going all out. One after another, shockwaves blasted out, forcing the green-robed man and the others to retreat repeatedly. How could they possibly dare to stay where they were? That would only be suicidal.
The Imperial Son was indeed difficult to deal with.

Ling Han thought internally. Not only could he burn his Imperial Blood to increase his battle prowess, he also had the protection of Great Emperor-level precious treasures, so he was unafraid of any adverse effects. With this turn of events, the difference in battle prowess was at least a dozen over Heavens.
Otherwise, would it be so difficult for him to kill someone of the same cultivation level?
But even so, Shi Yuanzhen was still in imminent danger, because his Imperial Blood could not
burn for too long.
-After all, the Imperial Blood required a Saint to release his own blood essence to quickly
replenish it. That was precious blood that was equivalent to Saintly medicine, and even a
Saint could not afford such extravagance.
Thus, Shi Yuanzhen could only last for about thirty minutes.
He knew very well. Thus, after only a few fierce exchanges, he began to break out of the siege.
He wanted to flee?
Ling Han beckoned with his hand, and an Earth Dragon immediately shot out of the ground, attacking Shi Yuanzhen.
“Get lost!” Shi Yuanzhen brandished his Spirit Tool and attacked. At this moment, his battle prowess reached 34 Heavens, and the Earth Dragon was no match for him at all. It was easily
shattered.
But in this way, his course of retreat was also hindered.
Helpless, Shi Yuanzhen could only continue to battle Ling Han.
In just a few moves, he wanted to flee again, but was once again blocked by the Earth Dragon.
Boom!

He defeated the Earth Dragon, and faced with Ling Han’s fist, he chose to ignore it. -Even if he had to take this punch in exchange for time for him to escape, he had the Substitution Seal anyways, so no matter how terrible it was, he wouldn’t die.
When Ling Han saw this, he couldn’t help but chuckle coldly.
He was truly seeking death.
Fine, I’ll oblige you.
Boom, the iron fist blasted out madly, blazing with energy.
Peng!
Shi Yuanzhen’s attack landed, and he immediately looked terrified. He discovered that his
mind was crumbling!
How was this possible?

The Evolution Fruit changed hands, and he naturally had no intention of paying any more attention to the green-robed man.
In his eyes, this was already a dead man.
Ling Han smiled faintly, and walked towards Shi Yuanzhen.
Meanwhile, the green-robed man and the others were trembling in fear.
Their lives were no longer in their hands.
“Here.” Ling Han stretched out his right hand, and the Evolution Fruit was presently held in his hand.
Shi Yuanzhen also stretched out his hand, but it was not to grab at the Evolution Fruit.
Instead, it was to grab at Ling Han’s neck.
His fingers instantly turned black, as if they had become refined metal.
It was as if Ling Han hadn’t seen him, and he didn’t dodge or evade.
F***, was this guy an idiot?
The green-robed man and the others were all in despair.
At first, they had still held onto a sliver of hope, but even if your strength is higher than the heavens, would you still be able to turn the situation around with someone holding onto your neck?
Meanwhile, Shi Yuanzhen’s expression was cold.
Was this really an idiot?
His hand had already made contact, but with a zi, flashes of lightning flickered.
He felt his right hand go numb, and involuntarily, bounced back.
‘So powerful!’
Shi Yuanzhen immediately looked wary.
This person was not really stupid, but was extremely strong, and that was why he dared to take such a risk.
“Who exactly are you?” he asked again.
“Sigh, I already said we were old friends.
You are really too heartless.” Ling Han shook his
head.
Shi Yuanzhen gave a soft exclamation, and directly launched an attack.
Ling Han laughed loudly, and brandished his fists to greet the incoming attack.
Peng!
It was only a single strike, and Shi Yuanzhen was sent flying.
He was completely unqualified
to match Ling Han.
“Ling Han!” He finally recognized him.
In the past, he had been sent flying by this punch.
Although Ling Han’s identity at the time was the Buddha Son of West Heavenly Realm, after the truth was revealed, he naturally
understood.
Ling Han cracked a smile, “That’s right, it’s your Grandpa Ling.”
“Damn it!” Shi Yuanzhen roared loudly, burning his Imperial Blood at the first instant.
He was extremely decisive, because he knew that he was no match for Ling Han.
If he did not use his trump card, that would only be courting death.
His power was originally around 16 Heavens, and now, it had suddenly leaped to 25 Heavens.
The improvement could be considered extremely shocking, and if he used Imperial Techniques, his maximum battle prowess would soar directly to 34 Heavens.
Unfortunately, Ling Han’s battle prowess was also 34 Heavens, so he was still unable to gain
the upper hand.
Hong!
Hong!
Hong!
The two of them battled fiercely, both of them going all out.
One after another, shockwaves blasted out, forcing the green-robed man and the others to retreat repeatedly.
How could they possibly dare to stay where they were?
That would only be suicidal.
The Imperial Son was indeed difficult to deal with.
Ling Han thought internally.
Not only could he burn his Imperial Blood to increase his battle prowess, he also had the protection of Great Emperor-level precious treasures, so he was unafraid of any adverse effects.
With this turn of events, the difference in battle prowess was at least a dozen over Heavens.
Otherwise, would it be so difficult for him to kill someone of the same cultivation level?
But even so, Shi Yuanzhen was still in imminent danger, because his Imperial Blood could not
burn for too long.
-After all, the Imperial Blood required a Saint to release his own blood essence to quickly
replenish it.
That was precious blood that was equivalent to Saintly medicine, and even a
Saint could not afford such extravagance.
Thus, Shi Yuanzhen could only last for about thirty minutes.
He knew very well.
Thus, after only a few fierce exchanges, he began to break out of the siege.
He wanted to flee?
Ling Han beckoned with his hand, and an Earth Dragon immediately shot out of the ground, attacking Shi Yuanzhen.
“Get lost!” Shi Yuanzhen brandished his Spirit Tool and attacked.
At this moment, his battle prowess reached 34 Heavens, and the Earth Dragon was no match for him at all.
It was easily
shattered.
But in this way, his course of retreat was also hindered.
Helpless, Shi Yuanzhen could only continue to battle Ling Han.
In just a few moves, he wanted to flee again, but was once again blocked by the Earth Dragon.
Boom!

He defeated the Earth Dragon, and faced with Ling Han’s fist, he chose to ignore it. -Even if he had to take this punch in exchange for time for him to escape, he had the Substitution Seal anyways, so no matter how terrible it was, he wouldn’t die.
When Ling Han saw this, he couldn’t help but chuckle coldly.
He was truly seeking death.
Fine, I’ll oblige you.
Boom, the iron fist blasted out madly, blazing with energy.
Peng!
Shi Yuanzhen’s attack landed, and he immediately looked terrified.
He discovered that his
mind was crumbling!
How was this possible?

chapters.title: Chapter 4245: Another Kill
paragraphs: It was not that Shi Yuanzhen had not “died” before. It was all the Substitution Seal that had taken effect, saving him from this calamity.
Thus, he clearly knew what kind of process this was.
But this time was different. His mind was really crumbling.
Not good, he was done for!
How was this possible?
He had the Substitution Seal.
Could it be that it was the Saint of the clan that was screwing him over?
Boom! The destructive power swept over him, and he no longer had the ability to think. He was completely dead.
Ling Han waited slightly, but did not discover that Shi Yuanzhen had “revived” - in truth, his head had already exploded, so how could he possibly come back to life?
As expected, the Destructive Energy possessed the ability to kill, rendering even Substitution Seal useless.
“Thank you.” At this moment, the green-robed man and the others all walked over, expressing their gratitude towards Ling Han.
Ling Han nodded, “I did it casually.”

“It was a casual action on your part, sir, but to us, it is a debt of gratitude for saving our lives.” The green-robed man seemed to have the highest status, and it was he who answered all the questions.
Ling Han merely smiled. If you guys want to be grateful, then be grateful.
Yi?
He discovered that these four people were all staring at him. More precisely, they were staring at the Evolution Fruit in his hand.
“Do you guys want me to return this thing to you?” he asked with a smile.

“That would naturally be good.” The green-robed man swallowed, and seemed to feel that this was inappropriate to say. The other had just saved their lives, so he hurriedly added, “Of course, if Benefactor needs it, you can take it as you like.”
“Alright, then I won’t be reserved.” Ling Han put the Evolution Fruit away.
Yi, are you not going to be reserved?

The green-robed man had planned it out very well. As long as Ling Han was the slightest bit polite, he would take back the Evolution Fruit. After all, the Evolution Fruit was too valuable, but it could help them advance into the Fifth Form. This meant that they would have a chance to become great Sect Master elites.
But Ling Han was really too unreserved. He directly put away the Evolution Fruit, leaving him completely at a loss for words.
Ling Han chuckled. Playing tricks in front of him? How naive.
He activated the Star Steps, and xiu, he instantly disappeared from sight.
“Sigh!” The four young people all sighed. They had finally found an Evolution Fruit after much difficulty, and it was gone just like that.
“Let’s just search again. In any case, there’s still a long time.”
“En!”
They all nodded. Just as they were about to leave, weng, a terrifying aura assaulted them, making them feel a little suffocated.
A figure appeared, his aura astonishing. However, his forehead was too protruding, like a bird’s beak.
“Puchi!” The red-clothed woman instantly laughed, but when she realized that this was not good, she hurriedly covered her mouth with her hand again.
Baili Yun looked towards that woman, a cold light interwoven in his eyes.

The red-clothed woman only felt a pain in her mind, and then fell down loudly. “Junior Sister!” The green-robed man and the others hurriedly went to help her up, yet shockingly discovered that the red-clothed woman’s vitality had completely disappeared. “You, you, you, were you the one who did it?” The three of them all looked angrily at Baili
Yun.

“A mere ant dares to shout in front of me?” Baili Yun humphed, his eyes sharp, and killing intent surged. Peng, peng, peng! The green-robed man and the others all fell to the ground, unable to stand back up.
He looked at Shi Yuanzhen’s corpse not far away, and couldn’t help but frown slightly. “This is the Imperial Son of the Shi Clan, right? I’ve seen him once, and I remember his aura.”
“Hehe, this Ling Han is really outrageously bold. He even dares to kill an Imperial Son!”
“If I kill this despicable brat, not only will I be able to obtain the treasures on him, I will also be able to ask for a favor from the Shi Clan. Hehe, killing two birds with one stone.”
“Yi?”
He examined Shi Yuanzhen’s corpse, and his expression instantly became solemn.
“The Substitution Seal is still here.”
“How is this possible!”
He was stunned. The Substitution Seal had not cracked yet, which meant that he had not expended all his uses of the Substitution Seal. Then, how had Shi Yuanzhen died?

After a long while, he finally murmured, “I heard the Saints of my clan coincidentally mention that the Substitution Seal is indeed not perfect. As long as the strength of the person who made it is above that of the Saint that created the Substitution Seal, then the Substitution Seal would not be effective.”
“The Substitution Seal is equivalent to a Saint moving to save someone’s life. However, if the opponent’s strength surpasses the Saint’s, it’s naturally impossible to save them.”
“The question is, how could that brat, Ling Han, possibly possess strength that surpasses Saints?”
“Could it be... that he has grasped some kind of super technique, and in terms of quality, it has even surpassed Saint-level?”
“Could it be that this is the secret to that brat’s rise in power?”
“That’s right. If he had not grasped Emperor-level techniques, how could he have surpassed
an Imperial Son?”
Thinking of this, he was naturally even more tempted. If he could capture Ling Han, his gains could possibly exceed his imagination.
Baili Yun’s heart burned with desire. He took out a copper coin and tossed it over. After predicting the direction of Ling Han’s whereabouts, he immediately set off in pursuit.
Ling Han naturally would not know what had happened after he had left, and would not have foreseen that Baili Yun would be so deranged, to make a move on someone unrelated to him.
-To the Imperial Clan, the others were only ants. If they were trampled to death, so be it. What need was there for them to be concerned?
He took out the Evolution Fruit, washed it slightly, and began to eat.
This was a familiar taste, and it was just as delicious.
After eating this Evolution Fruit and refining the medicinal effects, Ling Han’s sixth clay fetus
also successfully evolved to Stone Fetus.
“I’m still short of three Evolution Fruits.”
Ling Han shuttled back and forth on the Island of the Sky, searching everywhere for the
Evolution Fruit.
Time slowly passed, and Baili Yun caught up to him a few more times. However, since he had
grasped the Star Steps, he was naturally unscathed. In fact, he even gave Baili Yun a few surprises, causing him to break out in a cold sweat.
Baili Yun knew that Ling Han possessed a technique that rendered the Substitution Seal ineffective. As long as he was killed once, he would really be done for.

One fruit, two fruits, three fruits... The Island of the Sky was massive, and there were also a considerable number of Evolution Fruits. However, the majority of them grew in the harsh mountains and rivers, and there was a natural barrier formed by Regulations. If one wanted to cross this barrier, they would have to pay an exorbitant price.

However, this was no big deal for Ling Han. He had grasped the Star Steps, and as long as there were ley lines nearby, he could easily reach them. What barrier? In his eyes, they were completely non-existent.

This naturally allowed him to reap a great harvest - when others sought out the Evolution Fruit, obtaining one would be considered lucky. Furthermore, it was not to be used to increase one’s cultivation level, because there were other means to increase one’s cultivation level, but if one wanted to break through the limit and create the fifth form, unless one himself was incredibly freakish, he could only depend on the Evolution Fruit.
But what about Ling Han? Of course, it was the other way around.
The seventh Stone Fetus, the eighth Stone Fetus... done!
After Ling Han had entered the Island of the Sky for a year, his cultivation level was already
close to the limit of the second form. He was only left with one last clay fetus that had not
completed its evolution.
“I’m still short of one Evolution Fruit,” Ling Han murmured. With another Evolution Fruit, he would be able to complete cultivating the second form and begin breaking through to the
third form.

In order not to let Baili Yun discover any clues, Ling Han had even suppressed the urge to ambush him these days. This was to prevent Baili Yun from sensing that he was about to advance into the Third Form, realize there would be a change in the comparison of strength between them, and choose to no longer pursue him.
“At that time, it would be my turn to become the hunter,” he smiled faintly.

chapters.title: Chapter 4246: Natural-born Stone Spirit
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
A whole year had passed since the Island of the Sky had opened.
How many people had entered this time?
Many, many people.
Thus, there would definitely be Evolution Fruits on the island, but there definitely wouldn’t be many. The difficulty of finding them would naturally increase continuously.
Even if Ling Han had mastered the ley lines and the chances of him finding Evolution Fruit was a hundred times more likely than others, his gains were still negligible.
“F*ck, I’m only missing one Evolution Fruit. Is it that difficult?”
Ling Han sighed. In his mind, the ninth clay fetus was only one third away from completely evolving into Stone Fetus, but at this moment, he couldn’t find the Evolution Fruit no matter what.
“If I cultivate on my own, I’ll need at least half a year!”
He lacked cultivation resources. Even if he had his own alchemical pills, he still needed half a year’s time.
Too long, it was really too long.
“No, I definitely have to get another Evolution Fruit.”

Ling Han sat down in a cross-legged position, and continued to communicate with the ley lines. Previously, he had discovered that there was a dangerous place on the Island of the Sky. The power of Regulation was extremely powerful. Even with the help of the ley lines, he did not dare to touch it, fearing that he would suffer a backlash.
But now, he planned to give it a try.

He only needed one Evolution Fruit, and he would be able to reach the end of the second form. Then, he would be able to break through to the third form, and possess the strength to beat up Baili Yun. He could not resist this kind of temptation.
He released his divine sense to communicate with the ley lines, probing into the place that he hadn’t dared to touch before.
“This!”
He was suddenly shocked, because he had touched an incredibly vast and mighty aura, indescribably strong.
What was this?
A precious tool? An elite?
At this moment, Ling Han couldn’t confirm it. This aura was extremely obscure. Furthermore, he didn’t dare to get too close, as he didn’t know what consequences it would cause.
However, under his continuous probing, this ball of aura did not have any reaction.
Treasure?

Ling Han thought. The Regulations of the highest level intertwined here, giving birth to treasures like the Evolution Fruit. However, the Evolution Fruit was only at the True Self Tier, and no matter how awesome it was, this fact couldn’t be changed.
Wasn’t this overkill?
His heart throbbed wildly. Had he discovered the biggest secret of the Island of the Sky?
As an extremely curious person, Ling Han immediately decided that he was going to explore.
“Let’s go.”
He immediately moved out, using the ley lines to traverse. After a long time, he finally approached the place.
Ahead of him was where a powerful aura was spreading out.
Ling Han stopped. Though he had already made up his mind, that aura was too strong. He had to be careful. Otherwise, it might be that he could not obtain the treasure, and could even lose his life.
He was now underground, and wrapped in the power of Regulation, he was like a fish swimming in water. The ground was completely unable to stop him.
However, at present, he could only use his divine sense to sense ahead through the ley lines, while the naked eye was completely useless.
He carefully advanced. If he discovered anything off, he would immediately use the ley lines to escape.
Weng, ahead of him, a terrifying aura surged out, like boiling water.
He couldn’t pass. Ling Han shook his head. This terrifying aura could easily shatter him.
‘Hmm?’
With a thought from Ling Han, the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower instantly floated above his head, sending down streaks of Primal Chaos Qi.
Although this wasn’t an Imperial Weapon, the Origin Gold was the highest level material in the world.
Could it withstand this aura?

Ling Han took a slight step forwards, and a terrifying aura surged out, as if it wanted to destroy the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower. However, the Origin Gold was the ultimate material. Previously, the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower was unafraid of even the Imperial Weapon, and wanted to clash with it, what more now?
The Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower also released a powerful aura to resist this oncoming surge of aura.
Ling Han advanced step by step, penetrating deeply into this aura.
After walking for a long time, yi, the path ahead suddenly opened up.
He had actually entered into a cave.
Da, da, da! Drops of water dripped down from above, landing on the ground. In this dead silent space, there was actually a soul-stirring feeling.
Ling Han headed deeper into the cave. He had a feeling that he was about to discover some incredible treasure.

As he walked, his speed wasn’t fast. There was a terrifying aura surging here, and although the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower could resist it, Ling Han was like an ordinary person walking in a swamp. Every step was extremely difficult.
After spending close to an hour, he finally arrived at the end of the cave.
Ahead of them, a human figure had appeared.
What? The source of this terrifying aura... was actually a person!
Ling Han couldn’t help but feel extremely disappointed. He was hoping to obtain a precious treasure.
But now?
Furthermore, if it was a human, it meant that this was an elite slumbering here. Wasn’t he going to get into trouble trouble by disturbing the elite like this?
Taking advantage of the fact that the other party was still sleeping, he had to flee quickly.

Ling Han believed that the Saint was definitely in a state of deep slumber. Otherwise, this wisp of aura wouldn’t have been so obscure and calm. It wasn’t like he hadn’t seen a Saint at close quarters before. The surge of his aura was truly terrifying.
He was just about to turn around and leave, but when he used his eye technique, he was surprised.
This was not a real person, but rather a rock. However, its shape was very human-like.
“This is... Natural-born Stone Spirit!”

Ling Han’s heart beat fiercely. Natural-born Stone Spirit was the ultimate material comparable to the Origin Gold! However, no one would forge Natural-born Stone Spirit into a Spirit Tool. Instead, they would forge a doppelganger with it, and that was comparable to an Imperial Weapon!

If he obtained it, he would be rich. As long as he reached the Spirit Transformation Tier, he would be able to manifest a doppelganger and insert it into this Natural-born Stone Spirit, and his battle prowess would be able to... hehe, there should be no problem for him to defeat Venerate Tiers.

And as his cultivation level increased, the more he could unleash the might of the Natural-born Stone Spirit, just like the Origin Gold, which could be refined into an Imperial Weapon, killing Saints would be as easy as slaughtering chickens.
I’m rich! I’m rich!
Ling Han carefully advanced. The problem now was how to retrieve this Natural-born Stone Spirit.
Could this be stored into a Spatial Spirit Tool? It didn’t seem like it could, as it was a something born of nature.

He definitely couldn’t bring it with him. He had to rely on the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower to resist the aura emitted by the Natural-born Stone Spirit. Otherwise, he would be crushed into a bloody mush at any moment, but if he carried this thing around everywhere... he would soon be targeted by Saints.

This was Natural-born Stone Spirit. All the elites in the world would be tempted, and Saints would also surge out madly. If this was refined into a doppelganger, it would be equivalent to possessing a body on the level of Origin Gold. Furthermore, it was close to Dao, so battle prowess would definitely surpass Saint Tier.
Then he could only break through to Spiritual Transformation Tier here.
However, there were only two years left. Would that be enough?
Ling Han thought as he walked forwards, slowly approaching this Natural-born Stone Spirit. When he was close enough, he couldn’t help but gape.
These were the words that he did not curse out loud.

He had been happy for nothing for so long. That was because he could see clearly now that he was so close. This Natural-born Stone Spirit was only an empty shell, but its insides had already been hollowed out.
Who would be so reckless?
Ling Han almost wanted to pummel that person. This was a massive waste.
That’s not right!
He immediately discovered that the inside of this Natural-born Stone Spirit was extremely clean, without the slightest sign of being carved.

If this was a normal rock, any cultivator would be able to easily do so. However, this was different. This was Natural-born Stone Spirit, and it was comparable to Origin Gold. Was it really so fragile and tender?
“Hiss, could it be that the Natural-born Stone Spirit has developed a willpower of its own, and has come into being?” Ling Han thought of a possibility, and couldn’t help but inhale sharply.

Is it that difficult?”
Ling Han sighed.
In his mind, the ninth clay fetus was only one third away from completely evolving into Stone Fetus, but at this moment, he couldn’t find the Evolution Fruit no matter what.
“If I cultivate on my own, I’ll need at least half a year!”
He lacked cultivation resources.
Even if he had his own alchemical pills, he still needed half a year’s time.
Too long, it was really too long.
“No, I definitely have to get another Evolution Fruit.”
Ling Han sat down in a cross-legged position, and continued to communicate with the ley lines.
Previously, he had discovered that there was a dangerous place on the Island of the Sky.
The power of Regulation was extremely powerful.
Even with the help of the ley lines, he did not dare to touch it, fearing that he would suffer a backlash.
But now, he planned to give it a try.
He only needed one Evolution Fruit, and he would be able to reach the end of the second form.
Then, he would be able to break through to the third form, and possess the strength to beat up Baili Yun.
He could not resist this kind of temptation.
He released his divine sense to communicate with the ley lines, probing into the place that he hadn’t dared to touch before.
“This!”
He was suddenly shocked, because he had touched an incredibly vast and mighty aura, indescribably strong.
What was this?
A precious tool?
An elite?
At this moment, Ling Han couldn’t confirm it.
This aura was extremely obscure.
Furthermore, he didn’t dare to get too close, as he didn’t know what consequences it would cause.
However, under his continuous probing, this ball of aura did not have any reaction.
Treasure?
Ling Han thought.
The Regulations of the highest level intertwined here, giving birth to treasures like the Evolution Fruit.
However, the Evolution Fruit was only at the True Self Tier, and no matter how awesome it was, this fact couldn’t be changed.
Wasn’t this overkill?
His heart throbbed wildly.
Had he discovered the biggest secret of the Island of the Sky?
As an extremely curious person, Ling Han immediately decided that he was going to explore.
“Let’s go.”
He immediately moved out, using the ley lines to traverse.
After a long time, he finally approached the place.
Ahead of him was where a powerful aura was spreading out.
Ling Han stopped.
Though he had already made up his mind, that aura was too strong.
He had to be careful.
Otherwise, it might be that he could not obtain the treasure, and could even lose his life.
He was now underground, and wrapped in the power of Regulation, he was like a fish swimming in water.
The ground was completely unable to stop him.
However, at present, he could only use his divine sense to sense ahead through the ley lines, while the naked eye was completely useless.
He carefully advanced.
If he discovered anything off, he would immediately use the ley lines to escape.
Weng, ahead of him, a terrifying aura surged out, like boiling water.
He couldn’t pass.
Ling Han shook his head.
This terrifying aura could easily shatter him.
‘Hmm?’
With a thought from Ling Han, the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower instantly floated above his head, sending down streaks of Primal Chaos Qi.
Although this wasn’t an Imperial Weapon, the Origin Gold was the highest level material in the world.
Could it withstand this aura?
Ling Han took a slight step forwards, and a terrifying aura surged out, as if it wanted to destroy the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower.
However, the Origin Gold was the ultimate material.
Previously, the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower was unafraid of even the Imperial Weapon, and wanted to clash with it, what more now?
The Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower also released a powerful aura to resist this oncoming surge of aura.
Ling Han advanced step by step, penetrating deeply into this aura.
After walking for a long time, yi, the path ahead suddenly opened up.
He had actually entered into a cave.
Da, da, da!
Drops of water dripped down from above, landing on the ground.
In this dead silent space, there was actually a soul-stirring feeling.
Ling Han headed deeper into the cave.
He had a feeling that he was about to discover some incredible treasure.
As he walked, his speed wasn’t fast.
There was a terrifying aura surging here, and although the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower could resist it, Ling Han was like an ordinary person walking in a swamp.
Every step was extremely difficult.
After spending close to an hour, he finally arrived at the end of the cave.
Ahead of them, a human figure had appeared.
What?
The source of this terrifying aura... was actually a person!
Ling Han couldn’t help but feel extremely disappointed.
He was hoping to obtain a precious treasure.
But now?
Furthermore, if it was a human, it meant that this was an elite slumbering here.
Wasn’t he going to get into trouble trouble by disturbing the elite like this?
Taking advantage of the fact that the other party was still sleeping, he had to flee quickly.
Ling Han believed that the Saint was definitely in a state of deep slumber.
Otherwise, this wisp of aura wouldn’t have been so obscure and calm.
It wasn’t like he hadn’t seen a Saint at close quarters before.
The surge of his aura was truly terrifying.
He was just about to turn around and leave, but when he used his eye technique, he was surprised.
This was not a real person, but rather a rock.
However, its shape was very human-like.
“This is...
Natural-born Stone Spirit!”
Ling Han’s heart beat fiercely.
Natural-born Stone Spirit was the ultimate material comparable to the Origin Gold!
However, no one would forge Natural-born Stone Spirit into a Spirit Tool.
Instead, they would forge a doppelganger with it, and that was comparable to an Imperial Weapon!
If he obtained it, he would be rich.

As long as he reached the Spirit Transformation Tier, he would be able to manifest a doppelganger and insert it into this Natural-born Stone Spirit, and his battle prowess would be able to... hehe, there should be no problem for him to defeat Venerate Tiers.

And as his cultivation level increased, the more he could unleash the might of the Natural-born Stone Spirit, just like the Origin Gold, which could be refined into an Imperial Weapon, killing Saints would be as easy as slaughtering chickens.
I’m rich!
I’m rich!
Ling Han carefully advanced.
The problem now was how to retrieve this Natural-born Stone Spirit.
Could this be stored into a Spatial Spirit Tool?
It didn’t seem like it could, as it was a something born of nature.
He definitely couldn’t bring it with him.
He had to rely on the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower to resist the aura emitted by the Natural-born Stone Spirit.
Otherwise, he would be crushed into a bloody mush at any moment, but if he carried this thing around everywhere... he would soon be targeted by Saints.
This was Natural-born Stone Spirit.
All the elites in the world would be tempted, and Saints would also surge out madly.
If this was refined into a doppelganger, it would be equivalent to possessing a body on the level of Origin Gold.
Furthermore, it was close to Dao, so battle prowess would definitely surpass Saint Tier.
Then he could only break through to Spiritual Transformation Tier here.
However, there were only two years left.
Would that be enough?
Ling Han thought as he walked forwards, slowly approaching this Natural-born Stone Spirit.
When he was close enough, he couldn’t help but gape.
These were the words that he did not curse out loud.
He had been happy for nothing for so long.
That was because he could see clearly now that he was so close.
This Natural-born Stone Spirit was only an empty shell, but its insides had already been hollowed out.
Who would be so reckless?
Ling Han almost wanted to pummel that person.
This was a massive waste.
That’s not right!
He immediately discovered that the inside of this Natural-born Stone Spirit was extremely clean, without the slightest sign of being carved.
If this was a normal rock, any cultivator would be able to easily do so.
However, this was different.
This was Natural-born Stone Spirit, and it was comparable to Origin Gold.
Was it really so fragile and tender?
“Hiss, could it be that the Natural-born Stone Spirit has developed a willpower of its own, and has come into being?” Ling Han thought of a possibility, and couldn’t help but inhale sharply.

chapters.title: Chapter 4247: Ge Qianqiu
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
Everything in the world could develop consciousness.

The simplest example was Ancestral King Pan Shi. This ruler of heaven and earth was only a stubborn rock at the very beginning, yet unexpectedly developed consciousness, advancing step by step to become the strongest, suppressing an era.

And in the case of the Natural-born Stone Spirit, it was already standing at the pinnacle of the world from the very beginning. It was an ultimate material comparable to Origin Gold, so how awesome was it?
Once this kind of treasure developed consciousness, its starting point would be Saint Tier.

In history, there had indeed been examples of Natural-born Stone Spirit being intelligent and traveling the world. They were countless times more powerful than ordinary Saints, and could be called Pseudo-Emperors!

In an era when there was no Emperor in the world, if the Natural-born Stone Spirit was to commit evil, the world would be in chaos, and if they were to commit good, the world would be peaceful. Of course, if there was a Great Emperor in the world, then the Natural-born Stone Spirit could only be said to be born at the wrong time. No matter how awesome the Pseudo-Emperor was, it could not possibly match the Great Emperor.
However, though the Natural-born Stone Spirit was so awesome, there had never been any precedent of becoming Emperor.

—The most ordinary people in the world could attain Dao, and even a rock could attain Dao, but the Natural-born Stone Spirit, who had stood at the pinnacle of the world from the very beginning, could not. One could not help but sigh at the wonders of creation of the heavens.
Perhaps, without experiencing the process of advancing from ordinary to the pinnacle, one would not be able to break through to that highest position.
He ignored this for the moment. The problem was, if this Natural-born Stone Spirit really developed consciousness, then it would be a Pseudo-Emperor!
How awesome was a Pseudo-Emperor?
Just think of Buddha Doga. He had practically killed all the Saints in the world.
Ling Han instantly had the thought of leaving. It was not appropriate to stay here for too long. Who knew if that Natural-born Stone Spirit had just developed consciousness, and was still here.
Hold on.
He looked at the outer shell of the Natural-born Stone Spirit that had been shed. Although it no longer had the Stone Spirit, this outer shell should still be quite extraordinary.
‘I’ll take it!’
Ling Han walked forwards, planning to collect this. Even if it was inferior to the ultimate ingredients, it was still indescribably precious.
Since he had entered into a mountain of treasure, how could he return empty-handed?
“Sigh!” A sigh suddenly rang out, and reverberated lightly by Ling Han’s ear.
This voice was very soft, but Ling Han’s hair stood on end.
F***, whatever he feared would come true!

He slowly turned around, and saw that an old man had appeared behind him at some point in time. He was a little too ordinary, and belonged to the category that could be found in large numbers on the streets, but how could such an old grandpa possibly appear here?
“Senior, sorry for disturbing you!” Ling Han said solemnly. At the same time, he was prepared to use the ley lines to escape at any time.

“Young man, don’t be nervous. This old man won’t eat you.” The old man coughed, and even his body was trembling. He was like a dying candle in the wind, and it was possible that his flame of life would be extinguished at any moment.
Ling Han bared his teeth in a grin, but his heart was beating like a drum. As if he would believe him.
He wasn’t sure where this old man came from. Could it be that he had come for the Natural-born Stone Spirit?
“How should I address Senior?” he asked.
The old man couldn’t help but laugh, “You’re trying to dig out my bottom line? Heh, whatever, my surname is Ge, and my given name is Qianqiu.”
“Good name, your merit will last to benefit generations, senior is generous.” Ling Han immediately bootlicked1.
Ge Qianqiu laughed loudly, but as if his injuries were affected or something, he coughed again, “Young man, you really have a sweet tongue. All right, come and tell me, what time is it now?”
Yi, it can’t be that you have been staying here all this while, so you don’t know what year this is, right?
A thought flashed in Ling Han’s head, and he said, “Senior, there is no uniform chronological method in the universe, so I don’t know how to describe it either.”
“Hehe, that’s right.” Ge Qianqiu slapped his forehead, and said with a smile, “Look at this old man, I’ve really become senile. Then, what’s the name of the latest Ancestral King?”

“I don’t know.” Ling Han shook his head, and seeing the puzzled look on Ge Qianqiu’s face, he hurriedly said, “Ten million years ago, it is suspected that an Ancestral King ascended Dao, but a great turmoil happened, and history was erased. Thus, even the origins of that Ancestral King are unknown to anyone.”
Ge Qianqiu couldn’t help but show a hint of anger in his expression, and even humphed heavily, “Those old b@stards, as expected, are still not willing to behave themselves!”
A thought flashed in Ling Han’s head. It seemed like this Uncle Ge knew the inside story!
He was extremely curious, and couldn’t help but ask, “Senior, do you know the reason for this unrest?”
“Brat, have you always been so curious?” Ge Qianqiu asked with a smile.

“I saw Senior’s friendliness, so I mustered up the courage to ask a few more questions,” Ling Han said. When he wanted to anger someone, he could drive them crazy, but when he was sweet-talking, he could also make people happy.
Ge Qianqiu laughed, “You are too weak now, and there are some things that are not suitable for you to know. It would only be detrimental to you.”
To be able to say such words, it meant that the old man should be a reasonable person.
Ling Han’s heart calmed slightly, and he mustered up the courage to ask, “Why is Senior here?”
“You actually want to ask, where did this Natural-born Stone Spirit go?” Ge Qianqiu countered.
Er... the older one was, the wiser they were.
Ling Han smiled, “As for that, I am indeed a little curious.”

Ge Qianqiu shook his head, “When this old man came here, the Natural-born Stone Spirit was already gone. I don’t know if it was because it had gained consciousness, or if it had been refined into a doppelganger by another.”

Ling Han was surprised. This old man should have been here for a very, very long time. Then, the Natural-born Stone Spirit should have disappeared a very, very long time ago. It was very likely tens of millions of years ago.
However, could the old man live for so long?

As if sensing Ling Han’s confusion, Ge Qianqiu said with a smile, “There is a mysterious thing called the Primordial Source Clay. If one is sealed within, the passing of life would be halted. Thus, after a long slumber, the world would have changed.”

Ling Han immediately thought of the little azure dragon. He was the youngest son of the True Dragon, and if he really counted, how old would he be? He should have long since turned into dust, but now, he was pretending to be young everywhere, living too vividly.
Obviously, the little azure dragon must have been sealed in the Primordial Source Clay all this while.

However, Ling Han didn’t understand. Wasn’t it good to live in the present? With his friends and family, wouldn’t it be too lonely to sleep for a long time and have no family or friends in the world after ten million years?
What reason was there for him to have to surpass such a long period of time?

Ge Qianqiu asked Ling Han a great many questions, such as whether the True Dragon Abyss had been opened, how the present world was, and whether there were Yin souls invading. His expression was always calm, but when he spoke of the countless corpses of Saints buried in that sea of blood, the old man looked furious, which was very frightening.
“Alright, you can leave now. I still have to sleep for a few more years.” The old man began to chase him off.
Just a few years?
Ling Han thought internally. The few years he was talking about was really a few years, but if this Uncle Ge was talking about a few years, could it be tens of thousands of years?
Forget it, let’s just leave first.

Since such an elite had already issued the command to leave, how could he possibly refuse? Though the old man looked quite good-tempered, what elite would not have words that had enormous weight, and allow others to bargain with them?
Ling Han was very tactful. After exiting the cave, he used the Star Steps and quickly left.

“So only ten million years have passed,” Ge Qianqiu murmured. “Xuan Taiyu, I lost to you ten million years ago. Logically, I should have died and disappeared with the wind, but the darkness desires to devour the heavens. This old man can only use this damaged body to battle with the heavens and with others. If I can attain Dao, I will avenge you, and our battles for so many years would not be in vain!”

chapters.title: Chapter 4248: The Third Form of True Self Tier!
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
Ling Han left, but on his way, he unexpectedly sensed the presence of the Evolution Fruit. He immediately changed course and stored the Evolution Fruit into his pocket.
He couldn’t help but grin. Although he didn’t obtain the Natural-born Stone Spirit, he obtained an Evolution Fruit, so he didn’t come for nothing.
Of course, compared to the Natural-born Stone Spirit, the Evolution Fruit could only be considered a minuscule gain. However, who asked the Natural-born Stone Spirit to be long gone?
Ling Han began to gnaw on the Evolution Fruit. With this one, he would be able to reach the end of the second form.
Come on then!
Very soon, the medicinal effects rolled out, helping to push the ninth clay fetus towards Stone Fetus.
Merely half a day later, he had succeeded.

Theoretically speaking, Ling Han was already qualified to break through to the third form. However, the majority of his Stone Fetusrd was stimulated by the medicinal effects, so it was inevitable that he would have a chronic illness of unstable foundations, which prevented him from immediately breaking through.

Ling Han settled down for a few days, then changed to another location. He then continued to settle down his cultivation level, so that his condition could reach its optimal state. At the same time, he also allowed Baili Yun to continue eating his dust behind him.
A month later, Ling Han finally felt that he had adjusted his condition to perfection.
That was enough.
He did not immediately attempt to break through to the Third Form, but rather waited, and waited for Baili Yun to catch up to him. Only then did he run 150,000 km in a single go.
—Previously, he had been at the very edge of the Island of the Sky, and now, he had run to the farthest end. Hehe, in this way, Baili Yun would need to spend a great many days to be able to find him.
Ling Han immediately began to attempt the third form. When Baili Yun caught up to him, he would give him a surprise.
The third form of the True Self Tier, Silver Fetus!

Ling Han continued to gain enlightenment. The True Self of Destruction was beginning to advance from the Stone Fetus to the Silver Fetus. The power of heaven and earth surged over, and the Regulations also converged, wrapping around him. His whole person turned into a jade statue.
He sat as still as a rock, but his whole person was undergoing an earthshaking change.
Not only was the Stone Fetus in his mind advancing towards the Silver Fetus, but his physical body was also greedily absorbing the power of heaven and earth, advancing in large strides in Body Art.
He had great ambitions. Since he cultivated both body and mystical power, he had to maintain the momentum of advancing both together. He definitely could not allow either of them to fall behind.
Three days later, there was a change in the Stone Fetus. There was an additional layer of metallic light.
A smile spread across Ling Han’s face. He had finally taken the first step.
This step was very small, but it was incredibly important. It meant that he could take large strides forwards from now on.
Boom, the speed at which the energy of heaven and earth surged in suddenly soared, and the Regulations intertwined to become brilliant.
The Stone Fetus’s rate of evolution also sped up. The True Self of Destruction emitted a vast aura, having the air of great dao.
Another seven days later, Ling Han leaped up. Peng, the energy wrapped around him, and shards of Regulations danced wildly.
In his mind, the True Self of Destruction had already turned into a silver fetus that was flickering with silver light.
The third form of the True Self Tier!
Boom!
Ling Han brandished his fists, and his power surged. It was indescribably powerful.
“Mystical power and Body Art have both reached 25 Heavens. With the two exploding at the same time, 31 Heavens!”

“If I go all out, my maximum battle prowess can reach 42 Heavens, and I myself can disperse attacks within six Heavens. Thus, even if I am fighting battle prowess of 48 Heavens, I can still be undefeated.”

“Unfortunately, the barrage of murderous aura and suppression of battle prowess won’t work on Imperial Sons, and with my current strength, I can already crush Dao Child and the like. These two Mystical Powers would seem useless.”
“However, when I step into the Spirit Transformation Tier these two Mystical Powers can still unleash their extraordinary might.”
“Baili Yun, are you ready?”
Ling Han closed his eyes, and activated his divine sense. He communicated with the ley lines, and began to capture Baili Yun’s whereabouts.
However, the other party was still far away from him, and for the moment, he had not discovered him.
Ling Han casually waved his hand. Boom! An Earth Dragon emerged from the ground, its might astonishing.
“The stronger my own strength is, the stronger the might of the Earth Dragon I summoned would be. This should have reached the battle prowess of forty Heavens.”
“Unfortunately, it has lost its agility. Otherwise, if it summoned a few more, even the Silver Generation would be killed!”
Ling Han strode forwards. He was going to find Baili Yun.
It was time for an accounting.

He used the Star Steps to travel in the opposite direction. With every section of the journey, he would use the ley lines as his eyes and ears, searching for Baili Yun’s whereabouts. However, this guy was like a lingering ghost that kept following him, but now, it was as if he had disappeared from the face of the earth.
Ling Han almost suspected that the other party knew that he had broken through, and had thus given up on pursuing him.

chapters.title: Chapter 4249: Hundred Flowers Valley
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
Yi?
Why had the battle ended? Why had Guan Yuanming’s head exploded?
This wasn’t right!
Where was the Substitution Seal? Did you f not bring the Substitution Seal with you when you f went out?
Was the Xuanfeng Imperial Clan that poor?
Everyone was dumbfounded. Why had Guan Yuanming died just like that? This was completely illogical.
However, the wind rustled, and Guan Yuanming simply lay there, blood gushing from his shattered head. He did not look at all like he would be standing up.
Hiss!
Everyone inhaled sharply, feeling their scalps go numb.
Something big had happened. An Imperial Son had actually been killed!

“Ling, Ling Han!” someone said in a trembling voice. This battle method was simple and violent, which was Ling Han’s usual style, and everyone already knew that Ling Han possessed the ability to disguise himself. Thus, even if the spiritual waves were different, it did not stop everyone from guessing.
Ling Han smiled faintly. With a thought, he had already reverted to his original appearance.
It was indeed him!
Everyone thought this in their hearts, and a stormy wave rose up.

If they were to believe that Guan Yuanming didn’t have a Substitution Seal, or that his Substitution Seal had lost its effect, that would be too ridiculous. As a noble and dignified Imperial Clan, how could it be that the Saints of the Imperial Clan would be stingy in creating Substitution Seals for the Imperial Son?
The Imperial Son. That was the image of an Imperial Clan, and needed to be fully protected.
Thus, there could only be one reason.
Ling Han possessed the ability to render the Substitution Seal ineffective.
That’s right. This was still unbelievable, but because Ling Han had already created enough miracles, relatively speaking, everyone was willing to believe the latter.
But when they thought about how Ling Han possessed the ability to kill people while ignoring the Substitution Seal, every Imperial Son felt apprehensive.
Initially, they were fearless. Even if they encountered a super great enemy, they still had the Substitution Seal that could save their lives, but now?
They only had one life.
“Brother-in-law!” The silver-haired little lolita ran out, then leaped, falling into Ling Han’s arms.
Ling Han had no choice, and could only stretch out his arms to embrace the little loli.
“Brother-in-law, why do you have such a dark expression? Do you hate me?” The little loli pouted. “Will you happier if you’re hugging my sister?”
This damn child!
Chi Menghan couldn’t help but blush. Even the white veil covering her face couldn’t conceal her breathtaking charm.
“Brother-in-law, you also know about the Hundred Flowers Valley?” the little loli asked.
What Hundred Flowers Valley?
Ling Han couldn’t help but turn to look at Chi Menghan. This little loli was quite mischievous, always saying embarrassing things. He was more willing to converse with Chi Menghan.
“There’s news that there’s a large number of Evolution Fruits in the Hundred Flowers Valley!” Chi Menghan said.
Large amount!

Ling Han couldn’t help but feel tempted. The Island of the Sky had already been open for more than a year, so it could be said that the majority of the Evolution Fruits had already been harvested. It was extremely difficult to obtain another one now.
However, there was actually a large number of Evolution Fruits in the Hundred Flowers Valley, so this would naturally attract a large number of people.
“Where did this news come from?” he asked.
With such a good thing, who would leak it out?

“I don’t know. We only decided to go and take a look after hearing the news,” Chi Menghan said. “At the beginning, we also suspected that this was a trap, but with how powerful we are, who here can do anything to us?”

True, those that entered into the Island of the Sky were all investigated, and it was impossible that anyone whose cultivation level exceeded their cultivation level would come. Thus, what did the Imperial Clan members have to fear?

In the past, the Imperial Clans had reached a mutual understanding, and handed the Island of the Sky over to the administration of the Dongfang Clan. There was naturally a reason for this, so how could they possibly lay a trap for themselves?
No wonder there was no sign of Baili Yun. He should have also gotten the news, and turned to the Hundred Flowers Valley.
—If he advanced into the fifth form, or even the sixth form in fact, wouldn’t it be even easier for him to suppress Ling Han?
Ling Han calculated in his mind. He had the Star Steps, so there was absolutely no need for him to worry about safety here.
‘Whatever, I’ll go take a look.’
“Then, let’s go together,” Ling Han said with a smile.
“Sure,” the little loli clapped her hands.

The others gritted their teeth. This was a bringer of misfortune. Guan Yuanming’s corpse was still lying there, and he was using blood to remind everyone that this was an Imperial Son Killer, a real Imperial Son Killer.
However, did they dare to chase him away?
Since Ling Han dared to kill Guan Yuanming, it was equivalent to offending Xuanfeng Imperial Clan to the extreme. Then, would he still need to fear killing a few more Imperial Clan members?
On the way, the atmosphere of the group appeared extremely oppressive. Aside from the silver-haired little lolita, no one else was in the mood to talk.

“You are too rash.” Chi Menghan sent a message through divine sense, “Even if you want to kill Guan Yuanming, you can make your move without anyone witnessing. You are indeed wanted by the Imperial Clans, but it is only a warrant. None of the Imperial Clans have become serious.”
“But now that an Imperial Son is dead, the nature is completely different.”

“Even the Saints of the Imperial Clans would be alerted. Even if you hide at the corners of the world, the Saints would still be able to easily predict your whereabouts. There would be no need for them to move personally. As long as the Imperial Clans speak, there would be plenty of forces that would move for them.”
Ling Han smiled, and asked, “Are you worried about me?”
Chi Menghan was instantly rendered speechless. Just how carefree was this guy? Things had already come to this, and he was still in the mood to tease her?

“Unless you have the Imperial Weapon, which can hide you from destiny, or you continue to hide in a Mystery Realm, once you leave, you would not be able to escape the prediction of a Saint,” Chi Menghan warned seriously again.
Ling Han smiled. He really did have an Imperial Weapon on him... it was a bit lacking, and that was why Baili Yun had found him time and time again?
If he didn’t store the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower in his mind and hid it on his body, would he be able to hide from destiny?
It should be possible. Though it was not an Imperial Weapon, it was Origin Gold, the ultimate material!
“Thank you.” He nodded at Chi Menghan.
Chi Menghan was a little unused to this. She was used to Ling Han’s cheeky grin, and now that he was suddenly serious, she actually felt a little awkward.

They headed towards the Hundred Flowers Valley. Ling Han did not make a move on the other Imperial Clans. What he hated the most were Guan Yuanming, Xu Jie, Shi Yuanzhen and Baili Che. Now, aside from Baili Che, who had already become a cripple, the other three had all been killed by him.
As they walked, Ling Han’s expression suddenly became a little strange.
That was because the location of this Hundred Flowers Valley was directly above that underground cave.
Wasn’t this too coincidental?

Ling Han remained calm and collected. He really wanted to see what was going on here. Furthermore, Baili Yun was definitely in the valley. If he missed this chance, it would be difficult to kill this person again.
Another day later, they arrived at the Hundred Flowers Valley.
Though this was called the Hundred Flowers Valley, it completely did not live up to its name. The valley was completely barren, without even a single tree, so how could there be Hundred Flowers?
They weren’t the first batch of people to enter the valley. More people had already arrived, and they were searching everywhere.

“There is indeed the fragrance of the Evolution Fruit. However, it seems to have been blocked by some kind of technique, and can’t be seen,” Chi Menghan said. “Chi Dao arrived a few days before us. He said that using his divine sense as a guide, he has indeed found an Evolution Fruit.”
“It’s said that there’s a cave in this valley, and there’s a large number of Evolution Fruits growing in this cave.”
