chapters.title: Chapter 4250: Switch in the balance of weak and strong
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
Ling Han shook his head, and said with a smile, “I’m really becoming more and more curious about the person who provided this information.”
“This person is far too omnipotent,” Chi Menghan said.
Who knew that this kind of news would still spread out? Others would definitely conceal it at all costs, and take them completely by thenselves.
Even if they didn’t need it, the Evolution Fruit was still extremely valuable. It could be sold for a huge sum of money, and even the Imperial Clans would be willing to generously pay for it.
But now, this kind of news was flying all over the place, and everyone knew about it. It was completely illogical.
“If there’s no conspiracy in this place, then even a ghost wouldn’t believe it,” Ling Han said.
“But there are so many Imperial Clan elites here, so who would dare to mess around?” Chi Menghan immediately analyzed.
This was what confused them the most. If this was really a conspiracy, then who would dare to trick and kill so many Imperial Sons and Imperial Daughters?
If a large group of Saints carrying Imperial Weapons appeared, even if their opponent was an Imperial Clan, they would still be able to flatten it.
There was no Emperor in this world, so who would dare to be so outrageously bold?
Thus, even though many smart people knew that something was off, they still came, because they really could not think of any force in this world that would dare target the Imperial Clans.

“Could it be the Battle God Palace?” Ling Han thought, but this thought passed in the blink of an eye. The Battle God Palace being unafraid of the Imperial Clans was only empty words. It was only that the Imperial Clans were unwilling to spend a lot of effort to deal with them.

Flipping through history, in truth, the number of times that the Battle God Palace had targeted the Imperial Clans could be counted on one’s fingers. It was merely for the sake of establishing their might. Furthermore, there had never been any attempted assassination of Imperial Son or Imperial Daughter. The Battle God Palace still had some propriety.

Moreover, how did the Battle God Palace know that there was a Hundred Flowers Valley here? Moreover, even if a large number of True Self Tier assassins from the Battle God Palace entered, would they be a match for the Imperial Sons?
There was the Silver Generation here, and even Ling Han had to admit that they were powerful.
Thus, the Battle God Palace most likely had nothing to do with this matter.
“We can only wait and see. If this is really a conspiracy, then it should be about time for the truth to come out,” Ling Han murmured.
He did not waste any time, but rather began to search for Baili Yun.
The Hundred Flowers Valley was very big, but no matter how big it was, there was a limit. As long as one was here, they would definitely be found in two to three days, at most.
As expected, on the second day, Ling Han found this Imperial Son of the Silver Generation.
When he saw Ling Han, Baili Yun was also startled.
However, he immediately smirked coldly. In his opinion, Ling Han should have also rushed over after receiving news of the Hundred Flowers Valley, and then coincidentally met him.

“Haha, there’s a path to heaven, yet you refuse to take it. There’s no door to hell, yet you barge in,” Baili Yun said with a smile. He was in a good mood now, because he had “harvested” three Evolution Fruits in this space. Now, he had encountered Ling Han, who had taken the initiative to deliver treasures to him.

The reason why there were quotation marks was because he had only managed to obtain one, and the other two had been obtained through threats and bribery. With his identity as a member of the Silver Generation, who would dare not give him face?

Unfortunately, three Evolution Fruits weren’t enough to support him to reach the fifth form. Thus, he didn’t ingest them immediately. Instead, he had to wait to obtain two more. If there were five, he was confident that he could reach the fifth form in one go.

Of course, even if he didn’t have the Evolution Fruit, with his Imperial Son aptitude, it wouldn’t be too difficult for him to reach the fifth form. However, that would need a large amount of time to accumulate energy, so it was naturally not as profitable as using the Evolution Fruit.
As he spoke, he had already used Regulations to seal off the surroundings, ensuring that Ling Han would not be able to stimulate even the ley lines.
He was strong enough, so he could naturally do it. Previously, it was just that Ling Han had not given him enough time.
However, what he didn’t know was that the current Ling Han wasn’t the Ling Han from before.
Ling Han looked at him silently. That expression... was as if he was looking at an idiot.

“Humph, I really don’t know where you got the courage to actually take the initiative to die!” Baili Yun said calmly. He had already completed his arrangements, and now he was only one step away from harvesting his prize.
Ling Han smiled faintly, and said, “Please continue. I’ll quietly watch your performance.”
“Die!”

As the Imperial Son, Baili Yun was naturally a resolute and decisive person. Any grand words could be left until after he had won. Now, he was going to kill Ling Han. If Ling Han managed to escape again, then whatever he said now would become a joke.
He merely raised his hand, and the Regulations transformed into a sword that slashed towards Ling Han.

Ling Han stretched out a hand and pressed down. Weng, the momentum of this sword immediately stopped. Then, Ling Han’s right hand gripped empty air. Peng, the sword of Regulations immediately shattered.
“En?” Baili Yun showed a hint of surprise. He cast another look at Ling Han, and couldn’t help but reveal a shocked expression, “You have broken through!”
This guy had actually advanced into the third form of the True Self Tier!
How was this possible?

He was sure that Ling Han had only created two Stone Fetuses before, at most, and with Ling Han’s freakishness, he was sure that there were at least eight True Selves. It had only been a year, and this guy had actually advanced into the Third Form?
How many Evolution Fruits have you f obtained!

“Do you really think I’m stupid?” Ling Han said with a smile. He leaped out, throwing out both fists. Weng, weng, weng! Instantly, multiple heavenly sabers slashed out, flickering with the terrifying light of Regulations, blasting towards Baili Yun.
Hong! Hong! Hong!
Ling Han took the initiative to attack. His battle prowess was terrifying.

Baili Yun exchanged a few blows, and discovered that Ling Han’s strength was completely not inferior to his. He couldn’t help but feel depressed. If he had known earlier, he would have used his ultimate move back then, not giving Ling Han any time to grow.
But now?
The other’s battle prowess was actually not inferior to his.
No!

Baili Yun shockingly discovered that Ling Han’s battle prowess was even superior to his. Though there was only a gap of one Heaven at most, in a clash of their level, to say nothing of the gap in battle prowess of one Heaven, even a sliver of difference was enough to influence the outcome of the battle.
He paled in shock, because he knew that Ling Han possessed the means to bypass the Substitution Seal and kill someone. He really only had one life.
“What a miscalculation. I allowed you to grow to this extent, but I will definitely not make another mistake!” Baili Yun humphed. Boom, he suddenly ignited the Imperial Bloodline.
How strong would the Silver Generation’s Imperial Blood be if it was ignited?
Boom!
Ling Han exchanged a blow with him, and his figure was instantly sent flying. However, he was completely unharmed.
Baili Yun’s battle prowess was only 45 Heavens, so his improvement was limited.
Why?

It was very understandable. That was because Baili Yun was actually not too far off from the battle prowess of the Great Emperor when he was young. Thus, burning the Imperial Blood would only allow him to be close to the standard of the young Great Emperor, and could not possibly surpass him.
Thus, his maximum battle prowess was 45 Heavens.
From this aspect, it would be useless even if the Golden Generation burned the Imperial Blood, because their aptitude was already infinitesimally close to the Great Emperors in their youth.
Ling Han’s battle prowess had reached 42 Heavens, and he could also disperse attacks within six Heavens. Thus, Baili Yun could only blast him backwards, but could not possibly wound him at all.
“Once the Imperial Bloodline is done burning, it will be the time of your death!” Ling Han said calmly.
“Aren’t you a little too proud? How many Silver Generation elites are there here? I only need to find one of them to join forces, and killing you would be a piece of cake.” Baili Yun was unafraid.
Ling Han smiled, “Don’t forget. You sealed off this place yourself. Under my attacks, would you have the chance to disperse the seal of Regulations?”
